name: Abnormality of body height
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deviation from the norm of height with respect to that which is expected according to age and gender norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Multicystic kidney dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multicystic dysplasia of the kidney is characterized by multiple cysts of varying size in the kidney and the absence of a normal pelvicaliceal system. The condition is associated with ureteral or ureteropelvic atresia, and the affected kidney is nonfunctional.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mode of inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The pattern in which a particular genetic trait or disorder is passed from one generation to the next.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Autosomal dominant inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that is observed for traits related to a gene encoded on one of the autosomes (i.e., the human chromosomes 1-22) in which a trait manifests in heterozygotes. In the context of medical genetics, an autosomal dominant disorder is caused when a single copy of the mutant allele is present. Males and females are affected equally, and can both transmit the disorder with a risk of 50% for each child of inheriting the mutant allele.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Autosomal recessive inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that is observed for traits related to a gene encoded on one of the autosomes (i.e., the human chromosomes 1-22) in which a trait manifests in individuals with two pathogenic alleles, either homozygotes (two copies of the same mutant allele) or compound heterozygotes (whereby each copy of a gene has a distinct mutant allele).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal morphology of female internal genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the female internal genitalia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Neurogenic bladder
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of bladder dysfunction caused by neurologic damage. Neurogenic bladder can be flaccid or spastic. Common manifestatios of neurogenic bladder are overflow incontinence, frequency, urgency, urge incontinence, and retention.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18095004, PMID:22400020]"}

name: Urinary urgency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Urge incontinence is the strong, sudden need to urinate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12559262]"}

name: Bladder diverticulum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Diverticulum (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urinary bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urinary retention
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to completely empty the urinary bladder during the process of urination.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nocturia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased production of urine during the night leading to an unusually frequent need to urinate.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Urinary hesitancy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty in beginning the process of urination.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urinary incontinence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of the ability to control the urinary bladder leading to involuntary urination.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:12559262]"}

name: Abnormal male internal genitalia morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the male internal genitalia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Inguinal hernia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Protrusion of the contents of the abdominal cavity through the inguinal canal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Prostatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inflammation of the prostate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Functional abnormality of male internal genitalia
Male hypogonadism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased functionality of the male gonad, i.e., of the testis, with reduced spermatogenesis or testosterone synthesis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Azoospermia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of any measurable level of sperm,whereby spermatozoa cannot be observed even after centrifugation of the semen pellet.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20514278]"}

name: Cryptorchidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Testis in inguinal canal. That is, absence of one or both testes from the scrotum owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202]"}

name: Testicular atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Wasting (atrophy) of the testicle (the male gonad) manifested by a decrease in size and potentially by a loss of fertility.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Testicular gonadoblastoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a gonadoblastoma of the testis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Epididymitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inflammation of the epididymis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal male external genitalia morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of male external genitalia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ambiguous genitalia, male
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ambiguous genitalia in an individual with XY genetic gender.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hydrocele testis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of clear fluid in the between the layers of membrane (tunica vaginalis) surrounding the testis.\" [PMID:32644551]"}

name: Abnormal testis morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the testicle (the male gonad).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal penis morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the male external sex organ.\" []"}

name: Male pseudohermaphroditism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hermaphroditism refers to a discrepancy between the morphology of the gonads and that of the external genitalia. In male pseudohermaphroditism, the genotype is male (XY) and the external genitalia are imcompletely virilized, ambiguous, or complete female. If gonads are present, they are testes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Epispadias
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Epispadias is a urogenital malformation characterized by the failure of the urethral tube to tubularize on the dorsal aspect. Unlike in hypospadias, where the meatus is on the ventral aspect, children with epispadias have a wide-open urethral plate on the dorsum. It is commonly seen as a component in the spectrum of bladder exstrophy-epispadias-complex. Isolated epispadias constitutes less than 10 percent of the total cases of epispadias.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202, PMID:33085327]"}

name: Long penis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Penile length more than 2 SD above the mean for age.\" []"}

name: Chordee
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly of the penis characterized by ventral (i.e., downward), lateral, or ventrolateral curvature of the shaft and glans penis of more than 30 degrees.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202, PMID:29570261]"}

name: Absent external genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of external genitalia in a male or female individual.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism is characterized by reduced function of the gonads (testes in males or ovaries in females) and results from the absence of the gonadal stimulating pituitary hormones: follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23503957]"}

name: Abnormal scrotum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the scrotum, i.e., the sac that contains the testes, epididymis, and the lower part of the spermatic cord.\" []"}

name: Hypospadias
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal position of urethral meatus on the ventral penile shaft (underside) characterized by displacement of the urethral meatus from the tip of the glans penis to the ventral surface of the penis, scrotum, or perineum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21968448]"}

name: Bifid scrotum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Midline indentation or cleft of the scrotum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202]"}

name: Shawl scrotum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Superior margin of the scrotum superior to the base of the penis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202]"}

name: Hypoplastic male external genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of part or all of the male external reproductive organs (which include the penis, the scrotum and the urethra).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Perineal hypospadias
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypospadias with location of the urethral meatus in the perineal region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8097257]"}

name: Urethral atresia, male
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital anomaly characterized by closure or failure to develop an opening in the urethra in males.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Micropenis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally small penis. At birth, the normal penis is about 3 cm (stretched length from pubic tubercle to tip of penis) with micropenis less than 2.0-2.5 cm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15102623]"}

name: Abnormal female external genitalia morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the female external genitalia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal labia morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the labia, the externally visible portions of the vulva.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ambiguous genitalia, female
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ambiguous genitalia in an individual with XX genetic gender.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ambiguous genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A genital phenotype that is not clearly assignable to a single gender. Ambiguous genitalia can be evaluated using the Prader scale: Prader 0: Normal female external genitalia. Prader 1: Female external genitalia with clitoromegaly. Prader 2: Clitoromegaly with partial labial fusion forming a funnel-shaped urogenital sinus. Prader 3: Increased phallic enlargement. Complete labioscrotal fusion forming a urogenital sinus with a single opening. Prader 4: Complete scrotal fusion with urogenital opening at the base or on the shaft of the phallus. Prader 5: Normal male external genitalia. The diagnosis of ambiguous genitalia is made for Prader 1-4.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15102623]"}

name: Fused labia minora
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fusion of the labia minora as a result of labial adhesions resulting in vaginal obstruction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urethral atresia, female
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital anomaly characterized by closure or failure to develop an opening in the urethra in females.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urethral atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital anomaly characterized by closure or failure to develop an opening in the urethra.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the ureter
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the ureter. The ureter is the duct by which urine passes from the kidney to the bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ureterocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A ureterocele is a congenital saccular dilatation of the distal segment of the ureter.\" [eMedicine:453993]"}

name: Ureteral stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a stenotic, i.e., constricted ureter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hydroureter
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The distention of the ureter with urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:33085364]"}

name: Ureteral duplication
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly characterized by the presence of two, instead of one, ureter connecting a kidney to the bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ureteropelvic junction obstruction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blockage of urine flow from the renal pelvis to the proximal ureter.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_ewuehl]"}

name: Renal duplication
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly of the urinary tract, in which the kidney is duplicated and is drained via two separate renal pelves and ureters.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vesicoureteral reflux
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal (retrograde) movement of urine from the bladder into ureters or kidneys related to inadequacy of the valvular mechanism at the ureterovesicular junction or other causes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of reproductive system physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal functionality of the genital system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Duplicated collecting system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A duplication of the collecting system of the kidney, defined as a kidney with two (instead of, normally, one) pyelocaliceal systems. The pyelocaliceal system is comprised of the renal pelvis and calices. The duplicated renal collecting system can be associated with a single ureter or with double ureters. In the latter case, the two ureters empty separately into the bladder or fuse to form a single ureteral orifice.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal insufficiency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the level of performance of the kidneys in areas of function comprising the concentration of urine, removal of wastes, the maintenance of electrolyte balance, homeostasis of blood pressure, and calcium metabolism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Horseshoe kidney
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A connection of the right and left kidney by an isthmus of functioning renal parenchyma or fibrous tissue that crosses the midline.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopic kidney
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect in which a kidney is located in an abnormal anatomic position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nephronophthisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of cysts at the corticomedullary junction of the kidney in combination with tubulointerstitial fibrosis.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Renal tubular atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of renal tubules with thick redundant basement membranes, or a reduction of greater than 50% in tubular diameter compared to surrounding non-atrophic tubules.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27211375]"}

name: Proteinuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased levels of protein in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal renal glomerulus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the glomerulus.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_ewuehl, PMID:18184729]"}

name: Glomerular sclerosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of scar tissue within the glomerulus.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Segmental accumulation of scar tissue in individual (but not all) glomeruli.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer, PMID:16164633]"}

name: Tall stature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A height above that which is expected according to age and gender norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nephrotic syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nephrotic syndrome is a collection of findings resulting from glomerular dysfunction with an increase in glomerular capillary wall permeability associated with pronounced proteinuria. Nephrotic syndrome refers to the constellation of clinical findings that result from severe renal loss of protein, with Proteinuria and hypoalbuminemia, edema, and hyperlipidemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal agenesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Agenesis, that is, failure of the kidney to develop during embryogenesis and development.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enlarged kidney
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal increase in the size of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fluid filled sac in the kidney.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Renal corticomedullary cysts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple cysts at the border between the renal cortex and medulla.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of developmental dysplasia of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal juxtaglomerular cell hypertrophy/hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased number and size of the juxtaglomerular cells.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_ewuehl]"}

name: Nephropathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nonspecific term referring to disease or damage of the kidneys.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Polycystic kidney dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple cysts in both kidneys.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Proximal tubulopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dysfunction of the proximal tubule, which is the portion of the duct system of the nephron of the kidney which leads from Bowman's capsule to the loop of Henle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal phosphate wasting
extra_json: {"definition": "\"High urine phosphate in the presence of hypophosphatemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the genitourinary system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of any abnormality of the genitourinary system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nephrocalcinosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nephrocalcinosis is the deposition of calcium salts in renal parenchyma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral renal agenesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A unilateral form of agenesis of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nephritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inflammation affecting the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal tubular dysfunction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal function of the renal tubule. The basic functional unit of the kidney, the nephron, consists of a renal corpuscle attached to a renal tubule, with roughly 0.8 to 1.5 nephrons per adult kidney. The functions of the renal tubule include reabsorption of water, electrolytes, glucose, and amino acids and secretion of substances such as uric acid.\" []"}

name: Pelvic kidney
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect in which a kidney is located in an abnormal anatomic position within the pelvis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hydronephrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severe distention of the kidney with dilation of the renal pelvis and calices.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal salt wasting
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A high concentration of one or more electrolytes in the urine in the presence of low serum concentrations of the electrolyte(s).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Renal potassium wasting
extra_json: {"definition": "\"High urine potassium in the presence of hypokalemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Uterine leiomyoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a leiomyoma of the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Menorrhagia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Prolonged and excessive menses at regular intervals in excess of 80 mL or lasting longer than 7 days.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22594864]"}

name: Gonadal dysgenesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Gonadal dysgenesis is the name given to any of a multitude of conditions that can cause impaired development of the gonads, i.e., the testes or ovaries, or to the related phenotypic features. The term is to be avoided if possible for new annotations, and more specific terms should be chosen.\" [PMID:30969708]"}

name: Female hypogonadism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased functionality of the female gonads, i.e., of the ovary.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ovarian cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of one or more cysts of the ovary.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Uterine prolapse
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of prolapse of the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the menstrual cycle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the ovulation cycle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23281358]"}

name: Amenorrhea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of menses for an interval of time equivalent to a total of more than (or equal to) 3 previous cycles or 6 months.\" [PMID:22594864]"}

name: Rectovaginal fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a fistula between the vagina and the rectum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vaginal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital occlusion of the vagina or adhesion of the walls of the vagina causing occlusion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ovarian gonadoblastoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a gonadoblastoma of the ovary.\" [eMedicine:986581, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gonadoblastoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a gonadoblastoma, a neoplasm of a gonad that consists of aggregates of germ cells and sex cord elements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia of the uterus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital defect characterized by absence of the uterus. Aplasia refers to the failure of an organ to develop during embryonic growth and development due to the absence of primordial tissue.\" []"}

name: Wide mouth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between the oral commissures more than 2 SD above the mean. Alternatively, an apparently increased width of the oral aperture (subjective).\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Oral ulcer
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Erosion of the mucous mebrane of the mouth with local excavation of the surface, resulting from the sloughing of inflammatory necrotic tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macroglossia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased length and width of the tongue.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Narrow mouth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between the commissures of the mouth more than 2 SD below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased width of the oral aperture (subjective).\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Median cleft upper lip
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cleft lip presenting as a midline (median) gap in the upper lip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Glossoptosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Posterior displacement of the tongue into the pharynx, i.e., a tongue that is mislocalised posteriorly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125428]"}

name: Abnormal oral cavity morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the oral cavity, i.e., the opening or hollow part of the mouth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Severe periodontitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to periodontitis, as manifested by severe periodontal infection with rapid alveolar bone loss, tooth mobility, and premature tooth exfoliation.\" [PMID:39274292, PMID:39412215]"}

name: Abnormal gingiva morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the gingiva (also known as gums).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gingival fibromatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of fibrosis of the gingiva.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Microglossia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased length and width of the tongue.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Abnormal uvula morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the uvula, the conic projection from the posterior edge of the middle of the soft palate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal palate morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the palate, i.e., of roof of the mouth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cleft palate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cleft palate is a developmental defect of the palate resulting from a failure of fusion of the palatine processes and manifesting as a separation of the roof of the mouth (soft and hard palate).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Submucous cleft hard palate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hard-palate submucous clefts are characterized by bony defects in the midline of the bony palate that are covered by the mucous membrane of the roof of the mouth. It may be possible to detect a submucous cleft hard palate upon palpation as a notch in the bony palate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19779505]"}

name: Thick lower lip vermilion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased thickness of the lower lip, leading to a prominent appearance of the lower lip. The height of the vermilion of the lower lip in the midline is more than 2 SD above the mean. Alternatively, an apparently increased height of the vermilion of the lower lip in the frontal view (subjective).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125428]"}

name: Lobulated tongue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple indentations and/or elevations on the edge and/or surface of the tongue producing an irregular surface contour.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Tongue muscle weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced strength of the tongue musculature, resulting in difficulties moving the tongue and possible accompanied by dysarthria or dysphagia.\" []"}

name: Cleft soft palate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cleft of the soft palate (also known as the velum, or muscular palate) as a result of a developmental defect occurring between the 7th and 12th week of pregnancy. Cleft soft palate can cause functional abnormalities of the Eustachian tube with resulting middle ear anomalies and hearing difficulties, as well as speech problems associated with hypernasal speech due to velopharyngeal insufficiency.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Narrow palate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Width of the palate more than 2 SD below the mean (objective) or apparently decreased palatal width (subjective).\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Abnormal oral frenulum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the lingual frenulum, that is of the small fold of mucous membrane that attaches the tongue to the floor of the mouth, or the presence of accessory frenula in the oral cavity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23633765]"}

name: Accessory oral frenulum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Extra fold of tissue extending from the alveolar ridge to the inner surface of the upper or lower lip.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Bifid uvula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Uvula separated into two parts most easily seen at the tip.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Open mouth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A facial appearance characterized by a permanently or nearly permanently opened mouth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lower lip pit
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Depression located on the vermilion of the lower lip, usually paramedian.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:19125428]"}

name: Abnormal parotid gland morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the parotid glands, which are the salivary glands that are located in the subcutaneous tissues of the face overlying the mandibular ramus and anterior and inferior to the external ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Short lingual frenulum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormally short lingual frenulum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pierre-Robin sequence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pierre Robin malformation is a sequence of developmental malformations characterized by micrognathia (mandibular hypoplasia), glossoptosis and cleft palate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Orofacial cleft
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a cleft (gap, opening, or groove) in the oral cavity, including cleft of the upper lip and/or cleft of the palate. Cleft of the upper lip is visible as a groove or fissure in the lip, most frequently due to a congenital failure of the maxillary and median nasal processes to fuse. Cleft palate is characterized by a grooved depression or fissure in the roof of the mouth, most often resulting from a congenital failure of the palate to fuse properly. Clefts of the lip and palate can occur individually or together. It is preferable to code each defect separately.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4142-7153, https://www.cdc.gov/ncbddd/birthdefects/surveillancemanual/chapters/chapter-4/chapter4-6.html, PMID:21331089]"}

name: Cleft upper lip
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A gap or groove in the upper lip. This is a congenital defect resulting from nonfusion of tissues of the lip during embryonal development.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pursed lips
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the appearance of the face caused by constant contraction of the lips leading to a puckered or pursed appearance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Triangular mouth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a triangular form of the mouth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Trismus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limitation in the ability to open the mouth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gingival overgrowth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperplasia of the gingiva (that is, a thickening of the soft tissue overlying the alveolar ridge. The degree of thickening ranges from involvement of the interdental papillae alone to gingival overgrowth covering the entire tooth crown.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Lip telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Telangiectasia (that is, the presence of small dilated superficial blood vessels) of the lips.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thick upper lip vermilion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Height of the vermilion of the upper lip in the midline more than 2 SD above the mean. Alternatively, an apparently increased height of the vermilion of the upper lip in the frontal view (subjective).\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Xerostomia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dryness of the mouth due to salivary gland dysfunction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: High palate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Height of the palate more than 2 SD above the mean (objective) or palatal height at the level of the first permanent molar more than twice the height of the teeth (subjective).\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Thin upper lip vermilion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Height of the vermilion of the upper lip in the midline more than 2 SD below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently reduced height of the vermilion of the upper lip in the frontal view (subjective).\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Velopharyngeal insufficiency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability of velopharyngeal sphincter to sufficiently separate the nasal cavity from the oral cavity during speech.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_jhurst]"}

name: Furrowed tongue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accentuation of the grooves on the dorsal surface of the tongue.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Tongue telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Telangiectasia (that is, the presence of small dilated superficial blood vessels) of the tongue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oral cavity telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of telangiectases in the oral cavity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Everted lower lip vermilion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal configuration of the lower lip such that it is turned outward i.e., everted, with the Inner aspect of the lower lip vermilion (normally opposing the teeth) being visible in a frontal view.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Thin vermilion border
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Height of the vermilion of the medial part of the lip more than 2 SD below the mean, or apparently reduced height of the vermilion of the lip in the frontal view. The vermilion is the red part of the lips (and confusingly, the vermilion itself is also often referred to as being equivalent the lips).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125428]"}

name: Abnormal cranial suture/fontanelle morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the fontanelles (the regions covered by a thick membrane that normally ossify in the first two years of life) or the cranial sutures (the fibrous joints in which the articulating bones or cartilages of the skull are connected by sutural ligaments).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12825844, PMID:31194354]"}

name: Abnormal anterior fontanelle morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the anterior fontanelle, i.e., the cranial fontanelle that is located at the intersection of the coronal and sagittal sutures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Small anterior fontanelle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally decreased size of the anterior fontanelle with respect to age-dependent norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hydrocephalus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hydrocephalus is an active distension of the ventricular system of the brain resulting from inadequate passage of CSF from its point of production within the cerebral ventricles to its point of absorption into the systemic circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18211712, PMID:19410151]"}

name: Large fontanelles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In newborns, the two frontal bones, two parietal bones, and one occipital bone are joined by fibrous sutures, which form a small posterior fontanelle, and a larger, diamond-shaped anterior fontanelle. These regions allow for the skull to pass the birth canal and for later growth. The fontanelles gradually ossify, whereby the posterior fontanelle usually closes by eight weeks and the anterior fontanelle by the 9th to 16th month of age. Large fontanelles are diagnosed if the fontanelles are larger than age-dependent norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of skull size
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the size of the skull.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Parietal bossing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Parietal bossing is a marked prominence in the parietal region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Trigonocephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Wedge-shaped, or triangular head, with the apex of the triangle at the midline of the forehead and the base of the triangle at the occiput.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Brachyturricephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal vertical height of the skull and a shortening of its anterior-posterior length, frequently combined with malformations of the occipital region.\" [PMID:8460563]"}

name: Abnormal paranasal sinus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the paranasal (cranial) sinuses, which are air-filled spaces that are located within the bones of the skull and face and communicate with the nasal cavity. They comprise the maxillary sinuses, the frontal sinuses, the ethmoid sinuses, and the sphenoid sinuses.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sinusitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the paranasal sinuses owing to a viral, bacterial, or fungal infection, allergy, or an autoimmune reaction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Brachycephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of skull shape characterized by a decreased anterior-posterior diameter. That is, a cephalic index greater than 81%. Alternatively, an apparently shortened anteroposterior dimension (length) of the head compared to width.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Dense calvaria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal increase of density of the bones making up the calvaria.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Microcephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender.\" [PMID:15806441, PMID:19125436, PMID:25465325, PMID:9683597]"}

name: Progressive microcephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Progressive microcephaly is diagnosed when the head circumference falls progressively behind age- and gender-dependent norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macrocephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Occipitofrontal (head) circumference greater than 97th centile compared to appropriate, age matched, sex-matched normal standards. Alternatively, a apparently increased size of the cranium.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Wide anterior fontanel
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of the anterior fontanelle with respect to age-dependent norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Turricephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tall head relative to width and length.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Oxycephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Oxycephaly (from Greek oxus, sharp, and kephalos, head) refers to a conical or pointed shape of the skull.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal mastoid morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the mastoid process, which is the conical prominence projecting from the undersurface of the mastoid portion of the temporal bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mastoiditis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infection of the mastoid air cells, arising as a complication of otitis media or occurring in the context of unusual susceptibility to infection.\" []"}

name: Cranial asymmetry
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Asymmetry of the bones of the skull.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dolichocephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of skull shape characterized by a increased anterior-posterior diameter, i.e., an increased antero-posterior dimension of the skull. Cephalic index less than 76%. Alternatively, an apparently increased antero-posterior length of the head compared to width. Often due to premature closure of the sagittal suture.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Prominent occiput
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased convexity of the occiput (posterior part of the skull).\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Delayed cranial suture closure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infants normally have two fontanels at birth, the diamond-shaped anterior fontanelle at the junction of the coronal and sagittal sutures, and the posterior fontanelle at the intersection of the occipital and parietal bones. The posterior fontanelle usually closes by the 8th week of life, and the anterior fontanel closes by the 18th month of life on average. This term applies if there is delay of closure of the fontanelles beyond the normal age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Malar flattening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the malar prominence of the jugal bone (zygomatic bone in mammals), appreciated in profile, frontal view, and/or by palpation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5889-4463, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Small face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A face that is short and narrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Narrow face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bizygomatic (upper face) and bigonial (lower face) width are both more than 2 standard deviations below the mean (objective); or, an apparent reduction in the width of the upper and lower face (subjective).\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Long face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Facial height (length) is more than 2 standard deviations above the mean (objective); or, an apparent increase in the height (length) of the face (subjective).\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Abnormal mandible morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the mandible, the bone of the lower jaw.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retrognathia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in which the mandible is mislocalised posteriorly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Coarse facial features
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of fine and sharp appearance of brows, nose, lips, mouth, and chin, usually because of rounded and heavy features or thickened skin with or without thickening of subcutaneous and bony tissues.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Broad face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bizygomatic (upper face) and bigonial (lower face) width greater than 2 standard deviations above the mean (objective); or an apparent increase in the width of the face (subjective).\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Epicanthus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fold of skin starting above the medial aspect of the upper eyelid and arching downward to cover, pass in front of and lateral to the medial canthus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased facial adipose tissue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased amount of subcutaneous fat tissue in the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Broad philtrum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between the philtral ridges, measured just above the vermilion border, more than 2 standard deviations above the mean, or alternatively, an apparently increased distance between the ridges of the philtrum.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Loss of facial adipose tissue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of normal subcutaneous fat tissue in the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Full cheeks
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased prominence or roundness of soft tissues between zygomata and mandible.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2972-5481]"}

name: Low anterior hairline
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between the hairline (trichion) and the glabella (the most prominent point on the frontal bone above the root of the nose), in the midline, more than two SD below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased distance between the hairline and the glabella.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Doll-like facies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A characteristic facial appearance with a round facial form, full cheeks, a short nose, and a relatively small chin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Facial hypotonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced muscle tone of a muscle that is innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mask-like facies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lack of facial expression often with staring eyes and a slightly open mouth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oval face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A face with a rounded and slightly elongated outline.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of facial musculature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of a muscle that is innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mandibular prognathia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal prominence of the chin related to increased length of the mandible.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the chin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the chin, i.e., of the inferior portion of the face lying inferior to the lower lip and including the central prominence of the lower jaw.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Pointed chin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A marked tapering of the lower face to the chin.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Microretrognathia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of developmental hypoplasia of the mandible in which the mandible is mislocalised posteriorly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal midface morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the midface, which is a region and not an anatomical term. It extends, superiorly, from the inferior orbital margin to, inferiorly, the level of nasal base. It is formed by the maxilla (upper jaw) and zygoma and cheeks and malar region. Traditionally, the nose and premaxilla are not included in the midface.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Round face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The facial appearance is more circular than usual as viewed from the front.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Hypertelorism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Interpupillary distance more than 2 SD above the mean (alternatively, the appearance of an increased interpupillary distance or widely spaced eyes).\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Facial myokymia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Facial myokymia is a fine fibrillary activity of one or more muscles innervated by the facial nerve (the seventh cranial nerve).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Smooth philtrum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Flat skin surface, with no ridge formation in the central region of the upper lip between the nasal base and upper vermilion border.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Square face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Facial contours, as viewed from the front, show a broad upper face/cranium and lower face/mandible, creating a square appearance.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Short philtrum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between nasal base and midline upper lip vermilion border more than 2 SD below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased distance between nasal base and midline upper lip vermilion border.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Facial asymmetry
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal difference between the left and right sides of the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Triangular face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Facial contour, as viewed from the front, triangular in shape, with breadth at the temples and tapering to a narrow chin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9602-2321, PMID:19125436, PMID:21166787, PMID:30515601]"}

name: Abnormal maxilla morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the Maxilla (upper jaw bone).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplasia of the maxilla
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally small dimension of the Maxilla. Usually creating a malocclusion or malalignment between the upper and lower teeth or resulting in a deficient amount of projection of the base of the nose and lower midface region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Facial hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, occurring in the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Short chin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased vertical distance from the vermilion border of the lower lip to the inferior-most point of the chin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Prominent supraorbital ridges
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Greater than average forward and/or lateral protrusion of the supraorbital portion of the frontal bones.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Broad forehead
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Width of the forehead or distance between the frontotemporales is more than two standard deviations above the mean (objective); or apparently increased distance between the two sides of the forehead.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Hypomimic face
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced degree of motion of the muscles beneath the skin of the face, often associated with reduced facial crease formation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pugilistic facies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Coarse facial features reminiscent of those of a boxer.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sloping forehead
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inclination of the anterior surface of the forehead from the vertical more than two standard deviations above the mean (objective); or apparently excessive posterior sloping of the forehead in a lateral view.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Narrow forehead
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Width of the forehead or distance between the frontotemporales is more than two standard deviations below the mean (objective); or apparently narrow intertemporal region (subjective).\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Long philtrum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between nasal base and midline upper lip vermilion border more than 2 SD above the mean. Alternatively, an apparently increased distance between nasal base and midline upper lip vermilion border.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Whistling appearance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of facial morphology characterized by a small mouth opening and constant contraction of the lips as if the patient were whistling.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:856233]"}

name: High forehead
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased height of the forehead.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Widow's peak
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Frontal hairline with bilateral arcs to a low point in the midline of the forehead.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Small forehead
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a forehead that is abnormally small.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Posteriorly rotated ears
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of abnormal location of the ears in which the position of the ears is characterized by posterior rotation (the superior part of the ears is rotated towards the back of the head, and the inferior part of the ears towards the front).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152421]"}

name: Tinnitus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tinnitus is an auditory perception that can be described as the experience of sound, in the ear or in the head, in the absence of external acoustic stimulation.\" []"}

name: Otosclerosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In otosclerosis, a callus of bone accumulates on the stapes creating a partial fixation. This limits the movement of the stapes bone, which results in hearing loss.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15931303]"}

name: Abnormal earlobe morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the lobule of pinna.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hearing abnormality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the sensory perception of sound.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decreased magnitude of the sensory perception of sound.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Low-set ears
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Upper insertion of the ear to the scalp below an imaginary horizontal line drawn between the inner canthi of the eye and extending posteriorly to the ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152421]"}

name: Acute otitis media
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acute otitis media is a short and generally painful infection of the middle ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal auditory canal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the external acoustic tube (also known as the auditory canal).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Incomplete partition of the cochlea type II
extra_json: {"definition": "\"With incomplete partition II, the cochlea consists of 1.5 turns; the apical and middle cochlea turns are undifferentiated and form a cystic apex. The vestibule is normal while the vestibular aqueduct is always enlarged. Developmental arrest occurs at the seventh week of gestation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21849370, PMID:34698066]"}

name: Abnormal pinna morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the pinna, which is also referred to as the auricle or external ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cupped ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Laterally protruding ear that lacks antihelical folding (including absence of inferior and superior crura).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19162421, PMID:22073081]"}

name: Stapes ankylosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stapes ankylosis refers to congenital or acquired fixation of the stapes (the stirrup-shaped small bone or ossicle in the middle ear), which is associated with conductive hearing resulting from impairment of the sound-conduction mechanism (the external auditory canal, tympanic membrane, and/or middle-ear ossicles).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12089654]"}

name: Preauricular skin tag
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A rudimentary tag of skin often containing ear tissue including a core of cartilage and located just anterior to the auricle (outer part of the ear).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent earlobe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of fleshy non-cartilaginous tissue inferior to the tragus and incisura.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152421]"}

name: Otitis media
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation or infection of the middle ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chronic otitis media
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Chronic otitis media refers to fluid, swelling, or infection of the middle ear that does not heal and may cause permanent damage to the ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thickened helices
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased thickness of the helix of the ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lop ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anterior and inferior folding of the upper portion of the ear that obliterates triangular fossa and scapha.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152421]"}

name: Prominent antihelix
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormally prominent antihelix.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Overfolded helix
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which the helix is folded over to a greater degree than normal. That is, excessive curling of the helix edge, whereby the free edge is parallel to the plane of the ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152421]"}

name: Prelingual sensorineural hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of sensorineural deafness with either congenital onset or infantile onset, i.e., before the acquisition of speech.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macrotia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Median longitudinal ear length greater than two standard deviations above the mean and median ear width greater than two standard deviations above the mean (objective); or, apparent increase in length and width of the pinna (subjective).\" [PMID:19152421]"}

name: Stenosis of the external auditory canal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal narrowing of the external auditory canal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent otitis media
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to otitis media, as manifested by recurrent episodes of otitis media.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Conductive hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of vibrational conductance of sound to the inner ear leading to impairment of sensory perception of sound.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sensorineural hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hearing impairment in one or both ears related to an abnormal functionality of the cochlear nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Progressive sensorineural hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A progressive form of sensorineural hearing impairment.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mixed hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hearing loss resulting from a combination of conductive hearing impairment and sensorineural hearing impairment.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Protruding ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Angle formed by the plane of the ear and the mastoid bone greater than the 97th centile for age (objective); or, outer edge of the helix more than 2 cm from the mastoid at the point of maximum distance (objective).\" [PMID:19152421]"}

name: Atresia of the external auditory canal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or failure to form of the external auditory canal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bulbous nose
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased volume and globular shape of the anteroinferior aspect of the nose.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Abnormal choanae morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the choanae (the posterior nasal apertures).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Short nasal septum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced superior to inferior length of the nasal septum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Epistaxis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Epistaxis, or nosebleed, refers to a hemorrhage localized in the nose.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal nasal bridge morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the nasal bridge, which is the saddle-shaped area that includes the nasal root and the lateral aspects of the nose. It lies between the glabella and the inferior boundary of the nasal bone, and extends laterally to the inner canthi.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Prominent nasal bridge
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anterior positioning of the nasal root in comparison to the usual positioning for age.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Abnormal morphology of the nasal alae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the Ala of nose.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Underdeveloped nasal alae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thinned, deficient, or excessively arched ala nasi.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Wide nasal bridge
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased breadth of the nasal bridge (and with it, the nasal root).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Abnormal nasal tip morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the nasal tip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Depressed nasal tip
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased distance from the nasal tip to the nasal base.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Convex nasal ridge
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nasal ridge curving anteriorly to an imaginary line that connects the nasal root and tip. The nose appears often also prominent, and the columella low.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Wide nose
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Interalar distance more than two standard deviations above the mean for age, i.e., an apparently increased width of the nasal base and alae.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Narrow nasal bridge
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased width of the bony bridge of the nose.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Prominent nose
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between subnasale and pronasale more than two standard deviations above the mean, or alternatively, an apparently increased anterior protrusion of the nasal tip.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Choanal stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal narrowing of the choana (the posterior nasal aperture).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Choanal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or abnormal closure of the choana (the posterior nasal aperture). Most embryologists believe that posterior choanal atresia results from a failure of rupture between the 35th and 38th day of fetal life of the partition which separates the bucconasal or buccopharyngeal membranes. The resultant choanal atresia may be unilateral or bilateral, bony or membranous, complete or incomplete. In over 90 per cent of cases the obstruction is bony, while in the remainder it is membranous. The bony type of atresia is commonly located 1-2 mm. anterior to the posterior edge of the hard palate, and the osseous septum varies in thickness from 1 to 10 mm. In the membranous form of choanal atresia the obstruction usually occurs further posteriorly. In approximately one third of cases the atresia is bilateral.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5889-4463, PMID:4996574]"}

name: Broad nasal tip
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in width of the nasal tip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Bifid nasal tip
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A splitting of the nasal tip. Visually assessable vertical indentation, cleft, or depression of the nasal tip.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Depressed nasal ridge
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of prominence of the nose resulting from a posteriorly-placed nasal ridge.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Anosmia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An inability to perceive odors. This is a general term describing inability to smell arising in any part of the process of smelling from absorption of odorants into the nasal mucous overlying the olfactory epithelium, diffusion to the cilia, binding to olfactory receptor sites, generation of action potentials in olfactory neurons, and perception of a smell.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Narrow nose
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Interalar distance more than 2 SD below the mean for age, or alternatively, an apparently decreased width of the nasal base and alae.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Anteverted nares
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anteriorly-facing nostrils viewed with the head in the Frankfurt horizontal and the eyes of the observer level with the eyes of the subject. This gives the appearance of an upturned nose (upturned nasal tip).\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Webbed neck
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pterygium colli is a congenital skin fold that runs along the sides of the neck down to the shoulders. It involves an ectopic fibrotic facial band superficial to the trapezius muscle. Excess hair-bearing skin is also present and extends down the cervical region well beyond the normal hairline.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24523736]"}

name: Increased adipose tissue around the neck
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased amount of subcutaneous fat tissue around the neck.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gastrointestinal angiodysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dysplasia affecting the vasculature of the gastrointestinal tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Torticollis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Involuntary contractions of the neck musculature resulting in an abnormal posture of or abnormal movements of the head.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thickened nuchal skin fold
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A thickening of the skin thickness in the posterior aspect of the fetal neck. A nuchal fold (NF) measurement is obtained in a transverse section of the fetal head at the level of the cavum septum pellucidum and thalami, angled posteriorly to include the cerebellum. The measurement is taken from the outer edge of the occiput bone to the outer skin limit directly in the midline. An NF measurement greater than 5 mm at 14 to 17+6 weeks of gestation, or 6 mm at 18 to 28 weeks has been associated with a markedly increased risk for Down syndrome.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637, PMID:30431620]"}

name: Cystic hygroma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cystic lymphatic lesion of the neck.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the eye
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the eye, including location, spacing, and intraocular abnormalities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal coloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A notch or cleft of the retina or choroid, located vertically below the optic disc.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal cornea morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the cornea, which is the transparent tissue at the front of the eye that covers the iris, pupil, and anterior chamber.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Microcornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital abnormality of the cornea in which the cornea and the anterior segment of the eye are smaller than normal. The horizontal diameter of the cornea does not reach 10 mm even in adulthood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Astigmatism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of refraction error associated with abnormal curvatures on the anterior and/or posterior surface of the cornea.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Hyperopic astigmatism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of astigmatism in which one meridian is hyperopic while the one at a right angle to it has no refractive error.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Megalocornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An enlargement of the cornea with normal clarity and function. Megalocornea is diagnosed with a horizontal corneal diameter of 12 mm or more at birth or 13 mm or more after two years of age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Strabismus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A misalignment of the eyes so that the visual axes deviate from bifoveal fixation. The classification of strabismus may be based on a number of features including the relative position of the eyes, whether the deviation is latent or manifest, intermittent or constant, concomitant or otherwise and according to the age of onset and the relevance of any associated refractive error.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:26319345]"}

name: Retinopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any noninflammatory disease of the retina. This nonspecific term is retained here because of its wide use in the literature, but if possible new annotations should indicate the precise type of retinal abnormality.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Deeply set eye
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An eye that is more deeply recessed into the plane of the face than is typical.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Abnormal foveal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the fovea centralis, the central area of the macula that mediates central, high resolution vision and contains the largest concentration of cone cells in the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Downslanted palpebral fissures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The palpebral fissure inclination is more than two standard deviations below the mean.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Recurrent corneal erosions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of recurrent corneal epithelial erosions. Although most corneal epithelial defects heal quickly, some may show recurrent ulcerations.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of eye movement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in voluntary or involuntary eye movements or their control.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Globe retraction and deviation on abduction
Glaucoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Glaucoma refers loss of retinal ganglion cells in a characteristic pattern of optic neuropathy usually associated with increased intraocular pressure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11815354]"}

name: Tortuosity of conjunctival vessels
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the conjunctival blood vessels.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Visual impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Visual impairment (or vision impairment) is vision loss (of a person) to such a degree as to qualify as an additional support need through a significant limitation of visual capability resulting from either disease, trauma, or congenital or degenerative conditions that cannot be corrected by conventional means, such as refractive correction, medication, or surgery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Telecanthus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between the inner canthi more than two standard deviations above the mean (objective); or, apparently increased distance between the inner canthi.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ptosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The upper eyelid margin is positioned 3 mm or more lower than usual and covers the superior portion of the iris (objective); or, the upper lid margin obscures at least part of the pupil (subjective).\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Rod-cone dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An inherited retinal disease subtype in which the rod photoreceptors appear to be more severely affected than the cone photoreceptors. Typical presentation is with nyctalopia (due to rod dysfunction) followed by loss of mid-peripheral field of vision, which gradually extends and leaves many patients with a small central island of vision due to the preservation of macular cones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20212494]"}

name: Vertical supranuclear gaze palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A supranuclear gaze palsy is an inability to look in a vertical direction as a result of cerebral impairment. There is a loss of the voluntary aspect of eye movements, but, as the brainstem is still intact, all the reflex conjugate eye movements are normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20671861]"}

name: Abnormal electroretinogram
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the electrical responses of various cell types in the retina as measured by electroretinography.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Slow saccadic eye movements
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally slow velocity of the saccadic eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cataract is an opacity or clouding that develops in the crystalline lens of the eye or in its capsule.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Developmental cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cataract that occurs congenitally as the result of a developmental defect, in contrast to the majority of cataracts that occur in adulthood as the result of degenerative changes of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Proptosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An eye that is protruding anterior to the plane of the face to a greater extent than is typical.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:19125427]"}

name: Alacrima
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The complete absence of aqueous tear production. Typically, this is clinically measured by a Schirmer I test result of 0 millimeters of wetting on the filter paper strip after 5 minutes.\" [http://orcid.og/0000-0001-9042-0508, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:39586848]"}

name: Subcapsular cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cataract that affects the region of the lens directly beneath the capsule of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Conjunctival telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of small (ca. 0.5-1.0 mm) dilated blood vessels near the surface of the mucous membranes of the conjunctiva.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality iris morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the iris, which is the pigmented muscular tissue between the cornea and the lens, that is perforated by an opening called the pupil.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aniridia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the iris characterized by, typically bilateral, complete or partial iris hypoplasia. The phenotype ranges from mild defects of anterior iris stroma only to almost complete absence of the iris.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:24138039, PMID:25313118, PMID:29850208]"}

name: Long eyelashes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mid upper eyelash length >10 mm or increased length of the eyelashes (subjective).\" [PMID:19125427, PMID:26288407]"}

name: Progressive visual loss
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction of previously attained ability to see.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Corneal crystals
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Refractile, glittering, or needle-shaped particles said to resemble crystals and located within the corneal epithelium and/or stroma, visible on slit-lamp examination, resulting from the focal accumulation of lipid, protein, or other metabolic material.\" [PMID:19236704]"}

name: Abnormal chorioretinal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the choroid and retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chorioretinal atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy (wasting) of the choroid and retinal layers of the fundus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20224472]"}

name: Epicanthus inversus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fold of skin starting at or just below the medial aspect of the lower lid and arching upward to cover, extend in front of and lateral to the medial canthus.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Pseudopapilledema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Apparent optic disc swelling in the absence of increased intracranial pressure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of refraction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in the process of focusing of light by the eye in order to produce a sharp image on the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypermetropia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of refraction characterized by the ability to see objects in the distance clearly, while objects nearby appear blurry.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal detachment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Separation of the inner layers of the retina (neural retina) from the pigment epithelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired ocular adduction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability to move the eye in the direction of the nose.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Optic disc pallor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pale yellow discoloration of the optic disc (the area of the optic nerve head in the retina). The optic disc normally has a pinkish hue with a central yellowish depression.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myopia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of refraction characterized by the ability to see objects nearby clearly, while objects in the distance appear blurry.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nonspecific term denoting progressive loss of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and/or neurosensory retinal cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:29493934]"}

name: Abnormal conjugate eye movement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal motor coordination of the eyes that allows for bilateral fixation on a single object.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Undetectable electroretinogram
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of any response to stimulation upon electroretinography.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Color vision defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the ability to discriminate between or recognize colors.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tritanomaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty distinguishing between yellow and blue, possible related to dysfunction of the S photopigment.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal uvea morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the uvea, the vascular layer of the eyeball.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Uveitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of one or all portions of the uveal tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Leukocoria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal white reflection from the pupil rather than the usual black reflection.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Retinal dystrophy is an abnormality of the retina associated with a hereditary process. Retinal dystrophies are defined by their predominantly monogenic inheritance and they are frequently associated with loss or dysfunction of photoreceptor cells as a primary or secondary event.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Buphthalmos
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Diffusely large eye (with megalocornea) associated with glaucoma.\" []"}

name: Rieger anomaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital malformation of the anterior segment characterized by iridicorneal malformation, glaucoma, iris stroma hypoplasia, posterior embryotoxon, and corneal opacities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Keratoconus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cone-shaped deformity of the cornea characterized by the presence of corneal distortion secondary to thinning of the apex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7767020]"}

name: Lacrimal duct atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental disorder of the lacrimal drainage system that most often affects the lacrimal ostium and resulting in non-opening of the nasolacrimal duct. It usually results from a non-canalization of the nasolacrimal duct.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Esotropia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of strabismus with one or both eyes turned inward ('crossed') to a relatively severe degree, usually defined as 10 diopters or more.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chorioretinal coloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of a region of the retina, retinal pigment epithelium, and choroid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Microphthalmia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal smallness of one or both eyes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal saccadic eye movements
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of eye movement characterized by impairment of fast (saccadic) eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypometric saccades
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Saccadic undershoot, i.e., a saccadic eye movement that has less than the magnitude that would be required to gain fixation of the object.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:572501]"}

name: Visual loss
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of visual acuity (implying that vision was better at a certain time point in life). Otherwise the term reduced visual acuity should be used (or a subclass of that).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Retinal hemorrhage
