extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bleeding located within the retina. Retinal hemorrhages range from the smallest dot and blot hemorrhage to massive sub-hyaloid hemorrhage.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti]"}

name: Thick eyebrow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased density/number and/or increased diameter of eyebrow hairs.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Scotoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A regional and pathological increase of the light detection threshold in any region of the visual field surrounded by a field of normal or relatively well-preserved vision.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Centrocecal scotoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A scotoma (area of diminished vision within the visual field) located between the central point of fixation and the blind spot with a roughly horizontal oval shape.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Exotropia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of strabismus with one or both eyes deviated outward.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pigmentary retinopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the retina characterized by pigment deposition. It is typically associated with migration and proliferation of macrophages or retinal pigment epithelial cells into the retina; melanin from these cells causes the pigmentary changes. Pigmentary retinopathy is a common final pathway of many retinal conditions and is often associated with visual loss.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Blepharophimosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fixed reduction in the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelids with short palpebral fissures.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Upslanted palpebral fissure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The palpebral fissure inclination is more than two standard deviations above the mean for age (objective); or, the inclination of the palpebral fissure is greater than typical for age.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Band keratopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the cornea characterized by the deposition of calcium in a band across the central cornea, leading to decreased vision, foreign body sensation, and ocular irritation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Shallow orbits
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced depth of the orbits associated with prominent-appearing ocular globes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Optic disc coloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cleft of the optic nerve that extends inferiorly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16219745]"}

name: Coloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect characterized by a cleft of some portion of the eye or ocular adnexa.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Progressive external ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Initial bilateral ptosis followed by limitation of eye movements in all directions and slowing of saccades.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Blue sclerae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal bluish coloration of the sclera.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal anterior chamber morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the anterior chamber, which is the space in the eye that is behind the cornea and in front of the iris.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Shallow anterior chamber
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced depth of the anterior chamber, i.e., the anteroposterior distance between the cornea and the iris is decreased.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ophthalmoparesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ophthalmoplegia is a paralysis or weakness of one or more of the muscles that control eye movement.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the frontal hairline
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the placement or shape of the hairline (trichion) on the forehead, that is, the border between skin on the forehead that has head hair and that does not.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the pharynx
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the pharynx, i.e., of the tubular structure extending from the base of the skull superiorly to the esophageal inlet inferiorly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypotelorism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Interpupillary distance less than 2 SD below the mean (alternatively, the appearance of an decreased interpupillary distance or closely spaced eyes).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125427]"}

name: Ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paralysis of one or more extraocular muscles that are responsible for eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Central scotoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An area of depressed vision located at the point of fixation and that interferes with central vision.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Supranuclear gaze palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A supranuclear gaze palsy is an inability to look in a particular direction as a result of cerebral impairment. There is a loss of the voluntary aspect of eye movements, but, as the brainstem is still intact, all the reflex conjugate eye movements are normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the periorbital region
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the region situated around the orbit of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macular degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nonspecific term denoting degeneration of the retinal pigment epithelium and/or retinal photoreceptor cells of the macula lutea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Abnormal choroid morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the choroid (the posterior part of the uvea, the middle tunic of the eye, consisting mainly of blood vessels).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:38432349]"}

name: Photophobia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive sensitivity to light with the sensation of discomfort or pain in the eyes due to exposure to bright light.\" []"}

name: Abnormal nasolacrimal system morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the nasolacrimal drainage system, which serves as a conduit for tear flow from the external eye to the nasal cavity.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Abnormality of ocular smooth pursuit
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of eye movement characterized by impaired smooth-pursuit eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Blindness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blindness is the condition of lacking visual perception defined as a profound reduction in visual perception. On the 6m visual acuity scale, blindness is defined as less than 3/60. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, blindness is defined as less than 20/400. On the decimal visual acuity scale, blindness is defined as less than 0.05. Blindness is typically characterized by a visual field of no greater than 10 degrees in radius around central fixation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592, PMID:28779882]"}

name: Impaired convergence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability to turn the eyes inward in order to focus on a nearby object.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Entropion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal inversion (turning inward) of the eyelid (usually the lower) towards the globe. Entropion is usually acquired as a result of involutional or cicatricial processes but may occasionally be congenital.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:19125427]"}

name: Blurred vision
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of sharpness of vision resulting in the inability to see fine detail.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Supranuclear ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A vertical gaze palsy with inability to direct the gaze of the eyes downwards.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20629667]"}

name: Eyelid coloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A short discontinuity of the margin of the lower or upper eyelid.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Posterior embryotoxon
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A posterior embryotoxon is the presence of a prominent and anteriorly displaced line of Schwalbe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal retinal arterial/arteriolar morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal structure of the retinal artery or arterioles.\" []"}

name: Retinal arterial tortuosity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the retinal artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10193892]"}

name: Decreased lacrimation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally decreased lacrimation, that is, reduced tear production.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:35925585]"}

name: Impaired ocular abduction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An impaired ability of the eye to move in the outward direction (towards the side of the head).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Blue irides
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A markedly blue coloration of the iris.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Upper eyelid coloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A short discontinuity of the margin of the upper eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Long palpebral fissure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between medial and lateral canthi is more than two standard deviations above the mean for age (objective); or, apparently increased length of the palpebral fissures.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rhythmic, involuntary oscillations of one or both eyes related to abnormality in fixation, conjugate gaze, or vestibular mechanisms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gaze-evoked nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nystagmus made apparent by looking to the right or to the left.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dysmetric saccades
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The controller signal for saccadic eye movements has two components: the pulse that moves the eye rapidly from one point to the next, and the step that holds the eye in the new position. When both the pulse and the step are not the correct size, a dysmetric refixation eye movement results.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:572501]"}

name: Red-green dyschromatopsia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty with discriminating red and green hues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Blepharospasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A focal dystonia that affects the muscles of the eyelids and brow, associated with involuntary recurrent spasm of both eyelids.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Amblyopia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced visual acuity that is uncorrectable by lenses in the absence of detectable anatomic defects in the eye or visual pathways.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sclerocornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly in which a part or the whole of the cornea acquires the characteristics of sclera, resulting in clouding of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Optic atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of the optic nerve. Optic atrophy results from the death of the retinal ganglion cell axons that comprise the optic nerve and manifesting as a pale optic nerve on fundoscopy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of visual evoked potentials
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of visually evoked potentials (VEP), which are electrical potentials, initiated by brief visual stimuli, which are recorded from the scalp overlying the visual cortex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19826847]"}

name: Abnormal amplitude of pattern reversal visual evoked potentials
Diplopia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Diplopia is a condition in which a single object is perceived as two images, it is also known as double vision.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lower eyelid coloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A short discontinuity of the margin of the lower eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased light- and dark-adapted electroretinogram amplitude
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased amplitude of eletrical response upon electroretinography.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectropion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An outward turning (eversion) or rotation of the eyelid margin.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Oculomotor apraxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ocular motor apraxia is a deficiency in voluntary, horizontal, lateral, fast eye movements (saccades) with retention of slow pursuit movements. The inability to follow objects visually is often compensated by head movements. There may be decreased smooth pursuit, and cancelation of the vestibulo-ocular reflex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20615230]"}

name: Peters anomaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of anterior segment dysgenesis in which abnormal cleavage of the anterior chamber occurs. Peters anomaly is characterized by central, paracentral, or complete corneal opacity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lipemia retinalis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A creamy appearance of the retinal blood vessels that occurs when the concentration of lipids in the blood is extremely increased, with pale pink to milky white retinal vessels and altered pale reflexes from choroidal vasculature.\" [PMID:10379021, PMID:16120862]"}

name: Nyctalopia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to see well at night or in poor light.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Synophrys
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Meeting of the medial eyebrows in the midline.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Horizontal nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nystagmus consisting of horizontal to-and-fro eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Phthisis bulbi
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of the eyeball with blindness and decreased intraocular pressure due to end-stage intraocular disease.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypodontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The absence of five or less teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Carious teeth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Caries is a multifactorial bacterial infection affecting the structure of the tooth. This term has been used to describe the presence of more than expected dental caries.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anodontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The absence of all teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Macrodontia of permanent maxillary central incisor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased size of the maxillary central secondary incisor tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Oligodontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The absence of six or more teeth from the normal series by a failure to develop.\" [PMID:19125428, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Dental crowding
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Changes in alignment of teeth in the dental arch\" [PMID:19125428, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Taurodontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased volume of dental pulp of permanent molar characterized by a crown body-root ratio equal or larger than 1:1 or an elongated pulp chambers and apical displacement of the bifurcation or trifurcation of the roots.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Delayed eruption of primary teeth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed tooth eruption affecting the primary dentition.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Grayish enamel
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A gray discoloration of the dental enamel.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Delayed eruption of teeth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed tooth eruption, which can be defined as tooth eruption more than 2 SD beyond the mean eruption age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:19125428, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Widely spaced teeth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased spaces (diastemata) between most of the teeth in the same dental arch.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Dental malocclusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dental malocclusion refers to an abnormality of the occlusion, or alignment, of the teeth and the way the upper and lower teeth fit together, resulting in overcrowding of teeth or in abnormal bite patterns.\" [PMID:31468724]"}

name: Agenesis of maxillary lateral incisor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Agenesis of one or more maxillary lateral incisor, comprising the maxillary lateral primary incisor and maxillary lateral secondary incisor.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Microdontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased size of the teeth, which can be defined as a mesiodistal tooth diameter (width) more than 2 SD below mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased maximum width of tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:19125428]"}

name: Tooth malposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal alignment, positioning, or spacing of the teeth, i.e., misaligned teeth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Odontodysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The diagnosis odontodysplasia requires clinical and radiological exams, in which unusually large pulp chambers and large pulp room chambers with thin enamel and dentin are visible. It may affect either a single tooth or several teeth. The term regional odontodysplasia is used if several teeth are affected. It affects the deciduous and permanent dentitions in the maxilla, the mandible or both, although the maxilla is more frequently involved. A type of dental dysplasia occurring in dentinogenesis imperfecta in which the pulp chambers are enlarged and there is a reduced amount of coronal dentin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Natal tooth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tooth present at birth or erupting within the first month of life.\" [PMID:19125428, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Delayed eruption of permanent teeth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed tooth eruption affecting the secondary dentition.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Conical tooth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal conical form of the teeth, that is, a tooth whose sides converge or taper together incisally.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Diastema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased space between two adjacent teeth in the same dental arch.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Periapical bone loss
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Radiolucency (reflecting a reduction in the bony substance) around the apex (the tip of the dental root).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Amelogenesis imperfecta
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental dysplasia of the dental enamel.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:18499550]"}

name: Eruption failure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tooth which does not erupt within the teeth eruption timeline and after the loss of eruption potential.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Atypical behavior
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atypical behavior is an abnormality in a person's actions that can be controlled or modulated by the will of the individual. While abnormal behaviors can be difficult to control, they are distinct from other abnormal actions that cannot be affected by the individual's will.\" []"}

name: Psychosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition characterized by changes in personality and thought patterns, often accompanied by hallucinations and delusional beliefs, is known as psychosis.\" []"}

name: Hyperorality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperorality is a condition characterized by an excessive preoccupation with oral sensations and behaviors, such as chewing, sucking, biting, swallowing, and excessive mouthing of objects.\" [PMID:29112858]"}

name: Restlessness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A state of unease is characterized by diffuse motor activity or motion, which is subject to limited control, nonproductive, or disorganized behavior.\" []"}

name: Emotional lability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Unstable emotional experiences and frequent mood changes; emotions that are easily aroused, intense, and/or disproportionate to events and circumstances.\" []"}

name: Agitation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A state of excessive motor activity that is associated with mental distress or a feeling of substantial unease or inner tension. Distinguished from restlessness by the increased level of emotional distress and negative intensity of the experience. Agitation has a significant level of physical activity that is typically threatening to the self or others.\" []"}

name: Depression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Frequently experiencing feelings of being down, miserable, and/or hopeless; struggling to recover from these moods; having a pessimistic outlook on the future; feeling a pervasive sense of shame; having a low self-worth; experiencing thoughts of suicide and engaging in suicidal behavior.\" []"}

name: Autism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Autism is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by impaired social interaction and communication, and by restricted and repetitive behavior. Autism begins in childhood. It is marked by the presence of markedly abnormal or impaired development in social interaction and communication and a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest. Manifestations of the disorder vary greatly depending on the developmental level and chronological age of the individual (DSM-IV).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Aggressive behavior
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Behavior or an act aimed at harming a person, animal, or physical property (e.g., acts of physical violence; shouting, swearing, and using harsh language; slashing someone's tires).\" []"}

name: Inappropriate behavior
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An explicit or perceived action, demonstration, conduct, or language (verbal and written) that is contrary to generally accepted norms, rules, procedures, or unacceptable within the context in which it is carried out. Inappropriate behaviors could take place in a sexual or social context and could be aggressive, violent, impulsive, intimidating, or threatening in nature.\" []"}

name: Compulsive behaviors
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Behavior that consists of repetitive acts, characterized by the feeling that one \\\"has to\\\" perform them, while being aware that these acts are not in line with one's overall goal.\" []"}

name: Restrictive behavior
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Behavior characterized by an abnormal limitation to a few interests and activities.\" []"}

name: Psychotic episodes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Periods of time during which an individual experiences significant disturbances in their thoughts, perceptions, emotions, and behavior, resulting in a loss of touch with reality. These episodes are hallmark features of psychotic disorders such as schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, and certain forms of bipolar disorder.\" []"}

name: Dementia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A loss of global cognitive ability of sufficient amount to interfere with normal social or occupational function. Dementia represents a loss of previously present cognitive abilities, generally in adults, and can affect memory, thinking, language, judgment, and behavior.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced ability to form peer relationships
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty to establish relations with others in a comparable social group (peers) that may be manifested in pehnomena such as not being able to initiative a conversation, understand social cues, or to discuss shared interests. This feature is associated with poor integration within a community or group.\" []"}

name: Autistic behavior
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistent deficits in social interaction and communication and interaction as well as a markedly restricted repertoire of activity and interest as well as repetitive patterns of behavior.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28879490]"}

name: Inflexible adherence to routines
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A need to strictly adhere to repetitive routines or patterns of behavior which are created by the environment. One becomes upset or distressed when their routines are disrupted or altered.\" []"}

name: Motor stereotypy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Use of the same abnormal action in response to certain triggers or at random. They may be used as a way to regulate one's internal state but must otherwise have no apparent functional purpose.\" []"}

name: Disinhibition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability to control, or a failure to resist a temptation, urge, or impulse. Examples include disregard for social conventions, general impulsivity, and poor risk assessment.\" []"}

name: Short attention span
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced attention span characterized by distractibility and impulsivity.\" [PMID:26386541]"}

name: Irritability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An emotional state characterized by negative feelings of heightened frustration, annoyance, or feeling upset, often triggered by internal factors (e.g., fatigue, hunger, unfulfilled desires) or external factors (e.g., social or environmental challenges). Irritability may be unpredictable, and is accompanied by a lowered threshold for emotional reactivity and observable features (speech, facial expressions, or psychomotor activity).\" [PMID:1521100]"}

name: Hallucinations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Perceptions in a conscious and awake state that, in the absence of external stimuli, have qualities of real perception. These perceptions are vivid, substantial, and located in external objective space.\" []"}

name: Anxiety
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intense feelings of nervousness, tension, or panic often arise in response to interpersonal stresses. There is worry about the negative effects of past unpleasant experiences and future negative possibilities. Individuals may feel fearful, apprehensive, or threatened by uncertainty, and they may also have fears of falling apart or losing control.\" []"}

name: Episodic paroxysmal anxiety
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent attacks of severe anxiety, which occur without restriction to any particular situation or set of circumstances, are therefore unpredictable.\" []"}

name: Apathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Apathy is a quantitative reduction of interest, motivation and the initiation and persistence of goal-directed behavior, where often the accompanying emotions, thoughts, and social interactions are also diminished. The individual is typically non-reactive to provocations, positive or negative, and appears to not care. Distinguished from lethargy which involves lack of physical or mental energy.\" []"}

name: Self-mutilation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deliberate harm to one's body resulting in tissue damage, without a conscious intent to die.\" [PMID:7754789]"}

name: Frontal release signs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Primitive reflexes traditionally held to be a sign of disorders that affect the frontal lobes.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Low frustration tolerance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The feeling of frustration can be defined as an emotional reaction that occurs when a desired goal is not achieved. Frustration intolerance is defined as an age-inappropriate response to frustration, characterized by crying or temper tantrums in children, or aggressive or other maladaptive behaviors.\" []"}

name: Abnormal diminished volition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in willful and motivated goal-directed behavior that is considered the determinant of behavior and adaptation that allows individuals to get started, be energized to perform a sustained and directed action.\" []"}

name: Delusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A delusion is a fixed false belief held despite evidence to the contrary. The term delusion broadly encompasses all false judgments that possess the following external characteristics to a significant, albeit unspecified, extent: (1) they are held with an exceptional level of conviction, accompanied by an unparalleled subjective certainty; (2) there is an inability to consider alternative experiences or compelling counter-arguments; (3) the content of the belief is impossible.\" []"}

name: Inappropriate laughter
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Laughing that may be excessive and/or inappropriate in context (e.g., laughing at a funeral while others are crying).\" []"}

name: Delayed speech and language development
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A degree of language development that is significantly below the norm for a child of a specified age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Personality changes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal shift in patterns of thinking, acting, or feeling.\" []"}

name: Hyperactivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperactivity is a condition characterized by constant and unusually high levels of activity, even in situations where it is deemed inappropriate.\" []"}

name: Agoraphobia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of anxiety disorder characterized by the avoidance of public places, especially where crowds gather.\" []"}

name: Lack of insight
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of insight (Anosognosia) is a neurological condition in which an individual is unaware of his or her own neurological deficit or psychiatric condition. Anosognosia can be associated with mental illness, dementia, and structural brain lesions and can affect an individual's conscious awareness of deficits involving judgment, emotions, memory, executive function, language skills, and motor ability.\" []"}

name: Abnormal nonverbal communicative behavior
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormalities in eye contact, communicative facial expressions, gesture use, or the use of others' bodies to communicate convey shared meanings within a culture that replace or supplement verbal communication.\" []"}

name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the peripheral nervous system, which is composed of the nerves that lead to or branch off from the central nervous system. This includes the cranial nerves (olfactory and optic nerves are technically part of the central nervous system).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased nerve conduction velocity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the speed at which electrical signals propagate along the axon of a neuron.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal thorax morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the thorax (the region of the body formed by the sternum, the thoracic vertebrae and the ribs).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal sternum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the sternum, also known as the breastbone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pectus excavatum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A defect of the chest wall characterized by a depression of the sternum, giving the chest (\\\"pectus\\\") a caved-in (\\\"excavatum\\\") appearance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pectus carinatum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deformity of the chest caused by overgrowth of the ribs and characterized by protrusion of the sternum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gynecomastia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal development of large mammary glands in males resulting in breast enlargement.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Narrow chest
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced width of the chest from side to side, associated with a reduced distance from the sternal notch to the tip of the shoulder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the diaphragm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the diaphragm, the sheet of skeletal muscle that separates the thoracic cavity from the abdominal cavity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a hernia of the diaphragm present at birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal thymus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the thymus, an organ located in the upper anterior portion of the chest cavity just behind the sternum and whose main function is to provide an environment for T lymphocyte maturation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal scapula morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the scapula, also known as the shoulder blade.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Kidney stone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Kidney stones (calculi) are mineral concretions in the renal calyces and pelvis that are found free or attached to the renal papillae.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28079115]"}

name: Hematuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of blood in the urine. Hematuria may be gross hematuria (visible to the naked eye) or microscopic hematuria (detected by dipstick or microscopic examination of the urine).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Uric acid nephrolithiasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of uric acid-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of glomerulonephritis characterized by diffuse mesangial cell proliferation and the thickening of capillary walls due to subendothelial extension of the mesangium. The term membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis is often employed to denote a general pattern of glomerular injury seen in a variety of disease processes that share a common pathogenetic mechanism, rather than to describe a single disease entity\" [PMID:19908070]"}

name: IgA deposition in the glomerulus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of immunoglobulin A deposits in the glomerulus.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_ewuehl]"}

name: Abnormality of the urethra
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the urethra, i.e., of the tube which connects the urinary bladder to the outside of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urethral obstruction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Obstruction of the flow of urine through the urethra.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oligozoospermia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced count of spermatozoa in the semen, defined as a sperm count below 20 million per milliliter semen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impotence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to develop or maintain an erection of the penis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal cortical cysts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cysts of the cortex of the kidney.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Xanthine nephrolithiasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of xanthine-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enuresis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of the ability to control the urinary bladder leading to involuntary urination at an age where control of the bladder should already be possible.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Glanular hypospadias
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hypospadias in which the urethral meatus is located at the head of the penis, but not all the way at the tip.\" [PMID:28190103]"}

name: Penoscrotal hypospadias
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A severe form of hypospadias in which the urethral opening is located at the junction of the penis and scrotum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urinary tract atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital absence of the normal opening of a structure of the urinary tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal external genitalia morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the external genitalia.\" []"}

name: Abnormal internal genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the adnexa, uterus, and vagina (in female) or seminal tract and prostate (in male).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypergonadotropic hypogonadism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced function of the gonads (testes in males or ovaries in females) associated with excess pituitary gonadotropin secretion and resulting in delayed sexual development and growth delay.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of Krebs cycle metabolism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the tricarboxylic acid cycle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced eye contact
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced frequency or duration of eye contact.\" []"}

name: Diabetes mellitus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A group of abnormalities characterized by hyperglycemia and glucose intolerance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypertension
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of chronic increased pressure in the systemic arterial system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Delayed puberty
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Passing the age when puberty normally occurs with no physical or hormonal signs of the onset of puberty.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased response to growth hormone stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Insufficient responses to growth hormone (GH) provocation tests. GH deficiency is defined as a serum peak GH concentration less than 10 ng/mL on provocation with a combination of at least two separate stimulation tests.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25914878]"}

name: Hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of insulin combined with a decreased concentration of glucose in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Precocious puberty
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The onset of secondary sexual characteristics before a normal age. Although it is difficult to define normal age ranges because of the marked variation with which puberty begins in normal children, precocious puberty can be defined as the onset of puberty before the age of 8 years in girls or 9 years in boys.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoparathyroidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition caused by a deficiency of parathyroid hormone characterized by hypocalcemia and hyperphosphatemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anterior hypopituitarism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition of reduced function of the anterior pituitary gland characterized by decreased secretion of one or more of the pituitary hormones growth hormone, thyroid-stimulating hormone, adrenocorticotropic hormone, prolactin, luteinizing hormone, and follicle-stimulating hormone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Insulin-resistant diabetes mellitus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of diabetes mellitus related not to lack of insulin but rather to lack of response to insulin on the part of the target tissues of insulin such as muscle, fat, and liver cells. This type of diabetes is typically associated with increases both in blood glucose concentrations as well as in fasting and postprandial serum insulin levels.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7706500]"}

name: Primary hypothyroidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hypothyroidism that results from a defect in the thyroid gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the adrenal glands
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the adrenal glands, i.e., of the endocrine glands located at the top of the kindneys.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperthyroidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of thyroid physiology characterized by excessive secretion of the thyroid hormones thyroxine (i.e., T4) and/or 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine zwitterion (i.e., triiodothyronine or T3).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased circulating gonadotropin level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Overproduction of gonadotropins (FSH, LH) by the anterior pituitary gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]"}

name: Pituitary dwarfism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of reduced stature with normal proportions related to dysfunction of the pituitary gland related to either an isolated defect in the secretion of growth hormone or to panhypopituitarism, i.e., a deficit of all the anterior pituitary hormones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Adrenogenital syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Adrenogenital syndrome is also known as congenital adrenal hyperplasia, which results from disorders of steroid hormone production in the adrenal glands leading to a deficiency of cortisol. The pituitary gland reacts by increased secretion of corticotropin, which in turn causes the adrenal glands to overproduce certain intermediary hormones which have testosterone-like effects.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperactive renin-angiotensin system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased activity of the renin-angiotensin system, causing hypertension by a combination of volume excess and vasoconstrictor mechanisms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperinsulinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of insulin in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperparathyroidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive production of parathyroid hormone (PTH) by the parathyroid glands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elevated circulating growth hormone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acromegaly is a condition resulting from overproduction of growth hormone by the pituitary gland in persons with closed epiphyses, and consists chiefly in the enlargement of the distal parts of the body. The circumference of the skull increases, the nose becomes broad, the tongue becomes enlarged, the facial features become coarsened, the mandible grows excessively, and the teeth become separated. The fingers and toes grow chiefly in thickness.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Adrenal insufficiency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Insufficient production of steroid hormones (primarily cortisol) by the adrenal glands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11443143]"}

name: Increased circulating renin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased level of renin in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Congenital hypothyroidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hypothyroidism with congenital onset.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pseudohypoparathyroidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition characterized by resistance to the action of parathyroid hormone, in which there is hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, and (appropriately) high levels of parathyroid hormone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thyroid adenoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a adenoma of the thyroid gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Insulin resistance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased resistance towards insulin, that is, diminished effectiveness of insulin in reducing blood glucose levels.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Irregular menstruation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally high variation in the amount of time between periods.\" [PMID:29323693]"}

name: Increased circulating aldosterone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Overproduction of the mineralocorticoid aldosterone by the adrenal cortex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Central diabetes insipidus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of diabetes insipidus related to a failure of vasopressin (AVP) release from the hypothalamus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the hypothalamus-pituitary axis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the pituitary gland (also known as hypophysis), which is an endocrine gland that protrudes from the bottom of the hypothalamus at the base of the brain. The pituitary gland secretes the hormones ACTH, TSH, PRL, GH, endorphins, FSH, LH, oxytocin, and antidiuretic hormone. The secretion of hormones from the anterior pituitary is under the strict control of hypothalamic hormones, and the posterior pituitary is essentially an extension of the hypothalamus, so that hypothalamus and pituitary gland may be regarded as a functional unit.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]"}

name: Secondary hyperparathyroidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Secondary hyperparathyroidism refers to the production of higher than normal levels of parathyroid hormone in the presence of hypocalcemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19836494]"}

name: Increased circulating prolactin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of abnormally increased levels of prolactin in the blood. Prolactin is a peptide hormone produced by the anterior pituitary gland that plays a role in breast development and lactation during pregnancy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Panhypopituitarism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pituitary functional deficit affecting all the anterior pituitary hormones (growth hormone, thyroid-stimulating hormone, follicle-stimulating hormone, luteinizing hormone, adrenocorticotropic hormone, and prolactin).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12466332]"}

name: Hashimoto thyroiditis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A chronic, autoimmune type of thyroiditis associated with hypothyroidism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Diabetes insipidus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A state of excessive water intake and hypotonic (dilute) polyuria. Diabetes insipidus may be due to failure of vasopressin (AVP) release (central or neurogenic diabetes insipidus) or to a failure of the kidney to respond to AVP (nephrogenic diabetes insipidus).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oligomenorrhea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infrequent menses (less than 6 per year or more than 35 days between cycles).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22594864]"}

name: Insulin-resistant diabetes mellitus at puberty
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of insulin-resistant diabetes mellitus that develops around the time of publerty in contrast to the common form of type 2 diabetes-associated insulin resistance that typically presents in mid-to-late adulthood.\" [PMID:21865368, PMID:31214120]"}

name: Horizontal ribs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A horizontal (flat) conformation of the ribs, the long curved bones that form the rib cage and normally progressively oblique (slanted) from ribs 1 through 9, then less slanted through rib 12.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bifid ribs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bifid rib refers to cleavage of the sternal end of a rib, usually unilateral. Bifid ribs are usually asymptomatic, and are often discovered incidentally by chest x-ray.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bulging of the costochondral junction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal outward curving (protuberance) of the junction of ribs and costal cartilage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lateral clavicle hook
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An excessive upward convexity of the lateral clavicle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7322653]"}

name: Rib exostoses
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple circumscribed bony excrescences located in the ribs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Rachitic rosary
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A row of beadlike prominences at the junction of a rib and its cartilage (i.e., enlarged costochondral joints), resembling a rosary. Note that rachitic rosary would have one bead per rib (a swelling at the costochondral junction), while beaded ribs in the context of multiple rib fractures have multiple beads (fractures) along the same rib.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26745253]"}

name: Rib fusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete or partial merging of adjacent ribs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Flaring of rib cage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of wide, concave anterior rib ends.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Progressive clavicular acroosteolysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Progressive bone resorption in the distal part of the clavicle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Flat glenoid fossa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally flat configuration of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15163819]"}

name: Sprengel anomaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital skeletal deformity characterized by the elevation of one scapula (thus, one scapula is located superior to the other).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Posterior rib fusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete or partial merging of the posterior part of adjacent ribs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pectus excavatum of inferior sternum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pectus excavatum (defect of the chest wall characterized by depression of the sternum) affecting primarily the inferior region of the sternum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Superior pectus carinatum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pectus carinatum affecting primarily the superior part of the sternum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Scapular exostoses
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple exostoses on the scapula. An exostosis is a benign growth the projects outward from the bone surface. It is capped by cartilage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the costochondral junction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the costochondral junction. The costochondral junctions are located between the distal part of the ribs and the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage that connect the ribs to the sternum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enlargement of the costochondral junction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased size of the costochondral junctions, which are located between the distal part of the ribs and the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage that connect the ribs to the sternum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Missing ribs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly with absence of one or more ribs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Platyspondyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A flattened vertebral body shape with reduced distance between the vertebral endplates.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of skeletal maturation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The bones of the skeleton undergo a series of characteristic changes in size, shape, and calcification from fetal life until puberty. An abnormality of this process can include delayed or accelerated skeletal maturation, or deviation of some, but not all bones from the expected patterns of maturation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal skull morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the skull, the bony framework of the head which is comprised of the neurocranium (with eight cranial bones) and the viscerocranium (facial skeleton) that comprises fourteen facial bones with the mandible as its largest bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elevated imprint of the transverse sinuses
Thinning and bulging of the posterior fossa bones
Abnormal posterior cranial fossa morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the fossa cranii posterior (the posterior fossa), which is made up primarily of the occipital bone and which surrounds to the foramen magnum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25970099, PMID:28295149]"}

name: Posterior fossa cyst at the fourth ventricle
Chondrocalcinosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Radiographic evidence of articular calcification that represent calcium pyrophosphate depositions in soft tissue surrounding joints and at the insertions of tendons near joints (Entheses/Sharpey fibers) .\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Thickened cortex of long bones
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal thickening of the cortex of long bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Osteopenia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Osteopenia is a term to define bone density that is not normal but also not as low as osteoporosis. By definition from the World Health Organization osteopenia is defined by bone densitometry as a T score -1 to -2.5.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21234807]"}

name: Osteoporosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Osteoporosis is a systemic skeletal disease characterized by low bone density and microarchitectural deterioration of bone tissue with a consequent increase in bone fragility. According to the WHO criteria, osteoporosis is defined as a BMD that lies 2.5 standard deviations or more below the average value for young healthy adults (a T-score below -2.5 SD).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28293453]"}

name: Abnormal diaphysis morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the structure or form of the diaphysis, i.e., of the main or mid-section (shaft) of a long bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal metaphysis morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of one or more metaphysis, i.e., of the somewhat wider portion of a long bone that is adjacent to the epiphyseal growth plate and grows during childhood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dumbbell-shaped long bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal appearance of the long bones with resemblance to a dumbbell, a short bar with a weight at each end. That is, the long bone is shortened and displays flaring (widening) of the metaphyses.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Jaundice
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Yellow pigmentation of the skin due to bilirubin, which in turn is the result of increased bilirubin concentration in the bloodstream.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperpigmentation of the skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A darkening of the skin related to an increase in melanin production and deposition.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Single transverse palmar crease
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The distal and proximal transverse palmar creases are merged into a single transverse palmar crease.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Acanthosis nigricans
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A dermatosis characterized by thickened, hyperpigmented plaques, typically on the intertriginous surfaces and neck.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011, PMID:19061584]"}

name: Cafe-au-lait spot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cafe-au-lait spots are hyperpigmented lesions that can vary in color from light brown to dark brown with smooth borders and having a size of 1.5 cm or more in adults and 0.5 cm or more in children.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dry skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Skin characterized by the lack of natural or normal moisture.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sacral dimple
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cutaneous indentation resulting from tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) of the intergluteal cleft.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28245993]"}

name: Cyanosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bluish discoloration of the skin and mucosa due to poor circulation or inadequate oxygenation of arterial or capillary blood.\" [PMID:25658213]"}

name: Hyperkeratosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperkeratosis is a histopathological term defining a thickened stratum corneum and may be present in many different skin conditions, with many possible overlaps. Hyperkeratosis refers to the increased thickness of the stratum corneum, the outer layer of the skin. Hyperkeratosis is subclassified as orthokeratotic or parakeratotic. Orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis refers to the thickening of the keratin layer with preserved keratinocyte maturation, while parakeratotic hyperkeratosis shows retained nuclei as a sign of delayed maturation of keratinocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32965877]"}

name: Thin skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction in thickness of the skin, generally associated with a loss of suppleness and elasticity of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Eczematoid dermatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Eczema is a form of dermatitis that is characterized by scaly, pruritic, erythematous lesions located on flexural surfaces.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32412211]"}

name: Cutis marmorata
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reticular discoloration of the skin with cyanotic (reddish-blue appearing) areas surrounding pale central areas due to dilation of capillary blood vessels and stagnation of blood within the vessels. Cutis marmorata generally occurs on the legs, arms and trunk and is often more severe in cold weather.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Petechiae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Petechiae are pinpoint-sized reddish/purple spots, resembling a rash, that appear just under the skin or a mucous membrane when capillaries have ruptured and some superficial bleeding into the skin has happened. This term refers to an abnormally increased susceptibility to developing petechiae.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:29493956]"}

name: Ectodermal dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ectodermal dysplasia is a group of conditions in which there is abnormal development of the skin, hair, nails, teeth, or sweat glands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin, or in one or more cavities of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal sweat gland morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the sweat gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal thickening of the skin localized to the palm of the hand and the sole of the foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperextensible skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which the skin can be stretched beyond normal, and then returns to its initial position.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Hyperhidrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal excessive perspiration (sweating) despite the lack of appropriate stimuli like hot and humid weather.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Soft skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Subjective impression of increased softness upon palpation of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bruising susceptibility
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An ecchymosis (bruise) refers to the skin discoloration caused by the escape of blood into the tissues from ruptured blood vessels. This term refers to an abnormally increased susceptibility to bruising. The corresponding phenotypic abnormality is generally elicited on medical history as a report of frequent ecchymoses or bruising without adequate trauma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Purpura
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Purpura (from Latin: purpura, meaning purple) is the appearance of red or purple discolorations on the skin that do not blanch on applying pressure. They are caused by bleeding underneath the skin. This term refers to an abnormally increased susceptibility to developing purpura. Purpura are larger than petechiae.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11515831]"}

name: Palmoplantar keratoderma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal thickening of the skin of the palms of the hands and the soles of the feet.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pruritus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased disposition to experience pruritus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Xanthomatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple xanthomas (xanthomata) in the skin. Xanthomas are yellowish, firm, lipid-laden nodules in the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cutaneous photosensitivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased sensitivity of the skin to light. Photosensitivity may result in a rash upon exposure to the sun (which is known as photodermatosis). Photosensitivity can be diagnosed by phototests in which light is shone on small areas of skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Molluscoid pseudotumors
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bluish-grey, spongy nodules associated with scars over pressure points and easily traumatized areas like the elbows and knees.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Melanocytic nevus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A oval and round, colored (usually medium-to dark brown, reddish brown, or flesh colored) lesion. Typically, a melanocytic nevus is less than 6 mm in diameter, but may be much smaller or larger.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Facial capillary hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells with small endothelial spaces, occurring in the face.\" []"}

name: Axillary freckling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence in the axillary region (armpit) of an increased number of freckles, small circular spots on the skin that are darker than the surrounding skin because of deposits of melanin.\" [PMID:12186179]"}

name: Hypertrichosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypertrichosis is increased hair growth that is abnormal in quantity or location.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pyoderma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any manifestation of a skin disease associated with the production of pus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal skin pigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the pigmentation of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Multiple lentigines
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of an unusually high number of lentigines (singular: lentigo), which are flat, tan to brown oval spots.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lymphedema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Localized fluid retention and tissue swelling caused by a compromised lymphatic system.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Hirsutism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased hair growth referring to a male pattern of body hair (androgenic hair).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Telangiectasias refer to small dilated blood vessels located near the surface of the skin or mucous membranes, measuring between 0.5 and 1 millimeter in diameter. Telangiectasia are located especially on the tongue, lips, palate, fingers, face, conjunctiva, trunk, nail beds, and fingertips.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypopigmentation of the skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction of skin color related to a decrease in melanin production and deposition.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Multiple lipomas
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple lipomas (a type of benign tissue made of fatty tissue).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Eruptive xanthomas
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Eruptive xanthomas are yellow-orange-to-red-brown papules that are often surrounded by an erythematous halo. They appear in crops on the buttocks, extensor surfaces of the extremities, and flexural creases. Acutely, variable amounts of pruritus and pain occur.\" [PMID:12165227, PMID:22375975]"}

name: Angiokeratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Angiokeratomas are hyperkeratotic papules that are characterized histologically by superficial ectatic (i.e., dilated) blood vessels with epidermal proliferation. Clinically, angiokeratoma presents as a small, raised, dark-red spot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8993949]"}

name: Prominent superficial veins
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which superficial veins (i.e., veins just under the skin) are more conspicuous or noticeable than normal.\" []"}

name: Anemic pallor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of pallor that is secondary to the presence of anemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal palmar dermatoglyphics
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the dermatoglyphs, i.e., an abnormality of the patterns of ridges of the skin of palm of hand.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Erythroderma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An inflammatory exfoliative dermatosis involving nearly all of the surface of the skin. Erythroderma develops suddenly. A patchy erythema may generalize and spread to affect most of the skin. Scaling may appear in 2-6 days and be accompanied by hot, red, dry skin, malaise, and fever.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11606915, PMID:25710899, PMID:25882661, PMID:32555205, PMID:35238435]"}

name: Albinism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation (reduced or absent) of skin, hair and eye (iris and retina).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Skin dimple over apex of long bone angulation
Urticaria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Raised, well-circumscribed areas of erythema and edema involving the dermis and epidermis. Urticaria is intensely pruritic, and blanches completely with pressure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Soft, doughy skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A skin texture that is unusually soft (and may feel silky), and has a malleable consistency resembling that of dough.\" []"}

name: Hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hemangioma is a benign tumor characterized by blood-filled spaces lined by benign endothelial cells. A hemangioma characterized by large endothelial spaces (caverns) is called a cavernous hemangioma (in contrast to a hemangioma with small endothelial spaces, which is called capillary hemangioma).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Poikiloderma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Poikiloderma refers to a patch of skin with (1) reticulated hypopigmentation and hyperpigmentation, (2) wrinkling secondary to epidermal atrophy, and (3) telangiectasias.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32363096]"}

name: Fragile skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Skin that splits easily with minimal injury.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent distal interphalangeal creases
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the distal interphalangeal flexion creases of the fingers.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypermelanotic macule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hyperpigmented circumscribed area of change in normal skin color without elevation or depression of any size.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Parakeratosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal formation of the keratinocytes of the epidermis characterized by persistence of nuclei, incomplete formation of keratin, and moistness and swelling of the keratinocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Facial erythema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Redness of the skin of the face, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intermittent jaundice
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Jaundice that is sometimes present, sometimes not.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Atopic dermatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atopic dermatitis (AD) or atopic eczema is an itchy, inflammatory skin condition with a predilection for the skin flexures. It is characterized by poorly defined erythema with edema, vesicles, and weeping in the acute stage and skin thickening (lichenification) in the chronic stage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27904186]"}

name: Cavernous hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a cavernous hemangioma. A hemangioma characterized by large endothelial spaces (caverns) is called a cavernous hemangioma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent dorsal skin creases over affected joints
Seborrheic dermatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Seborrheic dermatitis is a form of eczema which is closely related to dandruff. It causes dry or greasy peeling of the scalp, eyebrows, and face, and sometimes trunk.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nevus flammeus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital vascular malformation consisting of superficial and deep dilated capillaries in the skin which produce a reddish to purplish discolouration of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:22483320]"}

name: Erysipelas
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to erysipelas, as manifested by a medical history of repeated episodes of erysipelas, which is a superficial infection of the skin, typically involving the lymphatic system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Milia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of multiple small cysts containing keratin (skin protein) and presenting as tiny pearly-white bumps just under the surface of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia cutis congenita
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect resulting in the congenital absence of skin in multiple or solitary non-inflammatory, well-demarcated, oval or circular ulcers with a diameter of about 1 to 2 cm. Aplasia cutis congenita most commonly occurs on the scalp, but may present in the face, trunk, or limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Poor wound healing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced ability to heal cutaneous wounds.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pterygium
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pterygia are 'winglike' triangular membranes occurring in the neck, eyes, knees, elbows, ankles or digits.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Axillary pterygium
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of a cutaneous membrane (flap) in the armpit.\" []"}

name: Acne
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A skin condition in which there is an increase in sebum secretion by the pilosebaceous apparatus associated with open comedones (blackheads), closed comedones (whiteheads), and pustular nodules (papules, pustules, and cysts).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Atypical nevus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A large pigmented lesion measuring 5-15 mm in diameter with irregular, notched, and ill defined border and with color that may range from tan to dark brown to pink.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acrocyanosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bluish discoloration of the skin of the hands or feet.\" [PMID:32644593]"}

name: Striae distensae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thinned, erythematous, depressed bands of atrophic skin. Initially, striae appear as flattened and thinned, pinkish linear regions of the skin. Striae tend to enlarge in length and become reddish or purplish. Later, striae tend to appear as white, depressed bands that are parallel to the lines of skin tension. Striae distensae occur most often in areas that have been subject to distension such as the lower back, buttocks, thighs, breast, abdomen, and shoulders.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Neurofibroma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor that generally appears as a soft, skin-colored papule or small subcutaneous nodule. Individuals with neurofibromatosis can have numerous neurofibromas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:30969529]"}

name: Angiokeratoma corporis diffusum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Angiokeratoma corporis diffusum (ACD) is typically characterized by innumerable small red to black papules which occur in clusters and are situated symmetrically in the bathing trunks area. The number of lesions and the extension of the body increase steadily with time so that generalization and mucosal involvement are common. The single lesion begins with a minute reddish papule which enlarges to up to 10 mm in diameter, becomes dark red to black with a discrete keratotic overgrowth. Histologically, the papules are characterized by superficial dilated capillaries in papillary dermis with epidermal proliferation.\" []"}

name: Atypical nevi in non-sun exposed areas
Atrophic scars
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Scars that form a depression compared to the level of the surrounding skin because of damage to the collagen, fat or other tissues below the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cholelithiasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hard, pebble-like deposits that form within the gallbladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cholecystitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inflammatory changes in the gallbladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopia lentis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dislocation or malposition of the crystalline lens of the eye. A partial displacement (or dislocation) of the lens is described as a subluxation of the lens, while a complete displacement is termed luxation of the lens. A complete displacement occurs if the lens is completely outside the patellar fossa of the lens, either in the anterior chamber, in the vitreous, or directly on the retina. If the lens is partially displaced but still contained within the lens space, then it is termed subluxation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Corneal arcus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hazy, grayish-white ring about 2 mm in width located close to but separated from the limbus (the corneoscleral junction). Corneal arcus generally occurs bilaterally, and is related to lipid deposition in the cornea. Corneal arcus can occur in elderly persons as a part of the aging process but may be associated with hypercholesterolemia in people under the age of 50 years.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Papilledema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Papilledema refers to edema (swelling) of the optic disc secondary to any factor which increases cerebral spinal fluid pressure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Developmental glaucoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Glaucoma which forms during the early years of a child's life is called developmental or congenital glaucoma.\" []"}

name: Brushfield spots
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of whitish spots in a ring-like arrangement at the periphery of the iris.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent lacrimal punctum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"No identifiable superior and/or inferior lacrimal punctum.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Optic nerve dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of developmental dysplasia of the optic nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Iridocyclitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of anterior uveitis, in which there is Inflammation of the iris and the ciliary body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypertensive retinopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Condition of the retina, secondary to severe systemic arterial hypertension which can be acute or longstanding. Features include one or several of the following: retinal vascular tortuosity, arteriovenous crossing signs, retinal cotton wool spot and intraretinal hemorrhages. It can be associated with optic disc swelling.\" [PMID:36196693]"}

name: Keratoconjunctivitis sicca
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dryness of the eye related to deficiency of the tear film components (aqueous, mucin, or lipid), lid surface abnormalities, or epithelial abnormalities. Keratoconjunctivitis sicca often results in a scratchy or sandy sensation (foreign body sensation) in the eyes, and may also be associated with itching, inability to produce tears, photosensitivity, redness, pain, and difficulty in moving the eyelids.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal fundus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the fundus of the eye.\" []"}

name: Atrophic fundus lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Well-defined or diffused area or lesion of loss of normal retinal tissue; this is often illustrated by greyish discoloration of fundus and/or better visible choroidal vasculature on funduscopy.\" []"}

name: Heterochromia iridis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Heterochromia iridis is a difference in the color of the iris in the two eyes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Angioid streaks
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Irregular lines in the outer retina and Bruch membrane that are typically configured in a radiating fashion and emanate from the optic disc. Angioid streaks are crack-like dehiscences in abnormally thickened and calcified Bruch membrane, resulting in atrophy of the overlying retinal pigment epithelium. They may be associated with a number of endocrine, metabolic, and connective tissue abnormalities but can be idiopathic. They can be associated with neovascular complexes (choroid).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:30844178]"}

name: Abnormal macular morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the macula, a region that, in a clinical context, is typically used to describe the central part of the retina within the vascular arcades.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16255686]"}

name: Retinal atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and neurosensory retinal cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Periorbital hyperpigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased pigmentation of the skin in the region surrounding the orbit of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ocular albinism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation (reduced or absent) of the iris and retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Leber optic atrophy
