extra_json: {"definition": "\"Degeneration of retinal ganglion cells and their axons.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Xanthelasma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of xanthomata in the skin of the eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Posterior polar cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A polar cataract that affects the posterior pole of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macular pseudocoloboma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A so-called macular coloboma is characterized by a sharply defined, usually excavated, area without neuroretina and RPE tissues in the central area of the fundus. This lesion is not related to classical colobomas associated with optic fissure closure defects.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592, PMID:15069441, PMID:36682978]"}

name: Sudden loss of visual acuity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severe loss of visual acuity within hours or days. This is characteristic of Leber hereditary optic neuropathy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Juvenile cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cataract that is not apparent at birth but that arises in childhood or adolescence.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Keratoglobus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limbus-to-limbus corneal thinning, often greatest in the periphery, with globular protrusion of the cornea.\" [PMID:19667340]"}

name: Abnormality of corneal size
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the size or morphology of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Transient unilateral blurring of vision
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Transient blurring of vision associated with the aura phase of migraine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cryptophthalmos
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cryptophthalmos is a condition of total absence of eyelids and the skin of forehead is continuous with that of cheek, in which the eyeball is completely concealed by the skin, which is stretched over the orbital cavity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125427]"}

name: Trichiasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inversion and rubbing of the eyelashes against the globe of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Corneal dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term corneal dystrophy embraces a heterogenous group of bilateral genetically determined non-inflammatory corneal diseases that are restricted to the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lens subluxation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial dislocation of the lens of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Constriction of peripheral visual field
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An absolute or relative decrease in retinal sensitivity extending from edge (periphery) of the visual field in a concentric pattern. The visual field is the area that is perceived simultaneously by a fixating eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Anterior polar cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A polar cataract that affects the anterior pole of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal arteriolar tortuosity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the retinal arterioles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Alternating esotropia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Esotropia in which either eye may be used for fixation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Limbal dermoid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign tumor typically found at the junction of the cornea and sclera (limbal epibullar dermoid).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Severely reduced visual acuity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severe reduction of the ability to see. On the 6m visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 6/60 but at least 3/60. On the 20ft visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 20/200 but at least 20/400. On the decimal visual acuity scale, severe reduction is defined as less than 0.1 but at least 0.05.\" [PMID:28779882]"}

name: Lenticonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A conical projection of the anterior or posterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Orbital cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of a cyst in the region of the periorbital tissues. Orbital cysts can be derived from epithelial or glandular tissue within or surrounding the orbit (lacrimal glands, salivary glands, conjunctival, oral, nasal, or sinus epithelium).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal exudate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Yellow-white intraretinal deposits in the retina typically associated with damaged inner blood-retina barrier and exudation of serous fluid and lipids from the retinal microvasculature.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lattice corneal dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of fine, branching linear opacities in Bowman's layer in the central area that may spread to the periphery in the clinical course. The deep corneal stroma may be involved but the process does not reach Descemet's membrane. Recurrent corneal erosion may occur. Histologic examination reveals amyloid deposits in the collagen fibers of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired horizontal smooth pursuit
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of ocular smooth pursuit characterized by an impairment of the ability to track horizontally moving objects.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Saccadic smooth pursuit interruptions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of tracking eye movements in which smooth pursuit is interrupted by an abnormally high number of saccadic movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Septate vagina
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a vaginal septum, thereby creating a vaginal duplication. The septum is longitudinal in the majority of cases.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the hand
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality affecting one or both hands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Brachydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Digits that appear disproportionately short compared to the hand/foot. The word brachydactyly is used here to describe a series distinct patterns of shortened digits (brachydactyly types A-E). This is the sense used here.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Webbing or fusion of the fingers or toes, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as \\\"bony\\\" syndactyly if the fusion occurs in a radio-ulnar axis. Fusions of bones of the fingers or toes in a proximo-distal axis are referred to as \\\"symphalangism\\\".\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hand polydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of polydactyly characterized by the presence of a supernumerary finger or fingers.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Postaxial hand polydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Supernumerary digits located at the ulnar side of the hand (that is, on the side with the fifth finger).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Broad palm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"For children from birth to 4 years of age the palm width is more than 2 SD above the mean; for children from 4 to 16 years of age the palm width is above the 95th centile; or, the width of the palm appears disproportionately wide for the length.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Split hand
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which middle parts of the hand (fingers and metacarpals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. The severity is very variable ranging from slightly hypoplastic middle fingers over absent middle fingers as far as oligo- or monodactyl hands.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Abnormal thumb morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal structure of the first digit of the hand.\" []"}

name: Preaxial hand polydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Supernumerary digits located at the radial side of the hand. Polydactyly (supernumerary digits) involving the thumb occurs in many distinct forms of high variability and severity. Ranging from fleshy nubbins over varying degrees of partial duplication/splitting to completely duplicated or even triplicated thumbs or preaxial (on the radial side of the hand) supernumerary digits.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ulnar claw
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal hand position characterized by hyperextension of the fourth and fifth fingers at the metacarpophalangeal joints and flexion of the interphalangeal joints of the same fingers such that they are curled towards the palm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Adducted thumb
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In the resting position, the tip of the thumb is on, or near, the palm, close to the base of the fourth or fifth finger.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:16235349, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Tapered finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The gradual reduction in girth of the finger from proximal to distal.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Hyperextensibility of the finger joints
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The ability of the finger joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hand clenching
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal hand posture in which the hands are clenched to fists. All digits held completely flexed at the metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints. In prenatal sonography of the fetal clenched hand, the index finger overlaps a clenched fist formed by the other digits. The proximal interphalangeal articulation of the index finger is flexed and ulnarly deviated, and the thumb is adducted.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:10085502, PMID:16702456, PMID:27638597]"}

name: Abnormal carpal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality affecting the carpal bones of the wrist (scaphoid, lunate, triquetral, pisiform, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ulnar deviation of the hand or of fingers of the hand
Abnormalities of placenta or umbilical cord
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the placenta (the organ that connects the developing fetus to the uterine wall) or of the umbilical cord (the cord that connects the fetus to the placenta).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Single umbilical artery
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Single umbilical artery (SUA) is the absence of one of the two umbilical arteries surrounding the fetal bladder and in the fetal umbilical cord.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of prenatal development or birth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the fetus or the birth of the fetus, excluding structural abnormalities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Triphalangeal thumb
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A thumb with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis. Thus, this term applies if the thumb has an accessory phalanx, leading to a digit like appearance of the thumb.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Distal finger symphalangism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term distal symphalangism refers to a bony fusion of the distal and middle phalanges of the digits of the hand, in other words the distal interphalangeal joint (DIJ) is missing which can be seen either on x-rays or as an absence of the distal interphalangeal finger creases.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Abnormal fingertip morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal structure of the tip (end) of a finger.\" []"}

name: Prominent fingertip pads
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue prominence of the ventral aspects of the fingertips. The term \\\"persistent fetal fingertip pads\\\" is often used as a synonym, but should better not be used because it implies knowledge of history of the patient which often does not exist.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Camptodactyly of 2nd-5th fingers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The distal interphalangeal joint and/or the proximal interphalangeal joint of the second to fifth fingers cannot be extended to 180 degrees by either active or passive extension.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Delayed ossification of carpal bones
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ossification of carpal bones occurs later than age-adjusted norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Clubbing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Broadening of the soft tissues (non-edematous swelling of soft tissues) of the digital tips in all dimensions associated with an increased longitudinal and lateral curvature of the nails.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Autoamputation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Auto-amputation is the spontaneous detachment of an appendage from the body due to long standing pathology.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:31633102]"}

name: Interphalangeal joint contracture of finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Chronic loss of joint motion in an interphalangeal joint of a finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pointed proximal second through fifth metacarpals
extra_json: {"definition": "\"All of the metacarpal bones of the hand have a pointed proximal appearance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the thenar eminence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the thenar eminence, i.e., of the muscle on the palm of the human hand just beneath the thumb.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nail bed telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Telangiectases in the area of the nails.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: 2-3 finger cutaneous syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second to the third fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Hitchhiker thumb
extra_json: {"definition": "\"With the hand relaxed and the thumb in the plane of the palm, the axis of the thumb forms an angle of at least 90 degrees with the long axis of the hand.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Slender finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fingers that are disproportionately narrow (reduced girth) for the hand/foot size or build of the individual.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Wrist flexion contracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A chronic loss of wrist joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevent normal movement of the joints of the wrist.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Small thenar eminence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the thenar eminence with reduced palmar soft tissue mass surrounding the base of the thumb.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Short tubular bones of the hand
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased length of the tubular bones of the hand, that is, the phalanges and metacarpals.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intellectual disability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term intellectual disability or intellectual developmental disorder is used to describe significantly sub-average intellectual and adaptive functioning based on clinical assessment and as measured by individually administered, appropriately normed, standardized and validated tests of intellectual functioning and adaptive behavior, with onset during the developmental period from infancy through adolescence.\" [PMID:31292035, PMID:32206581, PMID:36975277]"}

name: Seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A seizure is an intermittent abnormality of nervous system physiology characterized by a transient occurrence of signs and/or symptoms due to abnormal excessive or synchronous neuronal activity in the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15816939]"}

name: Ataxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ataxia refers to impaired coordination of voluntary muscle movement. Cerebellar ataxia refers to ataxia due to dysfunction of the cerebellum. This causes a variety of elementary neurological deficits including asynergy (lack of coordination between muscles, limbs and joints), dysmetria (lack of ability to judge distances that can lead to under- or overshoot in grasping movements), and dysdiadochokinesia (inability to perform rapid movements requiring antagonizing muscle groups to be switched on and off repeatedly).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypotonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypotonia is an abnormally low muscle tone (the amount of tension or resistance to movement in a muscle). Even when relaxed, muscles have a continuous and passive partial contraction which provides some resistance to passive stretching. Hypotonia thus manifests as diminished resistance to passive stretching. Hypotonia is not the same as muscle weakness, although the two conditions can co-exist.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21418198]"}

name: Lethargy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A state of fatigue, either physical or mental slowness and sluggishness, with difficulties in initiating or performing simple tasks. Distinguished from apathy which implies indifference and a lack of desire or interest in the task. A person with lethargy may have the desire, but not the energy to engage in personal or socially relevant tasks.\" []"}

name: Mild intellectual disability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mild intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by mildly sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 50-69.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spasticity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A motor disorder characterized by a velocity-dependent increase in tonic stretch reflexes with increased muscle tone, exaggerated (hyperexcitable) tendon reflexes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spastic paraplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete loss of the ability to move the lower limbs accompanied by spasticity of the lower limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19277459]"}

name: Coma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The complete absence of wakefulness and consciousness, which is evident through a lack of response to any form of external stimuli.\" [PMID:33218655]"}

name: Dysarthria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dysarthric speech is a general description referring to a neurological speech disorder characterized by poor articulation. Depending on the involved neurological structures, dysarthria may be further classified as spastic, flaccid, ataxic, hyperkinetic and hypokinetic, or mixed.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Excessive daytime somnolence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A state of abnormally strong desire for sleep during the daytime.\" [PMID:32901432]"}

name: Global developmental delay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child, including motor skills, speech and language, cognitive skills, and social and emotional skills. This term should only be used to describe children younger than five years of age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Spastic diplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spasticity (neuromuscular hypertonia) primarily in the muscles of the legs, hips, and pelvis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyporeflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction of neurologic reflexes such as the knee-jerk reaction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Choreoathetosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Involuntary movements characterized by both athetosis (inability to sustain muscles in a fixed position) and chorea (widespread jerky arrhythmic movements).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mental deterioration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of previously present mental abilities, generally in adults.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemiparesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of strength in the arm, leg, and sometimes face on one side of the body. Hemiplegia refers to a complete loss of strength, whereas hemiparesis refers to an incomplete loss of strength.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UKB_tklockgether, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Motor delay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of Developmental delay characterized by a delay in acquiring motor skills.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebellar atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cerebellar atrophy is defined as a cerebellum with initially normal structures, in a posterior fossa with normal size, which displays enlarged fissures (interfolial spaces) in comparison to the foliae secondary to loss of tissue. Cerebellar atrophy implies irreversible loss of tissue and result from an ongoing progressive disease until a final stage is reached or a single injury, e.g. an intoxication or infectious event.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12169461, PMID:26331051]"}

name: Agenesis of corpus callosum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the corpus callosum as a result of the failure of the corpus callosum to develop, which can be the result of a failure in any one of the multiple steps of callosal development including cellular proliferation and migration, axonal growth or glial patterning at the midline.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypertonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which there is increased muscle tone so that arms or legs, for example, are stiff and difficult to move.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Orthostatic hypotension
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hypotension characterized by a sudden fall in blood pressure that occurs when a person assumes a standing position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Syncope
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A transient loss of consciousness (i.e., characterized by a rapid onset, a short duration, and a spontaneous and complete recovery) due to cerebral hypoperfusion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:29255499]"}

name: Tetany
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition characterized by intermittent involuntary contraction of muscles (spasms) related to hypocalcemia or occasionally magnesium deficiency.\" []"}

name: Bulbar palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bulbar weakness (or bulbar palsy) refers to bilateral impairment of function of the lower cranial nerves IX, X, XI and XII, which occurs due to lower motor neuron lesion either at nuclear or fascicular level in the medulla or from bilateral lesions of the lower cranial nerves outside the brain-stem. Bulbar weakness is often associated with difficulty in chewing, weakness of the facial muscles, dysarthria, palatal weakness and regurgitation of fluids, dysphagia, and dysphonia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Areflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of neurologic reflexes such as the knee-jerk reaction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gait disturbance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term gait disturbance can refer to any disruption of the ability to walk.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27770207]"}

name: Confusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of clarity and coherence of thought, perception, understanding, or action.\" []"}

name: Abnormal cranial nerve morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Structural abnormality affecting one or more of the cranial nerves, which emerge directly from the brain stem.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Stroke
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden impairment of blood flow to a part of the brain due to occlusion or rupture of an artery to the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Encephalopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Encephalopathy is a term that means brain disease, damage, or malfunction. In general, encephalopathy is manifested by an altered mental state.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:KI_phemming, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Parkinsonism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Characteristic neurologic anomaly resulting from degeneration of dopamine-generating cells in the substantia nigra, a region of the midbrain, characterized clinically by shaking, rigidity, slowness of movement and difficulty with walking and gait.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pachygyria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pachygyria is a malformation of cortical development with abnormally wide gyri with sulci 1,5-3 cm apart and abnormally thick cortex measuring more than 5 mm (radiological definition). See also neuropathological definitions for 2-, 3-, and 4-layered lissencephaly.\" [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22427329]"}

name: Torsion dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sustained involuntary muscle contractions that produce twisting and repetitive movements of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dandy-Walker malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital brain malformation typically characterized by incomplete formation of the cerebellar vermis, dilation of the fourth ventricle, and enlargement of the posterior fossa. In layman's terms, Dandy Walker malformation is a cyst in the cerebellum (typically symmetrical) that is involved with the fourth ventricle. This may interfere with the ability to drain cerebrospinal fluid from the brain, resulting in hydrocephalus. Dandy Walker cysts are formed during early embryonic development, while the brain forms. The cyst in the cerebellum typically has several blood vessels running through it connecting to the brain, thereby prohibiting surgical removal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26246090]"}

name: Tongue fasciculations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fasciculations or fibrillation affecting the tongue muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dysmetria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of ataxia characterized by the inability to carry out movements with the correct range and motion across the plane of more than one joint related to incorrect estimation of the distances required for targeted movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal nervous system electrophysiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the function of the electrical signals with which nerve cells communicate with each other or with muscles as measured by electrophysiological investigations.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Giant somatosensory evoked potentials
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal enlargement (i.e. increase in measured voltage) of somatosensory evoked potentials.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Diminished deep tendon reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction (hyporeflexia) or complete absence (areflexia) of the involuntary muscle contraction normally elicited by a reflex stimulus, such as tapping a deep tendon.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20941667]"}

name: Abnormal cerebellum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the cerebellum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27160001]"}

name: Neonatal hypotonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Muscular hypotonia (abnormally low muscle tone) manifesting in the neonatal period.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebellar hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cerebellar hypoplasia is a descriptive term implying a cerebellum with a reduced volume, but a normal shape and is stable over time.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26331051, PMID:27160001]"}

name: EEG with irregular generalized spike and wave complexes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"EEG shows spikes (<80 ms) and waves, which are recorded over the entire scalp and do not have a specific frequency.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Photosensitive myoclonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Generalised myoclonic seizure provoked by flashing or flickering light.\" [PMID:28276060]"}

name: Specific learning disability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impairment of certain skills such as reading or writing, coordination, self-control, or attention that interfere with the ability to learn. The impairment is not related to a global deficiency of intelligence.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent septum pellucidum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the septum pellucidum (meaning translucent wall in Latin - SP), also known as the ventricle of Sylvius. The septum pellucidum is a thin, triangular double membrane separating the frontal horns of the right and left lateral ventricles of the brain. It extends between the anterior portion of the corpus callosum, and the body of the fornix and its width varies from 1.5 to 3.0 mm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:30725733]"}

name: Dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased muscular tone that causes fixed abnormal postures. There is a slow, intermittent twisting motion that leads to exaggerated turning and posture of the extremities and trunk.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Communicating hydrocephalus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hydrocephalus in which there is no visible obstruction to the flow of the cerebrospinal fluid between the ventricles and subarachnoid space.\" [eMedicine:1135286, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bimanual synkinesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Involuntary movements of one hand that accompany and mirror intentional movements of the opposite hand.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22412265, PMID:28945198]"}

name: Myoclonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Very brief, involuntary random muscular contractions occurring at rest, in response to sensory stimuli, or accompanying voluntary movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20589866]"}

name: Tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unintentional, oscillating to-and-fro muscle movement about a joint axis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16344298, PMID:20589866]"}

name: Partial agenesis of the corpus callosum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A partial failure of the development of the corpus callosum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lissencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A spectrum of malformations of cortical development caused by insufficient neuronal migration that subsumes the terms agyria, pachygyria and subcortical band heterotopia. See also neuropathological definitions for 2-, 3-, and 4-layered lissencephaly.\" [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28440899]"}

name: Enhancement of the C-reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in amplitude of a long-loop response upon somatosensory evoked potential testing, representing an electrically evoked myoclonic response.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:4819909]"}

name: Cerebral hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemorrhage into the parenchyma of the brain.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti]"}

name: Kernicterus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Damage to cerebral nuclei caused in infants by highly increased levels of unconjugated bilirubin. The basal ganglia and brainstem nuclei could be shown to have a yellow staining historically in infants who died of kernicterus, that is, kernicterus is strictly speaking a pathological diagnosis. The presence of kernicterus may be inferred in infants with characteristic acute or chronic bilirubin-induced neurological dysfunction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent speech
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete lack of development of speech and language abilities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Psychotic mentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pattern of thinking and perceiving characterized by a loss of contact with reality, leading to significant changes in thoughts, perceptions, and behaviors.\" []"}

name: Hyperreflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperreflexia is the presence of hyperactive stretch reflexes of the muscles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Brisk reflexes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tendon reflexes that are noticeably more active than usual (conventionally denoted 3+ on clinical examination). Brisk reflexes may or may not indicate a neurological lesion. They are distinguished from hyperreflexia by the fact that hyerreflexia is characterized by hyperactive repeating (clonic) reflexes, which are considered to be always abnormal.\" []"}

name: Facial diplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Facial diplegia refers to bilateral facial palsy (bilateral facial palsy is much rarer than unilateral facial palsy).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Slurred speech
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal coordination of muscles involved in speech.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9102-5232]"}

name: Jerk-locked premyoclonus spikes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Jerk-locked averaging (JLA) is used to record the timing and distribution of brain activity preceding brisk involuntary movements such as those observed in patients with myoclonus. JLA is capable of revealing a premyoclonus spike in the absence of paroxysmal activity in the routine EEG.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:1464676, PMID:30653168]"}

name: Megalencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Diffuse enlargement of the entire cerebral hemispheres leading to macrocephaly (with or without overlying cortical dysplasia).\" [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28658095, PMID:29594439]"}

name: Plagiocephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Asymmetric head shape, which is usually a combination of unilateral occipital flattening with ipsilateral frontal prominence, leading to rhomboid cranial shape.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Holoprosencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Holoprosencephaly is a structural anomaly of the brain in which the developing forebrain fails to divide into two separate hemispheres and ventricles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nystagmus-induced head nodding
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Head movements associated with nystagmus, that may represent an attempt to compensate for the involuntary eye movements and to improve vision.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Calvarial skull defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A localized defect in the bone of the skull resulting from abnormal embryological development. The defect is covered by normal skin. In some cases, skull x-rays have shown underlying lytic bone lesions which have closed before the age of one year.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Craniosynostosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Craniosynostosis refers to the premature closure of the cranial sutures. Primary craniosynostosis refers to the closure of one or more sutures due to abnormalities in skull development, and secondary craniosynostosis results from failure of brain growth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal joint morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal structure or form of the joints, i.e., one or more of the articulations where two bones join.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Rheumatoid arthritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammatory changes in the synovial membranes and articular structures with widespread fibrinoid degeneration of the collagen fibers in mesenchymal tissues, as well as atrophy and rarefaction of bony structures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Flexion contracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A flexion contracture is a bent (flexed) joint that cannot be straightened actively or passively. It is thus a chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in muscle, tendons, ligaments, or skin that prevents normal movement of joints.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Limitation of joint mobility
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the freedom of movement of one or more joints.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Limited elbow extension
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limited ability to straighten the arm at the elbow joint.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Joint hypermobility
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The capability that a joint (or a group of joints) has to move, passively and/or actively, beyond normal limits along physiological axes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28145606]"}

name: Hip dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of developmental dysplasia of the hip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Joint stiffness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Joint stiffness is a perceived sensation of tightness in a joint or joints when attempting to move them after a period of inactivity. Joint stiffness typically subsides over time.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cirrhosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A chronic disorder of the liver in which liver tissue becomes scarred and is partially replaced by regenerative nodules and fibrotic tissue resulting in loss of liver function.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hepatic fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of excessive fibrous connective tissue in the liver. Fibrosis is a reparative or reactive process.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cholestasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impairment of bile flow due to obstruction in bile ducts.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hepatic steatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Steatosis is a term used to denote lipid accumulation within hepatocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:31603713]"}

name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of neoplasm of the liver that originates in hepatocytes and presents macroscopically as a soft and hemorrhagic tan mass in the liver.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macrovesicular hepatic steatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hepatic steatosis characterized by the presence of large, lipid-laden vesicles in the affected hepatocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Periportal fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of fibrosis affecting the interlobular stroma of liver.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intrahepatic cholestasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impairment of bile flow due to obstruction in the small bile ducts within the liver.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased liver function
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability of the liver to perform its functions.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enteroviral hepatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the liver due to infection with enterovirus.\" [PMID:15056237]"}

name: Micronodular cirrhosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cirrhosis characterized by the presence of small regenerative nodules.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Microvesicular hepatic steatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hepatic steatosis characterized by the presence of small, lipid-laden vesicles in the affected hepatocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: X-linked inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that is observed for traits related to a gene encoded on the X chromosome.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: X-linked recessive inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that is observed for recessive traits related to a gene encoded on the X chromosome. In the context of medical genetics, X-linked recessive disorders manifest in males (who have one copy of the X chromosome and are thus hemizygotes), but generally not in female heterozygotes who have one mutant and one normal allele.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the musculature of the hand
X-linked dominant inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that is observed for dominant traits related to a gene encoded on the X chromosome. In the context of medical genetics, X-linked dominant disorders tend to manifest very severely in affected males. The severity of manifestation in females may depend on the degree of skewed X inactivation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Non-Mendelian inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that depends on genetic determinants in more than one gene.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mitochondrial inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that is observed for traits related to a gene encoded on the mitochondrial genome. Because the mitochondrial genome is essentially always maternally inherited, a mitochondrial condition can only be transmitted by females, although the condition can affect both sexes. The proportion of mutant mitochondria can vary (heteroplasmy).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hepatosplenomegaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Simultaneous enlargement of the liver and spleen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the shoulder girdle musculature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural or functional anomaly of the shoulder girdle, which which connects the upper limb to the axial skeleton via the sternoclavicular joint.\" [PMID:30725618]"}

name: Abnormality of the foot musculature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the musculature of foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the musculature of the lower limbs
Abnormal abdomen morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the abdomen ('belly'), that is, the part of the body between the pelvis and the thorax.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Typified by somatic mosaicism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Description of conditions in which affected individuals typically display somatic mosaicism, i.e., genetically distinct populations of somatic cells in a given organism caused by DNA mutations, epigenetic alterations of DNA, chromosomal abnormalities or the spontaneous reversion of inherited mutations. In many conditions typified by somatic mosaicism, constitutive mutation is lethal and cases are exclusively or predominantly mosaic.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12360233]"}

name: Abnormality of the musculature of the upper limbs
Y-linked inheritance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mode of inheritance that is observed for traits related to a gene encoded on the Y chromosome.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the musculature of the upper arm
1-3 toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syndactyly with fusion of toes one to three.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the shoulder musculature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the muscles of the shoulder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Contiguous gene syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A syndrome caused by the effects of abnormality (typically a deletion or duplication) of 2 or more adjacent genes\" []"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the musculature of the upper limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the musculature of the upper limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the musculature of the upper arm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the muscles of the upper arm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal morphology of the pelvis musculature
Sex-limited expression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sex limitation is used to refer to a monogenic trait linked to an autosomal locus in which the phenotypic effects of allelic differences are expressed only in one sex.\" []"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the musculature of the pelvis
Sclerotic scapulae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased density of the bony tissue of the scapula.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Male-limited expression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Used to refer to a monogenic trait linked to an autosomal locus in which the phenotypic effects of allelic differences are expressed only in the male sex.\" []"}

name: Delayed closure of the anterior fontanelle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A delay in closure (ossification) of the anterior fontanelle, which generally undergoes closure around the 18th month of life.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Compensatory chin elevation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tendency to hold the chin elevated by about 20 to 30 degrees to compensate for a limitation of eye movement.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Freckling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased number of freckles, small circular spots on the skin that are darker than the surrounding skin because of deposits of melanin.\" []"}

name: Subcutaneous nodule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Slightly elevated lesions on or in the skin with a diameter of over 5 mm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Eye poking
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repetitive pressing, poking, and/or rubbing in the eyes.\" [PMID:8157154]"}

name: Posterior vitreous detachment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Separation of the vitreous humor from the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24376338]"}

name: Congenital fibrosis of extraocular muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital non-progressive ophthalmoplegia with multiple extraocular muscle restrictions. Typically, there is ptosis and variable degrees of restriction of horizontal and vertical eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Axenfeld anomaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Axenfeld's anomaly is a bilateral disorder characterized by a prominent, anteriorly displaced Schwalbe's line (posterior embryotoxon) and peripheral iris strands which span the anterior chamber angle to attach to Schwalbe's line.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Falciform retinal fold
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An area of the retina that is buckled so that a sector-shaped sheet of retina lies in front of the normal retina. This feature is of congenital onset.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Carpal bone hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of one or more carpal bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Broad finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased width of a non-thumb digit of the hand.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Failure to thrive
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure to thrive (FTT) refers to a child whose physical growth is substantially below the norm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Growth delay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deficiency or slowing down of growth pre- and postnatally.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intrauterine growth retardation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal restriction of fetal growth with fetal weight below the tenth percentile for gestational age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Small for gestational age
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Smaller than normal size according to sex and gestational age related norms, defined as a weight below the 10th percentile for the gestational age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Disproportionate tall stature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tall and slim body build with increased arm span to height ratio (>1.05) and a reduced upper-to-lower segment ratio (<0.85), i.e., unusually long arms and legs. The extremities as well as the hands and feet are unusually slim.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Large for gestational age
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term large for gestational age applies to babies whose birth weight lies above the 90th percentile for that gestational age.\" [eMedicine:262679, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Death in infancy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Death within the first 24 months of life.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemihypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Overgrowth of only one side of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mild postnatal growth retardation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mild degree of slow or limited growth after birth, being between two and three standard deviations below age- and sex-related norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Slender build
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Asthenic habitus refers to a slender build with long limbs, an angular profile, and prominent muscles or bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Umbilical hernia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Protrusion of abdominal contents through a defect in the abdominal wall musculature around the umbilicus. Skin and subcutaneous tissue overlie the defect.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Protuberant abdomen
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A thrusting or bulging out of the abdomen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Omphalocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A midline anterior incomplete closure of the abdominal wall in which there is herniation of the abdominal viscera into the base of the abdominal cord.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Diastasis recti
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation of the rectus abdominis muscle into right and left halves (which are normally joined at the midline at the linea alba).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ascites
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of fluid in the peritoneal cavity (between the layers of the peritoneum that lines the abdomen).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gastroschisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of congenital ventral incomplete closure of the abdominal wall in which the intestines and sometimes other organs extend freely into the amniotic fluid space through a small opening in the abdomen, usually to the right of the umbilicus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal rib cage morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A morphological anomaly of the rib cage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Overgrowth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive postnatal growth which may comprise increased weight, increased length, and/or increased head circumference.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal umbilicus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the structure or appearance of the umbilicus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Barrel-shaped chest
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A rounded, bulging chest that resembles the shape of a barrel. That is, there is an increased anteroposterior diameter and usually some degree of kyphosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Asymmetry of the thorax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of symmetry between the left and right halves of the thorax.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased fetal movement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in quantity or strength of fetal movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the amniotic fluid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the amniotic fluid, which is the fluid contained in the amniotic sac surrounding the developing fetus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Polyhydramnios
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of excess amniotic fluid in the uterus during pregnancy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fetal polyuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased production of urine by the fetus resulting in polyhydramnios.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21460147]"}

name: Widely-spaced maxillary central incisors
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased distance between the maxillary central permanent incisor tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Macrodontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased size of the teeth, which can be defined as a mesiodistal tooth diameter (width) more than 2 SD above mean for age. Alternatively, an apparently increased maximum width of the tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:19125428]"}

name: Abnormality of the integument
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the integument, which consists of the skin and the superficial fascia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Primary hypercortisolism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypercortisolemia associated with a primary defect of the adrenal gland leading to overproduction of cortisol.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent skin infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infections of the skin that happen multiple times.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Redundant skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loose and sagging skin often associated with loss of skin elasticity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Rotary nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of nystagmus in which the eyeball makes rotary motions around the axis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vesicovaginal fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a fistula connecting the urinary bladder to the vagina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bell-shaped thorax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The rib cage has the shape of a wide mouthed bell. That is, the superior portion of the rib cage is constricted, followed by a convex region, and the inferior portion of the rib cage expands again to have a large diameter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Selective tooth agenesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Agenesis of some but not all teeth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:40428404]"}

name: Maxillary lateral incisor microdontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased size of the maxillary permanent incisor.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Alopecia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A noncongenital process of hair loss, which may progress to partial or complete baldness.\" [PMID:14676077]"}

name: Abnormal nail morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal structure or appearance of the nail.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Concave nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The natural longitudinal (posterodistal) convex arch is not present or is inverted.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Laryngomalacia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Laryngomalacia is a congenital abnormality of the laryngeal cartilage in which the cartilage is floppy and prolapses over the larynx during inspiration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Laryngeal stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stricture or narrowing of the larynx that may be associated with symptoms of respiratory difficulty depending on the degree of laryngeal narrowing.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vocal cord paralysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A loss of the ability to move the vocal folds.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hoarse voice
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hoarseness refers to a change in the pitch or quality of the voice, with the voice sounding weak, very breathy, scratchy, or husky.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypernasal speech
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of speech characterized by the presence of an abnormally increased nasal airflow during speech associated with structural abnormality of the nasal passages.\" []"}

name: Dysphonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty in speaking due to a physical disorder of the mouth, tongue, throat, or vocal cords. Associated with a known physical or neurological cause.\" []"}

name: Abnormally high-pitched voice
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A persistent (minutes to hours) abnormal increase in the pitch (frequency) of the voice for the context or social situation or significantly different from baseline of the individual.\" []"}

name: Premature birth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The birth of a baby of less than 37 weeks of gestational age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Breech presentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A position of the fetus at delivery in which the fetus enters the birth canal with the buttocks or feet first.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ventricular septal defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hole between the two bottom chambers (ventricles) of the heart. The defect is centered around the most superior aspect of the ventricular septum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:33327983]"}

name: Atrial septal defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrial septal defect (ASD) is a congenital abnormality of the interatrial septum that enables blood flow between the left and right atria via the interatrial septum.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal mitral valve morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the mitral valve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mitral valve prolapse
extra_json: {"definition": "\"One or both of the leaflets (cusps) of the mitral valve bulges back into the left atrium upon contraction of the left ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Congestive heart failure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormality of cardiac function that is responsible for the failure of the heart to pump blood at a rate that is commensurate with the needs of the tissues or a state in which abnormally elevated filling pressures are required for the heart to do so. Heart failure is frequently related to a defect in myocardial contraction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tetralogy of Fallot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital cardiac malformation comprising pulmonary stenosis, overriding aorta, ventricular septum defect, and right ventricular hypertrophy. The diagnosis of TOF is made if at least three of the four above mentioned features are present.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal myocardium morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the muscle layer of the heart wall.\" []"}

name: Cardiomyopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A myocardial disorder in which the heart muscle is structurally and functionally abnormal, in the absence of coronary artery disease, hypertension, valvular disease and congenital heart disease sufficient to cause the observed myocardial abnormality.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17916581]"}

name: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is defined by the presence of increased ventricular wall thickness or mass in the absence of loading conditions (hypertension, valve disease) sufficient to cause the observed abnormality.\" [PMID:17916581]"}

name: Cardiomegaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased size of the heart, clinically defined as an increased transverse diameter of the cardiac silhouette that is greater than or equal to 50% of the transverse diameter of the chest (increased cardiothoracic ratio) on a posterior-anterior projection of a chest radiograph or a computed tomography.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:31194436]"}

name: Abnormal pulmonary valve morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the pulmonary valve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pulmonic stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A narrowing of the right ventricular outflow tract that can occur at the pulmonary valve (valvular stenosis), below the pulmonary valve (infundibular stenosis), or above the pulmonary valve (supravalvar stenosis).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Patent ductus arteriosus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In utero, the ductus arteriosus (DA) serves to divert ventricular output away from the lungs and toward the placenta by connecting the main pulmonary artery to the descending aorta. A patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) in the first 3 days of life is a physiologic shunt in healthy term and preterm newborn infants, and normally is substantially closed within about 24 hours after bith and completely closed after about three weeks. Failure of physiologcal closure is referred to a persistent or patent ductus arteriosus (PDA). Depending on the degree of left-to-right shunting, PDA can have clinical consequences.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20421261]"}

name: Dilated cardiomyopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is defined by the presence of left ventricular dilatation and left ventricular systolic dysfunction in the absence of abnormal loading conditions (hypertension, valve disease) or coronary artery disease sufficient to cause global systolic impairment. Right ventricular dilation and dysfunction may be present but are not necessary for the diagnosis.\" [PMID:17916581]"}

name: Sudden cardiac death
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The heart suddenly and unexpectedly stops beating resulting in death within a short time period (generally within 1 h of symptom onset).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bicuspid aortic valve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an aortic valve with two instead of the normal three cusps (flaps). Bicuspid aortic valvue is a malformation of a commissure (small space between the attachment of each cusp to the aortic wall) and the adjacent parts of the two corresponding cusps forming a raphe (the fused area of the two underdeveloped cusps turning into a malformed commissure between both cusps; the raphe is a fibrous ridge that extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17467434, PMID:24827036]"}

name: Cor pulmonale
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Right-sided heart failure resulting from chronic hypertension in the pulmonary arteries and right ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tachycardia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A rapid heartrate that exceeds the range of the normal resting heartrate for age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aortic valve stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a stenosis (narrowing) of the aortic valve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dextrocardia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The heart is located in the right hand sided hemithorax. That is, there is a left-right reversal (or \\\"mirror reflection\\\") of the anatomical location of the heart in which the heart is locate on the right side instead of the left.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Mitral regurgitation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the mitral valve characterized by insufficiency or incompetence of the mitral valve resulting in retrograde leaking of blood through the mitral valve upon ventricular contraction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal heart valve morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of a cardiac valve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Patent foramen ovale
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of the foramen ovale to seal postnatally, leaving a potential conduit between the left and right cardiac atria.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Prolonged QT interval
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myocardial infarction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Necrosis of the myocardium caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart and often associated with chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations, and anxiety as well as characteristic EKG findings and elevation of serum markers including creatine kinase-MB fraction and troponin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aortic regurgitation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An insufficiency of the aortic valve, leading to regurgitation (backward flow) of blood from the aorta into the left ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Truncus arteriosus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A single arterial trunk arises from the cardiac mass. The pulmonary arteries, aorta and coronary arteries arise from this single trunk with no evidence of another outflow tract.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bradycardia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A slower than normal heart rate (in adults, slower than 60 beats per minute).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ventricular fibrillation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Uncontrolled contractions of muscles fibers in the left ventricle not producing contraction of the left ventricle. Ventricular fibrillation usually begins with a ventricular premature contraction and a short run of rapid ventricular tachycardia degenerating into uncoordinating ventricular fibrillations.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Torsade de pointes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of ventricular tachycardia characterized by polymorphioc QRS complexes that change in amplitue and cycle length, and thus have the appearance of oscillating around the baseline in the EKG.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Right ventricular hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In this case the right ventricle is more muscular than normal, causing a characteristic boot-shaped (coeur-en-sabot) appearance as seen on anterior- posterior chest x-rays. Right ventricular hypertrophy is commonly associated with any form of right ventricular outflow obstruction or pulmonary hypertension, which may in turn owe its origin to left-sided disease. The echocardiographic signs are thickening of the anterior right ventricular wall and the septum. Cavity size is usually normal, or slightly enlarged. In many cases there is associated volume overload present due to tricuspid regurgitation, in the absence of this, septal motion is normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Transposition of the great arteries
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A complex congenital heart defect in which the aorta arises from the morphologic right ventricle and the pulmonary artery arises from the morphologic left ventricle.\" [eMedicine:900574, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10798431]"}

name: Asymmetric septal hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with an asymmetrical pattern of hypertrophy, with a predilection for the interventricular septum and myocyte disarray.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17916581]"}

name: Abnormal cardiac septum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the intra-atrial or intraventricular septum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Complete atrioventricular canal defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital heart defect characterized by a specific combination of heart defects with a common atrioventricular valve, primum atrial septal defect and inlet ventricular septal defect.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16722604]"}

name: Coronary artery atherosclerosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction of the diameter of the coronary arteries as the result of an accumulation of atheromatous plaques within the walls of the coronary arteries, which increases the risk of myocardial ischemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:31420554]"}

name: Atrioventricular block
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed or lack of conduction of atrial depolarizations through the atrioventricular node to the ventricles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Coarctation of aorta
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Coarctation of the aorta is a narrowing or constriction of a segment of the aorta.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23909637]"}

name: Angina pectoris
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paroxysmal chest pain that occurs with exertion or stress and is related to myocardial ischemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Subvalvular aortic stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fixed form of obstruction to blood flow across the left-ventricular outflow tract related to stenosis (narrowing) below the level of the aortic valve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopia cordis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital malformation of the ventral wall with partial or total evisceration of the heart outside the thoracic cavity and through the defect in the ventral wall.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]"}

name: Secundum atrial septal defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of atrial septum defect arising from an enlarged foramen ovale, inadequate growth of the septum secundum, or excessive absorption of the septum primum.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myocardial fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myocardial fibrosis is characterized by dysregulated collagen turnover (increased synthesis predominates over unchanged or decreased degradation) and excessive diffuse collagen accumulation in the interstitial and perivascular spaces as well as by phenotypically transformed fibroblasts, termed myofibroblasts.\" [PMID:28157267]"}

name: Sinus bradycardia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bradycardia related to a mean resting sinus rate of less than 50 beats per minute.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Muscular subvalvular aortic stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of subvalvular aortic stenosis resulting from thickening of the musculature of the interventricular septum, which results in obstruction to blood flow through the left-ventricular outflow tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Atrial arrhythmia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of supraventricular tachycardia in which the atria are the principal site of electrophysiologic disturbance.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]"}

name: Cardiac shunt
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Right-to-left shunt
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pattern of blood flow in the heart that deviates from the normal circuit of the circulatory system from the right side of the heart to the left.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9114-8737]"}

name: Situs inversus totalis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A left-right reversal (or mirror reflection) of the anatomical location of the major thoracic and abdominal organs.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal pericardium morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the pericardium, i.e., of the fluid filled sac that surrounds the heart and the proximal ends of the aorta, vena cava, and the pulmonary artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myocardial necrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Irreversible damage to heart tissue (myocardium) due to lack of oxygen after a heart attack (myocardial infarction).\" [PMID:20405318]"}

name: Pericarditis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the sac-like covering around the heart (pericardium).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal tricuspid valve morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the tricuspid valve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tricuspid valve prolapse
extra_json: {"definition": "\"One or more of the leaflets (cusps) of the tricuspid valve bulges back into the right atrium upon contraction of the right ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Right ventricular outlet tract obstruction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An obstruction to the forward flow of blood in the outflow tract of the right ventricle.\" [PMID:30038501]"}

name: Endocardial fibroelastosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Diffuse thickening of the ventricular endocardium and by associated myocardial dysfunction\" [PMID:23109776]"}

name: Abnormal right ventricle morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the right ventricle of the heart.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Right ventricular failure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability of the right ventricle to perform its function (to receive blood from the right atrium and to eject blood into the pulmonary artery), often leading to pitting peripheral edema, ascites, and hepatomegaly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Third degree atrioventricular block
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Third-degree atrioventricular (AV) block (also referred to as complete heart block) is the complete dissociation of the atria and the ventricles. Third-degree AV block exists when more P waves than QRS complexes exist and no relationship (no conduction) exists between them.\" [PMID:21841933]"}

name: Conotruncal defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital malformation of the outflow tract of the heart. Conotruncal defects are thought to result from a disturbance of the outflow tract of the embryonic heart, and comprise truncus arteriosus, tetralogy of Fallot, interrupted aortic arch, transposition of the great arteries, and double outlet right ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal left ventricle morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the left ventricle of the heart.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Left ventricular hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement or increased size of the heart left ventricle.\" [MP:0002625]"}

name: Ventricular hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of the cardiac ventricular muscle tissue with increase in the width of the wall of the ventricle and loss of elasticity. Ventricular hypertrophy is clinically differentiated into left and right ventricular hypertrophy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A disorder of the cardiac conduction system of the heart characterized by ventricular preexcitation due to the presence of an abnormal accessory atrioventricular electrical conduction pathway.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Coronary artery calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in a coronary artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mitral stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal narrowing of the orifice of the mitral valve.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown]"}

name: Double outlet right ventricle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Double outlet right ventricle (DORV) is a type of ventriculoarterial connection in which both great vessels arise entirely or predominantly from the right ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10798433]"}

name: High-output congestive heart failure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of heart failure characterized by elevated cardiac output. This may be seen in patients with heart failure and hyperthyroidism, anemia, pregnancy, arteriovenous fistulae, and others.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Restrictive cardiomyopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Restrictive left ventricular physiology is characterized by a pattern of ventricular filling in which increased stiffness of the myocardium causes ventricular pressure to rise precipitously with only small increases in volume, defined as restrictive ventricular physiology in the presence of normal or reduced diastolic volumes (of one or both ventricles), normal or reduced systolic volumes, and normal ventricular wall thickness.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17916581]"}

name: Thromboembolic stroke
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cerebrovascular accident (stroke) that occurs because of thromboembolism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Progressive hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hearing impairment that remains stable over time.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:40407660]"}

name: Pancreatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inflammation in the pancreas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Annular pancreas
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly in which the pancreas completely (or sometimes incompletely) encircles the second portion of duodenum and occasionally obstructs the more proximal duodenum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pancreatic cysts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cyst of the pancreas that possess a lining of mucous epithelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impaired function of the exocrine pancreas associated with a reduced ability to digest foods because of lack of digestive enzymes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Phimosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The male foreskin cannot be fully retracted from the head of the penis.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Nasal congestion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability to pass air through the nasal cavity often leading to mouth breathing.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Accessory spleen
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An accessory spleen is a round, iso-echogenic, homogenic and smooth structure and is seen as a normal variant mostly on the medial contour of the spleen, near the hilus or around the lower pole. This has no pathogenic relevance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Polysplenia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Polysplenia is a congenital disease manifested by multiple small accessory spleens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Single ventricle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of only one working lower chamber in the heart, usually with a virtual absence of the ventricular septum and usually present in conjunction with double inlet left or right ventricle.\" [MP:0010432]"}

name: Abnormal vestibular function
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the functioning of the vestibular apparatus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vestibular hyporeflexia
