extra_json: {"definition": "\"A general descriptive term that describes impaired functioning of the vestibular apparatus that leads to manifestations such as dizziness or postural imbalance\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32767115]"}

name: High-frequency sensorineural hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of sensorineural hearing impairment that affects primarily the higher frequencies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal foot morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the skeleton of foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pes cavus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in height of the medial longitudinal arch of the foot that does not flatten on weight bearing (i.e., a distinctly hollow form of the sole of the foot when it is bearing weight).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Talipes equinovarus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Talipes equinovarus (also called clubfoot) typically has four main components: inversion and adduction of the forefoot; inversion of the heel and hindfoot; equinus (limitation of extension) of the ankle and subtalar joint; and internal rotation of the leg.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32491773]"}

name: Pes planus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A foot where the longitudinal arch of the foot is in contact with the ground or floor when the individual is standing; or, in a patient lying supine, a foot where the arch is in contact with the surface of a flat board pressed against the sole of the foot by the examiner with a pressure similar to that expected from weight bearing; or, the height of the arch is reduced.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Hammertoe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperextension of the metatarsal-phalangeal joint with hyperflexion of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joint.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Broad foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A foot for which the measured width is above the 95th centile for age; or, a foot that appears disproportionately wide for its length.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Webbing or fusion of the toes, involving soft parts only or including bone structure. Bony fusions are referred to as \\\"bony\\\" Syndactyly if the fusion occurs in a radio-ulnar axis. Fusions of bones of the toes in a proximo-distal axis are referred to as \\\"Symphalangism\\\".\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Talipes equinovalgus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deformity of foot and ankle in which the foot is bent down and outwards.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Short foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A measured foot length that is more than 2 SD below the mean for a newborn of 27 - 41 weeks gestation, or foot that is less than the 3rd centile for individuals from birth to 16 years of age (objective). Alternatively, a foot that appears disproportionately short (subjective).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Bulbous tips of toes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the morphology of the toes, such that the tips of the toes are prominent and bulbous.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Broad metatarsal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased side-to-side width of a metatarsal bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Narrow foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A foot for which the measured width is below the 5th centile for age; or, a foot that appears disproportionately narrow for its length.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Premature rupture of membranes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Premature rupture of membranes (PROM) is a condition which occurs in pregnancy when the amniotic sac ruptures more than an hour before the onset of labor.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hydrops fetalis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The abnormal accumulation of fluid in two or more fetal compartments, including ascites, pleural effusion, pericardial effusion, and skin edema.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nonimmune hydrops fetalis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hydrops fetalis in which there is no identifiable circulating antibody to red blood cell antigens .\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fetal ascites
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of fluid in the peritoneal cavity during the fetal period.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Small nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nail that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped nail.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Hyperconvex nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"When viewed on end (with the digit tip pointing toward the examiner's eye) the curve of the nail forms a tighter curve of convexity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Nail pits
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Small (typically about 1 mm or less in size) depressions on the dorsal nail surface.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Onychogryphosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onychogryphosis is a disorder of nail plate growth that is clinically characterized by an opaque, yellow-brown thickening of the nail plate with associated gross hyperkeratosis, elongation, and increased curvature.\" [PMID:19125433, PMID:30410908, PMID:33021642]"}

name: Onycholysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detachment of the nail from the nail bed.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ridged nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Longitudinal, linear prominences in the nail plate.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Split nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nail plate that has a longitudinal separation and the two sections of the nail share the same lateral radius of curvature.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Dystrophic toenail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Toenail changes apart from changes of the color of the toenail (nail dyschromia) that involve partial or complete disruption of the various keratinous layers of the nail plate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperconvex fingernails
extra_json: {"definition": "\"When viewed on end (with the finger tip pointing toward the examiner's eye) the curve of the fingernail forms a tighter curve of convexity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Thin nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nail that appears thin when viewed on end.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Paronychia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The nail disease paronychia is an often-tender bacterial or fungal hand infection or foot infection where the nail and skin meet at the side or the base of a finger or toenail. The infection can start suddenly (acute paronychia) or gradually (chronic paronychia).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hallux valgus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lateral deviation of the great toe (i.e., in the direction of the little toe).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Genital tract atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital occlusion of a tube in the genital tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Foot polydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of polydactyly characterized by the presence of a supernumerary toe or toes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Postaxial foot polydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Polydactyly of the foot most commonly refers to the presence of six toes on one foot. Postaxial polydactyly affects the lateral ray and the duplication may range from a well-formed articulated digit to a rudimentary digit.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Short toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A toe that appears disproportionately short compared to the foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal metatarsal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormalities of the metatarsal bones (i.e. of five tubular bones located between the tarsal bones of the hind- and mid-foot and the phalanges of the toes).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Long foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased back to front length of the foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Camptodactyly of toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Camptodactyly is a painless flexion contracture of the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joint that is usually gradually progressive. This term refers to camptodactyly of one or more toes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Broad toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Visible increase in width of the non-hallux digit without an increase in the dorso-ventral dimension.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Rocker bottom foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of both a prominent heel and a convex contour of the sole.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Split foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which middle parts of the foot (toes and metatarsals) are missing giving a cleft appearance. The severity is very variable ranging from slightly hypoplastic 3rd toe over absent 2nd or 3rd toes as far as oligo- or monodactyl feet.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Metatarsus adductus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The metatarsals are deviated medially (tibially), that is, the bones in the front half of the foot bend or turn in toward the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Preaxial foot polydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Duplication of all or part of the first ray.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Abnormal hallux morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This term applies for all abnormalities of the big toe, also called hallux.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Overlapping toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Describes a foot digit resting on the dorsal surface of an adjacent digit when the foot is at rest. Initially clawing may be dynamic and only noticeable on walking. Over time the plantar plate tears, subluxation occurs at the metatarsophalangeal joint (MTPJ), and the deformity becomes permanent.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Calcaneovalgus deformity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This is a postural deformity in which the foot is positioned up against the tibia. The heel (calcaneus) is positioned downward (that is, the ankle is flexed upward), and the heel is turned outward (valgus).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Foot oligodactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of toes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the tarsal bones
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the tarsus are the cluster of seven bones in the foot between the tibia and fibula and the metatarsus, including the calcaneus (heel) bone and the talus (ankle) bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sandal gap
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A widely spaced gap between the first toe (the great toe) and the second toe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Podagra
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Gout affecting the Metatarsophalangeal joint of big toe.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Short distal phalanx of toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Short distance from the end of the toe to the most distal interphalangeal crease or distal interphalangeal joint flexion point, i.e., abnormally short distal phalanx of toe.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Distal toe symphalangism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bony fusion at the distal interphalangeal joint of the second, third, fourth, or fifth toe.\" []"}

name: Toe clinodactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bending or curvature of a toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Clinodactyly of the 5th toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bending or curvature of a fifth toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Autoamputation of foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The spontaneous detachment of a foot from the body due to long standing pathology.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:31633102]"}

name: Deep plantar creases
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of unusually deep creases (ridges/wrinkles) on the skin of sole of foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of blood and blood-forming tissues
Thrombocytopenia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the number of circulating thrombocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased total neutrophil count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25642312]"}

name: Pancytopenia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in numbers of all blood cell types (red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemolytic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of anemia caused by premature destruction of red blood cells (hemolysis).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal eosinophil morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal count or structure of eosinophils.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23154224]"}

name: Increased total eosinophil count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased count of eosinophils in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Decreased total leukocyte count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal decreased number of leukocytes in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Talipes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deformity of foot and ankle that has different subtypes that are talipes equinovarus, talipes equinovalgus, talipes calcaneovarus and talipes calcaneovalgus.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Talipes calcaneovalgus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Talipes calcaneovalgus is a flexible foot deformity (as opposed to a rigid congenital vertical talus foot deformity) that can either present as a positional or structural foot deformity depending on severity and/or causality. The axis of calcaneovalgus deformity is in the tibiotalar joint, where the foot is positioned in extreme hyperextension. On inspection, the foot has an \\\"up and out\\\" appearance, with the dorsal forefoot practically touching the anterior aspect of the ankle and lower leg.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Foot osteomyelitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An infection of bone of the foot.\" []"}

name: Decreased total lymphocyte count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced number of lymphocytes in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Megaloblastic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anemia characterized by the presence of erythroblasts that are larger than normal (megaloblasts).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal bleeding
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal susceptibility to bleeding, often referred to as a bleeding diathesis. A bleeding diathesis may be related to vascular, platelet and coagulation defects.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thrombocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased numbers of platelets in the peripheral blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reticulocytopenia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced number of reticulocytes in the peripheral blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Normocytic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of anemia in which the volume of the red blood cells is normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased red blood cell mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased mass of red blood cells in the circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased hematocrit
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation above the normal ratio of the volume of red blood cells to the total volume of blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased circulating hemoglobin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of hemoglobin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Polycythemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Polycythemia is diagnosed if the red blood cell count, the hemoglobin level, and the red blood cell volume all exceed the upper limits of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Giant platelets
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Giant platelets are larger than 7 micrometers and usually 10 to 20 micrometers. The term giant platelet is used when the platelet is larger than the size of the average red cell in the field. (Description adapted from College of American Pathologists, Hematology Manual, 1998).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in erythrocytes volume or hemoglobin concentration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Autoimmune neutropenia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of the absolute number of neutrophils in the blood, per microlitre, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, accompanied by the detection of anti-neutrophil antibodies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25642312]"}

name: Thromboembolism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The formation of a blood clot inside a blood vessel that subsequently travels through the blood stream from the site where it formed to another location in the body, generally leading to vascular occlusion at the distant site.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplastic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anemia with varying degrees of erythrocytic hypoplasia without leukopenia or thrombocytopenia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Leukemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cancer of the blood and bone marrow characterized by an abnormal proliferation of leukocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, NCIT:C3161]"}

name: Abnormal granulocyte morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality or abnormal count of granulocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal basophil morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality or abnormal count of basophils.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24075190]"}

name: Decreased total granulocyte count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of absolute number of granulocytes in the blood, per microliter, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplastic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Aplastic anemia is defined as pancytopenia with a hypocellular marrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21239768]"}

name: Renal amyloidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of amyloidosis that affects the kidney. On hematoxylin and eosin stain, amyloid is identified as extracellular amorphous material that is lightly eosinophilic. These deposits often stain weakly for periodic acid Schiff (PAS), demonstrate a blue-to-gray hue on the trichrome stain and are typically negative on the Jones methenamine silver (JMS) stain. These tinctorial properties contrast with the histologic appearance of collagen, a major component of basement membranes, mesangial matrix and areas of sclerosis, which demonstrates strong positivity for PAS and JMS (See Figure 1 of PMID:25852856).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25852856]"}

name: Acute kidney injury
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden loss of renal function, as manifested by decreased urine production, and a rise in serum creatinine or blood urea nitrogen concentration (azotemia).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal artery stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of stenosis of the renal artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vacuolated lymphocytes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of clear, sharply defined vacuoles in the lymphocyte cytoplasm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20633042]"}

name: Reticulocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation in the number of reticulocytes (immature erythrocytes) in the peripheral blood circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sideroblastic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sideroblastic anemia results from a defect in the incorporation of iron into the heme molecule. A sideroblast is an erythroblast that has stainable deposits of iron in cytoplasm (this can be demonstrated by Prussian blue staining).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acanthocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acanthocytosis is a type of poikilocytosis characterized by the presence of spikes on the cell surface. The cells have an irregular shape resembling many-pointed stars.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of coagulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the process of blood coagulation. That is, altered ability or inability of the blood to clot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced factor XI activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased activity of coagulation factor XI. Factor XI, also known as plasma thromboplastin antecedent, is a serine proteinase that activates factor IX.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypochromic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of anemia characterized by an abnormally low concentration of hemoglobin in the erythrocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Subcutaneous hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This term refers to an abnormally increased susceptibility to bruising (purpura, petechiae, or ecchymoses).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Microcytic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of anemia in which the volume of the red blood cells is reduced.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal acid accumulation or depletion of base.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24381489]"}

name: Metabolic acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Metabolic acidosis (MA) is characterized by a fall in blood pH due to a reduction of serum bicarbonate concentration. This can occur as a result of either the accumulation of acids (high anion gap MA) or the loss of bicarbonate from the gastrointestinal tract or the kidney (hyperchloremic MA). By definition, MA is not due to a respirary cause.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17936961, PMID:31418093]"}

name: Hypoglycemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decreased concentration of glucose in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fever
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Body temperature elevated above the normal range.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:9759682]"}

name: Ketosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of elevated levels of ketone bodies in the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28278308]"}

name: Renal tubular acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acidosis owing to malfunction of the kidney tubules with accumulation of metabolic acids and hyperchloremia, potentially leading to complications including hypokalemia, hypercalcinuria, nephrolithiasis and nephrocalcinosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Alkalosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Depletion of acid or accumulation base in the body fluids.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24381489]"}

name: Respiratory alkalosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Alkalosis due to excess loss of carbon dioxide from the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Glucose intolerance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Glucose intolerance (GI) can be defined as dysglycemia that comprises both prediabetes and diabetes. It includes the conditions of impaired fasting glucose (IFG) and impaired glucose tolerance (IGT) and diabetes mellitus (DM).\" [PMID:29763085]"}

name: Diabetic ketoacidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of diabetic metabolic abnormality with an accumulation of ketone bodies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unexplained fevers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Episodes of fever for which no infectious cause can be identified.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Truncal obesity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Obesity located preferentially in the trunk of the body as opposed to the extremities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Polydipsia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive thirst manifested by excessive fluid intake.\" []"}

name: Hypoplastic ventricle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital defect characterized by underdevelopment of a ventricle of the heart.\" []"}

name: Palpitations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sensation that the heart is pounding or racing, which is a non-specific sign but may be a manifestation of arrhythmia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal speech discrimination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hearing impairment prominently characterized by a difficulty in understanding speech, rather than an inability to hear speech. Poor speech discrimination is a very common symptom of high frequency hearing loss.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of metatarsal bones
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the metatarsal bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal scalp morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the scalp, the skin an subcutaneous tissue of the head on which head hair grows.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal glomerular mesangium morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the mesangium, i.e., of the central part of the renal glomerulus between capillaries.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19470685, PMID:20828589]"}

name: Diffuse mesangial sclerosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thickening and scarring (sclerosis) of the mesangium (a structure in the glomerulus). The sclerosis affects a large portion of the mesangium across multiple glomeruli. Histologic features include an increase in the mesangial matrix, thickened glomerular basement membrane, tubular casts, and interstitial inflammation. Diffuse mesangial sclerosis presents with nephrotic syndrome at birth or within the first year of life. Glomeruli are small and condensed in appearance, with early lesions showing increased loose mesangial collagen that progress to sclerosis with dense collagen without hypercellularity. Podocytes do not show hyperplasia but may be immature and cobblestone-like. Electron microscopy shows extensive foot process effacement without deposits, but increased collagen within mesangial areas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26408240]"}

name: Abnormal tubulointerstitial morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality that involves the tubules and interstitial tissue of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tubulointerstitial nephritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of inflammation of the kidney affecting the interstitium of the kidneys surrounding the tubules.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypersplenism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A malfunctioning of the spleen in which it prematurely destroys red blood cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macrocytic anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of anemia characterized by increased size of erythrocytes with increased mean corpuscular volume (MCV) and increased mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19202968]"}

name: Autoimmune thrombocytopenia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of thrombocytopenia in combination with detection of antiplatelet antibodies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]"}

name: Increased total leukocyte count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal increase in the number of leukocytes in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased platelet glycoprotein IIb-IIIa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein IIb-IIIa.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]"}

name: Reduced antithrombin III activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of antithrombin-III.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal thrombosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Venous or arterial thrombosis (formation of blood clots) of spontaneous nature and which cannot be fully explained by acquired risk (e.g. atherosclerosis).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Extramedullary hematopoiesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The process of hematopoiesis occurring outside of the bone marrow (in the liver, thymus, and spleen) in the postnatal organisms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27377325, PMID:28101170]"}

name: Megaloblastic bone marrow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increased number of megaloblasts in the bone marrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Schistocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormal number of fragmented red blood cells (schistocytes) in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sea-blue histiocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of histiocytes, in which the cells take on a sea blue appearance due to abnormally increased lipid content. Histiocytes are a type of macrophage. Sea-blue histiocytes are typically large macrophages from 20 to 60 micrometers in diameter with a single eccentric nucleus whose cytoplasm if packed with sea-blue or blue-green granules when stained with Wright-Giemsa.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8797061]"}

name: Reduced lymphocyte surface expression of CD43
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the expression of CD43 on the cell surface of lymphocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoketotic hypoglycemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decreased concentration of glucose in the blood associated with a reduced concentration of ketone bodies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperammonemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of ammonia in the blood.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti]"}

name: Recurrent hypoglycemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent episodes of decreased concentration of glucose in the blood.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti]"}

name: Fetal akinesia sequence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased fetal activity associated with multiple joint contractures, facial anomalies and pulmonary hypoplasia. Ultrasound examination may reveal polyhydramnios, ankylosis, scalp edema, and decreased chest movements (reflecting pulmonary hypoplasia).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Organic aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excretion of non-amino organic acids in urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ketoacidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acidosis resulting from accumulation of ketone bodies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal Fanconi syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An inability of the tubules in the kidney to reabsorb small molecules, causing increased urinary loss of electrolytes (sodium, potassium, bicarbonate), minerals, glucose, amino acids, and water.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperchloremic acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acidosis (pH less than 7.35) that develops with an increase in ionic chloride.\" [PMID:29493965]"}

name: Gout
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent attacks of acute inflammatory arthritis of a joint or set of joints caused by elevated levels of uric acid in the blood which crystallize and are deposited in joints, tendons, and surrounding tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Abnormal facial shape
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal morphology (form) of the face or its components.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9602-2321]"}

name: Short columella
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced distance from the anterior border of the naris to the subnasale.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Deep philtrum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accentuated, prominent philtral ridges giving rise to an exaggerated groove in the midline between the nasal base and upper vermillion border.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Tessier cleft
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital malformation with a cleft (gap or opening) in the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Frontal bossing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bilateral bulging of the lateral frontal bone prominences with relative sparing of the midline.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Potter facies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A facial appearance characteristic of a fetus or neonate due to oligohydramnios experienced in the womb, comprising ocular hypertelorism, low-set ears, receding chin, and flattening of the nose.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Morphological central nervous system abnormality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the abdominal organs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the viscera of the abdomen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vomiting
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Forceful ejection of the contents of the stomach through the mouth by means of a series of involuntary spasmic contractions.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Diarrhea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased frequency (usually defined as three or more) loose or watery bowel movements a day.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nausea and vomiting
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nausea is a commonly encountered symptom that has been defined as an unpleasant painless subjective feeling that one will imminently vomit. Vomiting has been defined as the forceful expulsion of the contents of the stomach, duodenum, or jejunum through the oral cavity. While nausea and vomiting are often thought to exist on a temporal continuum, this is not always the case. There are situations when severe nausea may be present without emesis and less frequently, when emesis may be present without preceding nausea.\" [PMID:26770271]"}

name: Nausea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sensation of unease in the stomach together with an urge to vomit.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26770271]"}

name: Gastroesophageal reflux
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which the stomach contents leak backwards from the stomach into the esophagus through the lower esophageal sphincter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pyloric stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pyloric stenosis, also known as infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis, is an uncommon condition in infants characterized by abnormal thickening of the pylorus muscles in the stomach leading to gastric outlet obstruction. Clinically infants are well at birth. Then, at 3 to 6 weeks of age, the infants present with projectile vomiting, potentially leading to dehydration and weight loss.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32310391]"}

name: Anal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital absence of the anus, i.e., the opening at the bottom end of the intestinal tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Malabsorption
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impaired ability to absorb one or more nutrients from the intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abdominal pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the abdomen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chronic diarrhea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of chronic diarrhea, which is usually taken to mean diarrhea that has persisted for over 4 weeks.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Esophageal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the esophagus such that the esophagus ends in a blind pouch rather than connecting to the stomach.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Poor suck
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An inadequate sucking reflex, resulting in the difficult of newborns to be breast-fed.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal rectum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormaltiy of the rectum, the final segment of the large intestine that stores solid waste until it passes through the anus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Rectal prolapse
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Protrusion of the rectal mucous membrane through the anus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hiatus hernia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a hernia in which the upper part of the stomach, i.e., mainly the gastric cardia protrudes through the diaphragmatic esophageal hiatus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Inflammation of the large intestine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation, or an inflammatory state in the large intestine.\" []"}

name: Anorexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of desire to eat (loss of appetite).\" []"}

name: Esophageal varix
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Extreme dilation of the submucusoal veins in the lower portion of the esophagus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Esophageal stricture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pathological narrowing of the esophagus that is caused by the development of a ring of scar tissue that constricts the esophageal lumen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which there is increased production of gastrin by a gastrin-secreting tumor (usually located in the pancreas, duodenum, or abdominal lymph nodes) that stimulates the gastric mucosa to maximal activity, with consequent gastrointestinal mucosal ulceration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypothermia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced body temperature due to failed thermoregulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Heat intolerance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The inability to maintain a comfortable body temperature in warm or hot weather.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Malignant hyperthermia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Malignant hyperthermia is characterized by a rapid increase in temperature to 39-42 degrees C. Malignant hyperthermia may occur in response to either inhalational anesthetics such as halothane, to muscle relaxants such as succinylcholine, or to exercise.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Renal cortical atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of the cortex of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Proximal renal tubular acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of renal tubular acidosis characterized by a failure of the proximal tubular cells to reabsorb bicarbonate, leading to urinary bicarbonate wasting and subsequent acidemia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Curved linear dimple below the lower lip
Myopathic facies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A facial appearance characteristic of myopathic conditions. The face appears expressionless with sunken cheeks, bilateral ptosis, and inability to elevate the corners of the mouth, due to muscle weakness.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy (wasting, decrease in size of cells or tissue) affecting the cerebrum.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Abnormal cerebral morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the telencephalon, which is also known as the cerebrum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lower limb spasticity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spasticity (velocity-dependent increase in tonic stretch reflexes with increased muscle tone and hyperexcitable tendon reflexes) in the muscles of the lower limbs, hips, and pelvis.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UKT_rschuele, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal pyramidal tract morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the pyramidal tract, whose chief element, the corticospinal tract, is the only direct connection between the brain and the spinal cord. In addition to the corticospinal tract, the pyramidal system includes the corticobulbar, corticomesencephalic, and corticopontine tracts.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Rigidity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Continuous involuntary sustained muscle contraction. When an affected muscle is passively stretched, the degree of resistance remains constant regardless of the rate at which the muscle is stretched. This feature helps to distinguish rigidity from muscle spasticity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spastic gait
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spasticity is manifested by increased stretch reflex which is intensified with movement velocity. This results in excessive and inappropriate muscle activation which can contribute to muscle hypertonia. Spastic gait is characterized by manifestations such as muscle hypertonia, stiff knee, and circumduction of the leg.\" [PMID:25649546]"}

name: Gait ataxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to coordinate the movements required for normal walking. Gait ataxia is characteirzed by a wide-based staggering gait with a tendency to fall.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UKT_rschuele, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bradykinesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bradykinesia literally means slow movement, and is used clinically to denote a slowness in the execution of movement (in contrast to hypokinesia, which is used to refer to slowness in the initiation of movement).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure is a seizure defined by a tonic (bilateral increased tone, lasting seconds to minutes) and then a clonic (bilateral sustained rhythmic jerking) phase.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Limb ataxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of ataxia that affects movements of the extremities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of extrapyramidal motor function
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A neurological condition related to lesions of the basal ganglia leading to typical abnormalities including akinesia (inability to initiate changes in activity and perform volitional movements rapidly and easily), muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement), chorea (widespread arrhythmic movements of a forcible, rapid, jerky, and restless nature), athetosis (inability to sustain the muscles of the fingers, toes, or other group of muscles in a fixed position), and akathisia (inability to remain motionless).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chorea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Chorea (Greek for 'dance') refers to widespread arrhythmic involuntary movements of a forcible, jerky and restless fashion. It is a random-appearing sequence of one or more discrete involuntary movements or movement fragments. Movements appear random because of variability in timing, duration or location. Each movement may have a distinct start and end. However, movements may be strung together and thus may appear to flow randomly from one muscle group to another. Chorea can involve the trunk, neck, face, tongue, and extremities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20589866]"}

name: Increased neuronal autofluorescent lipopigment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lipofuscin, a generic term applied to autofluorescent lipopigment, is a mixture of protein and lipid that accumulates in most aging cells, particularly those involved in high lipid turnover (e.g., the adrenal medulla) or phagocytosis of other cell types (e g., the retinal pigment epithelium or RPE; macrophage). This term pertains if there is an increase in the neuronal accumulation of lipofuscin (also known as autofluorescent lipoprotein) more than expected for the age of the patient.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11406682]"}

name: Dysdiadochokinesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of ataxia characterized by the impairment of the ability to perform rapidly alternating movements, such as pronating and supinating his or her hand on the dorsum of the other hand as rapidly as possible.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UKB_tklockgether, HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:zaferyueksel, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Migraine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Migraine is a chronic neurological disorder characterized by episodic attacks of headache and associated symptoms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15304572]"}

name: Migraine with aura
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of migraine in which there is an aura characterized by focal neurological phenomena that usually proceed, but may accompany or occur in the absence of, the headache. The symptoms of an aura may include fully reversible visual, sensory, and speech symptoms but not motor weakness. Visual symptoms may include flickering lights, spots and lines and/or loss of vision and/or unilateral sensory symptoms such as paresthesias or numbness. At least one of the symptoms of an aura develops gradually over 5 or more minutes and/or different symptoms occur in succession.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15304572]"}

name: Truncal ataxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Truncal ataxia is a sign of ataxia characterized by instability of the trunk. It usually occurs during sitting.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UKT_rschuele, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intention tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of kinetic tremor that occurs during target directed movement is called intention tremor. That is, an oscillatory cerebellar ataxia that tends to be absent when the limbs are inactive and during the first part of voluntary movement but worsening as the movement continues and greater precision is required (e.g., in touching a target such as the patient's nose or a physician's finger).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16344298]"}

name: Migraine without aura
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repeated headache attacks lasting 4-72 h fulfilling at least two of the following criteria: 1) unilateral location, 2) pulsating quality, 3) moderate or severe pain intensity, and 4) aggravation by or causing avoidance of routine physical activity such as climbing stairs. Headache attacks are commonly accompanied by nausea, vomiting, photophobia, or phonophobia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15304572]"}

name: Encephalocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A neural tube defect characterized by sac-like protrusions of the brain and the membranes that cover it through openings in the skull.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Occipital encephalocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of encephalocele (that is, a a protrusion of part of the cranial contents including brain tissue through a congenital opening in the cranium, typically covered with skin or mucous membrane) in the occipital region of the skull. Occipital encephalocele presents as a midline swelling over the occipital bone. It is usually covered with normal full-thickness scalp.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2972-5481]"}

name: Abnormality of the respiratory system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the respiratory system, which include the airways, lungs, and the respiratory muscles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the upper respiratory tract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the upper respiratory tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pneumonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of any part of the lung parenchyma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Restrictive ventilatory defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional defect characterized by reduced total lung capacity (TLC) not associated with abnormalities of expiratory airflow or airway resistance. Spirometrically, a restrictive defect is defined as FEV1 (forced expiratory volume in 1 second) and FVC (forced vital capacity) less than 80 per cent. Restrictive lung disease may be caused by alterations in lung parenchyma or because of a disease of the pleura, chest wall, or neuromuscular apparatus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:28194273]"}

name: Pulmonary arterial hypertension
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pulmonary hypertension is defined mean pulmonary artery pressure of 25mmHg or more and pulmonary capillary wedge pressure of 15mmHg or less when measured by right heart catheterisation at rest and in a supine position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dyspnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficult or labored breathing. Dyspnea is a subjective feeling only the patient can rate, e.g., on a Borg scale.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16914301]"}

name: Respiratory distress
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Respiratory distress is objectively observable as the physical or emotional consequences from the experience of dyspnea. The physical presentation of respiratory distress is generally referred to as labored breathing, while the sensation of respiratory distress is called shortness of breath or dyspnea.\" []"}

name: Asthma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Asthma is characterized by increased responsiveness of the tracheobronchial tree to multiple stimuli, leading to narrowing of the air passages with resultant dyspnea, cough, and wheezing.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent aspiration pneumonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to aspiration pneumonia, defined as pneumonia due to breathing in foreign material, as manifested by a medical history of repeated episodes of aspiration pneumonia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal lung lobation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect in the formation of pulmonary lobes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal pleura morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the pulmonary pleura, the thin, transparent membrane which covers the lungs and lines the inside of the chest walls.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Apnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of breathing with no movement of the respiratory muscles and no exchange of air in the lungs. This term refers to a disposition to have recurrent episodes of apnea rather than to a single event.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemoptysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Coughing up (expectoration) of blood or blood-streaked sputum from the larynx, trachea, bronchi, or lungs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pneumothorax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of air in the pleural cavity leading to a partially or completely collapsed lung.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spontaneous pneumothorax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pneumothorax occurring without traumatic injury to the chest or lung.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bronchiectasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistent abnormal dilatation of the bronchi owing to localized and irreversible destruction and widening of the large airways.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal cerebral ventricle morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the cerebral ventricles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ventriculomegaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in size of the ventricular system of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral cortical atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of the cortex of the cerebrum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Generalized non-motor (absence) seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A generalized non-motor (absence) seizure is a type of a type of dialeptic seizure that is of electrographically generalized onset. It is a generalized seizure characterized by an interruption of activities, a blank stare, and usually the person will be unresponsive when spoken to. Any ictal motor phenomena are minor in comparison to these non-motor features.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Generalized myoclonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A generalized myoclonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral, sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Polymicrogyria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Polymicrogyria is a congenital malformation of the cerebral cortex characterized by abnormal cortical layering (lamination) and an excessive number of small gyri (folds).\" [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24888723]"}

name: Abnormal upper motor neuron morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly that affects the upper motor neuron.\" []"}

name: Episodic ataxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Periodic spells of incoordination and imbalance, that is, episodes of ataxia typically lasting from 10 minutes to several hours or days.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Porencephalic cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cavity within the cerebral hemisphere, filled with cerebrospinal fluid, that communicates directly with the ventricular system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:9279052]"}

name: Status epilepticus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Status epilepticus is a type of prolonged seizure resulting either from the failure of the mechanisms responsible for seizure termination or from the initiation of mechanisms which lead to abnormally prolonged seizures (after time point t1). It is a condition that can have long-term consequences (after time point t2), including neuronal death, neuronal injury, and alteration of neuronal networks, depending on the type and duration of seizures.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Basal ganglia calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of calcium deposition affecting one or more structures of the basal ganglia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Broad-based gait
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal gait pattern in which persons stand and walk with their feet spaced widely apart. This is often a component of cerebellar ataxia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Subarachnoid hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemorrhage occurring between the arachnoid mater and the pia mater.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Arrhinencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A defect of development of the brain characterized by congenital absence of the part of the brain that includes the olfactory bulbs, tracts, and other structures associated with the sense of smell.\" []"}

name: Ischemic stroke
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acute ischemic stroke (AIS) is defined by the sudden loss of blood flow to an area of the brain with the resulting loss of neurologic function. It is caused by thrombosis or embolism that occludes a cerebral vessel supplying a specific area of the brain. During a vessel occlusion, there is a core area where damage to the brain is irreversible and an area of penumbra where the brain has lost function owing to decreased blood flow but is not irreversibly injured.\" [PMID:32054610]"}

name: Abnormal spinal cord morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the spinal cord (myelon).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tethered cord
extra_json: {"definition": "\"During normal embryological development, the spinal cord first occupies the entire length of the vertebral column but goes on to assume a position at the level of L1 due to differential growth of the conus medullaris and the vertebral column. The filum terminale is a slender, threadlike structure that remains after the normal regression of the distal embryonic spinal cord and attaches the spinal cord to the coccyx. A tethered cord results if there is a thickened rope-like filum terminale which anchors the cord at the level of L2 or below, potentially causing neurologic signs owing to abnormal tension on the spinal cord.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Frontotemporal dementia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A dementia associated with degeneration of the frontotemporal lobe and clinically associated with personality and behavioral changes such as disinhibition, apathy, and lack of insight. The hallmark feature of frontotemporal dementia is the presentation with focal syndromes such as progressive language dysfunction, or aphasia, or behavioral changes characteristic of frontal lobe disorders.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24966676]"}

name: Hypophosphatemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of phosphate ion in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hyperuricemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of uric acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Increased circulating lactate concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased level of blood lactate (2-hydroxypropanoic acid). Lactate is produced from pyruvate by lactate dehydrogenase during normal metabolism. The terms lactate and lactic acid are often used interchangeably but lactate (the component measured in blood) is strictly a weak base whereas lactic acid is the corresponding acid. Lactic acidosis is often used clinically to describe elevated lactate but should be reserved for cases where there is a corresponding acidosis (pH below 7.35).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24079682]"}

name: Hyperproteinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of proteins in the blood.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti]"}

name: Hyperkalemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of potassium(1+) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hyperglycinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevated concentration of glycine in the blood.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti, PMID:16902722, PMID:4696900]"}

name: Hypertriglyceridemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of triglyceride in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Homocystinuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of homocystine in the urine.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti]"}

name: Azotemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of nitrogen compounds in the blood.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:gcarletti]"}

name: Heparan sulfate excretion in urine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of heparan sulfates in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperhomocystinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of homocystine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hyperlysinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of lysine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Low posterior hairline
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hair on the neck extends more inferiorly than usual.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Nail dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of developmental dysplasia of the nail.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nail pterygium
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inward advance of skin over the nail plate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired vibration sensation in the lower limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration in the legs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal speech pattern
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in the sound (volume) or cadence (rate) of speech.\" []"}

name: Scanning speech
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal pattern of speech in which the words are as if measured or scanned; there is a pause after every syllable, and the syllables themselves are pronounced slowly.\" [PMID:16247074]"}

name: Clonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A series of rhythmic and involuntary muscle contractions (at a frequency of about 5 to 7 Hz) that occur in response to an abruptly applied and sustained stretch.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gliosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Gliosis is the focal proliferation of glial cells in the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Postural instability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tendency to fall or the inability to keep oneself from falling; imbalance. The retropulsion test is widely regarded as the gold standard to evaluate postural instability, Use of the retropulsion test includes a rapid balance perturbation in the backward direction, and the number of balance correcting steps (or total absence thereof) is used to rate the degree of postural instability. Healthy subjects correct such perturbations with either one or two large steps, or without taking any steps, hinging rapidly at the hips while swinging the arms forward as a counterweight. In patients with balance impairment, balance correcting steps are often too small, forcing patients to take more than two steps. Taking three or more steps is generally considered to be abnormal, and taking more than five steps is regarded as being clearly abnormal. Markedly affected patients continue to step backward without ever regaining their balance and must be caught by the examiner (this would be called true retropulsion). Even more severely affected patients fail to correct entirely, and fall backward like a pushed toy soldier, without taking any corrective steps.\" [PMID:25613349]"}

name: Postural tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of tremors that is triggered by holding a limb in a fixed position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spinal cord compression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"External mechanical compression of the spinal cord.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Opisthotonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Opisthotonus is defined as a dramatic abnormal posture due to spastic contraction of the extensor muscles of the neck, trunk, and lower extremities that produces a severe backward arching from neck to heel. In most cases, the trunk is elevated off the ground by a few inches. It is usually sudden in onset and can be sustained or repetitive. It can be considered a variant of decerebrate posturing involving a hyperextension of the neck, back, and limbs.\" [PMID:29972427]"}

name: Neurodegeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Progressive loss of neural cells and tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal accumulation of fluid in the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Phonophobia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally heightened sensitivity to loud sounds.\" []"}

name: Neurofibrillary tangles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pathological protein aggregates formed by hyperphosphorylation of a microtubule-associated protein known as tau, causing it to aggregate in an insoluble form.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:19652142, PMID:38812098]"}

name: Apraxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A defect in the understanding of complex motor commands and in the execution of certain learned movements, i.e., deficits in the cognitive components of learned movements.\" []"}

name: Profound intellectual disability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Profound intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by profoundly sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) below 20.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Delayed CNS myelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed myelination in the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Choroid plexus cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cyst occurring within the choroid plexus within a cerebral ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Progressive spasticity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spasticity that increases in degree with time.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pseudobulbar affect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pseudobulbar affect (PBA) is characterized by uncontrolled crying or laughing which may be disproportionate or inappropriate to the social context. Thus, there is a disparity between the patient's emotional expression and his or her emotional experience.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:24348042]"}

name: Delayed gross motor development
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of motor delay characterized by a delay in acquiring the ability to control the large muscles of the body for walking, running, sitting, and crawling.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dysgenesis of the cerebellar vermis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Defective development of the vermis of cerebellum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myelopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myelopathy is an descriptive term, referring to pathology leading to a neurologic deficit related to the spinal cord. The clinical diagnosis of myelopathy requires a detailed history and physical examination to define the clinical syndrome. Neuroimaging is indicated in most instances of new-onset myelopathy. It is indicated also when the worsening of a myelopathy is unexplained.\" [PMID:27430455]"}

name: Generalized-onset seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A generalized-onset seizure is a type of seizure originating at some point within, and rapidly engaging, bilaterally distributed networks. The networks may include cortical and subcortical structures but not necessarily the entire cortex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20196795, PMID:23739099, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064, PMID:6790275]"}

name: Dilated fourth ventricle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal dilatation of the fourth cerebral ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pseudobulbar signs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pseudobulbar signs result from injury to an upper motor neuron lesion to the corticobulbar pathways in the pyramidal tract. Patients have difficulty chewing, swallowing and demonstrate slurred speech (often initial presentation) as well as abnormal behavioral symptoms such as inappropriate emotional outbursts of uncontrolled laughter or weeping etc.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Pleural effusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an excessive amount of fluid in the pleural cavity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Respiratory paralysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to move the muscles of respiration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pulmonary embolism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An embolus (that is, an abnormal particle circulating in the blood) located in the pulmonary artery and thereby blocking blood circulation to the lung. Usually the embolus is a blood clot that has developed in an extremity (for instance, a deep venous thrombosis), detached, and traveled through the circulation before becoming trapped in the pulmonary artery.\" []"}

name: Recurrent respiratory infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased susceptibility to respiratory infections as manifested by a history of recurrent respiratory infections.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pulmonary fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Replacement of normal lung tissues by fibroblasts and collagen.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_tkuijpers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Diffuse reticular or finely nodular infiltrations
Sparse scalp hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased number of hairs per unit area of skin of the scalp.\" [PMID:19125436, PMID:28061825]"}

name: White forelock
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A triangular depigmented region of white hairs located in the anterior midline of the scalp.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fine hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hair that is fine or thin to the touch.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sparse axillary hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced number or density of axillary hair.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Premature graying of hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Development of gray hair at a younger than normal age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Slow-growing hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hair whose growth is slower than normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Facial hypertrichosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive, increased hair growth located in the facial region.\" []"}

name: Melanin pigment aggregation in hair shafts
Woolly hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term wooly hair refers to an abnormal variant of hair that is fine, with tightly coiled curls, and often hypopigmented. Optical microscopy may reveal the presence of tight spirals and a clear diameter reduction as compared with normal hair. Electron microscopy may show flat, oval hair shafts with reduced transversal diameter.\" [PMID:20464096]"}

name: Sparse pubic hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced number or density of pubic hair.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: White eyebrow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"White color (lack of pigmentation) of the eyebrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: White eyelashes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"White color (lack of pigmentation) of the eyelashes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Generalized hirsutism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased hair growth over much of the entire body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Patchy alopecia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Transient, non-scarring hair loss and preservation of the hair follicle located in in well-defined patches.\" []"}

name: Early balding
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of scalp hair at an earlier than normal age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pili canaliculi
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A characteristic triangular, kidney- or heat-shaped diameter of hair shafts with typical longitudinal canalicular deformation as observable by scanning electron microscopy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8274794]"}

name: Frontal upsweep of hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Upward and/or sideward growth of anterior hair.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Abnormal intestine morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the intestine. The closely related term enteropathy is used to refer to any disease of the intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Protein-losing enteropathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal loss of protein from the digestive tract related to excessive leakage of plasma proteins into the lumen of the gastrointestinal tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal small intestine morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the small intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Meckel diverticulum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Meckel's diverticulum is a congenital diverticulum located in the distal ileum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal duodenum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the duodenum, i.e., the first section of the small intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Duodenal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the duodenal lumen, that is, an abnormal closure of the duodenum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Melena
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The passage of blackish, tarry feces associated with gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Melena occurs if the blood remains in the colon long enough for it to be broken down by colonic bacteria. One degradation product, hematin, imbues the stool with a blackish color. Thus, melena generally occurs with bleeding from the upper gastrointestinal tract (e.g., stomach ulcers or duodenal ulcers), since the blood usually remains in the gut for a longer period of time than with lower gastrointestinal bleeding.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aganglionic megacolon
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality resulting from a lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) that results in bowel obstruction with enlargement of the colon.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17965226]"}

name: Colonic diverticula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple diverticula of the colon.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intermittent diarrhea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repeated episodes of diarrhea separated by periods without diarrhea.\" []"}

name: Exaggerated cupid's bow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"More pronounced paramedian peaks and median notch of the Cupid's bow.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Focal clonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A focal clonic seizure is a type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained rhythmic jerking, that is regularly repetitive.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Exaggerated startle response
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An exaggerated startle reaction in response to a sudden unexpected visual or acoustic stimulus, or a quick movement near the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Paroxysmal dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of dystonia characterized by episodes of dystonia (often hemidystonia or generalized) lasting from minutes to hours. There are no dystonic symptoms between episodes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of neuronal migration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality resulting from an anomaly of neuronal migration, i.e., of the process by which neurons travel from their origin to their final position in the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the autonomic nervous system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the autonomic nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Horner syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality resulting from a lesion of the sympathetic nervous system characterized by a combination of unilateral ptosis, miosis, and often ipsilateral hypohidrosis and conjunctival injection.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enlarged cisterna magna
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in size of the cisterna magna, one of three principal openings in the subarachnoid space between the arachnoid and pia mater, located between the cerebellum and the dorsal surface of the medulla oblongata.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gray matter heterotopia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Heterotopia or neuronal heterotopia are macroscopic clusters of misplaced neurons (gray matter), most often situated along the ventricular walls or within the subcortical white matter.\" [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:22427329, PMID:25180909, PMID:7524438]"}

name: Global brain atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Unlocalized atrophy of the brain with decreased total brain matter volume and increased ventricular size.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Fair hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lesser degree of hair pigmentation than would otherwise be expected.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Alopecia universalis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of all hair on the entire body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Poliosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Circumscribed depigmentation of the hair of the head or the eyelashes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Frontal balding
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of hair in the anterior midline and/or parietal areas.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Brittle hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fragile, easily breakable hair, i.e., with reduced tensile strength.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Mutism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete lack of speech or verbal communication in a person despite attempts to engage in conversation. Mutism as a phenomena assumes the individual has previous capacity for speech and in the pediatric population it assumes that the person is past the age of typical language development.\" [PMID:26709680]"}

name: Hemiplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paralysis (complete loss of muscle function) in the arm, leg, and in some cases the face on one side of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Akinesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Athetosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A slow, continuous, involuntary writhing movement that prevents maintenance of a stable posture. Athetosis involves continuous smooth movements that appear random and are not composed of recognizable sub-movements or movement fragments. In contrast to chorea, in athetosis, the same regions of the body are repeatedly involved. Athetosis may worsen with attempts at movement of posture, but athetosis can also occur at rest.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20589866]"}

name: Drooling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Drooling is the overflowing of saliva from the mouth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15202698, PMID:19236564]"}

name: Chiari malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Chiari malformation consists of a downward displacement of the cerebellar tonsils and the medulla through the foramen magnum, sometimes causing hydrocephalus as a result of obstruction of CSF outflow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28613730]"}

name: Incoordination
