extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deficit in coordination of muscle movements. Coordination is defined as the orchestrated movement of multiple body parts as required to accomplish intended actions, like walking.\" []"}

name: Clumsiness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of physical coordination resulting in an abnormal tendency to drop items or bump into objects.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spastic paraparesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial loss of the ability to move the lower limbs accompanied by spasticity of the lower limbs.\" [PMID:19277459]"}

name: Degeneration of the lateral corticospinal tracts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deterioration of the tissues of the lateral corticospinal tracts.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Headache
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cephalgia, or pain sensed in various parts of the head, not confined to the area of distribution of any nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15304572]"}

name: Cervical myelopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A collection of pathologic conditions that result from progressive spinal cord dysfunction secondary to cord compression in the cervical spine.\" []"}

name: Vertigo
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal sensation of spinning while the body is actually stationary.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Resting tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A resting tremor occurs when muscles are at rest and becomes less noticeable or disappears when the affected muscles are moved. Resting tremors are often slow and coarse.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22675666]"}

name: Anencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anencephaly is a developmental anomaly characterized by a fetus that has no calvarium, with a lack of most or all of the fetus' brain tissue. Anencephaly belongs to a collective group known as neural tube defects (NTD) and is a result of the neural tube failing to close in its rostral end during fetal development.\" [PMID:31424828, PMID:32706613]"}

name: Hydranencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A defect of development of the brain characterized by replacement of greater portions of the cerebral hemispheres and the corpus striatum by cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and glial tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Drowsiness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal feeling of sleepiness or difficulty staying awake.\" [PMID:34589772]"}

name: Sleep attack
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sleep attack is a sudden, irresistable episode of sleep that occurs during waking hours.\" [PMID:12077032]"}

name: Recurrent paroxysmal headache
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repeated episodes of headache with rapid onset, reaching a peak within minutes and of short duration (less than one hour) with pain that is throbbing, pulsating, or bursting in quality.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lack of peer relationships
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The state of not having relationships with peers outside of school or organized activity appropriate to developmental level. This may be caused by behavioral or physical barriers.\" []"}

name: Motor deterioration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of previously present motor (i.e., movement) abilities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal cerebellar vermis morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the vermis of cerebellum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Agenesis of cerebellar vermis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital absence of the vermis of cerebellum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal caudate nucleus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the caudate nucleus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cervical cord compression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Compression of the spinal cord in the cervical region, generally manifested by paresthesias and numbness, weakness, difficulty walking, abnormalities of coordination, and neck pain or stiffness.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Moderate intellectual disability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Moderate intellectual disability (ID) is defined as a type of ID characterized by moderately sub-average adaptive functioning and intellectual functioning, with an intelligence quotient (IQ) the range of 35-49.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Normal pressure hydrocephalus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hydrocephalus characterized by enlarged cerebral ventricles and normal cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) pressure upon lumbar puncture.\" [eMedicine:1135286, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Action tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tremor present when the limbs are active, either when outstretched in a certain position or throughout a voluntary movement.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Head tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unintentional, oscillating to-and-fro muscle movement affecting head movement.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Focal aware seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of focal-onset seizure in which awareness is preserved. Awareness during a seizure is defined as the patient being fully aware of themself and their environment throughout the seizure, even if immobile.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Leukoencephalopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This term describes abnormality of the white matter of the cerebrum resulting from damage to the myelin sheaths of nerve cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG abnormality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality observed by electroencephalogram (EEG), which is used to record of the brain's spontaneous electrical activity from multiple electrodes placed on the scalp.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Memory impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An impairment of memory as manifested by a reduced ability to remember things such as dates and names, and increased forgetfulness.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Writer's cramp
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A focal dystonia of the fingers, hand, and/or forearm that appears when the affected person attempts to do a task that requires fine motor movements such as writing or playing a musical instrument.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sleep disturbance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal pattern in the quality, quantity, or characteristics of sleep.\" [PMID:32809555]"}

name: Psychomotor deterioration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of previously present mental and motor abilities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Shuffling gait
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of gait (walking) characterized by by dragging one's feet along or without lifting the feet fully from the ground.\" []"}

name: Abnormal lower motor neuron morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the lower motor neuron.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Visual hallucination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Visual perception in the absence of a visual stimulus.\" []"}

name: Normal interictal EEG
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of observable abnormal electroencephalographic (EEG) patterns in an individual with a history of seizures. About half of individuals with epilepsy show interictal epileptiform discharges upon the first investigation. The yield can be increased by repeated studies, sleep studies, or by ambulatory EEG recordings over 24 hours. Normal interictal EEG is a sign that can be useful in the differential diagnosis.\" []"}

name: Febrile seizure (within the age range of 3 months to 6 years)
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A febrile seizure is any type of seizure (most often a generalized tonic-clonic seizure) occurring with fever (at least 38 degrees Celsius) but in the absence of central nervous system infection, severe metabolic disturbance or other alternative precipitant in children between the ages of 3 months and 6 years.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10353950, PMID:19125841, PMID:30078767, PMID:6779259]"}

name: Hypokinesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally diminished motor activity. In contrast to paralysis, hypokinesia is not characterized by a lack of motor strength, but rather by a poverty of movement. The typical habitual movements (e.g., folding the arms, crossing the legs) are reduced in frequency.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Developmental regression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of developmental skills, as manifested by loss of developmental milestones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Hand tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unintentional, oscillating to-and-fro muscle movement affecting the hand.\" []"}

name: Fasciculations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fasciculations are observed as small, local, involuntary muscle contractions (twitching) visible under the skin. Fasciculations result from increased irritability of an axon (which in turn is often a manifestation of disease of a motor neuron). This leads to sporadic discharges of all the muscle fibers controlled by the axon in isolation from other motor units.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aphasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An acquired language impairment of some or all of the abilities to produce or comprehend speech and to read or write.\" [PMID:27384070]"}

name: Infectious encephalitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A disorder of the brain caused by an infectious agent that presents with fever, headache, and an altered level of consciousness. There may also be focal or multifocal neurologic deficits, and focal or generalized seizure activity.\" [PMID:24365426]"}

name: Focal impaired awareness seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal impaired awareness seizure (or focal seizure with impaired or lost awareness) is a type of focal-onset seizure characterized by some degree (which may be partial) of impairment of the person's awareness of themselves or their surroundings at any point during the seizure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064, PMID:9738682]"}

name: Paraparesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Weakness or partial paralysis in the lower limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cavum septum pellucidum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"If the two laminae of the septum pellucidum are not fused then a fluid-filled space or cavum is present. The cavum septum pellucidum is present at birth but usually obliterates by the age of 3 to 6 months. It is up to 1cm in width and the walls are parallel. It is an enclosed space and is not part of the ventricular system or connected with the subarachnoid space.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with polyspike wave complexes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of complexes of repetitive spikes and waves in EEG.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Lower limb hyperreflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased intensity of the a reflex in the leg.\" []"}

name: Cogwheel rigidity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of rigidity in which a muscle responds with cogwheellike jerks to the use of constant force in bending the limb (i.e., it gives way in little, repeated jerks when the muscle is passively stretched).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Stroke-like episode
extra_json: {"definition": "\"No consensus exists on what a stroke-like episode is, but these episodes can be functionally defined as a new neurological deficit, occurring with or without the context of seizures, which last longer than 24 hours.\" [PMID:22715346, PMID:23907585]"}

name: Positive Romberg sign
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The patient stands with the feet placed together and balance and is asked to close his or her eyes. A loss of balance upon eye closure is a positive Romberg sign and is interpreted as indicating a deficit in proprioception.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thickened superior cerebellar peduncle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased width of the superior cerebellar peduncle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Limb dysmetria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of dysmetria involving the limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral arteriovenous malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the brain.\" []"}

name: Aqueductal stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stenosis of the cerebral aqueduct (also known as the mesencephalic duct, aqueductus mesencephali, or aqueduct of Sylvius), which connects the third cerebral ventricle in the diencephalon to the fourth ventricle, which is between the pons and cerebellum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myokymia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myokymia consists of involuntary, fine, continuous, undulating contractions that spread across the affected striated muscle.\" [PMID:21501741]"}

name: Spina bifida
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Incomplete closure of the embryonic neural tube, whereby some vertebral arches remain unfused and open. The mildest form is spina bifida occulta, followed by meningocele and meningomyelocele.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Leukodystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Leukodystrophy refers to deterioration of white matter of the brain resulting from degeneration of myelin sheaths in the CNS. Their basic defect is directly related to the synthesis and maintenance of myelin membranes. Symmetric white matter involvement at MRI is a typical finding in patients with leukodystrophies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:30620693]"}

name: Subependymal cysts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cerebral cysts, usually located in the wall of the caudate nucleus or in the caudothalamic groove. They are found in up to 5.2% of all neonates, using transfontanellar ultrasound in the first days of life.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12423490]"}

name: Abnormal midbrain morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the midbrain, which has as its parts the tectum, cerebral peduncle, midbrain tegmentum and cerebral aqueduct.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Molar tooth sign on MRI
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal appearance of the midbrain in axial magnetic resonance imaging in which the elongated superior cerebellar peduncles give the midbrain an appearance reminiscent of a molar or wisdom tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:14657304]"}

name: Poor head control
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty to maintain correct position of the head while standing or sitting. Infant head lag is observed when the head seems to flop around or lags posteriorly behind the trunk. Several articles have maintained that head lag should be absent by age 3 to 4 months.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:33620859]"}

name: Long-tract sign
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Long-tract signs refer to symptoms that are attributable to the involvement of the long fiber tracts in the spinal cord, which connect the spinal cord to the brain and mediate spinal and motor functions. These include spasticity, hyperreflexia, and abnormal reflexes such as Babinski or Hoffman's sign. If possible, it is preferable to use the precise HPO terms for these abnormalities.\" []"}

name: Anarthria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A defect in the motor ability that enables speech.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Expressive aphasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impairment of expressive language and relative preservation of receptive language abilities. That is, the patient understands language (speech, writing) but cannot express it.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Meningocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Protrusion of the meninges through a defect of the skull or vertebral column.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:32965845]"}

name: Occipital meningocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull in the occipital region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dyscalculia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A specific learning disability involving mathematics and arithmetic.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypothalamic hamartoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a hamartoma of the hypothalamus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tetraplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paralysis of all four limbs, and trunk of the body below the level of an associated injury to the spinal cord. The etiology of quadriplegia is similar to that of paraplegia except that the lesion is in the cervical spinal cord rather than in the thoracic or lumbar segments of the spinal cord.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Astrocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Proliferation of astrocytes in the area of a lesion of the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal motor neuron morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly that affects the motor neuron.\" []"}

name: Limb dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of dystonia (abnormally increased muscular tone causing fixed abnormal postures) that affects muscles of the limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Eye of the tiger anomaly of globus pallidus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence, on T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging, of markedly low signal intensity of the globus pallidus that surrounds a central region of high signal intensity in the anteromedial globus pallidus, producing an eye-of-the-tiger appearance. The sign is thought to represent iron accumulation in the globus pallidus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11110959, PMID:19881070, PMID:29371252]"}

name: Distal muscle weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced strength of the musculature of the distal extremities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebellar dentate nucleus calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pathological deposition of calcium salts in the dentate nucleus of the cerebellum.\" []"}

name: Language impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Language impairment is a deficit in comprehension or production of language that includes reduced vocabulary, limited sentence structure, or impairments in written or spoken communication. Language abilities are substantially and quantifiably below age expectations.\" []"}

name: Spastic dysarthria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of dysarthria related to bilateral damage of the upper motor neuron tracts of the pyramidal and extra- pyramidal tracts. Speech of affected individuals is slow, effortful, and has a harsh vocal quality.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Expressive language delay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A delay in the acquisition of the ability to use language to communicate needs, wishes, or thoughts.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myelomeningocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Protrusion of the meninges and portions of the spinal cord through a defect of the vertebral column.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Primitive reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The primitive reflexes are a group of behavioral motor responses which are found in normal early development, are subsequently inhibited, but may be released from inhibition by cerebral, usually frontal, damage. They are thus part of a broader group of reflexes which reflect release phenomena, such as exaggerated stretch reflexes and extensor plantars. They do however involve more complex motor responses than such simple stretch reflexes, and are often a normal feature in the neonate or infant.\" [PMID:12700289]"}

name: Hepatic encephalopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Central nervous system dysfunction in association with liver failure and characterized clinically (depending on degree of severity) by lethargy, confusion, nystagmus, decorticate posturing, spasticity, and bilateral Babinski reflexes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myotonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An involuntary and painless delay in the relaxation of skeletal muscle following contraction or electrical stimulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperkinetic movements
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Motor hyperactivity with excessive movement of muscles of the body as a whole.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acute leukemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A clonal (malignant) hematopoietic disorder with an acute onset, affecting the bone marrow and the peripheral blood. The malignant cells show minimal differentiation and are called blasts, either myeloid blasts (myeloblasts) or lymphoid blasts (lymphoblasts).\" [NCIT:C9300]"}

name: Increased CSF lactate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of lactate in the cerebrospinal fluid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spasticity of facial muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spasticity of one or more muscles innervated by the facial nerve.\" []"}

name: Abnormal corticospinal tract morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the corticospinal tract, which is the chief element of the pyramidal system (the principle motor tract) and is the only direct connection between the cerebrum and the spinal cord.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Upper motor neuron dysfunction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the upper motor neuron. The upper motor neurons are neurons of the primary motor cortex which project to the brainstem and spinal chord via the corticonuclear, corticobulbar and corticospinal (pyramidal) tracts. They are involved in control of voluntary movements. Dysfunction leads to weakness, impairment of fine motor movements, spasticity, hyperreflexia and abnormal pyramidal signs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal rapid eye movement sleep
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of REM Sleep are phases of REM sleep are characterized by desynchronized EEG patterns, increases in heart rate and blood pressure, sympathetic activation, and a profound loss of muscle tone except for the eye and middle-ear muscles. There are also phases of rapid eye movements.\" [PMID:31910377, PMID:32179430]"}

name: Impaired vibratory sensation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration. Clinically, this is usually tested with a tuning fork which vibrates at 128 Hz and is applied to bony prominences such as the malleoli at the ankles or the metacarpal-phalangeal joints. There is a slow decay of vibration from the tuning fork. The degree of vibratory sense loss can be crudely estimated by counting the number of seconds that the examiner can perceive the vibration longer than the patient.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal cerebral white matter morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the cerebral white matter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Calcification of the small brain vessels
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deposition of calcium salts within small blood vessels of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Loss of ambulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to walk in a person who previous had the ability to walk.\" []"}

name: Semilobar holoprosencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of holoprosencephaly in which the left and right frontal and parietal lobes are fused and the interhemispheric fissure is only present posteriorly.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:GC_HPE]"}

name: Brainstem dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental structural anomaly of the stalk-like part of the brain that comprises the midbrain (aka mesencephalon), the pons (aka pons Varolii), and the medulla oblongata, and connects the cerebral hemispheres with the cervical spinal cord.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Alzheimer disease
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A degenerative disease of the brain characterized by the insidious onset of dementia. Impairment of memory, judgment, attention span, and problem solving skills are followed by severe apraxia and a global loss of cognitive abilities. The condition primarily occurs after age 60, and is marked pathologically by severe cortical atrophy and the triad of senile plaques, neurofibrillary tangles, and neuropil threads.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of calcium deposition within the cerebrum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Waddling gait
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Weakness of the hip girdle and upper thigh muscles, for instance in myopathies, leads to an instability of the pelvis on standing and walking. If the muscles extending the hip joint are affected, the posture in that joint becomes flexed and lumbar lordosis increases. The patients usually have difficulties standing up from a sitting position. Due to weakness in the gluteus medius muscle, the hip on the side of the swinging leg drops with each step (referred to as Trendelenburg sign). The gait appears waddling. The patients frequently attempt to counteract the dropping of the hip on the swinging side by bending the trunk towards the side which is in the stance phase (in the German language literature this is referred to as Duchenne sign). Similar gait patterns can be caused by orthopedic conditions when the origin and the insertion site of the gluteus medius muscle are closer to each other than normal, for instance due to a posttraumatic elevation of the trochanter or pseudarthrosis of the femoral neck.\" [PMID:27770207]"}

name: Increased intracranial pressure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase of the pressure inside the cranium (skull) and thereby in the brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal periventricular white matter morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the myelinated axons (white matter) located near the cerebral ventricles.\" []"}

name: Hypnagogic hallucination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypnagogic hallucinations are brief hallucinations that occur when falling asleep.\" [PMID:27872259]"}

name: Hypsarrhythmia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypsarrhythmia is abnormal interictal high amplitude waves and a background of irregular spikes. There is continuous (during wakefulness), high-amplitude (>200 Hz), generalized polymorphic slowing with no organized background and multifocal spikes demonstrated by electroencephalography (EEG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Areflexia of lower limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the lower limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cataplexy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sudden and transient episode of bilateral loss of muscle tone, often triggered by emotions.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21931493, PMID:22249574]"}

name: Deficit in nonword repetition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impaired ability to repeat non-word sounds. Nonword repetition (NWR) is a measure of short-term phonological memory.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Granulovacuolar degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Electron-dense granules within double membrane-bound cytoplasmic vacuoles.\" [PMID:22073234]"}

name: Neuronal loss in central nervous system
Axial dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of dystonia that affects the midline muscles, i.e., the chest, abdominal, and back muscles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal posturing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Involuntary flexion or extension of the arms and legs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal cortical gyration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the gyri (i.e., the ridges) of the cerebral cortex of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal cerebral cortex morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the cerebral cortex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:31373394]"}

name: Cortical dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of developmental dysplasia of the cerebral cortex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Olivopontocerebellar atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Neuronal degeneration in the cerebellum, pontine nuclei, and inferior olivary nucleus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retrocollis

name: Type IV atherosclerotic lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In type IV atherosclerotic lesions a dense accumulation of extracellular lipid occupies an extensive but well-defined region of the intima. This type of extracellular lipid accumulation is known as the lipid core. A fibrous tissue increase is not a feature, and complications such as defects of the lesion surface and thrombosis are not present. The type IV lesion is also known as atheroma. Type IV is the first lesion considered advanced in this classification because of the severe intimal disorganization caused by the lipid core. The characteristic core appears to develop from an increase and the consequent confluence of the small isolated pools of extracellular lipid that characterize type III lesions. The increase in lipid is believed to result from continued insudation from the plasma. Type IV lesions, when they first appear in younger people, are found in the same locations as adaptive intimal thickenings of the eccentric type. Thus, atheroma is, at least initially, an eccentric lesion.\" [PMID:7648691]"}

name: Budd-Chiari syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Budd-Chiari syndrome (BCS) is caused by obstruction of hepatic venous outflow at any level from the small hepatic veins to the junction of the inferior vena cava (IVC) with the right atrium, 1 and occurs in 1/100,000 of the general population worldwide. The most common presentation is with ascites, but can range from fulminant hepatic failure (FHF) to asymptomatic forms. Obstruction of hepatic venous outflow is mainly caused by primary intravascular thrombosis, which can occur suddenly or be repeated over time, accompanied by some revascularization, accounting for the variable parenchymal hepatic damage and histologic presentation. Budd-Chiari syndrome is thus a disease, but since it occurs as a manifestation of several other diseases, this term is kept for the present for convenience.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16265183]"}

Rickets
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rickets is divided into two major categories including calcipenic and phosphopenic. Hypophosphatemia is described as a common manifestation of both categories. Hypophosphatemic rickets is the most common type of rickets that is characterized by low levels of serum phosphate, resistance to ultraviolet radiation or vitamin D intake. There are several issues involved in hypophosphatemic rickets such as calcium, vitamin D, phosphorus deficiencies. Moreover, other disorder can be associated with its occurrence such as absorption defects due to pancreatic, intestinal, gastric, and renal disorders and hepatobiliary disease. Symptoms are usually seen in childhood and can be varied in severity. Severe forms may be linked to bowing of the legs, poor bone growth, and short stature as well as joint and bone pain. Hypophosphatemic rickets are associated with renal excretion of phosphate, hypophosphatemia, and mineral defects in bones. The familial type of the disease is the most common type of rickets.\" [GARD:0005700]"}

name: Osteomyelitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Osteomyelitis is an inflammatory process accompanied by bone destruction and caused by an infecting microorganism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15276398]"}

name: Pathologic fracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pathologic fracture occurs when a bone breaks in an area that is weakened secondarily to another disease process such as tumor, infection, and certain inherited bone disorders. A pathologic fracture can occur without a degree of trauma required to cause fracture in healthy bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent fractures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The repeated occurrence of bone fractures (implying an abnormally increased tendency for fracture).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Osteoarthritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Degeneration (wear and tear) of articular cartilage, i.e., of the joint surface. Joint degeneration may be accompanied by osteophytes (bone overgrowth), narrowing of the joint space, regions of sclerosis at the joint surface, or joint deformity.\" []"}

name: Generalized joint hypermobility
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Joint hypermobility (ability of a joint to move beyond its normal range of motion) affecting many or all joints of the body. In individuals with Joint hypermobility at multiple sites (usually five or more), the term generalized joint hypermobility is preferred.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28145606]"}

name: Multiple exostoses
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of more than one exostosis. An exostosis is a benign growth the projects outward from the bone surface. It is capped by cartilage, and arises from a bone that develops from cartilage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Stippled chondral calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Punctate (speckled, dot-like) deposition of calcium of calcium salts in the articular cartilage (cartilage located in joints).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:29246349]"}

name: Bronchomalacia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Weakness or softness of the cartilage in the walls of the bronchial tubes.\" [PMID:15764786]"}

name: Upper airway obstruction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased resistance to the passage of air in the upper airway.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent lower respiratory tract infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased susceptibility to lower respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent lower respiratory tract infections.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tracheobronchomalacia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Weakness of the cartilage in the trachea and the bronchi, resulting in a floppy (non-rigid) airway. Affected persons may have difficulties to maintain patency of the airways.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tracheal calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Calcification (abnormal deposits of calcium) in the tracheal tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18663210]"}

name: Recurrent upper respiratory tract infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased susceptibility to upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent upper respiratory tract infections (running ears - otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoventilation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the amount of air transported into the pulmonary alveoli by breathing, leading to hypercapnia (increase in the partial pressure of carbon dioxide).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced vital capacity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction on the vital capacity, which is defined as the total lung capacity (volume of air in the lungs at maximal inflation) less the residual volume (i.e., volume of air in the lungs following maximal exhalation) of the lung.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal pattern of respiration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the rhythm or depth of breathing.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Osteolysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Osteolysis refers to the destruction of bone through bone resorption with removal or loss of calcium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Congenital contracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"One or more flexion contractures (a bent joint that cannot be straightened actively or passively) that are present at birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple congenital contractures in different body areas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23050160]"}

name: Kyphosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Exaggerated anterior convexity of the thoracic vertebral column.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Coxa vara
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Coxa vara includes all forms of decrease of the femoral neck shaft angle (the angle between the neck and the shaft of the femur) to less than 120 degrees.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal limb bone morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of bones of the arms or legs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the knee
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the knee joint or surrounding structures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Genu recurvatum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased extension of the knee joint, so that the knee can bend backwards.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:9580896]"}

name: Abnormal femur morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the structure of the femur.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Caudal appendage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a tail-like skin appendage located adjacent to the sacrum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18266249, PMID:18629881, PMID:23904413]"}

name: Halberd-shaped pelvis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous radiographic appearance of the developing pelvis, in which the greater ischiadic noth (incisura ischiadica major) is shallow and the pelvis takes on the appearance said to resemble a halberd (a weapon especially of the 15th and 16th centuries consisting typically of a battle-ax and pike mounted on a handle).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19232556]"}

name: Hip dislocation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Displacement of the femur from its normal location in the hip joint.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Calcific stippling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) pattern of calcifications in soft tissues within or surrounding bones (as observed on radiographs).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cystic angiomatosis of bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Disseminated multifocal hemangiomatous or lymphangiomatous lesions of the skeleton. The lesions are lytic, well-defined, round or oval lesions within the medullary cavity, and they have an intact cortex, and manifest variable peripheral sclerosis and may exhibit endosteal scalloping.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11930062]"}

name: Aspiration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inspiration of a foreign object into the airway.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bladder exstrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Eversion of the posterior bladder wall through the congenitally absent lower anterior abdominal wall and anterior bladder wall.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202]"}

name: Recurrent bronchitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased susceptibility to bronchitis as manifested by a history of recurrent bronchitis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, ISBN:0199747725, PMID:28261574]"}

name: Urinary bladder sphincter dysfunction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal function of a sphincter of the urinary bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent fungal infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to fungal infections as manifested by multiple episodes of fungal infection.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal T cell morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase or decrease of total or subset T cell count. T cells are commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, or their subpopulations, in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group, measured ex vivo. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal B cell morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of B cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18725575]"}

name: Impaired memory B cell generation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impaired production of memory cells, the B cells that persist for years or an entire lifetime and which confer rapid and enhanced response to secondary challenge.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased specific anti-polysaccharide antibody concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of normal overall immunoglobulin levels with deficiency of specific immunoglobulins directed against bacterial polysaccharides.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absence of lymph node germinal center
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of germinal centers in lymph nodes. Germinal centers are the parts of lymph nodes in which B lymphocytes proliferate, differentiate, mutate through somatic hypermutation and class switch during antibody responses.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased circulating IgM concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin M (IgM) in blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased double-negative T cell number
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase of double negative (DN) CD3+CD4-CD8- T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.\" [PMID:19176318, PMID:34474549]"}

name: Increased HLA-DR+ CD4+ T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase of the activated HLA-DR+ CD4+ T cell subpopulation, measured as percentage of total CD4+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group.\" [PMID:11531958]"}

name: Genu valgum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The legs angle inward, such that the knees are close together and the ankles far apart.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Meningioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a meningioma, i.e., a benign tumor originating from the dura mater or arachnoid mater.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Squamous cell carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of squamous cell carcinoma of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a melanoma, a malignant cancer originating from pigment producing melanocytes. Melanoma can originate from the skin or the pigmented layers of the eye (the uvea).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bladder carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a carcinoma of the urinary bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Myelodysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Clonal hematopoietic stem cell disorders characterized by dysplasia (ineffective production) in one or more hematopoietic cell lineages, leading to anemia and cytopenia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Medullary thyroid carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a medullary carcinoma of the thyroid gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal ilium morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the ilium, the largest and uppermost bone of the pelvis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Narrow iliac wing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased width of the wing (or ala) of the ilium (which is the large expanded portion which bounds the greater pelvis laterally).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Flared iliac wing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Widening of the ilium ala, that is of the wing of the ilium, combined with external rotation, leading to a flared appearance of the iliac wing.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28744080]"}

name: Obstructive sleep apnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Obstructive Sleep Apnea is a condition characterized by the obstruction of the airway and pauses in breathing during sleep, which occur multiple times throughout the night. It is related to the relaxation of muscle tone that typically happens during sleep, leading to a partial collapse of the soft tissues in the airway and causing airflow obstruction.\" [PMID:35609941]"}

name: Central apnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Apnea resulting from depression of the respiratory centers in the medulla oblongata. There is a lack of respiratory effort rather than obstruction of airflow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Apneic episodes precipitated by illness, fatigue, stress
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent episodes of apnea that are precipitated by factors such as illness, fatigue, or stress.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Exertional dyspnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Perceived difficulty to breathe that occurs with exercise or exertion and improves with rest.\" [PMID:29763022]"}

name: Nocturnal hypoventilation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in alveolar ventilation occurring during sleep. This is characterized by a rise in arterial carbon dioxide.\" [PMID:20308760]"}

name: Respiratory failure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A severe form of respiratory insufficiency characterized by inadequate gas exchange such that the levels of oxygen or carbon dioxide cannot be maintained within normal limits.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anisospondyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased variability of the size of the vertebral bodies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sudden episodic apnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent bouts of sudden, severe apnea that may be life-threatening.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperventilation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperventilation refers to an increased pulmonary ventilation rate that is faster than necessary for the exchange of gases. Hyperventilation can result from increased frequency of breathing, an increased tidal volume, or both, and leads to an excess intake of oxygen and the blowing off of carbon dioxide.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hepatoblastoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of neoplasm of the liver that originates from immature liver precursor cells and macroscopically is composed of tissue resembling fetal or mature liver cells or bile ducts.\" [eMedicine:986802, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Medulloblastoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A rapidly growing embryonic tumor arising in the posterior part of the cerebellar vermis and neuroepithelial roof of the fourth ventricle in children. More rarely, medulloblastoma arises in the cerebellum in adults.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vagal paraganglioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor that develops in the retrostyloid compartment of the parapharyngeal space, arising from an island of paraganglion tissue derived from the neural crest that is located on the vagus nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17268589]"}

name: Ependymoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an ependymoma of the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thyroid carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a carcinoma of the thyroid gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a leiomyosarcoma of the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pituitary adenoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign epithelial tumor derived from intrinsic cells of the adenohypophysis (anterior pituitary).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, PMID:32119338]"}

name: Neoplasm of the pancreas
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the pancreas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Papillary thyroid carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a papillary adenocarcinoma of the thyroid gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Neoplasm of the liver
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the liver.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Parathyroid adenoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign tumor of the parathyroid gland that can cause hyperparathyroidism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypokalemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of potassium(1+) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hypocalcemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of calcium in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hyponatremia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of sodium in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hyperbilirubinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased amount of bilirubin in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperphosphatemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of phosphate ion in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Microscopic hematuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Microscopic hematuria detected by dipstick or microscopic examination of the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Generalized aminoaciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of all types of amino acid in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elevated circulating hepatic transaminase concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Elevations of the levels of SGOT and SGPT in the serum. SGOT (serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase) and SGPT (serum glutamic pyruvic transaminase) are transaminases primarily found in the liver and heart and are released into the bloodstream as the result of liver or heart damage. SGOT and SGPT are used clinically mainly as markers of liver damage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Methylmalonic acidemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of methylmalonic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hyperchloriduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of chloride in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypomagnesemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of magnesium in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Hypermagnesemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of magnesium in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Ketonuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"High levels of ketone bodies (acetoacetic acid, beta-hydroxybutyric acid, and acetone) in the urine. Ketone bodies are insignificant in the blood and urine of normal individuals in the postprandial or overnight-fasted state.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11344564]"}

name: Decreased circulating ACTH concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of corticotropin, also known as adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased CSF protein concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of protein in the cerebrospinal fluid.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:KI_phemming, PMID:29114301]"}

name: Rheumatoid factor positive
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence in the serum of an autoantibody directed against the Fc portion of IgG.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elevated circulating thyroid-stimulating hormone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) in the blood circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547]"}

name: Abnormality of thyroid physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal functionality of the thyroid gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Histidinuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of histidine in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18901181, PMID:20240447]"}

name: Decreased activity of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex
Impaired sensitivity to thyroid hormone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced sensitivity of end organs to thyroid hormone characterized by elevated serum levels of free thyroid hormone with nonsuppressed thyroid stimulating hormone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0538-4547, PMID:24847459]"}

name: Ventral hernia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ventral hernia refers to a condition in which abdominal contents protrude through a weakened portion of the abdominal wall.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5316-1399]"}

name: Distal sensory impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in sensation in the distal portions of the extremities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemivertebrae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of one half of the vertebral body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lumbar hyperlordosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal accentuation of the inward curvature of the spine in the lumbar region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thoracic kyphosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Over curvature of the thoracic region, leading to a round back or if sever to a hump.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cervical kyphosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Exaggerated convexity of the cervical vertebral column, causing the cervical spine to bow outwards and take on a rounded appearance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vertebral fusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect leading to the union of two adjacent vertebrae.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fused cervical vertebrae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly characterized by a joining (fusion) of two or more cervical vertebral bodies with one another.\" []"}

name: Partial absence of cerebellar vermis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital absence of a part of the vermis of cerebellum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Granulomatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A granulomatous inflammation leading to multiple granuloma formation, which is a specific type of inflammation. A granuloma is a focal compact collection of inflammatory cells, mononuclear cells predominating, usually as a result of the persistence of a non-degradable product and of active cell mediated hypersensitivity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10908370, PMID:937513]"}

name: Immune dysregulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Altered immune function characterized by lymphoid proliferation, immune activation, and excessive autoreactivity often leading to autoimmune/inflammatory complications.\" [PMID:26233425]"}

name: Impaired Ig class switch recombination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An impairment of the class-switch recombination process that normally leads B lymphocytes to produce IgG, IgA, or IgE.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11544001]"}

name: Autoimmunity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The occurrence of an immune reaction against the organism's own cells or tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal delayed hypersensitivity skin test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delay in cutaneous immune reaction to specific antigens mediated not by antibodies but by cells. The delayed hypersensitivity test is an immune function test measuring the presence of activated T cells that recognize a specific antigen and is performed by injecting a small amount of the antigen into the skin. The area of the injection is examined 48-72 hours thereafter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cutaneous anergy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to react to a delayed hypersensitivity skin test.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cubitus valgus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal positioning in which the elbows are turned out.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Genu varum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A positional abnormality marked by outward bowing of the legs in which the knees stay wide apart when a person stands with the feet and ankles together.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent microvilli on the surface of peripheral blood lymphocytes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the fingerlike protrusive, actin-dependent structures found on the surface of peripheral blood lymphocytes.\" [PMID:15130947]"}

name: Reduced delayed hypersensitivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased ability to react to a delayed hypersensitivity skin test.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Radioulnar synostosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal osseous union (fusion) between the radius and the ulna.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia involving the central nervous system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of tissue in the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bowing of the legs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bending or abnormal curvature affecting a long bone of the leg.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the calf
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the calf, i.e. of the posterior part of the lower leg.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tibial bowing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bending or abnormal curvature of the tibia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Radial bowing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bending or abnormal curvature of the radius.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elbow flexion contracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elbow contracture that limits the ability of the elbow joint to be extended (straightened), meaning that the elbow is fixed in an flexed (bent) position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal fibula morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the calf bone (fibula), one of the two bones of the calf.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Patellar dislocation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar dislocation occurs if the patella fully dislocates out of the groove.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Breast carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a carcinoma of the breast.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ganglioneuroma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign neoplasm that usually arises from the sympathetic trunk in the mediastinum, representing a tumor of the sympathetic nerve fibers arising from neural crest cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Neuroblastoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Neuroblastoma is a solid tumor that originate in neural crest cells of the sympathetic nervous system. Most neuroblastomas originate in the abdomen, and most abdominal neuroblastomas originate in the adrenal gland. Neuroblastomas can also originate in the thorax, usually in the posterior mediastinum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Prolonged bleeding time
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Prolongation of the time taken for a standardized skin cut of fixed depth and length to stop bleeding.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5523-511X]"}

name: Abnormality of the musculature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality originating in one or more muscles, i.e., of the set of muscles of body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bulging epiphyses

name: Ganglioside accumulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Defects in the lysosomal glycosidases or specific co-activators, result in accumulation of the substrates, such as glycosphingolipids, including gangliosides in GM1 gangliosidosis (Tay-Sachs disease) and GM2 gangliosidosis (Sandhoff disease).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21937853]"}

name: Weakness of muscles of respiration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced function of the muscles required to generate subatmospheric pressure in the thoracic cavity during breathing: the diaphragm, the external intercostal and the interchondral part of the internal intercostal muscles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of bone mineral density
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This term applies to all changes in bone mineral density which (depending on severity) can be seen on x-rays as a change in density and or structure of the bone. Changes may affect all bones of the organism, just certain bones or only parts of bones and include decreased mineralisation as may be seen in osteoporosis or increased mineralisation and or ossification as in osteopetrosis, exostoses or any kind of atopic calicfications of different origin and distribution. The overall amount of mineralization of the bone-organ can be measured as the amount of matter per cubic centimeter of bones, usually measured by densitometry of the lumbar spine or hip. The measurements are usually reported as g/cm3 or as a Z-score (the number of standard deviations above or below the mean for the patient's age and sex). Note that measurement with this method does not reflect local changes in other bones, and as such might not be correct with regard the hole bone-organ.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intestinal pseudo-obstruction

name: Peptic ulcer
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term peptic ulcer refers to acid peptic injury of the digestive tract, resulting in mucosal break reaching the submucosa. name: Cranium bifidum occultum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cranium bifidum occultum, also known as Catlin mark, is a congenital midline skull defect presenting as an enlarged posterior fontanelle in the upper posterior angle of the parietal bone close to the intersection of the sagittal and lambdoid sutures. Cranium bifidum occultum occurs due to a defect in intramembranous ossification, a process through which skull bones (frontal, parietal, squamous temporal and occipital bones superior to the mendosal suture) ossify under a vascularized membrane toward the midline to cover the brain. Unlike cranium bifidum cysticum, cranium bifidum occultum does not have herniation of intracranial contents. As the skull grows, the midline cranium bifidum occultum defect is separated into bilateral enlarged parietal foramina (EPF) by a midline osseous bridge.\" [PMID:28522383]"}

name: Elfin facies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This is a description previously used to describe a facial form characterized by a short, upturned nose, wide mouth, widely spaced eyes, and full cheeks. name: 4-layered lissencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of lissencephaly in which the cortex is thickened and has four more or less disorganized layers rather than six normal layers resulting from incomplete neuronal migration during brain development. Radiologocally would manifest as agyria or pachygyria with cortical thickness greater than 10 mm.\" [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28440899]"}

name: Frontal polymicrogyria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of polymicrogyria with a gradient of severity (anterior more severe than posterior) extending from frontal poles posteriorly to precentral gyrus and inferiorly to frontal operculum.\" [http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q90573458, PMID:20301504]"}

name: Sensorimotor polyneuropathy affecting arms more than legs
Lobar holoprosencephaly

name: Impaired distal vibration sensation

name: Hypnopompic hallucination

name: Abducens palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Malfunction of the abducens nerve as manifested by impairment of the ability of the affected eye to be moved outward. Some patients may present with a constant head turning movement to maintain binocular fusion and to lessen the degree of diplopia.\" [PMID:29489275]"}

name: Congenital intracerebral calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of calcium deposition within brain structures that is present already at the time of birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intraaxonal accumulation of curvilinear autofluorescent lipopigment storage material
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Curvilinear intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material within axons.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Axial muscle stiffness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stiffness (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) of the axial musculature.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral polymicrogyria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive number of small gyri (convolutions) on the surface of one side of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoglycemic encephalopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Brain damage related to a lowering of blood glucose below a critical level (around 30 mg/dl), which may lead to confusion, lethargy and delirium followed by seizures and coma. Prolonged hypoglycemia may lead to irreversible brain damage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Frontoparietal cortical dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of developmental dysplasia of the cortex of frontal lobe and the cortex of parietal lobe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pericallosal lipoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pericallosal lipomas are congenital soft masses of adipose cells encapsulated by a thin layer of fibrous tissue, appearing adjacent to the corpus callosum of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3302-4610, PMID:30104143]"}

name: Transient psychotic episodes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Relatively short-lived periods of psychosis are characterized by the sudden onset of severe disturbances in perception, thinking, and behavior. These episodes typically last for a brief duration, generally ranging from a few days to a few weeks, and are often triggered by a significant stressor or traumatic event.\" []"}

name: Congenital nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nystagmus dating from or present at birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired distal tactile sensation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation) on the skin of the distal limbs. This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired vibration sensation at ankles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decrease in the ability to perceive vibration at the ankles. Clinically, this is usually tested with a tuning fork which vibrates at 128 Hz and is applied to the malleoli of the ankles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abolished vibration sense
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A complete loss of the ability to perceive vibration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent meningitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased susceptibility to meningitis as manifested by a medical history of recurrent episodes of meningitis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Olivopontocerebellar hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypoplasia of the cerebellum, pontine nuclei, and inferior olivary nucleus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal auditory evoked potentials
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the auditory evoked potentials, which are used to trace the signal generated by a sound, from the cochlear nerve, through the lateral lemniscus, to the medial geniculate nucleus, and to the cortex.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Proximal spinal muscular atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Proximal spinal muscular atrophy, i.e., muscular weakness and atrophy related to loss of the motor neurons of the spinal cord and brainstem.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Choroid plexus calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of calcium deposition in the choroid plexus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gait instability, worse in the dark
Periventricular leukomalacia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Periventricular leukomalacia is characterized by diffuse injury of deep cerebral white matter, accompanied in its most severe form by focal necrosis. The neuropathologic hallmarks of PVL are microglial activation and focal and diffuse periventricular depletion of premyelinating oligodendroglia.\" [PMID:16808630, PMID:18852342, PMID:28406931]"}

name: Necrotizing encephalopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of encephalopathy (brain disease, damage, or malfunction accompanied by an altered mental state) that is characterized by evidence of necrosis of brain tissue.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:KI_phemming, PMID:23705127]"}

name: Deficit in grammar
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deficit in grammar, including syntax and morphology.\" []"}

name: Sleep-wake cycle disturbance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of an individual's circadian rhythm that affects the timing of sleeping and being awake is referred to as a sleep-wake disorder.\" [PMID:30725708, PMID:36115370, PMID:36872502]"}

name: Progressive leukoencephalopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Leukoencephalopathy that gets more severe with time.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Alobar holoprosencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of holoprosencephaly characterized by the presence of a single ventricle and no separation of the cerebral hemisphere. The single midline ventricle is often greatly enlarged.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:GC_HPE]"}

name: Dysplastic corpus callosum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dysplasia and dysgenesis of the corpus callosum are nonspecific descriptions that imply defective development of the corpus callosum. The term dysplasia is applied when the morphology of the corpus callosum is altered as a congenital trait. For instance, the corpus callosum may be hump-shaped, kinked, or a striped corpus callosum that lacks an anatomically distinct genu and splenium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21263138]"}

name: Myelin-dependent gliosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of gliosis that occurs in the vicinity of injured neurons.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Basal ganglia gliosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal proliferation of glial cells in the basal ganglia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Loss of Purkinje cells in the cerebellar vermis
Motor axonal neuropathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Progressive impairment of function of motor axons with muscle weakness, atrophy, and cramps. name: Cavitation of the basal ganglia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The formation of small cavities in the tissue of the basal ganglia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8516046]"}

name: Poor fine motor coordination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the ability (skills) to perform a precise movement of small muscles with the intent to perform a specific act. Fine motor skills are required to mediate movements of the wrists, hands, fingers, feet, and toes.\" []"}

name: Fourth cranial nerve palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paralysis of the fourth cranial (trochlear) nerve manifested as weakness of the superior oblique muscle which causes vertical diplopia that is maximal when the affected eye is adducted and directed inferiorly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Poor gross motor coordination

name: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) manifests at age 2-3 years or by first grade at the latest. The main symptoms are distractibility, impulsivity, hyperactivity, and often trouble organizing tasks and projects, difficulty going to sleep, and social problems from being aggressive, loud, or impatient.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pseudobulbar paralysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bilateral impairment of the function of the cranial nerves 9-12, which control musculature involved in eating, swallowing, and speech. Pseudobulbar paralysis is characterized clinically by dysarthria, dysphonia, and dysphagia with bifacial paralysis, and may be accompanied by Pseudobulbar behavioral symptoms such as enforced crying and laughing.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Cerebral berry aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A small, sac-like aneurysm (outpouching) of a cerebral blood vessel.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebellar dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cerebellar dysplasia (abnormal growth or development) is defined by abnormal cerebellar foliation, white matter arborization, and gray-white matter junction. Cerebellar dysplasia is a neuroimaging finding that describes abnormalities of both the cerebellar cortex and white matter and is associated with variable neurodevelopmental outcome. Dysplasia may globally involve the cerebellum or affect only one cerebellar hemisphere. In addition, cerebellar dysplasia may be associated with cortical/subcortical cysts.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25105227, PMID:27160001]"}

name: Anterior encephalocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of congenital malformation in which brain tissue protrudes through a defect in the anterior (front) part of the skull.\" [PMID:22069427, PMID:32965839]"}

name: Symmetric T2-signal increase with T1-signal decrease in the putamen
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A symmetric magnetic resonance imaing (MRI) abnormality of the basal ganglia characterized by an increase of signal intensity in T2-weighted images and a corresponding signal decrease on T1-weighted images.\" [PMID:15210883]"}

name: Chronic lymphocytic meningitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Meningitis that persists for more than 4 weeks, and lymphocytes are present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).\" [PMID:27608867]"}

name: Atrophy of the dentate nucleus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial or complete wasting (loss) of dentate nucleus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Proximal hyperreflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperactive stretch reflexes of muscles that move proximal joints (elbow, knee).\" []"}

name: Generalized cerebral atrophy/hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Generalized atrophy or hypoplasia of the cerebrum.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Aplasia of the inferior half of the cerebellar vermis
Progressive language deterioration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Progressive loss of previously present language abilities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Disorganization of the anterior cerebellar vermis
Proximal limb muscle stiffness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stiffness of the limbs (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) occurring in the proximal limb muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Distal peripheral sensory neuropathy

extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the inferior portion of the vermis of cerebellum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16580298]"}

name: Dilated third ventricle

name: Facial-lingual fasciculations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fasciculations affecting the tongue muscle and the musculature of the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Paroxysmal choreoathetosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Episodes of choreoathetosis that can occur following triggers such as quick voluntary movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chiari type I malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Arnold-Chiari type I malformation refers to a relatively mild degree of herniation of the posteroinferior region of the cerebellum (the cerebellar tonsils) into the cervical canal with little or no displacement of the fourth ventricle. It is characterized by one or both pointed (not rounded) cerebellar tonsils that project 5 mm below the foramen magnum, measured by a line drawn from the basion to the opisthion (McRae Line)\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28613730]"}

name: Hypointensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Infantile encephalopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Encephalopathy with onset in the infantile period.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Segmental peripheral demyelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers from segments of the peripheral nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Subcortical dementia

name: Acute demyelinating polyneuropathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acute progressive areflexic weakness and mild sensory changes resulting from myelin breakdown and axonal degeneration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pallidal degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Neurodegeneration involving the globus pallidus,a part of the basal ganglia that is involved in the regulation of voluntary movement.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Asymmetric limb muscle stiffness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stiffness of the limbs (a condition in which muscles cannot be moved quickly without accompanying pain or spasm) occurring in an asymmetric pattern.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Progressive extrapyramidal muscular rigidity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A progressive degree of muscular rigidity (continuous contraction of muscles with constant resistance to passive movement).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fluctuations in consciousness

name: Paroxysmal dyskinesia

name: Absent smooth pursuit
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A complete lack of the ability to track objects with the ocular smooth pursuit system, a class of rather slow eye movements that minimizes retinal target motion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Interosseus muscle atrophy
