name: Peripheral hypomyelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced amount of myelin in the nervous system resulting from defective myelinogenesis in the peripheral nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Focal T2 hyperintense basal ganglia lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the basal ganglia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Loss of consciousness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of awareness of oneself or one's surroundings, involving (i) a loss of normal motor control is evident as flaccidity or stiffness, either of which can be accompanied by jerking movements, and postural control is lost so that patients fall if they are in an upright position; (ii) normal responsiveness is lost; and (iii) the patient experiences amnesia for the event. name: Focal lissencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital absence of the convolutions of the cerebral cortex and a poorly formed sylvian fissure that affects a particular part of the cortex.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:KI_phemming]"}

name: Congenital facial diplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Facial diplegia (that is, bilateral facial palsy) with congenital onset.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Neuronal loss in the cerebral cortex
Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure on awakening

name: Episodic hypersomnia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent episodes of hypersomnia (sleeping 16 or more hours a day) over a period of days or weeks.\" [PMID:36865656]"}

name: Cerebral artery atherosclerosis

name: Hemimegalencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of all or parts of one cerebral hemisphere.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17416820]"}

name: Photosensitive tonic-clonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Generalized-onset tonic-clonic seizures that are provoked by flashing or flickering light.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Irregular myelin loops

name: Facial paralysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete loss of ability to move facial muscles innervated by the facial nerve (i.e., the seventh cranial nerve).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Periodic hyperkalemic paralysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Episodes of muscle weakness associated with elevated levels of potassium in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intracerebral periventricular calcifications

name: Abnormal vestibulo-ocular reflex

Ideally passive or active head movements in one direction are compensated for by eye movements of equal magnitude.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:3625219]"}

name: Vitelliform macular lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Egg yolk-like (vitelliform) maculopathy is a lesion caused by the accumulation of material, often lipofuscin, in the subretinal space underlying the macula. Lesions may be singular or multiple, and may be either sharply or poorly demarcated.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592, PMID:18289629]"}

name: Undetectable light- and dark-adapted electroretinogram
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the combined rod-and-cone response on electroretinogram.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal pupillary light reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the reflex that controls the diameter of the pupil, in response to the intensity of light that falls on the retina of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ocular anterior segment dysgenesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal development (dysgenesis) of the anterior segment of the eye globe. These structures are mainly of mesenchymal origin.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Abnormal retinal pigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal pigmentation of the retina.\" []"}

name: Paroxysmal involuntary eye movements
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden-onset episode of abnormal, involuntary eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Congenital aphakia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the crystalline lens of the eye as a result of a developmental defect.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Band-shaped corneal dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of genetically determined disease of the cornea with corneal lesions with a band-like shape.\" []"}

name: Uveal melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A malignant melanoma originating within the eye. The tumor originates from the melanocytes in the uvea (which comprises the iris, ciliary body, and choroid).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chronic irritative conjunctivitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A chronic irritative conjunctivitis, which commonly presents with general irritation and redness of the eyes, with a burning, dry, or foreign-body sensation of the eyes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Flat cornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cornea plana is an abnormally flat shape of the cornea such that the normal protrusion of the cornea from the sclera is missing. The reduced corneal curvature can lead to hyperopia, and a hazy corneal limbus and arcus lipoides may develop at an early age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Saccular conjunctival dilatations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of multiple dilatations (sac-like outpouchings) in the blood vessels of the conjunctiva.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal pigment epithelial atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Opacification of the corneal epithelium
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of transparency of the corneal epithelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Congenital miosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal (non-physiological) constriction of the pupil of congenital onset.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Iris hypopigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation of the iris.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chorioretinal dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal development of the choroid and retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spicular pigmentation of the retina
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pigment migration into the retina in a bone-spicule configuration (resembling the nucleated cells within the lacuna of bone).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macular dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Macular dystrophy is a nonspecific term for retinal degeneration, generally confined to the macula, usually presumed of genetic origin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Opacification of the corneal stroma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced transparency of the stroma of cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Pericentral scotoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A scotoma (area of diminished vision within the visual field) that surrounds the central fixation point.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Localized, irregular dilatation of small tortuous intraretinal blood vessels.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Deep anterior chamber
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased depth of the anterior chamber, i.e., the anteroposterior distance between the cornea and the iris is increased.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Optic disc hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the optic disc, that is of the optic nerve head, where ganglion cell axons exit the eye to form the optic nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Central retinal vessel vascular tortuosity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of retinal blood vessels (arteries, arterioles, veins, venules).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Peripheral retinal degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Progressive loss of peripheral retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and/or neurosensory retinal cells.\" []"}

name: Impaired smooth pursuit
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An impairment of the ability to track objects with the ocular smooth pursuit system, a class of rather slow eye movements that minimizes retinal target motion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vitreoretinopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ocular abnormality characterized by premature degeneration of the vitreous and the retina that may be associated with increased risk of retinal detachment.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:18179896]"}

name: Chorioretinal scar
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fibrous connective tissue resulting from incomplete healing of a wound (i.e., a scar) located in the choroid and retina or the eye.\" []"}

name: Posterior retinal neovascularization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of retinal neovascularization that affects the posterior pole of the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cortical pulverulent cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cataract characterized by punctate, dust-like opacities within the cortical region of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Posterior subcapsular cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cataract affecting the posterior pole of lens immediately adjacent to ('beneath') the Lens capsule.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Patchy atrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nonspecific term denoting wasting, especially as a result of degeneration, of the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) that occurs in small, isolated areas.\" []"}

name: Granular macular appearance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mottled (spotted or blotched with different shades) pigmentary abnormality of the macula.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anterior cortical cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cataract that affects the anterior part of the cortex of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Developmental retinal vascular malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A group of development abnormalities of retinal blood vessels.\" []"}

name: Conjunctival whitish salt-like deposits
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of whitish deposits in the conjunctiva resembling salt. May be related to calcinosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased axial length of the globe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal largeness of the eye with an axial length > 2.5 standard deviations from population mean.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Granular corneal dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of central, fine, whitish granular lesions in the stroma of the cornea. This type of corneal dystrophy is usually asymptomatic and begins in childhood and shows a slow progression. Later in the course, the corneal epithelium and Bowman's layer may be affected. Histologically, the cornea shows a uniform deposition of hyaline material.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Monochromacy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete color blindness, a complete inability to distinguish colors. Affected persons cannot perceive colors, but only shades of gray.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Horizontal pendular nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nystagmus consisting of horizontal to-and-fro eye movements of equal velocity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Herpetiform corneal ulceration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of one or more dendritic corneal epithelial ulcers characterized by a treelike branching linear pattern with feathery edges and terminal bulbs. Herpetiform corneal ulcers can be identified by fluorescein staining.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nongranulomatous uveitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of uveitis that is not associated with the formation of granulomas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal pigment epithelial mottling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mottling (spots or blotches of different shades) of the retinal pigment epithelium, i.e., localized or generalized fundus pigment granularity associated with processes at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Horizontal supranuclear gaze palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A supranuclear gaze palsy is an inability to look in a horizontal direction as a result of cerebral impairment. There is a loss of the voluntary aspect of eye movements, but, as the brainstem is still intact, all the reflex conjugate eye movements are normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Central heterochromia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of distinct colors in the central (pupillary) zone of the iris than in the mid-peripheral (ciliary) zone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Presenile cataracts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presenile cataract is a kind of cataract that occurs in early adulthood, that is, at an age that is younger than usual.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17030721]"}

name: Lacrimal punctal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital absence or closure of the opening of the lacrimal punctum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Total ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paralysis of both the extrinsic and intrinsic ocular muscles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Adult-onset night blindness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to see well at night or in poor light with onset in adulthood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nonprogressive restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nonprogressive restriction of movement of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position. Residual eye movements are significantly limited.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Progressive cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of cataract that progresses with age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Amyloid deposition in the vitreous humor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deposition of hyaline extracellular material (amyloid) into the vitreous humor, which can manifest as vitreous opacities and reduced visual acuity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Attenuation of retinal blood vessels
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Narrowing of the retinal blood vessels, both arterioles and venules.\" [PMID:22661482]"}

name: Punctate opacification of the cornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Punctate opacification (reduced transparency) of the corneal stroma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Chorioretinal lacunae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Punched out lesions in the pigmented layer of the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Congenital horizontal nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Horizontal nystagmus dating from or present at birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deposition of calcium salts in the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Restrictive partial external ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fibrosis of only some of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Choroidal hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Benign choroidal tumour, seen in the fundus as a reddish or orange choroidal lesion and usually associated with cystoid edema, and less commonly with Subretinal fluid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15763200]"}

name: Almond-shaped palpebral fissure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A shape created by an acute downward arching of the upper eyelid and upward arching of the lower eyelid, toward the medial canthus, which gives the outline of the palpebral fissures the configuration of an almond. Thus, the maximum distance between the fissures is offset from, and medial to, the center point.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Allergic conjunctivitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Allergic Conjunctivitis is an allergic inflammation of the conjunctiva.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Slowed horizontal saccades
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally slow velocity of horizontal saccadic eye movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Iridescent posterior subcapsular cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of posterior subcapsular cataract characterized by an iridescent color.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7826272]"}

name: Fundus hypopigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Generalized or focal reduced pigmentation of the fundus, evaluated in the context of skin and hair color. Fundoscopy may reveal a low level pigment.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Retinal nonattachment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Retinal nonattachment is a developmental (congenital) condition in which persistent fetal blood vessels appear to proliferate more dramatically during infancy, causing complete perinatal detachment of the retina. This may occur during or shortly after neurogenesis, since the pathology is apparent at birth, and it may have a tractional basis, involving fibrovascular strands between the retina, posterior lens and hyaloid vessels.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21441919]"}

name: Vitreous hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bleeding within the vitreous compartment of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463, PMID:16882398]"}

name: Paravenous chorioretinal atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Chorioretinal atrophy along the retinal veins.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15623792]"}

name: Ocular hypertension
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraocular pressure that is 2 standard deviations above the population mean.\" []"}

name: Reticular retinal dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of of patterned retinal dystrophy that shows a reticular pattern of pigmentation.\" []"}

name: Polymorphous posterior corneal dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This corneal dystrophy affects the posterior limiting membrane of the cornea and is characterized by polymorphous plaques of calcium deposits in the deep stromal layers of the cornea, and occasionally by vesicular lesions of the endothelium and edema of the deep corneal stroma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tractional retinal detachment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of retinal detachment arising due to a combination of contracting retinal membranes, abnormal vitreoretinal adhesions, and vitreous changes, in the absence of a full-thickness retinal defect.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, ISBN-13:978-0199679980]"}

name: Hypermyelinated retinal nerve fibers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myelinated retinal nerve fiber (MRNF) layer is a rare and mostly benign congenital anomaly in which the retinal nerve fibers anterior to the lamina cribrosa have a myelin sheath.\" [PMID:34017666]"}

name: Lacrimal duct aplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital defect resulting in absence of the lacrimal duct.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal flash visual evoked potentials
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anomaly of the visual evoked potentials elicited by a flash stimulus, generally a flash of light subtending an angle of at least 20 degrees of the visual field and presented in a dimly lit room.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Peripheral retinal detachment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Separation of the inner layers of the retina (neural retina) from the pigment epithelium occurring near the outer limit (periphery) of the retina.\" []"}

name: Bilateral congenital mydriasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital abnormal dilation of the pupil on both sides.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Broad lateral eyebrow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Regional increase in the width (height) of the lateral eyebrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fibrosis of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position. Residual eye movements are significantly limited.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reticular pigmentary degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pattern of peripheral netlike retinal pigmentation that forms a polygonal arrangement of hyperpigmented lines forming geometric patterns in the fundus.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:fprobst, PMID:28114409]"}

name: Blue cone monochromacy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of monochromacy in which vision is derived from the remaining preserved blue (S) cones and rod photoreceptors.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Limited extraocular movements
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limited mobility of the eye within its socket.\" []"}

name: Internal ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paralysis of the iris and ciliary apparatus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Congenital stapes ankylosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of stapes ankylosis with congenital onset.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral narrow palpebral fissure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fixed reduction in the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelids with short palpebral fissures on one side only.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pericentral retinitis pigmentosa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A subtype of retinitis pigmentosa in which, instead of the pathology starting in the mid-periphery like typical retinitis pigmentosa, the disease starts in the near periphery closer to the vascular arcades and tends to spare the far periphery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:28981474]"}

name: Dense posterior cortical cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of posterior cortical cataract characterized by dense lenticular opacities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Peripapillary chorioretinal atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Chorioretinal atrophy concentrated around the optic papilla (i.e., the optic nerve head).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Optic atrophy from cranial nerve compression
Pattern dystrophy of the retina
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A spectrum of fundoscopic appearances characterized by the development of a variety of patterns of deposits predominantly in the macular area. The deposits are typically bilateral, relatively symmetrical, yellow/white and associated with changes at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium. With time, retinal atrophy may occur. A number of pattern dystrophy subtypes have been described including butterfly-shaped dystrophy, reticular dystrophy (net-like pattern) and fundus pulverulentus (granular, mottled pigmentation).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Remnants of the hyaloid vascular system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistence of the hyaloid artery, which is the embryonic artery that runs from the optic disc to the posterior lens capsule may persist; the site of attachment may form an opacity. The hyaloid artery is a branch of the ophthalmic artery, and usually regresses completely before birth. This features results from a failure of regression of the hyaloid vessel, which supplies the primary vitreous during embryogenesis and normally regresses in the third trimester of pregnancy, leading to a particular form of posterior cataract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lamellar cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital cataract in which opacity is limited to layers of the lens external to the nucleus (i.e., the perinuclear region), i.e., between the nuclear and cortical layers of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal growth and differentiation, structure and appearance of the retina present from birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypometric horizontal saccades
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Saccadic undershoot of horizontal saccadic eye movements, i.e., a horizontal saccadic eye movement that has less than the magnitude that would be required to gain fixation of the object.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:572501]"}

name: Cerulean cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cerulean cataracts are a kind of congenital cataract having peripheral bluish and white opacifications in concentric layers with occasional central lesions arranged radially. Although the opacities may be observed during fetal development and childhood, usually visual acuity is only mildly reduced until adulthood, when lens extraction is generally necessary.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19496508, PMID:9158139]"}

name: Gaze-evoked horizontal nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Horizontal nystagmus made apparent by looking to the right or to the left.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent retinal pigment epithelium
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Discrete areas of pallor in which the pigment epithelium, choriocapillaris and choroidal pigment are absent.\" []"}

name: ERG: Reduced dark-adapted b-wave amplitude
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram in which the b-wave that is of markedly lower amplitude than the associated a-wave.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:34127841]"}

name: Retinal arteriolar occlusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blockage of retinal arteriole, generally associated with interruption of blood flow and oxygen delivery to affected regions of the retina. This can affect the inner or mid-retinal structures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macular hypopigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased amount of pigmentation in the macula.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Intraretinal exudate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Retinal exudate within the retinal tissue itself.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lattice retinal degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pattern of white lines and dots in the far periphery of the retina.\" [PMID:37605766]"}

name: Malformed lacrimal duct
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital malformation of the lacrimal duct associated with incomplete development of the bony nasolacrimal canal or craniofacial anomalies.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Peripheral visual field loss
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of peripheral vision with retention of central vision, resulting in a constricted circular tunnel-like field of vision.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased corneal reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally reduced response to stimulation of the cornea (by touch, foreign body, blowing air). The corneal reflex (also known as the blink reflex, normally results in an involuntary blinking of the eyelids.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Foveal hyperpigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased amount of pigmentation in the fovea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal macular pigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal, uniform distribution or appearance of pigment within the macular region of the retina.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Peripheral opacification of the cornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced transparency of the peripheral region of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Superior lens subluxation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial dislocation of the lens in a superior direction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:5087595]"}

name: Cystoid macular degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of macular degeneration characterized by the presence of multiple cystoid spaces in the macula.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Posterior Y-sutural cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of sutural cataract in which the opacity follows the posterior Y suture.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent anterior chamber of the eye
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the anterior chamber of the eye owing to a developmental defect.\" []"}

name: Aplastic/hypoplastic lacrimal glands
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the lacrimal gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Focal retinal arteriolar constriction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal decreased retinal arteriolar diameters, which may decrease blood flow and slow oxygen delivery to regions of the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the vasculature of the eye
Abnormal line of Schwalbe morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the line of Schwalbe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the palpebral fissures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the space between the medial and lateral canthi of the two open eyelids.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal fold
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A wrinkle of retinal tissue projecting outward from the surface of the retina and visible as a line on fundoscopy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal morphology of the conjunctival vasculature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the blood vessels of the conjunctiva.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia affecting the uvea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the uvea, the pigmented middle layer of the eye consisting of the iris and ciliary body together with the choroid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia affecting the fundus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect characterized by lack of development or underdevelopment of the fundus/fovea.\" []"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the fovea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital absence or underdevelopment of the fovea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia affecting the anterior segment of the eye
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the anterior segment of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ichthyosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the skin characterized the presence of excessive amounts of dry surface scales on the skin resulting from an abnormality of keratinization.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal blistering of the skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of one or more bullae on the skin, defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:31596619]"}

name: Osteolytic defects of the hand bones

name: Metacarpal synostosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fusion involving two or more metacarpal bones (A synostosis of the first metacarpal and the proximal phalanx of the thumb can also be observed, note that the first metacarpal bone corresponds to a proximal phalanx).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Carpal synostosis

name: Synostosis involving the 1st metacarpal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fusion of the 1st metacarpal with another bone. name: Chronic CSF lymphocytosis

name: Chilblains

We are unaware of a reliable estimate of incidence. It typically presents as tender, pruritic red or bluish lesions located symmetrically on the dorsal aspect of the fingers, toes, ears and nose. Less commonly, reports describe involvement of the thighs and buttocks. The lesions present hours after exposure to cold and usually resolve spontaneously in one to three weeks.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:1832531, PMID:22025653]"}

name: Retinal capillary hemangioma

name: Subependymal nodules

name: Cortical tubers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cortical tubers in the brain are hamartomatous lesions typically located at the gray-white matter interface, commonly in the frontal and parietal lobes. Cortical tubers are composed of abnormal glial and neural cells, and the size, number, and location vary among patients.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Subependymal giant-cell astrocytoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A demarcated, largely intraventricular tumor in the region of the foramen of Monro composed of spindle to large plump or ganglion-like cells with eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm and somewhat pleomorphic nuclei with occasional prominent nucleoli. These tumors are almost always associated with tuberous sclerosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypomelanotic macule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypomelanotic macules (\\\"ash leaf spots\\\") are white or lighter patches of skin that may appear anywhere on the body and are caused by a lack of melanin. White ash leaf-shaped macules are considered to be characteristic of tuberous sclerosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10695583]"}

name: Adenoma sebaceum

name: Shagreen patch
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A plaque representing a connective-tissue nevus. Shagreen patches are oval-shaped and nevoid, skin-colored or occasionally pigmented, smooth or crinkled. The word shagreen refers to a type of roughened untanned leather.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10695583]"}

name: Duplication of thumb phalanx
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete or partial duplication of the phalanges of the thumb. In contrast to the phalanges of the digits 2-5 (proximal, middle and distal), the proximal phalanx of the thumb is embryologically equivalent to the middle phalanges of the other digits, whereas the first metacarpal is embryologically of phalangeal origin and as such equivalent to the proximal phalanges of the other digits.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

A duplication leading to an accessory bone appearing in the proximo-distal axis on x-rays, this is actually a different entity called a Pseudoepiphyses (see according terms) sometimes also referred to as Hyperphalangism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal ventricular septum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the interventricular septum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopic accessory toe-like appendage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the fibular side of the foot, next top the little toe), preaxial (on the tibial side of the foot, next to the big toe) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between big and little toe), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopic accessory finger-like appendage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the ulnar side of the hand, next to the little finger), preaxial (on the radial side of the hand, next to the thumb) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between thumb and little finger), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Polydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of supernumerary fingers or toes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bifid femur
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bifid or bifurcated appearance of the femur as seen on x-rays, possible appearing as a more or less severe bowing of the upper leg. Might be associated with hip dysplasia on the affected side.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pulmonic regurgitation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The retrograde (backwards) flow of blood through the pulmonary valve into the right ventricle during diastole.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3302-4610, PMID:32491496]"}

name: Primum atrial septal defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An ostium primum atrial septal defect is located in the most anterior and inferior aspect of the atrial septum. The ostium primum refers to an anterior and inferior opening (ostium) within the septum primum, which divides the rudimentary atrium during fetal development. The ostium primum is normally sealed by fusion of the superior and inferior endocardial cushions around 5 weeks' gestation. Ostium primum defects result from a failure of the fusion of the embryologic endocardial cushion and septum primum.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:40843896]"}

name: Tricuspid stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A narrowing of the orifice of the tricuspid valve of the heart.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18222317]"}

name: Anal fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal connection between the epithelialised surface of the anal canal and the perianal skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Colonic atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the colon. That is, there is an abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the colon.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Esophageal stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal narrowing of the lumen of the esophagus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pelvic bone asymmetry
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pelvic asymmetry refers to asymmetric positioning of landmarks on the two sides of the pelvis and may have a structural or functional etiology.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acetabular spurs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of osteophytes (bone spurs), i.e., of bony projections originating from the acetabulum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Steep acetabular roof
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An exaggeration of the normal arched form of the acetabular roof such that it takes on a steep appearance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal greater sciatic notch morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the sacrosciatic notch, i.e., the deep indentation in the posterior border of the hip bone at the point of union of the ilium and ischium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Female pseudohermaphroditism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hermaphroditism refers to a discrepancy between the morphology of the gonads and that of the external genitalia. In female pseudohermaphroditism, the genotype is female (XX) and the gonads are ovaries, but the external genitalia are virilized.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: True hermaphroditism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of both ovarian and testicular tissues either in the same or in opposite gonads. Affected persons have ambiguous genitalia and may have 46,XX or 46,XY karyotypes or 46,XX/XY mosaicism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11327376]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the ovary
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the ovary.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia of the ovary
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Aplasia, that is failure to develop, of the ovary.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Streak ovary
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental disorder characterized by the progressive loss of primordial germ cells in the developing ovaries of an embryo, leading to hypoplastic ovaries composed of wavy connective tissue with occasional clumps of granulosa cells, and frequently mesonephric or hilar cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Precocious puberty in females
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The onset of puberty before the age of 8 years in girls.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent testis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Testis not palpable in the scrotum or inguinal canal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202]"}

name: Supernumerary testes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of more than two testes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oligosacchariduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased urinary excretion of oligosaccharides (low molecular weight carbohydrate chains composed of at least three monosaccharide subunits), derived from a partial degradation of glycoproteins.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating porphyrin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of porphyrins in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Porphyrinuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased excretion of porphyrins in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bladder stones
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Buildups of minerals that form in the urinary bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cloacal exstrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cloacal exstrophy is a severe anterior abdominal wall defect in which the two hemibladders are visible and are separated by a midline intestinal plate, an omphalocele, and an imperforate anus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the bladder
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the urinary bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Patent urachus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistence of the urachal canal resulting in a canal between the bladder and the umbilicus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urethral fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormal connection between the urethra and another organ or the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urethral valve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormal membrane obstructing the urethra.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acromelia of the upper limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Shortening of the arms predominantly affecting terminal parts of the arm in relation to the upper and middle limb segments.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypertrophy of the upper limb
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase in size of the upper limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperextensibility at elbow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The ability of the elbow joint to move beyond its normal range of motion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the hypothenar eminence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the hypothenar eminence, i.e., of the muscles on the ulnar side of the palm of the hand (i.e., on the side of the little finger).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Small hypothenar eminence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced muscle mass on the ulnar side of the palm, that is, reduction in size of the hypothenar eminence.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the palmar creases
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the palmar creases.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent palmar crease
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The absence of the major creases of the palm (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, or thenar crease).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Abnormal palmar crease morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the creases of the skin of palm of hand.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Digital constriction ring
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A narrow segment of significantly reduced circumference of a digit.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Osseous finger syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Long metacarpals
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased length of the metacarpal bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acromelia of the lower limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Shortening of the legs predominantly affecting terminal parts of the leg in relation to the upper and middle arm segments.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypertrophy of the lower limb
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase in size of the lower limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sirenomelia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect in which the legs are fused together.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bipartite patella
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect that occurs if the two halves of the patella fail to fuse in early childhood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Patellar subluxation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar subluxation refers to an unstable kneecap that does not slide centrally within its groove, i.e., a partial dislocation of the patella.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperextensibility of the knee
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The ability of the knee joint to extend beyond its normal range of motion (the lower leg is moved beyond a straight position with respect to the thigh).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Limitation of knee mobility
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal limitation of knee joint mobility.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fibular bowing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bending or abnormal curvature of the fibula.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fibular duplication
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Duplication of the fibula. This may occur as a part of diplopodia (accessory tarsal or metatarsal bone). Diplopodia with double fibula is an extremely rare condition.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased length of the tibia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal increase in the length of the tibia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Limitation of movement at ankles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal limitation of the mobility of the ankle joint.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal plantar dermatoglyphics
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of dermatoglyphs on the toes and soles, i.e., an abnormality of the patterns of ridges of the skin of sole of foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Foot asymmetry
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A difference in size or shape between the left and right foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Metatarsus valgus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which the anterior part of the foot rotates outward away from the midline of the body and the heel remains straight.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypermobility of toe joints
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An ability of the toe joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Long toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Toes that appear disproportionately long compared to the foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Pituitary calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deposition of calcium salts in the pituitary gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperpituitarism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypersecretion of one or more pituitary hormones. This can occur in conditions in which deficiency in the target organ leads to decreased hormonal feedback, or as a primary condition most usually in connection with a pituitary adenoma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopic thymus tissue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of ectopic thymus tissue. Normally, cells of the ventral bud of the third pharyngeal pouch detach and migrate in the eighth gestational week caudally and medially towards the location of the mature thyroid. They migrate further retrosternally into the superior mediastinum. There are two main ways ectopic thymus tissue can develop. Either cells detach along the descensus path and proliferate, thereby forming accessory thymus tissue, or the entire gland fails to descend.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thyroglossal cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the thyroid gland owing to the presence of a fibrous cyst resulting from the persistence of the thyroglossal duct.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased fetal movement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal increase in quantity or strength of fetal movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gait apraxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Gait apraxia affecting the ability to make walking movements with the legs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dyslexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A learning disorder characterized primarily by difficulties in learning to read and spell. Dyslectic children also exhibit a tendency to read words from right to left and to confuse letters such as b and d whose orientation is important for their identification. Children with dyslexia appear to be impaired in phonemic skills (the ability to associate visual symbols with the sounds they represent).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Alexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An acquired type of sensory aphasia where damage to the brain leads to the loss of the ability to read.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Disturbed sensory perception
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Alteration or impairment in the processing or interpretation of sensory information can lead to abnormal perceptions or experiences.\" []"}

name: Finger agnosia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The examiner identified the inability to name, move, or touch specific fingers.\" []"}

name: Dysgraphia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A writing disability in the absence of motor or sensory deficits of the upper extremities, resulting in an impairment in the ability to write regardless of the ability to read and not due to intellectual impairment.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Astereognosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tactile agnosia refers to the inability to recognize objects by touch, while the inability to discriminate shape and size by touch is also a related condition.\" []"}

name: Prosopagnosia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to recognize faces of familiar persons.\" []"}

name: Echolalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Echolalia is the automatic imitative repetition of sounds, words, or phrases in the absence of explicit awareness. The repeated words or phrases are typically odd or used in a non-social manner. These can be words or phrases that the affected individual has heard or invented.\" [PMID:31651053]"}

name: Palatal tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Palatal tremor (PT) is an involuntary, rhythmic and oscillatory movement of the soft palate. PT is a rare type of tremor involving the soft palate. It can be unilateral or bilateral.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:33101766]"}

name: Spinal myoclonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spinal myoclonus is generally due to a tumor, infection, injury, or degenerative process of the spinal cord, and is characterized by involuntary rhythmic muscle contractions, usually at a rate of more than one per second. Myoclonus occurs synchronously in several muscles and can be increased in severity and frequency by fatigue or stress, but is usually unaffected by sensory stimuli. Spinal myoclonus ceases during sleep or anesthesia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spasmus nutans
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The combination of pendular nystagmus, head nodding, and torticollis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7499100]"}

name: Transient global amnesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A paroxysmal, transient loss of memory function with preservation of immediate recall and remote memory but with a severe impairment of memory for recent events and ability to retain new information.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sleep apnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An intermittent cessation of airflow at the mouth and nose during sleep is known as sleep apnea. Apneas that last at least 10 seconds are considered significant, but individuals with sleep apnea may experience apneas lasting from 20 seconds up to 2 or 3 minutes. Patients may have up to 15 events per hour of sleep.\" []"}

name: Central sleep apnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sleep apnea results from a temporary loss of the central drive to the muscles responsible for breathing.\" [PMID:35551411, PMID:36031317]"}

name: Wide cranial sutures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased width of the cranial sutures for age-related norms (generally resulting from delayed closure).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thin calvarium
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormally thin calvarium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Advanced pneumatization of cranial sinuses
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A degree of pneumatization that is increased compared to age-related norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cutis gyrata of scalp
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of convoluted folds and furrows formed from thickened skin of the scalp, resembling cerebriform pattern. The scalp has convoluted and elevated folds, 1 to 2 cm in thickness. The convolutions generally cannot be flattened by traction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vestibular nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nystagmus due to disturbance of the vestibular system; eye movements are rhythmic, with slow and fast components.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Opsoclonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bursts of large-amplitude multidirectional saccades without intersaccadic interval\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Vertical nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Vertical nystagmus may present with either up-beating or down-beating eye movements or both. When present in the straight-ahead position of gaze it is referred to as upbeat nystagmus or downbeat nystagmus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Downbeat nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Downbeat nystagmus is a type of fixation nystagmus with the fast phase beating in a downward direction. It generally increases when looking to the side and down and when lying prone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21505601]"}

name: Muscle fibrillation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fine, rapid twitching of individual muscle fibers with little or no movement of the muscle as a whole as ascertained by electromyography (EMG). If a motor neuron or its axon is destroyed, the muscle fibers it innervates undergo denervation atrophy. This leads to hypersensitivity of individual muscle fibers to acetyl choline so that they may contract spontaneously. Isolated activity of individual muscle fibers is generally so fine it cannot be seen through the intact skin, although it can be recorded as a short-duration spike in the EMG.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Muscle flaccidity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of paralysis in which a muscle becomes soft and yields to passive stretching, which results from loss of all or practically all peripheral motor nerves that innervated the muscle. Muscle tone is reduced and the affected muscles undergo extreme atrophy within months of the loss of innervation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Percussion myotonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A localized myotonic contraction in a muscle in reaction to percussion (tapping with the examiner's finger, a rubber percussion hammer, or a similar object).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Weakness due to upper motor neuron dysfunction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Paralysis of voluntary muscles means loss of contraction due to interruption of one or more motor pathways from the brain to the muscle fibers. Although the word paralysis is often used interchangeably to mean either complete or partial loss of muscle strength, it is preferable to use paralysis or plegia for complete or severe loss of muscle strength, and paresis for partial or slight loss. Paralysis due to lesions of the principle motor tracts is related to a lesion in the corticospinal, corticobulbar or brainstem descending (subcorticospinal) neurons.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Paraplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severe or complete weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Paraplegia/paraparesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Weakness of both lower extremities with sparing of the upper extremities. Paraplegia refers to a severe or complete loss of strength, whereas paraparesis refers to a relatively mild loss of strength.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oculogyric crisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An acute dystonic reaction with blepharospasm, periorbital twitches, and protracted fixed staring episodes. There may be a maximal upward deviation of the eyes in the sustained fashion. Oculogyric crisis can be triggered by a number of factors including neuroleptic medications.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cutaneous finger syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two fingers that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal joint of the adjacent fingers.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Overlapping fingers

name: Y-shaped metatarsals
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Y-shaped metatarsals are the result of a partial fusion of two metatarsal bones, with the two arms of the Y pointing in the distal direction. Y-shaped metatarsals may be seen in combination with polydactyly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hamartoma of the eye

name: Intracranial cystic lesion

name: Cone-shaped epiphysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. name: Irregular epiphyses

name: Ivory epiphyses

name: Small epiphyses

name: Triangular epiphysis

name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at each end of a long bone, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12624140]"}

name: Chalazion

name: Hordeolum

Hordeola can either occur as Hordeola externa affecting the sebaceous glands of Zeis or the apocrine sweat glands of Moll or as Hordeola interna affecting the meibomian sebacious glands. In contrast to chalazia, hordeola are extremely painful and can cause extreme local swelling.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Hordeolum externum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hordeola externa are acute purulent infections affecting the sebaceous glands of Zeis or the apocrine sweat glands of Moll, often caused by staphylococcus infections. In contrast to chalazia, hordeola are extremely painfull and can cause extreme local swelling.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hordeolum internum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hordeola interna are acute purulent infections affecting the meibomian sebacious glands, often caused by staphylococcus infections. In contrast to chalazia (chronic epithelioid cell granulomatous inflammation of the meibomian gland caused by inflammation of a blocked meibomian gland), hordeola are extremely painfull and can cause extreme local swelling.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Skin tags
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cutaneous skin tags also known as acrochorda or fibroepithelial polyps are small benign tumors that may either form secondarily over time primarily in areas where the skin forms creases, such as the neck, armpit or groin or may also be present at birth, in which case they usually occur in the periauricular region.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Plantar pits

name: Fibroma

The term \\\"fibroblastic\\\" or \\\"fibromatous\\\" is used to describe tumors of the fibrous connective tissue. name: Lung fibroma

name: Cutaneous syndactyly of toes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between adjacent foot digits that involves at least half of the proximodistal length of one of the two involved digits; or, a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits of the foot that does not meet the prior objective criteria.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Flat nasal alae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal degree of flatness of the Ala of nose, which can be defined as a reduced nasal elevation index (lateral depth of the nose from the tip of the nose to the insertion of the nasal ala in the cheek x 100 divided by the side-to-side breadth of the nasal alae).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}
