name: 1-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the ring finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 1-5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the thumb to the little finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints (complete syndactyly of all fingers of the hand).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 2-4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second (index) to the fourth (ring) finger that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 3-5 finger syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the middle to little fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 1-2 toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syndactyly with fusion of toes one and two.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 1-4 toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syndactyly with fusion of toes one to four.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 1-5 toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syndactyly with fusion of toes one to five (complete syndactyly of all toes of the foot).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 2-4 toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syndactyly with fusion of toes two to four.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 2-5 toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syndactyly with fusion of toes two to five.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: 3-5 toe syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syndactyly with fusion of toes three to five.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Osseous syndactyly of toes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Webbing or fusion of the toes, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual bones of the toes. Bony fusions are referred to as \\\"bony\\\" Syndactyly if the fusion occurs in a tibial-fibular axis. Fusions of bones of the toes in a proximo-distal axis are referred to as \\\"Symphalangism\\\".\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Abnormality of hair texture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the texture of the hair.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal hair pattern
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the distribution of hair growth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal hair whorl
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal hair whorl (that is, a patch of hair growing in the opposite direction of the rest of the hair).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Asymmetry of the ears
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An asymmetriy, i.e., difference in size, shape or position between the left and right ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Advanced pneumatization of the mastoid process
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally advanced degree of pneumatization (i.e., formation of air cells) in the mastoid process with respect to age-dependent norms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Prominent corneal nerve fibers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal prominence of the corneal nerve fibers.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spontaneous rupture of the globe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rupture of the eyeball not due to trauma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia of the retina
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect characterized by absence of the retina.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cherry red spot of the macula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pallor of the perifoveal macula of the retina with appearance of a small circular reddish choroid shape as seen through the fovea centralis due to relative transparency of the macula.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Double eyebrow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This may present as a partial or complete duplication of the eyebrows.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Extension of eyebrows towards upper eyelid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The eyebrows extend towards - or even all the way down to - the margin of the upper eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Nodular changes affecting the eyelids
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nodular changes affecting the eyelids may have many different causes such as cystic lesions (chalaziae, hordeolae), lipogranulomas, melanomas, infectious diseases (Molluscum contagiosum) and many more.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Naevus flammeus of the eyelid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Naevus flammeus localized in the skin of the eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Fibrous dysplasia of bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"replacement of normal bone with abnormal, structurally unsound fibro-osseous tissue, with concomitant obliteration of the hematopoietic bone marrow. The fibrous tissue is rich in fibroblast-like cells that express markers of early stages of osteogenic maturation\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:31037426]"}

name: Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fibrous dysplasia of the bones were lesions are localized in many bones throughout of the body. Polyostotic fibrous dysplasia is a cardinal feature of McCune-Albright syndrome.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Monostotic fibrous dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fibrous dysplasia of the bones were lesions are localized in only one bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Osteopoikilosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Osteopoikilosis is a benign, asymptomatic sclerotic dysplasia of the bones. It affects both male and female and may be seen at any age. Radiographically sclerotic circular or ovoid lesions are usually symmetrically distributed in a periarticular location. Lesions can increase or decrease in size and number in serial radiographs or even disappear and do not have increased bone radiotracer uptake.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Osteopathia striata
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lamellar pattern visible on radiographs and mainly localized at the metaphyses of the long tubular bones. Pathologic-anatomical studies revealed that these benign signs on x-rays are the result of a juvenile metaphyseal bone necrosis. Calcifications in the necrotic marrow lead to this lamellar or lattice-like appearance.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Pedal edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal accumulation of excess fluid in the lower extremity resulting in swelling of the feet and extending upward to the lower leg.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Edema of the upper limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin of the arms.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Short metatarsal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Diminished length of a metatarsal bone, with resultant proximal displacement of the associated toe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Absent metatarsal bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental abnormality characterized by the absence (aplasia) of a metatarsal bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia of the phalanges of the toes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of a digit or of one or more phalanges of a toe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplasia of the phalanges of the toes
Medial flaring of the eyebrow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal distribution of eyebrow hair growth in the medial direction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopic lacrimal punctum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Positioning of a lacrimal punctum other than at the medial margins of the eyelid.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Blepharochalasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blepharochalasis is characterized by recurrent, non-painful, nonerythematous episodes of eyelid edema. It has been divided into hypertrophic and atrophic forms. In the hypertrophic form recurrent edema results in orbital fat herniation through a weakened orbital septum. Most patients who have blepharochalasis present in an atrophic condition with atrophy of redundant eyelid skin and superior nasal fat pads.\" [PMID:3207663]"}

name: Dermatochalasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of elasticity of the upper and lower eyelids causing the skin to sag and bulge.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dimple chin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A persistent midline depression of the skin over the fat pad of the chin.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Cleft mandible
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Midline deficiency of the mandible and some or all overlying tissues.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Asymmetry of the maxilla
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Asymmetry between the left and right sides of the maxilla.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5889-4463]"}

name: Aplasia of the premaxilla
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the premaxilla, which is the embryonic structure that forms the anterior part of the maxilla.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the premaxilla
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the premaxilla, the most anterior part of the maxilla that usually bears the central and lateral incisors and includes the anterior nasal spine and inferior aspect of the piriform rim. The premaxilla contains the bone and teeth of the primary palate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5889-4463, https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Prominence of the premaxilla
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Prominent positioning of the premaxilla in relation to the rest of the maxilla, the facial skeleton, or mandible. Not necessarily caused by an increase in size (hypertrophy of) the premaxilla.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5889-4463, https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Absent toe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Aplasia of a toe. That is, absence of all phalanges of a non-hallux digit of the foot and the associated soft tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chordoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A chordoma is a tumor that arises from embryonic remnants of the notochord along the length of the neuraxis. Chordomas generally occur in the sacrum, intracranially at the clivus, or along the spinal axis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Low insertion of columella
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Insertion of the posterior columella below the nasal base.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Palmar hyperkeratosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal thickening of the skin localized to the palm of the hand.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopic calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deposition of calcium salts in a tissue or location in which calcification does not normally occur.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sacrococcygeal pilonidal abnormality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a cyst, fistula, or abscess in the sacrococcygeal region (gluteal crease) characteristically accompanied by hair and skin folds.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pilonidal sinus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sinus in the coccygeal region (the region of the intergluteal cleft). A pilonidal sinus often contains hair and skin debris.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pilonidal abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hair-containing cyst or sinus usually in the coccygeal region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anomalous pulmonary venous return
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect characterized by abnormal connection of one or more pulmonary veins to the superior or inferior vena cava, the right atrium, or the coronary sinus, resulting in a left-to-right shunt of oxygenated blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of anomalous pulmonary venous return in which not all pulmonary veins drain abnormally. Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return frequently involves one or both of the veins from one lung.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cor triatriatum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an additional membrane in the left or right cardiac atrium which results in the subdivision of the affected atrium (and thus in total three atria, whence the name).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dbrown, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vascular ring
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect of the aortic arch system in which the trachea and esophagus are completely encircled by connected segments of the aortic arch and its branches. This occurs if the normal process of regression and persistence of the bilateral embryonic aortic arches fails.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tracheobronchmegaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Marked widening of the trachea and major bronchi that may be predispose to chronic respiratory tract infection.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bronchomegaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Marked widening of the major bronchi that may be predispose to chronic respiratory tract infection.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Large pelvis bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an abnormally large pelvis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperacusis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Over-sensitivity to certain frequency ranges of sound.\" [PMID:14645606, PMID:14647932, PMID:31669363]"}

name: Skin dimple
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Skin dimples are cutaneous indentations that are the result of tethering of the skin to underlying structures (bone) causing an indentation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Shoulder dimple
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A subtype of skin dimples occurring in the shoulder region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22679172]"}

name: Erythema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Redness of the skin, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6548-5200]"}

name: Uterine neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gonadal neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of a gonad.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urinary tract neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a neoplasm of the urinary system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Genital neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the genital system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Testicular neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a neoplasm of the testis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplasia of the Leydig cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperplasia of the Leydig cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypertrophy or overdevelopment of the interstitial (Leydig) cells of the testis. These cells produce testosterone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bifid nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A digit with two nails, with at least some soft tissue between them.\" [PMID:19125433]"}

name: Impaired visuospatial constructive cognition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability affecting mainly visuospatial cognition which may be tested using pattern construction (for example by Differential Ability Scales, which test a person's strengths and weaknesses across a range of intellectual abilities).\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:10521286]"}

name: Hemangioblastoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hemangioblastoma is a benign vascular neoplasm that arises almost exclusively in the central nervous system. Hemangioblastomas consist of a tightly packed cluster of small blood vessels forming a mass of up to 1 or 2 cm in diameter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lip freckle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased focal pigmentation of the vermilion of the lips.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Absent cupid's bow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of paramedian peaks and median notch of the upper lip vermilion.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Underdeveloped nasolabial fold
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced bulkiness of the crease or fold of skin running from the lateral margin of the nose, where nasal base meets the skin of the face, to a point just lateral to the corner of the mouth (cheilion or commissure).\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Perioral hyperpigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased pigmentation, either focal or generalized, of the skin surrounding the vermilion of the lips.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Everted upper lip vermilion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inner aspect of the upper lip vermilion (normally apposing the teeth) visible in a frontal view, i.e., the presence of an everted upper lip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125428]"}

name: Tented upper lip vermilion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Triangular appearance of the oral aperture with the apex in the midpoint of the upper vermilion and the lower vermilion forming the base.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Upturned corners of mouth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Oral commissures positioned superior to the midline labial fissure.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: U-Shaped upper lip vermilion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Gentle upward curve of the upper lip vermilion such that the center is placed well superior to the commissures.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Open bite
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Visible space between the dental arches in occlusion.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Protruding tongue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tongue extending beyond the alveolar ridges or teeth at rest.\" [PMID:19125428]"}

name: Abnormal position of hair whorl
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hair growth from a single point on the scalp in any location other than lateral to the midline and close to the vertex of the skull.\" [PMID:19125436]"}

name: Nevus sebaceous
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital, hairless plaque consisting of overgrown epidermis, sebaceous glands, hair follicles, apocrine glands and connective tissue. They are a variant of epidermal naevi. Sebaceous naevi most often appear on the scalp, but they may also arise on the face, neck or forehead. At birth, a sevaceous nevus typically appears as a solitary, smooth, yellow-orange hairless patch. Sebaceous naevi become more pronounced around adolescence, often appearing bumpy, warty or scaly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Epidermal nevus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Epidermal naevi are due to an overgrowth of the epidermis and may be present at birth (50%) or develop during childhood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20542174]"}

name: Linear nevus sebaceous
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of nevus sebaceous with a linear form, raised borders and yellowish color.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Generalized tonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A generalized tonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening without a subsequent clonic phase. The tonic activity can be a sustained abnormal posture, either in extension or flexion, sometimes accompanied by tremor of the extremities.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Atonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1 to 2 seconds, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11580774]"}

name: Focal emotional seizure with crying
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal emotional seizure with crying (dacrystic) is characterized by the presence of stereotyped crying, this may be accompanied by lacrimation, sad facial expression and sobbing. The subjective emotion of sadness may or may not be present.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276060, PMID:993803]"}

name: Focal emotional seizure with laughing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal emotional seizure with laughing (gelastic) is characterized by bursts of laughter or giggling, usually without appropriate related emotion of happiness, and described as 'mirthless'.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Scintillating scotoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A scintillating scotoma is a common visual aura that can precede a migraine, whereby a spot of flickering light near the center of the visual fields occurs. The spot prevents vision, and is thus termed scotoma. The scotoma can extend into one or more shimmering arcs of white or colored flashing lights.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ridged cranial sutures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An overlap of the bony plates of the skull in an infant, with or without early closure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal fifth cranial nerve morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the fifth cranial nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the eleventh cranial nerve
Abnormality of the twelfth cranial nerve
Abnormal seventh cranial physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the seventh cranial nerve sometimes also referred to as the facial nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemifacial spasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intermittent clonic or tonic contraction of muscles supplied by facial nerve. Muscles are relaxed in between contractions.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12145388]"}

name: Impaired temperature sensation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced ability to discriminate between different temperatures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired tactile sensation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced sense of touch (tactile sensation). This is usually tested with a wisp of cotton or a fine camel's hair brush, by asking patients to say 'now' each time they feel the stimulus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired proprioception
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A loss or impairment of the sensation of the relative position of parts of the body and joint position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of pain sensation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pain is an unpleasant sensation that can range from mild, localized discomfort to agony, whereby the physical part of pain results from nerve stimulation and is often accompanied by an emotional component. This term groups abnormalities in pain sensation presumed to result from abnormalities related to the specific nerve fibers that carry the pain impulses to the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spontaneous pain sensation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spontaneous pain is a kind of neuropathic pain which occurs without an identifiable trigger.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Trophic changes related to pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Trophic changes is a term used to describe abnormalities in the area of pain that include primarily wasting away of the skin, tissues, or muscle, thinning of the bones, and changes in how the hair or nails grow, including thickening or thinning of hair or brittle nails.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dissociated sensory loss
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pattern of sensory loss with selective loss of touch sensation and proprioception without loss of pain and temperature, or vice-versa.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating copper concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of copper cation in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: High nonceruloplasmin-bound serum copper
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of non ceruloplasmin bound copper in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased urinary copper concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of copper in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Multifocal epileptiform discharges
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG) and being identified at multiple locations (foci).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with focal slow activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal (localized) slow activity reflects focal dysfunction, not diffuse dysfunction (i.e., encephalopathy).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with multifocal slow activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multifocal slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: EEG with generalized slow activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Diffuse slowing of cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with persistent abnormal rhythmic activity
EEG with spike-wave complexes (<2.5 Hz)
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of complexes of slow spikes and slow waves (<2.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (2.5-3.5 Hz)
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (2.5-3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with spike-wave complexes (>3.5 Hz)
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of complexes of spikes and waves (>3.5 Hz) in electroencephalography (EEG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with spike-wave complexes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complexes of spikes (<70 ms) and sharp waves (70-200 ms), which are sharp transient waves that have a strong association with epilepsy, in cerebral electrical activity recorded along the scalp by electroencephalography (EEG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with burst suppression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The burst suppression pattern in electroencephalography refers to a characteristic periodic pattern of low voltage (<10 microvolts) suppressed background and a relatively shorter pattern of higher amplitude slow, sharp, and spiking complexes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22323592]"}

name: EEG with photoparoxysmal response
extra_json: {"definition": "\"EEG abnormalities (epileptiform discharges) evoked by flashing lights or black and white striped patterns.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: EEG with periodic lateralized epileptiform discharges

name: Supernumerary tooth

name: Abnormal molar morphology

extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of morphology of permanent molar.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tooth that has not erupted because of local impediments (overcrowding or fibrous gum overgrowth).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Abnormal premolar morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of morphology of premolar tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal conical morphology of the primary incisor.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Conical maxillary incisor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal conical morphology of either maxillary primary incisor tooth or maxillary permanent incisor tooth or both.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Hypocalcification of dental enamel
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hypomineralization of enamel characterized by reduced calcification.\" [PMID:18499550]"}

name: Hypomature dental enamel
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hypomineralization of enamel characterized by a chalky appearance of the enamel with orange, brown, or white color.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Dentinogenesis imperfecta of primary and permanent teeth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Developmental dysplasia of dentin or both the primary dentition and the permanent dentition.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Talon cusp
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Talon cusp is an accessory cusp located near the cingulum (the portion of the lingual or palatal aspect of the tooth that forms a convex protuberance at the cervical third of the anatomic crown).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Dens in dente
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the incisor characterized by invagination of the enamel, giving a radiographic appearance that suggests a tooth within a tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Fused teeth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The union of two separately developing tooth germs typically leading to one less tooth than normal in the affected dental arch.\" [PMID:18167487]"}

name: Gemination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The development of two teeth from a single tooth bud, leading to a larger fused tooth.\" [PMID:18167487]"}

name: Mulberry molar
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mulberry molars are irregular teeth generally affecting the first molars and are characterized by a grossly deformed crown imitating, as the name implies, the surface of a mulberry.\" []"}

name: Molarization of premolar
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased size and molar morphology of premolar tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:15587104]"}

name: Increased overbite
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Maxillary teeth cover the mandibular teeth when biting to an increased degree. The feature is defined as a vertical overlap of the maxillary incisors over the mandibular incisors that exceeds 2 mm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Overjet
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal anteroposterior extension of the maxillary teeth beyond the plane of the mandibular teeth upon jaw closure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9338-3017]"}

name: Peripheral demyelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A loss of myelin from the internode regions along myelinated nerve fibers of the peripheral nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Epileptic spasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: Grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. Epileptic spasms frequently occur in clusters. Infantile spasms are the best known form, but spasms can occur at all ages\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Speech apraxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of apraxia that is characterized by difficulty or inability to execute speech movements because of problems with coordination and motor problems, leading to incorrect articulation. An increase of errors with increasing word and phrase length may occur.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spastic hemiparesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Unilateral paresis (weakness) with spasticity of the affected muscles and increased tendon reflexes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intestinal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ileal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the ileum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal left ventricular outflow tract morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the outflow tract of the left ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of blood volume homeostasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in the amount of volume occupied by intravascular blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypervolemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypovolemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An decrease in the amount of intravascular fluid, particularly in the volume of the circulating blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent aphthous stomatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent episodes of ulceration of the oral mucosa, typically presenting as painful, sharply circumscribed fibrin-covered mucosal defects with a hyperemic border.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent tonsillitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the tonsils that has occurred repeatedly. The definition of recurrent may vary somewhat, but the criteria used recently as a measure of severity were five or more episodes of true tonsillitis per year, symptoms recurring for at least a year, and episodes that are disabling and that prevent normal functioning. In some cases recurrent tonsillitis may be related to immunosusceptibility. Evidence exists for a genetic predisposition for recurrent tonsillitis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15897415]"}

name: Abnormal immune serum protein physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the concentration or function of circulating immune proteins.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating cytokine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the cytokine levels in the blood, i.e., an abnormality of any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of cytokine secretion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in the production or cellular release of a cytokine (i.e., any of the non-antibody proteins made by inflammatory leukocytes and some non-leukocytic cells that affect the behavior of other cells).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Defective production of NFKB1-dependent cytokines
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An impairment in the production by leukocytes of NFKB1-dependent cytokines such as tumor necrosis factor-alpha and interferon-alpha.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating chemokine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in the production or cellular release of a chemokine (a class of cytokines).\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating interferon concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of an interferon is outside the limits of normal.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating interleukin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of an interleukin (a class of cytokines) is outside the limits of normal.\" [PMID:28487810]"}

name: Abnormality of tumor necrosis factor secretion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in the production or cellular release of tumor necrosis factor.\" []"}

name: Abnormal nasal dorsum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the nasal dorsum, also known as the nasal ridge.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Concave nasal ridge
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nasal ridge curving posteriorly to an imaginary line that connects the nasal root and tip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Abnormal skin physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the physiological function of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Inflammatory abnormality of the skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inflammation of the skin. That is, an abnormality of the skin resulting from the local accumulation of fluid, plasma proteins, and leukocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal epidermal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the morphology of the epidermis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal dermal melanosome morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the melanosomes, i.e., of the cellular organelles in which melanin pigments are synthesized and stored within melanocytes (the cells that produce pigment in the dermis).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nephroptosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A significant descent of the kidney as the patient moves from the supine to the erect position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18990154]"}

name: Perioral eczema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of eczema that occurs in the lips and perioral area.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acute esophageal necrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition characterized by necrosis of the mucosal and submucosal layers of the esophagus not related to ingestion of caustic or other injurious agents. Endoscopically, there is a dark lesion ('black esophagus') distributed in a circumferential manner in the distal one-third of the esophagus with or without exudates. There is involvement of the distal esophagus ending sharply at the gastroesophageal junction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17322991]"}

name: Abnormal renal calyx morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the morphology of the major calices or minor calices of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Perianal dermatitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a rash (change of color and texture) of the perianal skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chronic furunculosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A furuncle (boil) is a skin infection involving an entire hair follicle and nearby skin tissue. Chronic furunculosis refers to recurrent episodes of furuncles, often caused by recurrent staphylococcus infection.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased sensitivity to ionizing radiation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased sensitivity to the effects of ionizing radiation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Low-grade fever
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mild fever that does not exceed 38.5 degrees centigrade.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the sweat glands
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or developmental hypoplasia of the sweat glands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Non-pruritic urticaria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pale reddish slightly elevated papules and plaques of 0.5-3 cm in diameter and not accompanied by pruritus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal skin adnexa morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the skin adnexa (skin appendages), which are specialized skin structures located within the dermis and focally within the subcutaneous fatty tissue, comprising three histologically distinct structures: (1) the pilosebaceous unit (hair follicle and sebaceous glands); (2) the eccrine sweat glands; and (3) the apocrine glands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gastric duplication
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Gastric duplication is a usually cystic malformation of gastrointestinal tract, usually attached to the greater curvature of the stomach and has no communication with the stomach.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gastrointestinal duplication
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A spherical hollow structure with a smooth muscle coat, lined by a mucous membrane, and attached to any part of the gastrointestinal tract, from the base of the tongue to the anus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21218094]"}

name: Age-related cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cataract (opacification of the lens) that forms during the course of aging.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15708105]"}

name: Age-related nuclear cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the nucleus of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15708105]"}

name: Age-related cortical cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of age-related cataract that primarily affects the cortex of the lens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15708105]"}

name: Age-related posterior subcapsular cataract
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of age-related cataract consisting of granular opacities occurring mainly in the central posterior cortex just under the posterior capsule.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15708105]"}

name: Symptomatic seizures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A seizure that occurs in the context of a brain insult (systemic, toxic, or metabolic) and may not recur when the underlying cause has been removed or the acute phase has elapsed.\" [PMID:18184148]"}

name: Dialeptic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A dialeptic seizure is a type of seizure characterized predominantly by reduced responsiveness or awareness and with subsequent at least partial amnesia of the event.\" [PMID:9738682]"}

name: Typical absence seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A typical absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by its sudden onset, interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare, possibly a brief upward deviation of the eyes. Usually the patient will be unresponsive when spoken to. Duration is a few seconds to half a minute with very rapid recovery. Although not always available, an EEG would usually show 3 Hz generalized epileptiform discharges during the event.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064, PMID:6790275]"}

name: Absence seizure with eyelid myoclonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An absence with eyelid myoclonia seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by forced upward jerking of the eyelids during an absence seizure.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:19469840, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Myoclonic absence seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myoclonic absence seizure is a type of generalized non-motor (absence) seizure characterized by an interruption of ongoing activities, a blank stare and rhythmic three-per-second myoclonic movements, causing ratcheting abduction of the upper limbs leading to progressive arm elevation, and associated with 3 Hz generalized spike-wave discharges on the electroencephalogram. Duration is typically 10-60 s. Whilst impairment of consciousness may not be obvious the ILAE classified this seizure as a generalized non-motor seizure in 2017.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8486-0558, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064, PMID:9637609]"}

name: Atypical absence status epilepticus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atypical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged atypical absence seizure.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Early onset absence seizures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Typical absence seizures starting before the age of 4 years.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8486-0558]"}

name: Focal motor seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of focal-onset seizure characterized by a motor sign as its initial semiological manifestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Focal autonomic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An autonomic seizure is a type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by alteration of autonomic nervous system function as the initial semiological feature.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Focal sensory seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A focal sensory seizure is a type seizure beginning with a subjective sensation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1511-5893, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Focal sensory seizure with auditory features
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A seizure characterized by elementary auditory phenomena including buzzing, ringing, drumming or single tones as its first clinical manifestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation/nausea/vomiting/other gastrointestinal phenomena
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by symptoms or signs pertaining to the gastrointestinal system as the initial semiological feature.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Focal sensory seizure with gustatory features
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes as its first clinical manifestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Focal sensory seizure with olfactory features
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Seizures characterized by olfactory phenomena as its first clinical manifestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move as its first clinical manifestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Focal sensory seizure with visual features
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colors, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis as its first clinical manifestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Focal myoclonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction(s) of muscles(s) or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.\" [PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Focal tonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained increase in muscle contraction, lasting a few seconds to minutes.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Focal seizure with eyelid myoclonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal seizure with eyelid myoclonia, not eyelid myoclonias in the context of absence seizures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8486-0558]"}

name: Generalized clonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Generalized clonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by sustained bilateral jerking, either symmetric or asymmetric, that is regularly repetitive and involves the same muscle groups.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A generalized myoclonic-atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a myoclonic jerk followed by an atonic motor component.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Simple febrile seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A short generalized seizure, of a duration of <15 min, not recurring within 24 h, occurring during a febrile episode not caused by an acute disease of the nervous system intracranial infection or severe metabolic disturbance.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:19125841, PMID:6779259, PMID:972656]"}

name: Complex febrile seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A febrile seizure that has any of the following features: focal semiology (or associated with post-ictal neurologic abnormalities beyond drowsiness, such as a Todd's paresis), prolonged seizure beyond 15 minutes, or recurring (occurring more than once) in a 24 hour period.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:19125841, PMID:972656]"}

name: Focal behavior arrest seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of focal non-motor seizure characterized by an arrest or pause of activities, freezing, or immobilization as the predominant semiological feature throughout the seizure.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Focal hyperkinetic seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A focal seizure characterized at onset by predominantly proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements, such as pedaling, pelvic thrusting, thrashing, rocking movements.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers, PMID:11580774, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Focal motor seizure with version
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of focal motor seizure characterized by sustained, forced conjugate ocular, cephalic, and/or truncal rotation or lateral deviation from the midline as the initial semiological manifestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: EEG with constitutional variants
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An EEG with constitutional variants contains waves that are rare or unusual but not generally pathologic.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Partial beta-EEG
extra_json: {"definition": "\"EEG dominated by diffuse beta waves (>13 Hz) with occipitally localized alpha waves (8-13 Hz).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Low voltage EEG
extra_json: {"definition": "\"EEG with an amplitude less than 30 microvolts without observable occipital alpha rhythm (8-13 Hz).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jalbers]"}

name: Interictal epileptiform activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Epileptiform activity refers to distinctive EEG waves or complexes distinguished from background activity found in in a proportion of human subjects with epilepsy, but which can also be found in subjects without seizures. name: Severe receptive language delay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A severe delay in the acquisition of the ability to understand the speech of others.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Arterial intimal fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Formation of excess fibrous connective tissue in the tunica intima (innermost layer) of arteries.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Generalized abnormality of skin

name: Dry hair
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hair that lacks the luster (shine or gleam) of normal hair.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Acquired abnormal hair pattern
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the distribution of hair growth that is acquired during the course of life.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Congenital abnormal hair pattern
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital abnormality of the distribution of hair growth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Abnormality of hair growth rate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hair whose growth rate deviates from the norm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Epidermal thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thickening of the epidermal layer of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mongolian blue spot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital deep dermal melanosis in the sacral area.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1773-4011]"}

name: Recurrent cutaneous fungal infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to cutaneous fungal infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of cutaneous fungal infections.\" []"}

name: Recurrent viral skin infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to viral skin infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral skin infections.\" []"}

name: Aplasia of the inner ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the inner ear due to a developmental defect.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Incomplete partition of the cochlea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Incomplete formation of the cochlear partition. The scala vestibuli and scala tympani separated by the cochlear partition, except in the apical turn where the two scalae are in continuity via the helicotrema.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Incomplete partition of the cochlea type I
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Incomplete partition I is also known as cystic cochleovestibular malformation, where the cochlea has no bony modiolus, resulting in an empty cystic cochlea. This is accompanied by a dilated cystic vestibule with developmental arrest at the fifth week of gestation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_mbitner-glidicz, PMID:21849370]"}

name: Cochlear aplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the cochlea, a spiral shaped cavity in the inner ear, owing to a developmental defect.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Abnormal morphology of the vestibule of the inner ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A morphological abnormality of the vestibule, the central part of the osseous labyrinth that is situated medial to the tympanic cavity, behind the cochlea, and in front of the semicircular canals.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_mbitner-glidicz]"}

name: Aplasia of the vestibule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete absence of the vestibule of the inner ear.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Hypoplasia of the vestibule of the inner ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the vestibule of the inner ear.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_mbitner-glidicz]"}

name: Dilated vestibule of the inner ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dilatation of the vestibule of the inner ear.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_mbitner-glidicz]"}

name: Abnormal semicircular canal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the morphology of the semicircular canal.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Abnormality of the internal auditory canal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the Internal acoustic meatus, i.e., of the canal in the petrous part of the temporal bone through which the cranial nerve VII and cranial nerve VIII traverse.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_mbitner-glidicz]"}

name: Narrow internal auditory canal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction in diameter of the internal auditory canal.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Enlarged cochlear aqueduct
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased size of the cochlear duct, i.e., of a duct that communicates between the perilymphatic space and the subarachnoid space, and transmits a vein from the cochlea to join the internal jugular.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Functional abnormality of the inner ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the function of the inner ear.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Abnormal inner ear morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the internal part of the ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aplasia/Hypoplasia of the cochlea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence or underdevelopment of the cochlea, a spiral shaped cavity in the inner ear, owing to a developmental defect.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the cochlear nerve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the cohclear nerve, which is the part of the vestibulocochlear nerve that is responsible for transmitting auditory signals from the inner ear to the cochlear nuclei within the brainstem and ultimately to the primary auditory cortex within the temporal lobe.\" [PMID:30726044]"}

name: Abnormal spinal cord dorsal column morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the dorsal columns, i.e., of the dorsal portion of the gray substance of the spinal cord. The dorsal column consists of the fasciculus gracilis and fasciculus cuneatus and itself is part of the dorsal funiculus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal CNS myelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of myelination of nerves in the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9102-5232]"}

name: Delayed peripheral myelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed myelination in the peripheral nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal umbilical cord blood vessel morphology
Lethal short-trunk short stature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs that is lethal at birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Infancy onset short-trunk short stature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of disproportionate short stature characterized by a short trunk but a average-sized limbs with onset in infancy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Moderate intrauterine growth retardation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intrauterine growth retardation that is at least 3 standard deviations (SD) below average, but not as low as 4 SD, corrected for sex and gestational age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Abnormal placental membrane morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Structural anomaly of the fetal membranes (also known as the amniochorionic or placental membranes), which comprise a vital intrauterine compartment, where they perform mechanical, immune, and endocrine functions to promote growth of the fetus and protection from environmental adversity. Amniochorionic membranes anatomically consist of a single layer of cuboidal amnion epithelial cells, chorionic trophoblasts, and scattered fibroblasts connected by a layer of type IV collagen-rich extracellular matrix.\" [PMID:28939208]"}

name: Caesarean section
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delivery of a fetus through surgical incisions made through the abdominal wall (laparotomy) and the uterine wall (hysterotomy).\" []"}

name: Ventouse delivery
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delivery of newborn by means of a ventouse, a vacuum device used to assist the delivery of a baby when the second stage of labor has not progressed adequately.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Shoulder dystocia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Shoulder dystocia occurs when the fetal anterior shoulder impacts against the maternal symphysis following delivery of the vertex.\" [PMID:15086043]"}

name: Hydropic placenta
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the placenta in which there are numerous cystic spaces within the placenta as well as placental enlargement.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Abnormal insertion of umbilical cord
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anomalous location of the insertion of umbilical cord in the placenta. Normally, the insertion is at least two centimers distant from the edge of the placenta.\" []"}

name: Placental abruption
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Separation of the placenta from the uterus wall before delivery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Age of death
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The age group when the cessation of life happens.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Death in adolescence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Death during adolescence, the period between childhood and adulthood (roughly between the ages of 10 and 16 years).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating chloride concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of chloride in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Hyperchloremia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of chloride in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Increased serum zinc
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of zinc in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fetal ultrasound soft marker
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An finding upon obstetric ultrasound examination performed at around 16 to 20 weeks of gestation that is abnormal but not clearly identifiable as a fetal anatomic malformation or growth restriction. Such findings are known as soft markers since they are associated with increased risk for fetal aneuploidy or other disorders.\" [PMID:16100637]"}

name: Fetal choroid plexus cysts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fetal choroid plexus cysts (CPCs) are sonographically discrete, small cysts found in the choroid plexus within the lateral cerebral ventricles of the developing fetus at 14 to 24 weeks gestation. Imaging of the choroid plexus is performed in the transverse plane of the fetal head at the same level that the lateral cerebral ventricle is evaluated. The choroid plexus should be inspected bilaterally for the presence of cysts. The size of CPCs is not of clinical relevance (PMID:16100637).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:16100637, PMID:16809660]"}

name: Enlarged fetal cisterna magna
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The cisterna magna is measured on a transaxial view of the fetal head angled 15 degrees caudal to the canthomeatal line. The anterior/posterior diameter is taken between the inferior/posterior surface of the vermis of the cerebellum to the inner surface of the cranium. An enlarged cisternal magna is defined by an anterior/posterior diameter of 10 mm or more (PMID:16100637).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:16100637]"}

name: Short fetal femur length
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A short femur length is defined as either a measurement below the 2.5th percentile for gestational age or a measurement that is less than 0.9 of that predicted by the measured biparietal diameter. The femur should be measured with the bone perpendicular to the ultrasound beam and with epiphyseal cartilages visible but not included in the measurement (PMID:16100637).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]"}

name: Short fetal humerus length
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A short humerus length is defined as a length below the 2.5th percentile for gestational age or as a measurement less than 0.9 of that predicted by the measured biparietal diameter. The humerus should be measured with the bone perpendicular to the ultrasound beam and with epiphyseal cartilages visible but not included in the measurement (PMID:16100637).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]"}

name: Hypoplasia of fetal nasal bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"On prenatal ultrasound, the nasal bone is a thin echogenic line within the bridge of the fetal nose. The fetus is imaged facing the transducer with the fetal face strictly in the midline. The angle of insonation is 90 degrees, with the longitudinal axis of the nasal bone as the reference line. Calibres are placed at each end of the nasal bone. Absence of the nasal bone or measurements below 2.5th percentile are considered significant (PMID:16100637).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]"}

name: Fetal fifth finger clinodactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fifth finger clinodactyly is defined by a hypoplastic or absent mid-phalanx of the fifth digit. Ultrasound identification of the fetal hand must first be undertaken and then appropriate magnification accomplished. The evaluation requires stretching of the 5 fingers. The diagnosis is established when the middle phalanx of the fifth finger is markedly smaller than normal or absent, which often causes the finger to be curved inward (PMID:16100637).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16100637]"}

name: Elevated maternal circulating alpha-fetoprotein concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in the levels of maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein levels during pregnancy.\" [PMID:32039804]"}

name: High maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally high concentration of maternal serum human chorionic gonadotropin as compared to normal values for gestational-age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:2447576]"}

name: Low maternal circulating chorionic gonadotropin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally low concentration of maternal serum human chorionic gonadotropin as compared to normal values for gestational-age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:2447576]"}

name: Low maternal circulating PAPP-A concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally low concentration of serum PAPP-A (pregnancy associated plasma protein A), as compared to normal values for gestational-age.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:19038077]"}

name: Abnormal maternal serum screening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally elevated or decreased level of a maternal serum marker analytes used in screening for aneuploidy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, PMID:19038077]"}

name: Maternal autoimmune disease
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A medical history of a fetus or child born to a mother with an autoimmune disease.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Maternal teratogenic exposure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A medical history of exposure of the mother of a child or fetus to a teratogenic substance during pregnancy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Abnormal medulla oblongata morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the medulla oblongata, the lower half of the brainstem.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal central motor function
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the control or production of movement in the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decorticate rigidity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of rigidity in which the arms are in flexion and adduction and the legs are extended. This signifies a lesion in the cerebral white matter, internal capsules, or thalamus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Athetoid cerebral palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cerebral palsy characterized by slow, involuntary muscle movement and mixed muscle tone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1511-5893]"}

name: Ankle clonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Ankle clonus is tested by rapidly flexing the foot upward.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Knee clonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Clonus is an involuntary tendon reflex that causes repeated flexion and extension of the foot. Knee clonus can be tested by rapidly pushing the patella towards the toes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unusual CNS infection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to infections of the central nervous system, as manifested by recurrent, severe, or invasive infections involving the brain, meninges, or spinal cord. This can include infections caused by opportunistic or atypical pathogens, or common pathogens presenting with unusual severity or in anatomical locations.\" []"}

name: Primary microcephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Head circumference below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender at birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Functional abnormality of the middle ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the function of the middle ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal incus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the incus, an ossicle in the middle ear.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Abnormal malleus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the malleus, an ossicle in the middle ear.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Loss of eyelashes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This term refers to the loss of eyelashes that were previously present.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abdominal symptom
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A subjective manifestation of disease localized to the abdomen.\" []"}

name: Esophageal carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a carcinoma of the esophagus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882, NCIT:C3513]"}

name: Embryonal onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of disease at up to 8 weeks following fertilization (corresponding to 10 weeks of gestation).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]"}

name: Fetal onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset prior to birth but after 8 weeks of embryonic development (corresponding to a gestational age of 10 weeks).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]"}

name: Young adult onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of disease at the age of between 16 and 40 years.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Childhood onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of disease at the age of between 1 and 5 years.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Aganglionosis of the small intestine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) affecting the small intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Duodenal aganglionosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lack of intestinal ganglion cells (i.e., an aganglionic section of bowel) affecting the duodenum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Absent gallbladder
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect in which the gallbladder fails to form.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Facial tics
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden, repetitive, nonrhythmic motor movements (spasms), involving the eyes and muscles of the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2958-5076]"}

name: Villous atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The enteric villi are atrophic or absent.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Persistent stapedial artery
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistence of the stapedial artery, which normally regresses during embryonic life.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_mbitner-glidicz]"}

name: Profound sensorineural hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete loss of hearing related to a sensorineural defect.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_dfitzpatrick]"}

name: Upbeat nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"In primary position, the eyes drift slowly downward and then spontaneously beat upward. Upward gaze accentuates the nystagmus. The associated oscillopsias are often very irritating, but the symptoms are usually transient.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21505601]"}

name: True anophthalmia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of globe, optic nerve, chiasm and optic tracts. No evidence of ocular tissue on MRI scan or examination.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Abnormal lacrimal punctum morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the lacrimal punctum, an opening on the eyelid close to the medial canthus that drains tears from the conjunctival sac into the lacrimal duct in the same eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral microphthalmos
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal smallness of one eye.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Abnormal lacrimal duct morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the lacrimal duct, a duct that drain tears from the conjunctiva, via the lacrimal puncta, into the lacrimal sac.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal lacrimal gland morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the lacrimal gland, i.e., of the almond-shaped gland that secretes the aqueous layer of the tear film for each eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Adhesions between the iris and the cornea.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Posterior synechiae of the anterior chamber
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Adhesions between the iris and the lens.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Corneolenticular adhesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Developmental abnormality in which the lens and cornea are not separated.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Abnormal corneal thickness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal anteroposterior thickness of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Increased corneal thickness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A increased anteroposterior thickness of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal corneal endothelium morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the corneal endothelium, that is, the single layer of cells on the inner surface of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Abnormal Descemet membrane morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of Descemet's membrane, which is the basement membrane of the corneal endothelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Reduced number of corneal endothelial cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the number of corneal endothelial cells.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Abnormal corneal stroma morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the stroma of cornea, also known as the substantia propria of cornea.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Central opacification of the cornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced transparency of the central portion of the corneal stroma.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Generalized opacification of the cornea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Generalized reduced transparency of the stroma of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Abnormal corneal epithelium morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality of the corneal epithelium, that is of the epithelial tissue that covers the front of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Corneal neovascularization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ingrowth of new blood vessels into the cornea.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, PMID:22898649]"}

name: Rubeosis iridis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Formation of new blood vessels on the iris. The new vessels do not display the typical radially symmertic growth pattern of normal iris blood vessels, but rather appear disorganized. Rubeosis usually starts from the pupillary border with tiny tufts of dilated capillaries or red spots that can only be appreciated with high magnification.\" [PMID:27895936, PMID:29881517]"}

name: Anterior lenticonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A conical projection of the anterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Posterior lenticonus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A conical projection of the posterior surface of the lens, occurring as a developmental anomaly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Bull's eye maculopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Progressive maculopathy characterized by concentric regions of hyper- and hypopigmentation, with an initial foveal sparing and whose appearance is said to resemble the central target of a dart board.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592, PMID:31704701]"}

name: Cystoid macular edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cystoid thickening of the retina that takes place due to accumulation of extracellular fluid in the macula as a nonspecific response to blood-retinal barrier breakdown. Histological studies show that radially orientated cystoid spaces consisting of ophthalmoscopically clear fluid are often clinically detectable in the macula area.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter, PMID:19668445]"}

name: Choroidal neovascularization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Choroidal neovascularization (CNV) is the inward growth of new blood vessels arising from the choriocapillaris. Depending on the stage of development, they can be external (type 1 NV) or internal (type 2 NV) to the retinal pigment epithelium.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Macular flecks
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pale, often indistinct, multiple lesions of the macula, of variable shape that is not round. The lesions can be notched, angular, or pisciform (said to resemble a fish).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Macular hole
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A macular hole is a full thickness gap in the macula, located in the center of the retina.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Macular hyperpigmentation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased amount of pigmentation in the macula.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Drusen
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Drusen (singular, 'druse') are tiny yellow or white accumulations of extracellular material (lipofuscin) that build up in the Bruch membrane of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Macular schisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Splitting of the retina in the macular region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Retinal cavernous hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign tumor of the retina that appears as a grouping of blood-filled saccules within the inner retinal layers or on the surface of the optic disc. Retinal cavernous hemangioma are described as having a 'cluster of grapes' appearance.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20844673]"}

name: Abnormality of binocular vision
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of binocular vision, that is of the ability to synthesize the visual inputs from both eyes to a single image with perception of depth.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Abnormal stereopsis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to make fine depth discriminations from parallax provided by the two eyes' different positions on the head.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592]"}

name: Achromatopsia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition where the retina contains no functional cone cells, so that in addition to the absence of color discrimination, vision in lights of normal intensity is difficult.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8727-6592, PMID:12015282]"}

name: Cone monochromacy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The condition of having both rods and cones, but only a single kind of cone. Affected individuals have good pattern vision in daylight, but cannot distinguish between colors.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:DDD_ncarter]"}

name: Dichromacy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Individuals affected by dichromacy possess only two types of cones, instead of three.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anomalous trichromacy
