name: Hemorrhage of the eye
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bleeding from vessels of the various tissues of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Hyphema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bleeding in the anterior chamber of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Choroid hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemorrhage from the vessels of the choroid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anemia due to reduced life span of red cells

name: Subconjunctival hemorrhage

name: Increased total neutrophil count

name: Reduced alpha/beta synthesis ratio

name: Flattened metacarpal heads

name: Thoracic hypertrichosis

name: Transudative pleural effusion

name: Exudative pleural effusion

name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial complex III

name: Decreased activity of mitochondrial ATP synthase complex

name: Abnormal cerebellar peduncle morphology

name: Abnormal superior cerebellar peduncle morphology

name: Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia

extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple, localized or widespread, asymptomatic or inflammatory dermal cysts involving the pilosebaceous units. Lesions can appear anywhere on the body, but steatocystoma multiplex is more commonly involved with those areas of the skin with a high density of developed pilosebaceous units (e.g., the axilla, groin, neck, and proximal extremities).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20631281]"}

name: Sternocleidomastoid amyotrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Wasting of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, the muscle in the anterior part of the neck that acts to flex and rotate the head.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pectoralis amyotrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Wasting of the pectoral muscles, i.e., of the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor. This finding is often manifested by prominent axillary creases or double axillary creases.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Corneal guttata
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Corneal guttata are droplet-like accumulations of non-banded collagen on the posterior surface of Descemet's membrane. The presence of focal thickenings of Descemet's membrane histologically named guttae. Cornea guttata can be easily diagnosed in vivo and ex vivo by means of specular microscopy as it gives dark areas where no endothelial cells are visible.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10611102, PMID:11222329]"}

name: Descemet Membrane Folds
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of folds in the Descemet membrane, which is the basement membrane of the endothelial (inner) cell layer of the cornea. Descemet membrane folds are generally a manifestation of inflammation or edema of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Corneal stromal edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling of the stroma of cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aspirin-induced asthma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of asthma in which aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) that inhibit cyclooxygen-ase 1 (COX-1) exacerbate bronchoconstriction.\" [PMID:12743549]"}

name: Pendular nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rhythmic, involuntary sinusoidal oscillations of one or both eyes. The waveform of pendular nystagmus may occur in any direction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Seesaw nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Seesaw nystagmus is a type of pendular nystagmus where a half cycle consists of the elevation and intorsion of one eye, concurrently with the depression and extortion of the fellow eye. In the other half cycle, there is an inversion of the ocular movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal flecks
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of multiple yellowish-white lesions of various size and configuration on the retina not related to vascular lesions.\" [PMID:7952338]"}

name: Areflexia of upper limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the upper limbs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemeralopia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A visual defect characterized by the inability to see as clearly in bright light as in dim light. The word hemeralopia literally means day blindness.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oromandibular dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kind of focal dystonia characterized by forceful contractions of the face, jaw, and/or tongue causing difficulty in opening and closing the mouth and often affecting chewing and speech.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Laryngeal dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of focal dystonia that affects the vocal cords, associated with involuntary contractions of the vocal cords causing interruptions of speech and affecting the voice quality and often leading to patterned, repeated breaks in speech.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anasarca
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An extreme form of generalized edema with widespread and massive edema due to effusion of fluid into the extracellular space.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reactive hypoglycemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hypoglycermia following a meal (or more generally, after intake of glucose).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased circulating calcitriol concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of calcitriol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased circulating calcifediol concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced concentration of calcifediol in the blood. Calcifediol is also known as calcidiol, 25-hydroxycholecalciferol and 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Choroidal melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the choroid. The classic appearance of choroidal melanoma is a pigmented dome-shaped or collar button-shaped tumor with an associated exudative retinal detachment. Choroidal melanoma is usually pigmented, but can be variably pigmented and even amelanotic (non-pigmented).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22557869]"}

name: Ciliary body melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the ciliary body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cutaneous melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a melanoma of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Superficial spreading melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of melanoma that is flat and irregular in shape and color, with different shades of black and brown.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Nodular melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of melanoma that starts as a raised area that is usually dark blackish-blue or bluish-red but may not have any color.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lentigo maligna melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A subtype of melanoma in situ that typically develops on sun-damaged skin. The lesion is typically a large, irregularly pigmented macule that has developed from an ordinary lentigo (a small pigmented spot on the skin with a clearly-defined edge). Change to a malignant lentigo typically takes place over 20 years or more, and many patients accept the change as a consequence of aging.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acral lentiginous melanoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cutaneous melanoma localized to the palm, sole, or beneath the nail (subungual melanoma). Acral lentiginous melanoma starts as a slowly-enlarging flat patch of discolored skin and usually displays a size above 6 mm and often several centimeters or more in diameter upon diagnosis and variable pigmentation with a mixutre of colors including brown, and blue-grey, black and red. The surface of the lesion is initially smooth but later in the course may become thicker and irregular, and may ulcerate or bleed.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Urinary excretion of sialylated oligosaccharides
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excretion of oligosaccharides conjugated to sialic acid in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bone cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fluid filled cavity that develops with a bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aneurysmal bone cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Radiographic features include a dilated, radiolucent lesion typically located eccentrically within the metaphyseal portion of the bone, with fluid levels visible on magnetic resonance imaging.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22474093, PMID:7863874]"}

name: Unicameral bone cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign fluid filled simple cyst of bone filled with serous fluid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Multiple bony cystic lesions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of multiple cystic changes in multiple areas or multiple bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased urinary disaccharide excretion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of disaccharide in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Glycopeptiduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased excretion of glycopeptides in the urine. Glycopeptides are peptides with carbohydrate moieties covalently attached to the side chains of the amino acid residues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aspartylglucosaminuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excretion of excess amounts of aspartylglucosamine in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Keratan sulfate excretion in urine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of keratan sulfate in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chondroitin sulfate excretion in urine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of chondroitin sulfate (CHEBI:37397) in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating fatty acylcarnitine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of fatty acylcarnitine in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excretion of urine with an acid pH, i.e., having an increased hydrogen ion concentration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal urinary acylglycine profile
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal distribution of N-acylglycines in the urine. There are numerous different N-acylglycines, and this term refers to pathological alterations in their level or distribution.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10870848]"}

name: Tonic pupil
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the pupillary light reaction characterized by a marked slowing of the light reaction of usually just one pupil. The pupil tends to be relatively dilated, and there is reduced accommodation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Personality disorder
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A personality disorder is a deeply ingrained pattern of behavior of a specified kind that deviates markedly from the norms of generally accepted behavior. It is typically apparent by the time of adolescence and causes long-term difficulties in personal relationships or functioning in society.\" []"}

name: Borderline personality disorder
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A personality disorder characterized by impulsive behavior and unpredictable, capricious mood. Affected individuals show a tendency to have outbursts of emotion and an inability to control these behavioral explosions. They generally experience an intense fear of abandonment or instability and also struggle with feelings of emptiness.\" []"}

name: Histrionic personality disorder
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A personality disorder characterized by shallow and labile affectivity, self-dramatization, theatricality, exaggerated expression of emotions, suggestibility, egocentricity, self-indulgence, lack of consideration for others, easily hurt feelings, and continuous seeking for appreciation, excitement and attention.\" [ICD-10:F60.4]"}

name: Motor conduction block
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blockade of impulses at a focal site along the course of a motor axon.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of central motor conduction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the conduction of motor nerve impulses in the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:3572430]"}

name: Cerebellar granular layer atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the granular cell layer.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enlarged cerebellum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased size of the cerebellum compared to other brain structures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebellar Purkinje layer atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the Purkinje cell layer.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ubiquitin-positive cerebral inclusion bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates that show positive staining with antibodies against ubiquitin within cells of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of skeletal muscle fiber size
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormality of the size of the skeletal muscle cell.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pyuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of 10 or more white cells per cubic millimeter in a urine specimen, 3 or more white cells per high-power field of unspun urine, a positive result on Gram staining of an unspun urine specimen, or a urinary dipstick test that is positive for leukocyte esterase.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25760357]"}

name: Abnormal urinary color
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal color of the urine, that is, the color of the urine appears different from the usual straw-yellow color.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal mitochondrial shape
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the surface contour of mitochondria.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, MP:0011633]"}

name: Abnormal urinary odor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal odor of the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of pancreas physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the function of the pancreas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of exocrine pancreas physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the acinar gland portion of the pancreas that secretes digestive enzymes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of endocrine pancreas physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A function abnormality of the endocrine pancreas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal pancreas size
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal size of the pancreas.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intracranial epidermoid cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from ectodermal cells that normally form skin cells being left behind in the nervous system during development.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16714456]"}

name: Intracranial dermoid cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from the inclusion of ectodermally committed cells at the time of neural tube closure (3rd-5th week of embryogenesis). The capsule of dermoid cysts consists of simple epithelium supported by collagen. In thicker parts, the lining is supplemented with dermis containing hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and apocrine glands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16714456]"}

name: Edema of the dorsum of feet
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the feet.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating catecholamine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal catecholamine concentration in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating creatinine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal concentration of creatinine in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased serum creatinine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally reduced amount of creatinine in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal mitochondrial number
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal number of mitochondria per cell.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the mitochondrion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the mitochondrion, the membranous cytoplasmic organelle the interior of which is subdivided by cristae. The mitochondrion is a self replicating organelle that is the site of tissue respiration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Rhizomelic leg shortening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of the leg (i.e. the femur).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased fibular diameter
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, MP:0008159]"}

name: Open angle glaucoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of glaucoma defined by an open, normal appearing anterior chamber angle and raised intraocular pressure,\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11815354]"}

name: Angle closure glaucoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of glaucomatous optic neuropathy in an eye that has evidence of angle closure (i.e. significant iridotrabecular contact).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:11815354]"}

name: Abnormality of circulating glucocorticoid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the concentration of a glucocorticoid in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating corticosterone level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the concentration of corticosterone in the blood.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating creatine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of creatine in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Endometrial carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A carcinoma of the endometrium, the mucous lining of the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, NCIT:C7558]"}

name: Abnormal circulating albumin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of albumin in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Hyperalbuminemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of albumin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Methemoglobinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased levels of methemoglobin in the blood. In this form of hemoglobin, there is an oxidized ferric iron (Fe +3) rather than the reduced ferrous form (Fe 2+) that is normally found in hemoglobin. Methemoglobin has a reduced affinity for oxygen, resulting in a reduced ability to release oxygen to tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Methylmalonic aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of methylmalonic acid in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Panuveitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the uveal tract in which inflammation affects the anterior chamber, vitreous, retina or choroid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anterior uveitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the anterior chamber.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Posterior uveitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the retina or choroid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intermediate uveitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the vitreous.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Stomach cancer
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cancer arising in any part of the stomach.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Uraciluria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of uracil in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Basal ganglia necrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Death of cells in the basal ganglia. This finding can be confirmed by autopsy. It can be suspected with hyperintensities within the basal ganglia on FLAIR and T2-sequences on magnetic resonance imaging.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:33198265]"}

name: Abnormality of bone marrow stromal cells
Abnormal erythroid lineage cell morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of erythroid lineage cells, that is, of the erythropoietic cells in the lineage leading to and including erythrocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Abnormal number of erythroid precursors
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Erythroid hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Erythroid hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Abnormal granulocytopoietic cell morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of cells involved in the formation of a granulocytes, that is, of the granulocytopoietic cell.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Granulocytic hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased number of granulocyte precursors in the bone marrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Pancreatic squamous cell carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A subtype of ductal pancreatic carcinoma that is thought to originate from squamous metaplasia of pancreatic ductal epithelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19079631]"}

name: Abnormal megakaryocyte morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of megakaryocytes. Mature blood platelets are released from the cytoplasm of megakaryocytes, which are bone-marrow resident cells.\" []"}

name: Abnormal monocyte morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of a myeloid mononuclear recirculating leukocyte that can act as a precursor of tissue macrophages, osteoclasts and some populations of tissue dendritic cells.\" []"}

name: Abnormality of multiple cell lineages in the bone marrow
Abnormality of von Willebrand factor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased quantity or activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Reduced quantity of Von Willebrand factor
Multiple lineage myelodysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two or more of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Bilineage myelodysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Single lineage myelodysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormality/dysplasia of a single myeloid cell (erythroid, granulocytic, or megakaryocytic).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2945-4463]"}

name: Hemothorax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of blood in the pleural space.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Foveoschisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Splitting of the retinal layers in the macula and involving the fovea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25744445]"}

name: Hypotriglyceridemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of triglyceride in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Anhedonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased ability or inability to experience, feel, or anticipate pleasure from activities, experiences, or stimuli that are typically found pleasurable by the individual. This may involve diminished enjoyment of previously rewarding experiences (e.g., hobbies, social interactions, or sexual activity) or reduced pleasure in response to stimuli processed through the senses (e.g., music, food, or tactile contact). Anhedonia is a disruption in the capacity to derive emotional reward and is not due to primary sensory deficits or medical conditions (e.g., anosmia from viral illness). The phenomenon involves altered affective processing rather than impaired sensory perception.\" [PMID:3107136, PMID:32789515, PMID:33631251, PMID:37424409]"}

name: Decreased corneal sensation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability of the cornea to respond to stimulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hemophagocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Phagocytosis by macrophages of erythrocytes, leukocytes, platelets, and their precursors in bone marrow and other tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25328776]"}

name: Subcortical cerebral atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of the cerebral subcortical white and gray matter, termed subcortical atrophy, reflects loss of nerve cells in the basal ganglia or fibers in the deep white matter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20813998]"}

name: Carotid artery dissection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation (dissection) of the layers of the carotid artery wall.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Internal carotid artery dissection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation (dissection) of the layers of the internal carotid artery wall.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Intracranial internal carotid artery dissection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation (dissection) of the layers of the intracranial portion of the internal carotid artery wall.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: External carotid artery dissection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation (dissection) of the layers of the external carotid artery wall.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Common carotid artery dissection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation (dissection) of the layers of the common carotid artery wall.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Carotid artery dilatation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A dilatation (balooning or bulging out of the vessel wall) of a carotid artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Asterixis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A clinical sign indicating a lapse of posture and is usually manifest by a bilateral flapping tremor at the wrist, metacarpophalangeal, and hip joints.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oligodactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of digits.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Skin-picking
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repetitive and compulsive picking of skin which results in tissue damage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20575652]"}

name: Hair-pulling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A phenomenon in which persons repetitively pull out their own hair, resulting in noticeable hair loss.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Head-banging
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Habitual striking of one's own head against a surface such as a mattress or wall of a crib.\" []"}

name: Stereotypical hand wringing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Habitual clasping and wringing of the hands in the middle of the body, similar to a hand-washing movement.\" [PMID:28838622]"}

name: Stereotypical body rocking
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Habitual repetitive movement of the entire body, front to back or side to side.\" []"}

name: Orthostatic tachycardia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in heart rate with standing of 30 beats per minute or more.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:9244228]"}

name: Glioblastoma multiforme
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor arising from glia in the central nervous system with macroscopic regions of necrosis and hemorrhage. Microscopically, glioblastoma multiforme is characterized by regions of pseudopalisading necrosis, pleomorphic nuclei and cells, and microvascular proliferation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, NCIT:C3058, PMID:10841526]"}

name: Resistance to activated protein C
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Poor anticoagulant response to activated protein C. A plasma is termed 'APC resistant' when the addition of exogenous APC fails to prolong its clotting time in an activated partial thromboplastin time assay.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:14976057]"}

name: Abnormal natural killer cell morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the natural killer cell, which is a lymphocyte that can spontaneously kill a variety of target cells without prior antigenic activation via germline encoded activation receptors. It also regulates immune responses via cytokine release and direct contact with other cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21212348]"}

name: Abnormal natural killer cell physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal response of natural killer (NK) cells to stimuli.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cystic medial necrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A disorder of large arteries, in particular the aorta, characterized by an accumulation of basophilic ground substance in the media with cyst-like lesions associated with degenerative changes of collagen, elastin and the vascular smooth muscle cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Entrapment neuropathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Malfunction of a peripheral nerve resulting from mechanical compression of the nerve roots from internal or external causes and leading to a conduction block or axonal loss.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the oropharnyx.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperplastic colonic polyposis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of multiple hyperplastic polyps in the colon. Hyperplastic polyps are generally about 5 mm in size and show hyperplastic mucosal proliferation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elevated circulating HDL-C concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Constrictive median neuropathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Injury to the median nerve caused by its entrapment at the wrist as it traverses through the carpal tunnel. name: Entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve at elbow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve in the cubital tunnel (in the elbow) characterized by numbness in the ring and little fingers and weakness of the intrinsic muscles in the hand.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased erythrocyte protoporphyrin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of protoporphyrins in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18760763]"}

name: Hyperemesis gravidarum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive vomiting in early pregnancy, leading to the loss of 5% or more of body weight.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, OMIM:603373]"}

name: Hodgkin lymphoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: T-cell lymphoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of lymphoma that originates in T-cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: B-cell lymphoma

name: Anaplastic large-cell lymphoma

name: Episodic hemiplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Transient episodes of weakness of the arm, leg, and in some cases the face on one side of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cheyne-Stokes respiration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal pattern of respiration characterized by cycles of respiration that are increasingly deeper then shallower with possible periods of apnea. name: Insulinoma

name: Juvenile colonic polyposis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of more than 5 juvenile polyps of the colon. The term juvenile polyps refer to a special histopathology and not the age of onset as the polyp might be diagnosed at all ages. The juvenile polyp has a spherical appearance and is microscopically characterized by overgrowth of an oedematous lamina propria with inflammatory cells and cystic glands.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17768394, PMID:25022750]"}

name: Cluster headache
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of headache characterized by repeated attacks of unilateral pain lasting 15 to 180 minutes and associated with local autonomic signs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21912573]"}

name: Abnormality of prothrombin

name: Increased serum bile acid concentration

name: Unusual fungal nail infection

name: Recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis

name: Increased urinary porphobilinogen

name: Tension-type headache

name: Dysmorphic inferior cerebellar vermis

name: Chronic respiratory acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Longstanding impairment in ventilation such that the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) is elevated above the upper limit of the reference range (more than 45 mm Hg), with a normal or near-normal pH secondary to renal compensation and an elevated serum bicarbonate levels (more than30 mEq/L).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Acute respiratory acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden onset of impairment in ventilation such that the removal of carbon dioxide by the respiratory system is less than the production of carbon dioxide in the tissues, leading to an elevation of the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) above the normal limits (more than 45 mm Hg) with an accompanying acidemia (pH less than 7.35).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Chronic acidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Longstanding abnormal acid accumulation or depletion of base.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Infantile spasms
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infantile spasms represent a subset of \\\"epileptic spasms\\\". Infantile Spasms are epileptic spasms starting in the first year of life (infancy).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8486-0558]"}

name: Setting-sun eye phenomenon
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An ophthalmologic sign in young children resulting from upward-gaze paresis. In this condition, the eyes appear driven downward, the sclera may be seen between the upper eyelid and the iris, and part of the lower pupil may be covered by the lower eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17030938]"}

name: Thick vermilion border
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased width of the skin of vermilion border region of upper lip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Eclabion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A turning outward of the lip or lips, that is, eversion of the lips.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impaired specific antibody response
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability of the immune system to produce targeted, protective antibodies (immunoglobulins) against specific pathogens or vaccines in the setting of normal or near-normal serum levels of total IgG, IgA, and IgM and normal absolute counts of B cells and T cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17100769]"}

name: Decreased circulating specific pneumococcal antibody concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration in the blood circulation of specific immunoglobulins directed against pneumococci is below the lower limit of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vocal tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A wavering, unsteady voice that reflects involuntary and approximately sinusoidal oscillation of motor unit firings of laryngeal muscles. Vocal tremor results in low frequency modulations of voice frequency or amplitude and intermittent voice instability.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22505778]"}

name: Temporomandibular joint ankylosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bony fusion of the mandibular condyle to the base of the skull, resulting in limitation of jaw opening.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Temporomandibular joint crepitus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Noises from the temporomandibular joint during mandibular movement (e.g., chewing). Temporomandibular joint crepitus is often described as a clicking, popping, grating sound.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral venous angioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital malformation of veins which drain normal brain characterized by a caput medusae or an umbrellalike convergence of multiple venules on a single, or occasionally multiple, enlarged parenchymal or medullary vein, like the trunk of a tree or the shank of an umbrella. This dilated terminal vein penetrates the cortex to drain either (a) superficially to cortical veins or sinuses, (b) deeply to subependymal veins of the lateral ventricle and then into the galenic system, (c) to the fourth ventricle and then to the pontomesencephalic vein, or (d) to the precentral cerebellar vein and into the galenic system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8770251]"}

name: Frontal venous angioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A venous angioma of the frontal lobe of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal alpha granules
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Defective structure, size or content of alpha granules, platelet organelles that contain several growth factors destined for release during platelet activation at sites of vessel wall injury.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790, PMID:8467233]"}

name: Abnormal dense granules
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Defective structure, size or content of dense granules, platelet organelles that contain granules proaggregatory factors such as adenosine diphosphate (ADP), adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ionized calcium, histamine and serotonin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]"}

name: Abnormal surface-connected open canalicular system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the invaginations of the surface membrane that form the open canalicular system (OCS). The OCS serve as the pathway for transport of substances into the cells and as conduits for the discharge of alpha granule products secreted during the platelet release reaction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:1760557]"}

name: Cerebellopontine angle arachnoid cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An arachnoid cyst located at the margin of the cerebellum and pons.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Intraventricular arachnoid cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An arachnoid cyst located within the ventricular system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:8951893]"}

name: Suprasellar arachnoid cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An arachnoid cyst that progressively enlarges from an abnormality in the membrane of Liliequist or in the interpeduncular cistern, and typically, expands from the prepontine space, displacing the floor of the third ventricle upwards, the pituitary stalk and optic chiasm upwards and forwards, and the mammillary bodies upwards and backwards.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21586175]"}

name: Abnormal dense tubular system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the intracellular membrane complexes known as the dense tubular system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790, PMID:1322202]"}

name: Cerebral artery stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of a cerebral artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Middle cerebral artery stenosis

name: Anterior cerebral artery stenosis

name: Posterior cerebral artery stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the posterior cerebral artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced maximal inspiratory pressure

name: Reduced maximal expiratory pressure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decrease in the maximum amount of pressure of expired air achieved by a person after a full inspiration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Nuchal cord
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A complication of pregnancy and delivery in which the umbilical cord wraps around the fetal neck once or multiple times.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Descending aortic dissection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation of the layers within the wall of the descending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Verrucous papule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A wartlike (with multiple small elevated projections) papule.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal brainstem white matter morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the white matter of brainstem.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of the internal capsule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the internal capsule, which is an area of white matter in the brain that separates the caudate nucleus and the thalamus from the putamen and the globus pallidus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal size of pituitary gland
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal size of the pituitary gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enlarged pituitary gland
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased size of the pituitary gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Small pituitary gland
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally decreased size of the pituitary gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Weakness of orbicularis oculi muscle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced strength of the orbicularis oculi, the circumorbital muscle in the face that closes the eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Metamorphopsia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A visual anomaly in which images appear distorted. A grid of straight lines appears wavy and parts of the grid may appear blank.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Extra-axial cerebrospinal fluid accumulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased amount of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in the subarachnoid space.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22327705, PMID:23838695]"}

name: Temporal optic disc pallor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pale yellow discoloration of the temporal (lateral) portion of the optic disc.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19668477]"}

name: Diffuse optic disc pallor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pale yellow discoloration of the entire optic disc.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19668477]"}

name: Upper limb pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the arm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Lower limb pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the leg.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Hip flexor weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability to flex the femur, that is, to pull the knee upward.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An extreme form of tetralogy of Fallot characterized by absence of flow from the right ventricle to the pulmonary arteries.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:22368654]"}

name: Reduced circulating catalase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity or concentration of catalase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circle of Willis morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the circle of Willis, also known as the cerebral arterial circle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplastic posterior communicating artery
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomnaly characterized by underdevelopment of the posterior communicating artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Dilation of Virchow-Robin spaces
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased dimensions of the Virchow-Robin spaces (also known as perivascular spaces), which surround the walls of vessels as they course from the subarachnoid space through the brain parenchyma. Perivascular spaces are commonly microscopic, and not visible on conventional neuroimaging. This term refers to an increase of size of these spaces such that they are visible on neuroimaging (usually magnetic resonance imaging). The dilatations are regular cavities that always contain a patent artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:17620468, PMID:23867200, PMID:25564639]"}

name: Spider hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of telangiectasis characterized by a central elevated red dot the size of a pinhead, representing an arteriole, with numerous small blood vessels that radiate out thereby resembling the legs of a spider. Characteristically, compression of the central arteriole causes the entire lesion to blanch, and the lesion quickly refills once the compression is released.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22356347]"}

name: Oral aversion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reluctance or refusal of a child to be breastfed or eat, manifested as gagging, vomiting, turning head away from food, or avoidance of sensation in or around the mouth (i.e. toothbrushing or face-washing).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Abnormal platelet shape

name: Abnormal alpha granule distribution

name: Abnormal alpha granule content

name: Abnormal number of alpha granules

name: Abnormal dense granule content
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain adenosine triphosphate (ATP), adenosine diphosphate (ADP), serotonin, calcium, and pyrophosphate, which are secreted when platelets are activated.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]"}

name: Abnormal number of dense granules
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal count of dense granules per thrombocyte.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7744-1790]"}

name: Pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Chronic pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistent pain, usually defined as pain that has lasted longer than 3 to 6 months.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:1875958]"}

name: Allodynia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pain due to a stimulus that does not normally provoke pain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dysesthesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Painful sensations elicited by a nonpainful cutaneous stimulus such as a light touch or gentle stroking over affected areas of the body. Sometimes referred to as hyperpathia or hyperalgesia. Often perceived as an intense burning, dyesthesias may outlast the stimulus by several seconds.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Abnormal synaptic transmission
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse. This is a four step process, comprising (i) synthesis and storage of neurotransmitters; (ii) neurotransmitter release; (iii) activation of postsynaptic receptors by the neurotransmitter; and (iv) inactivation of the neurotransmitter. Thus, this term is defined as an anomaly of neurotransmitter metabolic process.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, MP:0003635]"}

name: Maternal anticardiolipin antibody positive
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of circulating autoantibodies to anticardiolipin in the mother.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432, PMID:1495720, PMID:9722063]"}

name: Food intolerance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A detrimental reaction to a food, beverage, food additive, or compound found in foods that produces symptoms in one or more body organs and systems that is not mediated by an immune reaction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gluten intolerance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A detrimental reaction to the presence of gluten in food, which may include abdominal pain, fatigue, headaches and paresthesia, or celiac disease.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by the absence of multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cephalohematoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemorrhage between the skull and periosteum of a newborn resulting from rupture of blood vessels that cross the periosteum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Hemosiderinuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of hemosiderin in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elevated circulating aldolase concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Fatty replacement of skeletal muscle

name: Conjunctival lipoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lipoma (a benign tumor composed of adipose tissue) located in the conjunctiva.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Colonic varices
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of varices (enlarged and convoluted blood vessels) in the colon.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16688816]"}

name: Absent neutrophil specific granules
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of specific granules in neutrophils.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:6155073]"}

name: Increased neutrophil nuclear projections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of an elevated number of projections from nuclei of neutrophils. These projections can have the shape of hooks, tags, or clubs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplastic thumbnail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A thumbnail that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped thumb nail.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyperbetaalaninemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of beta-alanine in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: EEG with centrotemporal focal spike waves
extra_json: {"definition": "\"EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the centrotemporal region of the brain (also known as the central sulcus), i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal T3/T4 ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that deviates from normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16982586]"}

name: Increased T3/T4 ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is higher than normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Decreased T3/T4 ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is lower than normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unicuspid aortic valve

name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in hand
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the hand, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the fibula, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in radius
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the radius, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Premature epimetaphyseal fusion in ulna
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the ulna, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lower eyelid edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Edema in the region of the Lower eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Delayed menarche
extra_json: {"definition": "\"First period after the age of 15 years.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Synovial sarcoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of mesenchymal tissue cell tumor that exhibits epithelial differentiation, which most frequently arises in the extremities.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ureter fissus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A partial duplication of the ureter where the duplicated ureters fuse to a single ureter before their insertion into the bladder.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_ewuehl]"}

extra_json: {"definition": "\"A complete duplication of the ureter, where the duplicated ureters have separate insertions into the bladder.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Global proximal tubulopathy

name: Mesangial hypercellularity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased numbers of mesangial cells per glomerulus, defined as more than 3 nuclei fully surrounded by matrix in one or more mesangial areas, not including perihilar region, on a standard 3-micron-thick tissue section, best evaluated on periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) stain.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular C3 deposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of complement 3 deposits in the glomerulus.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_ewuehl]"}

name: Thin glomerular basement membrane
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased thickness of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to a decrease in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations less than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals. May be focal or diffuse, although the term thin GBMs generally implies thinning of over 50% of GBMs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Membranous nephropathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of glomerulonephropathy characterized by thickening of the basement membrane and deposition of immune complexes in the subepithelial space.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Minimal change glomerulonephritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of minimal changes visible by light microscopy but flattened and fused podocyte foot processes on electron microscopy in a person with nephrotic range proteinuria.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:Eurenomics_fschaefer]"}

name: Calcium phosphate nephrolithiasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of calcium- and phosphate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bilateral renal dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bilateral form of developmental dysplasia of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bilateral renal atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A two-sided form of atrophy of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macroscopic hematuria
