name: Venous malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A vascular malformation resulting from a developmental error of venous tissue composed of dysmorphic channels lined by flattened endothelium and exhibiting slow turnover. A venous malformation may present as a blue patch on the skin ranging to a soft blue mass. Venous malformations are easily compressible and usually swell in thewhen venous pressure increases (e.g., when held in a dependent position or when a child cries). They may be relatively localized or quite extensive within an anatomic region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Heart block
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impaired conduction of cardiac impulse occurring anywhere along the conduction pathway.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sinoatrial block
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Disturbance in the atrial activation that is caused by transient failure of impulse conduction from the sinoatrial node to the cardiac atria.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Upper eyelid edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Edema in the region of the upper eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cutaneous syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal or metatarsophalangeal joint of the adjacent digits.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Episodic hypokalemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally decreased potassium concentration in the blood occurring periodically with a return to normal between the episodes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thoracic aortic aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the thoracic aorta.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fusiform descending thoracic aortic aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A concentric abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta that involves the full circumference of the vessel wall\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Saccular descending thoracic aortic aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An eccentric abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta that involves only a portion of the circumference of the vessel wall\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Aglossia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of the tongue owing to a developmental abnormality.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ectopic anterior pituitary gland
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal anatomic location of the anterior pituitary gland.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anorectal anomaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the anus or rectum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Macule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A flat, distinct, discolored area of skin less than 1 cm wide that does not involve any change in the thickness or texture of the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ketotic hypoglycemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Low blood glucose is accompanied by elevated levels of ketone bodies in the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cough
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sudden, audible expulsion of air from the lungs through a partially closed glottis, preceded by inhalation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16428719, PMID:17540788]"}

name: Profound global developmental delay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A profound delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6410-0882]"}

name: Small intestinal polyp
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A discrete abnormal tissue mass that protrudes into the lumen of the small intestine and is attached to the intestinal wall either by a stalk, pedunculus, or a broad base.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Agenesis of the small intestine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure to develop of the small intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Papilloma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor of the skin or mucous membrane with finger-like projections.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral cryptorchidism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of a testis from the scrotum on one side owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Thin fingernail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fingernail that appears thin when viewed on end.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Abdominal obesity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive fat around the stomach and abdomen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Short palpebral fissure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distance between the medial and lateral canthi is more than 2 SD below the mean for age (objective); or, apparently reduced length of the palpebral fissures.\" [PMID:19125427]"}

name: Thin toenail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Toenail that appears thin when viewed on end.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125433]"}

name: Abnormal brainstem MRI signal intensity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Focal T2 hyperintense brainstem lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Focal T2 hypointense brainstem lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: T2 hypointense brainstem
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting the entire brainstem.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Abnormal basal ganglia MRI signal intensity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Focal T2 hypointense basal ganglia lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the basal ganglia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: T2 hypointense basal ganglia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting all of the basal ganglia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: CNS hypermyelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased amount of myelin in the central nervous system.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Enlarged brainstem
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase in size of the brainstem.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: CSF polymorphonuclear pleocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased polymorphonuclear cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:KI_phemming]"}

name: Abnormal neuron morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of a neuron. Neurons are electrically excitable cells that transmit signals throughout the body. Neurons employ both electrical and chemical components in the transmission of information. Neurons are connected to other neurons at synapses and connected to effector organs or cells at neuroeffector junctions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:KI_phemming, PMID:28723006]"}

name: Neurodevelopmental delay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Neurodevelopmental delay (NDD) refers to delays in the maturation of the brain and central nervous system; infants and young children with NDD may experience delays in the development of one or more skills including gross motor abilities, fine-motor coordination, language abilities and ability to solve increasingly complex problems.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:31783983]"}

name: Neurodevelopmental abnormality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal of the neurological development of a child, which may include any or all of the aspects of the development of personal, social, gross or fine motor, and cognitive abilities.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:KI_phemming]"}

name: Reduced social responsiveness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced ability to participate in the back-and-forth flow of social interaction appropriate to culture and developmental level, which is normally characterized by an influence of the behavior of one person on the behavior of another person. This results in difficulty interacting with others through emotional, physical, or verbal communication.\" [PMID:28707360, PMID:34924788]"}

name: Absent mastoid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly in which the mastoid process fails to form and is thus found to be congenitally absent.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral white matter atrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebral white matter.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Paroxysmal dyspnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sudden attack of dyspnea that occurs while the affected person is at rest.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Orthopnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sensation of breathlessness in the recumbent position, relieved by sitting or standing.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Widened cerebellar subarachnoid space
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater in the region surrounding the cerebellum.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Widened cerebral subarachnoid space
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater in the region surrounding the cerebrum.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Abnormal placental size
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal size of the placenta.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal arm span
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal of the length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle)\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced arm span
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased arm span
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal upper to lower segment ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal of the relation between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced upper to lower segment ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased ratio between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis. Consider the term Disproportionate tall stature (HP:0001519) if tall stature is also present.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased upper to lower segment ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Elevated ratio between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Stellate iris
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lacy pattern or iris pigmentation that resembles the spokes of a bicycle wheel.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:CINEAS_asollie]"}

name: Abnormal ciliary body morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the ciliary body.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:CINEAS_asollie]"}

name: Retinal neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign or malignant tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the retina.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:CINEAS_asollie]"}

name: Retinal astrocytic hamartoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A glial tumor of the retinal nerve fiber layer arising from a retinal astrocyte.\" [PMID:20435268, PMID:23436975]"}

name: Transient hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hearing loss that occurs acutely and resolves completely.\" [PMID:21776317]"}

name: Neoplasm of the ear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the ear.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mid-frequency hearing loss
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the middle frequencies of sound (1000 Hz to 3000 Hz).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Perilobar nephrogenic rest
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of nephrogenic rest associated with multiple lesions in the periphery of the renal lobe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20301471]"}

name: Intralobar nephrogenic rest
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of nephrogenic rest usually representing single lesions within the renal lobe, renal sinus, or calyceal walls.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20301471]"}

name: Perinephritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the connective and adipose tissues surrounding the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Flexion contracture of finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Chronic loss of joint motion in a finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Recurrent cystitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repeated infections of the urinary bladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20639019]"}

name: Reticulate pigmentation of oral mucosa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A net-like pattern of increased pigmentation of the oral cavity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal intramembranous ossification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the process of intramembranous ossification by which flat bones (cranial bones of the skull, i.e., the frontal, parietal, occipital, and temporal bones, and the clavicles) are formed.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal humeral ossification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the process of formation of bone in the humerus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent ossification of thoracic vertebral bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lack of bone mineralization of one or more body of thoracic vertebra.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Kinked brainstem
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A kinked appearance of the brainstem, i.e., an exaggerated flexure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16301726]"}

name: Periventricular white matter hypodensities
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple areas of darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the cerebral ventricles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16239634]"}

name: Abnormal optic disc morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A morphological abnormality of the optic disc, i.e., of the portion of the optic nerve clinically visible on fundoscopic examination.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased cup-to-disc ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation in the ratio of the diameter of the cup of the optic disc to the total diameter of the disk. The optic disc has an orange-pink rim with a pale center (the cup) that does not contain neuroretinal tissue. An increase in this ratio therefore may indicate a decrease in the quantity of healthy neuroretinal cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23557744]"}

name: Lymphatic vessel neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the lymphatic vessels.\" [NCIT:C3723]"}

name: Pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infiltration of smooth muscle-like cells in lymph vessels as well as the lung (pleura, alveolar septa, bronchi, pulmonary vessels and lymphatics as well as lymph nodes, especially in posterior mediastinum and retroperitoneum). Focal emphysema can develop because of airway narrowing, and the thoracic duct may be obliterated. Pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis may lead to multiple small cysts with a hamartomatous proliferation of smooth muscle in their walls.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral facial palsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"One-sided weakness of the muscles of facial expression and eye closure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Accessory cranial suture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cranial suture that is in addition to canonical membrane-covered openings in the incompletely ossified skull of the fetus or newborn infant.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20496093]"}

name: Narrow jaw
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bigonial distance (lower facial width) more than 2 standard deviations below the mean (objective); or an apparently decreased width of the lower jaw (mandible) when viewed from the front (subjective).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Broad jaw
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bigonial distance (lower facial width) more than 2 SD above the mean (objective); or an apparently increased width of the lower jaw (mandible) when viewed from the front (subjective).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19125436]"}

name: Anisometropia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inequality of refractive power of the two eyes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Corneal ulceration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Disruption of the epithelial layer of the cornea with involvement of the underlying stroma.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Iris transillumination defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Transmission of light through the iris as visualized upon slit lamp examination or infrared iris transillumination videography. The light passes through defects in the pigmentation of the iris.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19920562]"}

name: Proboscis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fleshy, tube-like structure usually located in the midline of the face or just to one side of the midline.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: High insertion of columella
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Insertion of the posterior columella superior to the nasal base.\" [PMID:19152422]"}

name: Abnormal nasal base norphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the nasal base, which can be conceived of as an imaginary line between the most lateral points of the external inferior attachments of the alae nasi to the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Narrow nasal base
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased distance between the attachments of the alae nasi to the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Wide nasal base
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased distance between the attachments of the alae nasi to the face.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Wide nasal ridge
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased width of the nasal ridge.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Fullness of paranasal tissue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased bulk of tissue alongside the nose. The fullness can be caused by both bony and soft tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19152422]"}

name: Unilateral breast hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the breast on one side only.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bilateral breast hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the breast on both sides.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplastic female external genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of part or all of the female external reproductive organs (which include the mons pubis, labia majora, labia minora, Bartholin glands, and clitoris).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Right ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A predominantly right ventricular variant of isolated noncompaction cardiomyopathy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23921774]"}

name: Noncompaction cardiomyopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cardiomyopathy characterized anatomically by deep trabeculations in the ventricular wall, which define recesses communicating with the main ventricular chamber.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15210614, PMID:24282766]"}

name: Myocarditis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the myocardium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21304213, PMID:22185868, PMID:22361396]"}

name: Bilateral vocal cord paralysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A loss of the ability to move the vocal fold on both sides.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral vocal cord paresis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased strength of the vocal fold on one side.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bilateral vocal cord paresis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased strength of the vocal fold on both sides.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Clinical modifier
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This subontology is designed to provide terms to characterize and specify the phenotypic abnormalities defined in the Phenotypic abnormality subontology, with respect to severity, laterality, age of onset, and other aspects.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Severity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The intensity or degree of a manifestation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mild
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Having a relatively minor degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of between two and three standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Moderate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Having a medium degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of between three and four standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Borderline
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Having a minor degree of severity that is considered to be on the boundary between the normal and the abnormal ranges. For quantitative traits, a deviation of that is less than two standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Severe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Having a high degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of between four and five standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Profound
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Having an extremely high degree of severity. For quantitative traits, a deviation of more than five standard deviations from the appropriate population mean.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Position
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The anatomical localization of the specified phenotypic abnormality.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Laterality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The localization with respect to the side of the body of the specified phenotypic abnormality.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bilateral
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Being present on both sides of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unilateral
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Being present on only the left or only the right side of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Right
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Being located on the right side of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Left
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Being located on the left side of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Spatial pattern
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The pattern by which a phenotype affects one or more regions of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Generalized
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Affecting all regions without specificity of distribution.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Localized
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Being confined or restricted to a particular location.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Distal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Localized away from the central point of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Proximal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Localized close to the central point of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Retinal vascular tortuosity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased number of twists and turns of the retinal blood vessels. This can affect either arteries, veins or both.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Skin appendage neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the hair follicles, sebaceous glands, or sweat glands.\" [NCIT:C4463]"}

name: Hair follicle neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An uncontrolled autonomous cell-proliferation originating in a hair follicle, which is an epidermal adnexal structures responsible for hair growth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, NCIT:C7367]"}

name: Trichilemmoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign tumor originating from the outer root sheath of the hair follicle.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang]"}

name: Single trichilemmoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of a unitary trichilemmoma, a benign tumor originating from the outer root sheath of the hair follicle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Multiple trichilemmomata
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of multiple trichilemmomata, a benign tumor originating from the outer root sheath of the hair follicle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Epilepsia partialis continua
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Epilepsia partialis continua (also called Kojevnikov's or Kozhevnikov's epilepsia) is a type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repeated stereotyped simple motor manifestations such as jerks, typically of a limb or the face, recurring every few seconds or minutes for extended periods (days or years).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:26336950]"}

name: Small intestinal stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The narrowing or partial blockage of a portion of the small intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Small intestinal dysmotility
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal small intestinal contractions, such as spasms and intestinal paralysis related to the loss of the ability of the gut to coordinate muscular activity because of endogenous or exogenous causes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Colonic stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A narrowing of a segment of colon whereby bowel continuity is maintained.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hepatic bridging fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hepatic fibrosis that reaches from a portal area to another portal area.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:14568255]"}

name: Scrotal hypospadias

Toxoplasmosis is a life-threatening infection in immunocompromised patients (ICPs).\" [PMID:25762774]"}

name: Glomerular basement membrane duplication

name: Persistent human papillomavirus infection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are small oncogenic viruses. HPV has been shown to cause a variety of lesions and malignancies, which predominantly affect the anogenital region. Infection with anogenital HPV is usually asymptomatic and resolves spontaneously without consequences in the immunocompetent host. When disease does occur, the most common manifestation is genital warts, which may be small papules, or flat, smooth or pedunculated lesions. This resolution of HPV lesions is not generally seen in the immunosuppressed, resulting in severe, persistent and extensive manifestations of HPV disease.\" [PMID:24643184, PMID:26239127]"}

name: Colonization of follicles by lymphoma cells

name: Reduced lymph node lymphocyte morphological variability

name: Hodgkin morphology cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hodgkin cells are typically large and often show very large nucleoli and sometimes binucleation or multinucleation. Reed-Sternberg cells are a type of Hodgkin cell that is binucleated with very large nucleoli that stains slightly red on H&E stained sections (often said to mimic owl eyes). Other Hodgkin cell morphologies include cells that are dying with dark basophilic (blue) nuclei that appear somewhat smudged (mummified cells) and cells with a large space around or adjacent to the nuclei and retracted cytoplasm after tissue fixation (lacunar cells). Hodgkin cells are characteristic of Hodgkin lymphoma, however several non-Hodgkin lymphomas and noN-neoplastic conditions are known to sometimes show a few similar morphology cells.\" [PMID:31194473]"}

name: Malignant melanotic nerve sheath tumor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Malignant melanotic nerve sheath tumors (MMNSTs) are uncommon pigmented tumors of Schwann cell origin, most often found along the spinal nerves. MMNSTs were formerly known as melanotic schwannoma. Although MMNSTs can occur along cranial nerves, they tend to grow along the dorsal spinal nerve roots, and patients often present with indolent pain, weakness, or paresthesia along a corresponding dermatome. On imaging, spinal MMNSTs generally appear similar to the appearance presented in the current case: intradural, extramedullary tumors. name: Lisfranc injury

name: Abnormal dental physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of one or more teeth.\" []"}

name: Dental hypermobility

name: Antichromatin antibody positivity

name: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

name: Abnormal cecum morphology

name: Flail chest

name: Hallux rigidus

name: Thickening of glomerular capillary wall
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Widening of the wall of capillary blood vessels in the glomerulus. name: Abnormal glomerular capillary morphology

name: Ectopic fovea

name: Tracheal tug on inspiration

name: Forward slanting upper incisors

name: Foveal atrophy

name: Pyriform aperture stenosis

name: Decerebrate rigidity

name: Subcutaneous spheroids

name: Abnormal capillary morphology

name: Capillary fragility

name: Abnormal capillary physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the tiny blood vessels that connect arterioles with venules and whose walls act as semipermeable membranes that mediate the diffusion of fluids and gases between the blood circulation and body tissues.\" []"}

name: Arterial rupture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden breakage of an artery leading to leakage of blood from the circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Elevated circulating prostate-specific antigen concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of prostate-specific antigen in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Abnormal erythrocyte sedimentation rate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal range of the erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), a test that measures the distance that erythrocytes have fallen after one hour in a vertical column of anticoagulated blood under the influence of gravity. A decreased ESR may be seen in polycythemia or in certain blood diseases in which red blood cells have an irregular or smaller shape that causes slower settling.\" [PMID:10524488]"}

name: Decreased erythrocyte sedimentation rate

name: Rectal atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the rectum. That is, there is an abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the rectum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20006038]"}

name: Megarectum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal dilation of the rectum. There is a large filled rectum as a result of underlying innervation or muscular abnormalities, which remains after disimpaction of the rectum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10869000]"}

name: Rectovestibular fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital malformation characterized by an abnormal connection (fistula) between the rectum and the vulval vestibule, at the lower aspect of the vaginal opening.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: H-type rectovestibular fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rectovestibular fistula with a normal anus is known as H-type fistula or double termination of the alimentary tract.\" [PMID:20223314]"}

name: Osteoma cutis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term osteoma refers to the anomalous presence of ossification (bone formation) in the interior of the dermis or epidermis. The dermal or subcutaneous bone formation presents as stony hard nodules. The osteomata appear as irregular, hardened small nodules that are well circumscribed and generally of the same color as the skin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21152797, PMID:26273166]"}

name: Abnormal enteric nervous system morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of nerves of the enteric nervous system.\" []"}

name: Enteric neuronal degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deterioration of enteric neurons with impairment of enteric neuronal structure. Typical neuropathological findings include qualitative (e.g., neuronal swelling, intranuclear inclusions, axonal degeneration) and quantitative (e.g., reduction in the number of neurons) abnormalities of the enteric neurons.\" []"}

name: Abnormality of digestive system physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the digestive system.\" []"}

name: Abnormal digestive system morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the digestive system.\" []"}

name: Abnormal morphology of erythroid progenitor cell
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal form of the progenitor cells committed to the erythroid lineage.\" []"}

name: Abnormal proerythroblast morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anomalous form of the proerythroblast, i.e., the immature, nucleated erythrocyte occupying the stage of erythropoeisis that follows formation of erythroid progenitor cells. This cell is CD71-positive, has both a nucleus and a nucleolus, and lacks hematopoeitic lineage markers.\" []"}

name: Type I radial ray deficiency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by short distal radius. The distal radial epiphysis is present but delayed in appearance. The growth of the distal radial epiphysis is decreased causing a normal appearing but short radius. There is little radial deviation of the hand due to adequate radial carpal support. name: Hypothalamic gliosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal proliferation of glial cells in the hypothalamus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26530930]"}

name: Intratesticular abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A collection of pus within a testicle. Ultrasonographic features include shaggy, irregular walls, intratesticular location, low-level internal echoes, and occasionally, hypervascular margins.\" [PMID:11598263]"}

name: Basal ganglia edema

name: Thalamic edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Swelling within the thalamus due to the accumulation of fluid.\" []"}

name: Abnormality of mesenteric lymph nodes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A morphological anomaly of lymph nodes in the mesenteric root or throughout the mesentery.\" []"}

name: Enlarged mesenteric lymph node
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in size of one or more mesenteric lymph nodes.\" []"}

name: Lung abscess

name: Type II radial ray deficiency

name: Type III radial ray deficiency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of radial ray deficiency characterized by partial absence of the radius. The radius is partially absent. name: Hypothalamic atrophy

name: Splenic abscess

name: Geophagia

name: Scaphoid abdomen

name: Abnormal mean corpuscular volume

name: Decreased mean corpuscular volume
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction from normal of the mean corpuscular volume, or mean cell volume (MCV) of red blood cells (usually defined as an MCV below 80 femtoliters).\" []"}

name: Recurrent sepsis

name: Incomitant strabismus

name: Concomitant strabismus

name: Abnormal U wave
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the U wave of the electrocardiogram (EKG). The U wave is a small (0.5 mm) deflection immediately following the T wave, usually in the same direction as the T wave. It is best seen in leads V2 and V3.\" [PMID:22665396]"}

name: Exercise-induced U wave inversion

name: Increased QRS voltage

name: Abnormal QRS voltage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal amplitude of the QRS complex of the electrocardiogram (EKG).\" []"}

name: Decreased QRS voltage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced amplitude (height) of the QRS complex of the electrocardiogram (EKG), defined as amplitudes of all the QRS complexes in the limb leads are less than 5 mm or amplitudes of all the QRS complexes in the precordial leads less than 10 mm.\" []"}

name: Electrical alternans

name: Pancreatic abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma of the pancreas.\" []"}

name: Orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of hyperkeratosis characterized by thickening of the cornified layer without retained nuclei.\" []"}

name: Darier's sign
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A skin change elicited by briskly rubbing the skin lesion in urticaria pigmentosa (UP), whereby the area begins to itch and becomes raised and surrounded by erythema. name: Abnormal cutaneous elastic fiber morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the elastic fibers of the skin. Elastic fibers are the essential extracellular matrix macromolecules comprising an elastin core surrounded by a mantle of fibrillin-rich microfibrils.\" [PMID:12082143, PMID:21738362]"}

name: Elevated dermal desmosine content
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased amount of desmosine measure in the skin. Desmosine is a cross-linking amino acid formed from lysyl residues in elastin.\" [PMID:2307214]"}

name: Folliculitis

name: Bloody mucoid diarrhea

name: Delayed recoil upon stretching of skin

name: Feculent vomiting

name: Abnormal large intestinal mucosa morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the mucous lining of the large intestine.\" []"}

name: Epidermal acanthosis

name: Peripapillary exudate

name: Disciform macular scar

name: Sneeze

name: Dysgenesis of the hypothalamus

name: Dysgenesis of the thalamus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Structural abnormality of the thalamus related to defective development.\" []"}

name: Dysgenesis of the hippocampus

name: Dysgenesis of the basal ganglia

name: Umbilicated nodule

name: Capillary malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A capillary malformation is a flat, sharply defined vascular stain of the skin. In a capillary maformation, the predominant vessels are small, slow-flow vessels (i.e., arterioles and postcapillary venules).\" [PMID:22483320, PMID:25864701]"}

name: Nevus anemicus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital skin lesion characterized by irregular hypopigmented macules that coalesce to form plaques and occur particularly on the chest. It is generally present at birth or develops in the first days of life. It is more common in females. Diagnosis is confirmed by applying gentle friction to the lesion and the surrounding skin and checking that the erythema produced in the healthy skin does not appear in the hypopigmented lesion. This pale macule becomes more conspicuous when the lesion and its surroundings are rubbed. The margin of the naevus is ill-defined and consists of an archipelago of small anemic spots.\" [PMID:22483320, PMID:25864701]"}

name: Nevus roseus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A variant of port-wine stain characterized by a pale red or even pink tone, in contrast to the darker hue of the port-wine stain. By analogy with the term port-wine stain, this variant rose-wine stain, or nevus roseus. Nevus roseus, however, cannot be definitely diagnosed until adulthood as port-wine stains are sometimes pink in children. While the natural history of port-wine stains includes hypertrophy, darkening, and nodularity, nevus roseus remains unchanged for life.\" [PMID:22483320, PMID:25864701]"}

name: Cutis marmorata telangiectatica congenita
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital vascular malformation that presents as localized or generalized erythematous-telangiectatic lesions with a reticular pattern; the lesions are almost always present at birth or develop in the first days of life. name: Angioma serpentinum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Angioma serpiginosum consists of punctate, tightly packed telangiectatic lesions. Characteristic histopathological features are dilated and tortuous capillaries involving the uppermost part of the dermis.\" [PMID:25864701]"}

name: Reduced red cell pyruvate kinase level

name: Placoid macular lesion

name: Acquired aphakia

name: Misophonia

name: Hypergranulosis

name: Civatte bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Eosinophilic hyaline ovoid bodies which are often found in the subepidermal papillary regions or sometimes in the epidermis. They are 10-25 micrometers in diameter and situated mostly within or above the inflammatory cell infiltrate. In lichen planus, the number of necrotic keratinocytes may be so large that they are seen lying in clusters in the uppermost dermis. These bodies show a positive periodic acid Schiff reaction and are diastase resistant\" [PMID:23919028]"}

name: Fetal distress
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An intrauterine state characterized by suboptimal values in the fetal heart rate, oxygenation of fetal blood, or other parameters indicative of compromise of the fetus. Signs of fetal distress include repetitive variable decelerations, fetal tachycardia or bradycardia, late decelerations, or low biophysical profile.\" []"}

name: Rete ridge flattening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rete pegs (or ridges) are the epithelial extensions that project into the underlying connective tissue in both skin and mucous membranes. Rete ridge flattening refers to the loss of these projections so that the skin epithelium acquires a relatively flat appearance.\" [PMID:20548894]"}

name: Lip discoloration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lightening or darkening of the lips from their usual coloring.\" []"}

name: Violet lip discoloration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An alteration of the color of the lip to take on a violet color. This term does not include cyanosis.\" [PMID:24346922]"}

name: Abnormal circulating reverse T3 concentration

name: White lesion of the oral mucosa

name: Decreased small intestinal mucosa lactase level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lactase is produced in the small intestine in humans, Lactase is a member of the beta-galactosidase family of enzymes, and hydrolyzes D-lactose to form D-galactose and D-glucose, which can be absorbed by the small intestine. There are many ways of assessing lactase activity. In one test, an endoscopic biopsy from the postbulbar duodenum is incubated with lactose on a test plate, and a color reaction develops within 20 min as a result of hydrolyzed lactose (a positive result) in patients with normolactasia, whereas no reaction (a negative result) develops in patients with severe hypolactasia. Other, less direct, tests include the hydrogen breath test, and blood tests following lactose challenges.\" []"}

name: Abnormal temper tantrums

Temper tantrums that occur more frequently in a given time and/or are more severe in symptomatology and/or longer in duration and/or inappropriate for the given age compared to a temper tantrum that naturally occurs as a part of the developmental process are classified as abnormal temper tantrums.\" []"}

name: Frequent temper tantrums

name: Increased number of elastic fibers in the dermis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevated number of elastic fibers, that is of bundles of proteins and glycoproteins in the extracellular matrix in the reticular dermis. name: Clumping of elastic fibers in the dermis

name: Neuronal/glioneuronal neoplasm of the central nervous system
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A central nervous system neoplasm with neuronal and, less consistently, glial differentiation.\" []"}

name: Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor of the central nervous system that has components of both neurocytic and glial areas, whereby usually the glial component of the tumor predominates. Rossette-forming glioneuronal tumors (RGNT) have biphasic cytoarchitecture with two elements; neurocytic rosettes resembling Homer-Wright rosettes, and astrocytic component resembling a pilocytic astrocytoma. RGNTs are low-grade tumors that lack histopathological signs of malignancy.\" [PMID:27179225]"}

name: Smooth septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with a smooth appearance of the interlobular septa.\" []"}

name: Nodular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with a nodular or beaded appearance of the interlobular septa.\" []"}

name: Irregular septal thickening on pulmonary HRCT
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a high-resolution computed tomography scan with an irregular appearance of the interlobular septa. THis feature is often associated with distortion of lung architecture.\" []"}

name: Honeycomb lung
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Honeycombing represents destroyed and fibrotic lung tissue containing numerous cystic airspaces with thick fibrous walls, representing the late stage of various lung diseases, with complete loss of acinar architecture. The cysts range in size from a few millimeters to several centimeters in diameter, have variable wall thickness, and are lined by metaplastic bronchiolar epithelium. On chest radiographs, honeycombing appears as closely approximated ring shadows, typically 3-10 mm in diameter with walls 1-3 mm in thickness, that resemble a honeycomb; the finding implies end-stage lung disease. On CT scans, the appearance is of clustered cystic air spaces, typically of comparable diameters on the order of 3-10 mm but occasionally as large as 2.5 cm. Honeycombing is usually subpleural and is characterized by well-defined walls. It is a CT feature of established pulmonary fibrosis. Because honeycombing is often considered specific for pulmonary fibrosis and is an important criterion in the diagnosis of usual interstitial pneumonia, the term should be used with care, as it may directly impact patient care.\" [PMID:18195376]"}

name: Intralobular interstitial thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fine reticular pattern on high-resolution computed tomography, with the visible lines separated by a few millimeters. Regions of the lung with intralobular interstitial thickening characteristically show a fine lacelike or netlike appearance.\" []"}

name: Peribronchovascular interstitial thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thickening of the peribronchovascular interstitium, a connective tissue sheath that surrounds the central bronchi and pulmonary arteries. The peribronchovascular interstitium extends from the level of the pulmonary hila into the peripheral lung. This feature may be ascertained on high-resolution computer tomography.\" []"}

name: Subpleural interstitial thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in thickness of the subpleural interstitium.\" []"}

name: Ground-glass opacification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"On chest radiographs, ground-glass opacity appears as an area of hazy increased lung opacity, usually extensive, within which margins of pulmonary vessels may be indistinct. On CT scans, it appears as hazy increased opacity of lung, with preservation of bronchial and vascular margins. It is caused by partial filling of airspaces, interstitial thickening (due to fluid, cells, and/or fibrosis), partial collapse of alveoli, increased capillary blood volume, or a combination of these, the common factor being the partial displacement of air. Ground-glass opacity is less opaque than consolidation, in which bronchovascular margins are obscured.\" [PMID:18195376, PMID:23247773]"}

name: Centrilobular ground-glass opacification on pulmonary HRCT
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hazy area of increased attenuation in centrilobular areas of the lung with preserved bronchial and vascular markings seen on a computer tomography scan. Centrilobular refers to a location that is central within secondary pulmonary lobules.\" []"}

name: Abdominal aseptic abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abscess-like lesion located within the abdomen. The lesions are localized in the spleen, liver, abdominal lymph nodes. The lesions represent visceral sterile collections of mature neutrophils that do not respond to antibiotics but regress quickly when treated with corticosteroids, but relapses occur frequently.\" [PMID:22526827]"}

name: Localized area of pendulous skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A confined region of lax skin that hangs below the level of the surrounding skin. Histopatholigically, there is a loss of elastic fibers in the dermis of the affected region.\" []"}

name: Abnormal total CD4+ T cell number
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase or decrease of absolute number of helper CD3+CD4+ T cells (either count per volume or percentage of total lymphocytes), compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.\" []"}

name: Arousal parasomnia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An altered state of arousal during sleep that may be reported by the individual or an observation of others.\" [PMID:22965264]"}

name: Marcus Gunn jaw winking synkinesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Unilateral ptosis with associated upper eyelid contraction and contraction of either the external or the internal pterygoid muscle. It is thought to occur because of congenital miswiring of a branch of the fifth cranial nerve into the branch of the third cranial nerve supplying the levator muscle. In Marcus Gunn jaw winking synkinesis, elevation and even retraction of the affected eyelid is triggered by chewing, suction, lateral mandible movement, smiling, sternocleidomastoid contraction, protruding tongue, Valsalva maneuver and even by breathing.\" [PMID:23345532, PMID:25754805]"}

name: Sleep talking

name: Hypnic jerks

name: Bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bilateral tonic-clonic seizure with generalized onset is a type of bilateral tonic-clonic seizure characterized by generalized onset; these seizures rapidly engage networks in both hemispheres at the start of the seizure.\" [PMID:20196795, PMID:28276060, PMID:28276064, PMID:6790275]"}

name: Subtentorial periventricular white matter hyperdensity

name: Posterolateral diaphragmatic hernia

name: Morgagni diaphragmatic hernia

name: Central diaphragmatic hernia

name: Increased total iron binding capacity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity.\" [PMID:3542299]"}

name: Inclusion body fibromatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign tumor made up of mostly myofibroblasts that appears almost exclusively on the digits of the hands and feet, rarely involving the thumb or big toe. The lesion displays a proliferation of bland intradermal spindle cells arranged in whorls, fascicles, or a storiform pattern in a collagenous background of varying degrees. Also usually present are perpendicular tumor cell fascicles that extend to the epidermis. The small intracytoplasmic inclusions are said to appear similar to red blood cells. The inclusion bodies have been shown to be made up of densely packed vimentin and actin filaments. The tumor often causes a dome-shaped elevation of the overlying structures, forming a protuberant or polypoid nodule. The overlying epidermis can display a host of changes, including acanthosis, hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, rete ridge flattening, entrapment of adnexal structures, and, rarely, ulceration.\" [NCIT:C3456, PMID:27684985]"}

name: Inflammatory cap polyp

name: Preretinal hemorrhage

name: Flame-shaped retinal hemorrhage

name: Dot-and-blot retinal hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of blood located in the retina's inner nuclear and outer plexiform layers, and having a dot-like or blot-like shape. THe shape results from intraretinal compression, restricting the hemorrhages within a specific location.\" []"}

name: Subretinal hemorrhage

name: Cutaneous cyst

name: Trichilemmal cyst

name: Dermoid cyst

In contrast to epidermal cysts, dermoid cysts tend to contain various adnexal structures such as hair, sebaceous, eccrine or apocrine glands. Dermoid cysts are slowly progressive and can grow to a size of 1 to 4 cm.\" []"}

name: Eruptive vellus hair cyst

name: Comedo

name: Closed comedo

name: Open comedo
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A comedo in which the part of the pore at the surface of the skin is stretched and open, exposing the contents of the comedo, which appear black.\" []"}

name: Geographic tongue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the tongue characterized by loss (atrophy) of filiform papillae of the tongue, leaving areas of erythema (redness), surrounded by a serpiginous, white, hyperkeratotic border. The name geographic tongue refers to an appearance that is said to be similar to a map.\" [PMID:32119353]"}

name: Claustrophobia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal fear of being in a closed or narrow space with no escape is called claustrophobia.\" []"}

name: Ameliorated by

name: Ameliorated by heat

name: Acral

name: Choroidal nevus

name: Exacerbated by head trauma

name: Cubitus varus

name: Combined cystic and ground-glass pattern on pulmonary HRCT

name: Pulmonary pneumatocele

name: Diffuse alveolar hemorrhage
