name: Hypotropia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of manifest strabismus (heterotropia) in which one eye is deviated downwards when both eyes are open.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Hyperphoria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tendency for the visual axis of one eye to be higher than that of the other.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Hypertropia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of strabismus characterized by permanent upward deviation of the visual axis of one eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Hyperdeviation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of strabismus in which the visual axis of one eye is higher than that of the other.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Hypodeviation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of strabismus in which the visual axis of one eye is lower than that of the other.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Cyclodeviation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cyclodeviation is defined as the rotation of an eyeball along the anteroposterior axis and cyclotropia as a misalignment of cyclodeviation between the two eyes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:15731772]"}

name: Abnormal extraocular muscle physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the muscles of the eye.\" []"}

name: Abnormal superior oblique muscle physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the superior oblique muscle, a fusiform muscle that originates in the upper, medial side of the orbit. The superior oblique muscle abducts, depresses and internally rotates the eye, and is the only extraocular muscle innervated by the fourth cranial nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Superior oblique muscle weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased strength of the superior oblique muscle.\" []"}

name: Superior oblique muscle restriction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the superior oblique muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Superior oblique muscle overaction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An ocular motility abnormality characterized by an overacting superior oblique muscle resulting to vertical incomitance of the eyes in lateral gaze. On examination, this is commonly seen as a downshoot of the adducting eye occurring when gaze is directed into the field of action of the inferior oblique muscle, producing a greater downward excursion of the adducted eye than of the abducted eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:11545636]"}

name: Superior oblique muscle underaction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ocular movement of the superior oblique muscle which improves on testing ductions, typically associated with neurogenic palsy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Abnormal inferior oblique muscle physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the inferior oblique muscle, an extraocular muscle that has its origin on the maxillary bone just posterior to the inferior medial orbital rim and lateral to the nasolacrimal canal and that is innervated by the inferior branch of the oculomotor nerve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Inferior oblique muscle restriction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the inferior oblique muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Inferior oblique muscle weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased strength of the inferior oblique muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Inferior oblique muscle overaction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A common ocular motility disorder characterized by vertical incomitance of the eyes in lateral gaze. In primary inferior oblique muscle overaction, an upshoot of the adducting eye occurs when gaze is directed into the field of action of the inferior oblique muscle, producing a greater upward excursion of the adducted eye than of the abducted eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123, PMID:11545636]"}

name: Abnormal inferior rectus muscle physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the inferior rectus muscle, which is innervated by the inferior division of oculomotor nerve and functions in the depression, adduction, and lateral rotation (extortion) of the eye.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Inferior rectus muscle weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased strength of the inferior rectus muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Inferior rectus muscle restriction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mechanical limitation of the range of movement of the inferior rectus muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Abnormal superior rectus muscle physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the superior rectus muscle, an extraocular muscle that is innervated by the superior division of the oculomotor nerve, and whose primary function is the elevation of the globe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Orbital schwannoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A schwannoma (benign, usually encapsulated slow growing tumor composed of Schwann cells) located in the orbit.\" []"}

name: Lid lag on downgaze
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed descent of the upper eyelid on downgaze. Also described by some authors as von Graefe sign.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Abnormal medial rectus muscle physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of the medial rectus muscle, an extraocular muscle that is innervated by the inferior division of the oculomotor nerve and whose sole action is the adduction of the eyeball.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Upper eyelid entropion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An inward turning (inversion) of the margin of the upper eyelid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Cicatricial ectropion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An outward turning (eversion) or rotation of the eyelid margin (i.e., ectropion) caused by shortening or contraction of the anterior or middle lamellae related to scarring.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Anterior blepharitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of blepharitis that affects the eyelid skin, base of the eyelashes, and the eyelash follicles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Posterior blepharitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of blepharitis that affects the meibomian glands and meibomian gland orifices. This abnormality can be associated with a spectrum of appearances ranging from meibomian seborrhoea (foaming meibomian gland secretions) and meibomianitis (inflamed meibomian glands), to chalazia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Epicanthus superciliaris
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of epicanthus in which more extensive epicanthal folds with their origins in the eyebrow cover, pass in front of and lateral to the medial canthus (middle corner of the eye).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Corneal astigmatism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of refractive error related abnormal curvatures on the anterior or posterior surface of the cornea.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0986-4123]"}

name: Focal emotional seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Seizures presenting with an emotion or the appearance of having an emotion as an early prominent feature, such as fear, spontaneous joy or euphoria, laughing (gelastic), or crying, (dacrystic). These emotional seizures may occur with or without objective clinical signs of a seizure evident to the observer.\" [PMID:28276060, PMID:28276062, PMID:28276064]"}

name: Abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abscess is a localized collection of purulent material surrounded by inflammation and granulation.\" [PMID:35125157]"}

name: Sterile abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abscess not caused by infection with pyogenic bacteria. Operationally, a sterile abscess is inferred if investigations of an abscess fail to reveal evidence of pathogenic organisms.\" []"}

name: Abnormal total plasma cell count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are terminally differentiated B cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies.\" []"}

name: Reduced plasma cell count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally low number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies.\" []"}

name: Elevated plasma cell count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally high number of plasma cells in the blood circulation. Plasma cells are the the effector cells dedicated to the production of a high amount of antibodies.\" []"}

name: Decreased effector memory CD4+ T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally decreased proportion of effector memory CD4+ T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells have the phenotype CD3-positive, CD4-positive, CD62L-negative, CCR7-negative, CD127-positive, CD45RA-negative, CD45RO-positive, and CD25-negative.\" [PMID:22343568]"}

name: Increased effector memory CD4+ T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased proportion of effector memory CD4+ T cells compared to the total number of T cells in the blood. These are memory cells that are short-lived cells that migrate to the site of an infection and attempt to eliminate the pathogen. These cells may have a CD3/CD4/CD62L-/CD45RA phenotype.\" [PMID:22343568]"}

name: Increased circulating oleate level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally high concentration of oleic acid (oleate) in the blood circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:18772370]"}

name: Increased circulating octadecanoate level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally high concentration of octadecanoate in the blood circulation. Octadecanoate is a fatty acid anion 18:0 that is the conjugate base of octadecanoic acid (stearic acid).\" []"}

name: Increased circulating myristoleate level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally high concentration of myristoleate in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Anti-myelin-associated glycoprotein antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against myelin-associated glycoprotein (MAG).\" [PMID:16969155]"}

name: Argininosuccinic aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased amount of argininosuccinate in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:30158522]"}

name: Alpha-aminobutyric aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased amount of alpha-aminobutyric acid in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]"}

name: Abnormal ureter morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural abnormality of the ureter. The ureter is the duct by which urine passes from the kidney to the bladder.\" []"}

name: Abnormal ureter physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional abnormality of the ureter. The ureter is the duct by which urine passes from the kidney to the bladder.\" []"}

name: Ureteral polyp
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A growth protruding from the mucous membrane of the ureter. Ureteral polyps can be attached to the ureter by a broad base or a thin stalk.\" [NCIT:C4530]"}

name: Endometritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the inner lining of the uterus (endometrium).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:29960704]"}

name: Vasospasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Narrowing of an artery due to constriction of the blood vessels.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:20557770]"}

name: Elevated urinary N-butyrylglycine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased level of N-butyrylglycine in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049]"}

name: Increased urinary zinc level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally elevated amount of zinc in the urine, typically as assessed by a 24 hour urine collection.\" []"}

name: Abnormal urinary mineral level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal concentration or amount of a mineral in the urine. Medically relevant minerals include calcium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium, chloride, magnesium, iron, zinc, iodine, chromium, copper, fluoride, molybdenum, manganese, and selenium.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating glycolate concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of glycolate in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9969-8610, PMID:2002628]"}

name: Tarlov cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A cerebrospinal fluid-filled nerve root cyst most often localized in the sacral spine.\" [PMID:26435653]"}

name: Fixation-off epileptiform discharges
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fixation off sensitivity (FOS) is characterized by posterior or generalized epileptiform discharges that consistently occur with conditions that eliminate central vision, such as closed eyes, complete darkness, modified Ganzfeld stimulation (using a large white surface without visual cues), and Frenzel lenses. The FOS electroencephalogram (EEG) pattern usually consists of spikes/polyspikes and waves localized in occipital regions (bilateral or unilateral) or generalized discharges. It is usually inhibited by fixation of gaze, observing patterns, or intermittent photic stimulation (e.g., flashing light or patterns used as stimuli during the recording of the EEG).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, PMID:22925838, PMID:24099056]"}

name: Bilateral polymicrogyria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Polymicrogyria that affects all or some of both cerebral hemispheres.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178]"}

name: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of nephrotic syndrome in which complete remission (albumin urine dipstick negative/trace or proteinuria <4mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio <200mg/g (<20 mg/mmol) for 3 consecutive days) is achieved within initial 4 weeks of corticosteroid therapy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]"}

name: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with infrequent relapses
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome in which relapses occur at a frequency of one relapse (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria over 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) within 6 months of initial response, or one to three relapses in any 12-month period.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]"}

name: Steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome with frequent relapses
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome in which relapses occur at a frequency of two or more relapses (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria over 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) within 6 months of initial response or four or more relapses in any 12-month period.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]"}

name: Steroid-dependent nephrotic syndrome
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of nephrotic syndrome in which two consecutive relapses (albumin urine dipstick at least 3+ or proteinuria greater than 40 mg/m2/d or urinary protein to creatinine ratio at least 2000 mg/g for 3 consecutive days) occur during corticosteroid therapy, or within 14 days of ceasing therapy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2234-4248, PMID:29910038]"}

name: Abnormal placental adhesion into the uterine wall
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal placental adhesion is characterized by an anomalous adherence of the placenta to the uterine wall. Based on the degree of adhesion, placental invasion can be classified into accreta, increta, or percreta.\" [PMID:30210239]"}

name: Placenta percreta
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Placenta percreta is a rare form of morbidly adherent placenta with penetration through the myometrium reaching serosa and even adjacent pelvic organs.\" [PMID:30210239]"}

name: Placenta accreta
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally firm adherence of the placenta to the uterine wall.\" [PMID:15145367]"}

name: Placenta increta
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal placental pentration into but not beyond the uterine wall.\" []"}

name: Prenatal double bubble sign
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sonographic detection of a double bubble sign in the upper abdomen is strongly indicative of duodenal obstruction. One bubble represents fetal stomach, and the other is attributed to a dilated proximal part of the duodenum; continuity between both bubbles is required for the sign.\" [PMID:31167209]"}

name: Decreased circulating creatine kinase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The activity of creatine kinase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Chiari type II malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of Chiari malformation that consists of brainstem herniation and a towering cerebellum in addition to the herniated cerebellar tonsils and vermis due to an open distal spinal dysraphism/myelomeningocele.\" [PMID:28613730, PMID:32706613]"}

name: Chiari type III malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of Chiari malformation that involves herniation of the hindbrain (cerebellum with or without the brainstem) into a low occipital or high cervical meningoencephalocele.\" [PMID:28613730]"}

name: Abnormal fetal skeletal morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous structural finding of the fetal skeleton. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other terms from the skeletal hierarchy can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.\" []"}

name: Reduced fetal femur/foot length ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This ratio relates the length of the fetal femur to that of the fetal foot. The ratio is approximately 1 throughout the age range of 14 to 40 weeks of gestation. A substantial reduction in the raio can help differentiate fetuses that have dysplastic limb reduction from those whose limbs are short because of constitutional factors or IUGR. It can reduce the problem of an unknown gestational age and help to distinguish between fetal skeletal dysplasia and intrauterine growth retardation caused by other factors.\" [PMID:2406168, PMID:3292975]"}

name: Moderate to late preterm birth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Birth at 32 to 36 completed weeks of gestation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157]"}

name: Extremely preterm birth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Birth before 28 completed weeks of gestation (up to and including 27 weeks and 6 days of gestation).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157]"}

name: Very preterm birth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Birth before 32 completed weeks of gestation (28 up to but not including 32 weeks).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:27743648]"}

name: Fetal neck anomaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly in the fetal neck region. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.\" []"}

name: Abnormal neck morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the neck region.\" []"}

name: Abnormal neck physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any functional anomaly of the neck region.\" []"}

name: Syntelencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Syntelencephaly is a rare malformation that consists of an abnormal midline connection of the cerebral hemispheres in the posterior frontal and parietal regions, with interhemispheric separation of the basal forebrain, anterior frontal lobes, and occipital regions.\" [PMID:11827888]"}

name: Fetal pericardial effusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal accumulation of fluid in which the heart is partially or completely surrounded by fluid that is seen in all views and the thickness of the fluid as observed by prenatal ultrasound is above age-dependent norms.\" [PMID:16098320, PMID:33781717]"}

name: Fetal skin edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A separation of skin in one or more regions of the body or even along the entire length of body wall (to a degree greater than gestational-age related norms) related to pathologically increased fluid accumulation in the subcutaneous tissue.\" [PMID:23696062]"}

name: Loculated ascites
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of ascites (peritoneal fluid collection) that is divided into loculi (compartments) by septa (fibrous walls). Ascites fluid can become loculated when confined by adhesions, malignancy or infection.\" [PMID:14981382, PMID:28567101]"}

name: Meconium pseudocyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A meconium-containing cyst in the peritoneal space . Meconium pseudocysts form in the presence of meconium peritonitis, which is defined as a sterile peritonitis caused by escape of meconium from the intestinal tract into the general peritoneal cavity during the fetal or perinatal period. When the extruded meconium becomes walled off, it can form a rim-calcified mass representing the meconium pseudocyst.\" [PMID:19293041]"}

name: Premature closure of the ductus arteriosus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A prenatal partial or complete closure of the ductus arteriosus (i.e., prior to delivery).\" [PMID:34304616]"}

name: Fetal pleural effusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fetal pleural effusion is the accumulation of excess fluid in the layers of tissue (pleura) lining the lungs and wall of the chest. It may be primary, also termed hydrothorax, occurring as an isolated finding or it may be secondary, most commonly resulting from non-immune hydrops.\" [PMID:18280793]"}

name: Fetal chylothorax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of chyle (a type of lipid-rich lymph) in the pleural space (the space surrounding the lung) as observed in a fetus.\" [PMID:10472400, PMID:28351595]"}

name: Fetal hydrothorax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of lymphatic fluid in the pleural space. This finding is usually observed by prenatal sonography. Once neonatal feeding is established and the lymphatic fluid contains chyle, transformation to chylothorax may be observed.\" [PMID:25721226]"}

name: Diskitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of an intervertebral disk or disk space.\" [PMID:31082091]"}

name: Compound muscle action potential amplitude facilitation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Compound muscle action potential amplitude (CMAP) facilitation denotes an increase in tendon reflexes, strength, or CMAP amplitude after 10 seconds of maximal voluntary contraction.\" [PMID:25192047]"}

name: Distal clavicular thinning
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally reduced diameter (cross section) of the clavicles that is limited to the distal region.\" []"}

name: Crouch gait
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A gait disturbance that is characterized by excessive ankle dorsiflexion, knee and hip flexion during the stance phase.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6670-9157, PMID:26709688, PMID:28279852]"}

name: Abnormal amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Amyloid beta is a peptide of 36-43 amino acids that is processed from the Amyloid precursor protein. ABeta42, which is 42 amino acids in length, is the longer form.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:27025652]"}

name: Decreased amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:15992827, PMID:31391004]"}

name: Increased amyloid beta 42 peptide CSF concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation above the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226]"}

name: Abnormal amyloid beta 40 peptide CSF concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of amyloid beta 42 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). Amyloid beta is a peptide of 36-43 amino acids that is processed from the Amyloid precursor protein. ABeta40, which is 40 amino acids in length, is the shorter form.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:29420472]"}

name: Increased amyloid beta 40 peptide CSF concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation above the normal concentration of amyloid beta 40 peptide in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:19273758]"}

name: Abnormal amyloid beta peptide CSF concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly in the concentration of a cleaved APP amyloid beta protein fragment in the cerebrospinal fluid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:31391004]"}

name: Extra-abdominal umbilical vein varix
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal dilatation of the extra-abdominal portion of the umbilical vein. An extra-abdominal umbilical varix is difficult to diagnose prenatally as it can appear like a cyst on ultrasound prior to birth.\" [PMID:33099808]"}

name: Fetal intra-abdominal umbilical vein varix
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fetal intra-abdominal umbilical vein varix (FIUVV) is defined by the focal dilatation of the fetal umbilical vein between its entry in the abdomen and its ending in the portal system. The dilatation can be defined using one of the following criteria: a portion of intra-abdominal umbilical vein that is at least 50% wider than the non-dilated portion; a dilatation of 9 mm or more, or a dilatation greater than 2 SD above the mean value for gestational age.\" [PMID:24883288, PMID:28876490]"}

name: Impaired fasting glucose
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impaired fasting glucose (IFG) is indicated by a fasting plasma glucose above normal but below the diabetic range. Levels between 110 mg/dl (6.1 mmol/l) to 125 mg/dl (6.9 mmol/l) are diagnostic of IFG.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7505-5418, PMID:17327355, PMID:29763085]"}

name: Atelencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A defect of development of the brain characterized by absence of the telencephalon (embryonic structure from which the mature cerebrum develops).\" [PMID:26260203]"}

name: Pituitary macroadenoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pituitary gland adenoma that is larger than 10mm.\" [PMID:32119338]"}

name: Pituitary microadenoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pituitary adenoma that is less than 10 mm in diameter.\" [PMID:32119338]"}

name: Mucus plug
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mucus that is abnormally thick in consistency (ie, inspissated) and plugs the airway is known as a mucus plug. Mucus plugs consist of mucins and cells and can partially or completely obstruct one or more airways and cause serious consequences, including atelectasis and recurrent infection.\" []"}

name: Airway casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A replicate of airways from accumulated and condensed mucous and cellular material. These semisolid occlusions take the shape of the airway within they are formed, leading to obstruction of the tracheobronchial tree with consecutive respiratory insufficiency. Based on their principal composition, one can differentiate fibrin casts and mucin casts. Plastic bronchitis is the name of the condition characterized by the formation of airway casts.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:34713989]"}

name: Fibrin casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of airway casts that consist of plasma components and inflammatory cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]"}

name: Mucin casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of airway casts that consist of impacted mucus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]"}

name: Perisylvian FDG hypermetabolism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"18F-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography and computed tomography (FDG-PET/CT) evaluates the glucose metabolism of the brain. FDG uptake is interpreted to represent glycolysis. This term therefore represents an abnormally increased FDG uptake (increased glucose metabolism) in the region of the brain that surrounds the Sylvian fissure.\" [PMID:33452041]"}

name: Anhydramnios
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A complete or near-complete lack of amniotic fluid surrounding a fetus. This finding can be observed sonographically in the third trimesters if the deepest pocket of amniotic fluid is less than or equal to 2 cm.\" [PMID:34230606]"}

name: Distended jugular lymphatic sacs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The jugular lymphatic sacs (JLS) are a physiological and temporary part of fetal lymphatic development. They are formed from small buds of lymphatic endothelial cells arising from the internal jugular veins. By 14 weeks gestation they have developed into lymphatic nodes which drain into the systemic circulation. Visibility of JLS on ultrasound past 14 weeks of gestation implies distension and this may be associated with raised nuchal translucency.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7653-4653, PMID:19248150, PMID:20227670, PMID:23718767]"}

name: Type 1 schizencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of Schizencephaly in which there is a trans-mantle column of abnormal gray matter but no evidence of a CSF-containing cleft on MR imaging.\" [PMID:30027296, PMID:3111205]"}

name: Type 2 schizencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of Schizencephaly in which CSF-containing cleft is present with abutting lining lips of abnormal gray matter that are opposed to each other.\" [PMID:30027296]"}

name: Type 3 schizencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of Schizencephaly in which CSF-containing cleft present with non-abutting lining lips of abnormal gray matter.\" [PMID:30027296]"}

name: Abnormal fetal nasal bone visualization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal appearance or non-visualization (apparent absence) of the nasal bone of a fetus in first trimester sonographic screening. Assessment of the fetal nasal bone is generally performed at 11-14 weeks gestational age.\" [PMID:16813740]"}

name: Absent fetal nasal bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The nasal bone is considered absent when it is not visualized on a midsagittal view of the profile. In the second trimester, a true midsagittal view of the fetal profile is obtained and magnified to fill the majority of the image space. The nasal bone appears as an echogenic linear structure below the skin edge. The optimal angle of insonation is 45 degrees to the longitudinal axis of the fetal nasal bone. If the angle of insonation is 0 or 180 degrees, the nasal bone may appear artificially absent. The presence or absence of the nasal bone may be determined at the time of the 11- to 14-week ultrasound examination and used as part of the risk assessment for aneuploidy.\" [PMID:23324624, PMID:31679594]"}

name: Hypoplastic fetal nasal bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Length of the nasal bone below a predetermined cut-off as seen on antenatal ultrasound using standard imaging techniques.\" []"}

name: Early young adult onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 16 to under 19 years.\" []"}

name: Intermediate young adult onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 19 to under 25 years.\" []"}

name: Late young adult onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of disease at an age of greater than or equal to 25 to under 40 years.\" []"}

name: Convergence-retraction nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Convergence-retraction nystagmus is an irregular, jerky nystagmus in which both eyeballs rhythmically converge and retract into the orbit, particularly on attempting an upward gaze.\" [PMID:27169871]"}

name: Spontaneous chorioamniotic separation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistence separation of the chorionic and amnionic membranes after the 16th week of gestation (not as a result of a procedure such as amniocentesis).\" [PMID:27683622]"}

name: Neurite dystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dystrophic neurites are abnormal neuronal processes characterized microscopically by aberrant sprouting, dystrophic expansion, and accumulation of various cellular organelles and cytoskeletal/signaling proteins.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:30899091]"}

name: Cerebral cortical microinfarct
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An infarct located on the outer layer of the cerebrum that can only be observed microscopically. Cerebral microinfarcts are typically defined as sharply delimited microscopic regions of cellular death or tissue necrosis, sometimes with cavitation (that is, a central fluid-filled cavity). The term microscopic denotes that these lesions are not visible by gross inspection of the brain but seen by light microscopy. The term infarct is most commonly used for ischemia-related tissue loss, and indeed the pathologic appearance of microinfarcts is consistent with that of known ischemic infarctions.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2307-1226, PMID:10867785]"}

name: Abnormal umbilical artery doppler waveform during pregnancy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal waveforms the Doppler sonographic examination of bloodflow in the umbilical artery. vUmbilical arterial Doppler assessment is used in surveillance of fetal health in the third trimester.\" [PMID:12768548]"}

name: Fetal anemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Low hemoglobin/hematocrit in a fetus as evidenced by percutaneous umbilical cord sampling and Doppler ultrasonographic assessment of the peak velocity of systolic blood flow in the middle cerebral artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8593-2186, PMID:30718211]"}

name: Skeletal muscle autophagosome accumulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal accumulation of autophagosomes in skeletal muscle tissue.\" [PMID:20040311]"}

name: Skeletal muscle hyperechogenicity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased echo intensity of muscle tissue on sonography, defined as an increased amount of returning echoes per square area of muscle tissue. On cross-section, normal muscle appears as a relatively anechoic structure with hyperechoic speckles within the tissue representing perimysial septa, giving it a starry night appearance. The boundaries of each muscle are delineated by the presence of hyperechoic fascia. In muscle disorders, one of the hallmark findings is replacement of healthy muscle with fat and fibrosis, manifested by an increase in echogenicity from higher sound transitions in the muscle. This increase in echogenicity is most distinct in conditions that lead to chronic pathology, such as long-standing muscle inflammation, dystrophy, or denervation.\" [PMID:32989482]"}

name: Maternal vascular malperfusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Gross findings of maternal vascular malperfusion include placental hypoplasia, placental infarction, and retroplacental hemorrhage. If information is available, it is preferable to annotate using the HPO terms that corresponding to the specific abnormalities.\" [PMID:30129127]"}

name: Limited horizontal extraocular movement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limited mobility of the eye to move from side to side (horizontally) within its socket.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3302-4610]"}

name: Limited vertical extraocular movement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limited mobility of the eye to move up and down (vertically) within its socket.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3302-4610]"}

name: Cerebral infarct
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A necrotic lesion in the cerebrum resulting from a sudden insufficiency of arterial or venous blood supply due to emboli, thrombi or mechanical factors.\" [PMID:10867785]"}

name: Abnormal fetal skin morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the skin of the fetus or newborn. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.\" []"}

name: Caseous vernix-like desquamation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Vernix caseosa is a physiological, viscous biofilm that is produced by desquamated fetal skin and sebaceous glands covering the fetus at the third trimester in-utero. The substance's gross morphology in post-partum is described by the etymology, as vernix means varnish, and caseosa means cheesy-like matter. This finding refers to an abnormally thick and greasy vernix caseosa-like scale present at birth.\" [PMID:21856041]"}

name: Type 1 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by multiple large cysts or a single dominant cyst.\" [PMID:27070354]"}

name: Type 2 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by multiple evenly spaced cysts (sponge-like appearance).\" [PMID:27070354]"}

name: Type 3 congenital pulmonary airway malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of congenital pulmonary airway malformation that is characterized by a bulky firm mass with an adenomatoid appearance.\" [PMID:27070354]"}

name: Periventricular pseudocyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pseudocysts that lack an epithelial lining, PVPCs are frequently observed in the caudothalamic groove or in the infero-lateral aspect of the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles, but may also be located elsewhere along the periventricular germinal matrix, as in the temporal or occipital horns.\" [PMID:12423480, PMID:32277778]"}

name: Fetal vascular malperfusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term fetal vascular malperfusion (FVM) is used to describe placental pathology that is thought to result from an obstruction in fetal blood flow that could result from a number of conditions (eg, umbilical cord lesions, hypercoagulability, complications of fetal cardiac dysfunction, such as hypoxia, etc.).\" [PMID:27223167]"}

name: Foramen ovale aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Foramen ovale aneurysm (FOA) or atrial septal aneurysm is abnormal redundancy of the atrial septum primum, with bulging of the septum by at least half the width of the atrial chamber, or by at least 10 mm beyond the level of the atrial septum. The abnormal protrusion of the interatrial septum results in decreased left atrial volume. On color Doppler there is reduced left ventricular inflow.\" [PMID:30601441]"}

name: Anti-glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchored high-density lipoprotein binding protein 1 antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchored high-density lipoprotein binding protein 1.\" [PMID:28402248, PMID:32948662, PMID:35185060, PMID:36402671]"}

name: Abnormal social development
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A substantial lag in the achievement of or divergence from typical milestones in social interaction and communication skills. Social-emotional competencies in young children include helping, sharing, comforting, and exhibiting empathy and compliance.\" [PMID:30623038]"}

name: Streak gonad
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of gonadal dysgenesis in which the gonadal tissue is underdeveloped and appears as fibrous, streak-like structures instead of fully formed ovaries or testes.\" []"}

name: Elevated urinary 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:32550677]"}

name: Abnormal third cranial nerve morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the third (oculomotor) cranial nerve.\" []"}

name: Long-bone fracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A partial or complete breakage of a lone bone (e.g., the femur, tibia, fibula, humerus, radius, and ulna).\" []"}

name: Abnormal subthalamic nucleus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the subthalamic nucleus, a small lens-shaped structure located within the diencephalon near the junction with the midbrain. The subthalamic nucleus composes the majority of the subthalamus along with the subthalamic fasciculus, ansa lenticularis, and several other smaller structures.\" [PMID:32644428]"}

name: Ring-enhancing cerebral lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal neuroimaging finding consisting in an area of decreased density surrounded by a bright rim from concentration of the enhancing contrast dye.\" [PMID:28198691]"}

name: Optic nerve mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A swelling or enlargement localized to the optic nerve. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.\" []"}

name: Elevated brain succinate level by MRS
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in the level of succinate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).\" []"}

name: Brainstem lucency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lesion located in the brainstem that appears areas less dense on magnetic resonance imaging or lighter on computed tomography.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine L-xylulose level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of L-xylulose in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine biliverdin level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of biliverdin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine dodecanedioic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of dodecanedioic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Diminished urine glutamine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of glutamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Tongue spasticity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spasticity (velocity-dependent increase in tonic stretch reflexes with increased muscle tone and hyperexcitable tendon reflexes) in the muscles of the tongue.\" []"}

name: Restricted tongue movement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limited ability to move the tongue related to mechanical restrictions such as akyloglossia and not associated with tongue muscle weakness.\" []"}

name: Asymmetric blood pressure between limbs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left limb (arm or leg or both).\" []"}

name: Asymmetric blood pressure between legs
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left legs.\" [PMID:34907753]"}

name: Reduced anterior scleral thickness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the height of the anterior portion of the sclera.\" [PMID:32271887]"}

name: Reduced posterior scleral thickness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the height of the posterior portion of the sclera.\" [PMID:32271887]"}

name: Elevated urinary 2-aminoisobutyric acid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of 2-aminoisobutyric acid in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Reduced beta-hexosaminidase A activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration or activity of beta hexosaminidase A in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Abnormal nail shape
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality affecting the outline (shape) or contour of the nail.\" [PMID:25821724]"}

name: Abnormal nail attachment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the connection of the nail to the nailbed.\" [PMID:25821724]"}

name: Abnormal nail surface
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the surface of the nail.\" [PMID:25821724]"}

name: Characteristic of mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction. This term refers to a property (characteristic) of a mass.\" []"}

name: Mobile lump
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that can be moved or shifted under the skin when pressed or manipulated.\" []"}

name: Immobile lump
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that cannot be moved or shifted under the skin when pressed or manipulated.\" []"}

name: Painless mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that does not elicit pain upon palpation.\" []"}

name: Anti-ganglionic acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against acetylcholine receptors of the ganglionic type.\" [PMID:18474849]"}

name: Positive urine anion gap
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The urine anion gap (UAG), calculated as [(Na+ + K+) - (Cl-)] has been used to roughly estimate whether urine ammonium is increased or decreased in the evaluation of hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis. The more ammonium in the urine, the lower the UAG is, which achieves negative values within a wide range (0 to -200 mEq/L) during hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis. In patients with distal renal tubular acidosis (RTA) of several etiologies, the UAG is positive, despite the prevailing metabolic acidosis, and this is a useful bedside diagnostic index of impaired ammonium excretion.\" [PMID:29311217]"}

name: Nasoethmoidal encephalocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of encephalocele that is characterized by herniation through the foramen cecum into the prenasal space and nasal cavity under the nasal bones and above the nasal septum.\" [PMID:32965839]"}

name: Rubber-like lump
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This modifier is applied to a palpable mass or swelling in the body that has a rubber-like consistency, that is, it is soft and somewhat compressible.\" []"}

name: Abnormal affect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in intensity, frequency, or duration of the verbal or behavioral expression of emotions, feelings, or thoughts.\" [PMID:37925091]"}

name: Disordered formal thought process
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in the dynamic mode, rate, or form of thought processes as recognized from the flow of ideas expressed in speech. Successive thoughts and speech are easily diverted by external stimuli or internal superficial associations. Unable to maintain a constant train of thought and loose themselves in side issues, losing the thread and are unable to recover it. Superficial connections appear to drive the subject matter.\" [PMID:30416391, PMID:31582814]"}

name: Ruminations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent thoughts that have a thematic thread that is typically familiar to the individual and are often willfully brought forth or occur in the context of an anxious preoccupation or worry about a relevant concern which may be out of proportion to the context. Ruminations may be of normal thinking rate and are characterized by a recurring theme that usually has a negative connotation.\" []"}

name: Abnormal lexical patterns
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A persistent abnormality in patterns or meanings of expressed language. Words and phrases are disorganized in relationship to each other and often used incorrectly or inappropriately for the context and background culture of the person.\" []"}

name: Abnormal semantics
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Odd use of words that are out of context and inappropriate for the social situation.\" []"}

name: Idiosyncratic use of words
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Words or phrases and their expression that are used in a manner that is not consistent with the current and accepted meaning for the context and social circumstance. This does not apply to peer or culture driven novel uses of words that are accepted within the given social circles.\" []"}

name: Tangential speech
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Patterns of expressed speech that have many words to describe a feature, but are themselves vague and approximations. The speech does not get to the point, but rather seems to go around and around and is inconcise and difficult to grasp the primary issue or purpose of the communicated words.\" []"}

name: Thought insertion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The experience that thoughts are forced into the conscious awareness by external and foreign entities. The affected individual typically does not recognize the thoughts as coming from themselves and may develop secondary delusional ideas to explain the source of the process.\" []"}

name: Thought broadcasting
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The experience that thoughts are being broadcasted from their head/conscious experience, some report that their thoughts are escaping, while others may believe that their thoughts are being picked up by a nearby receiver only to be further propagated. The person subsequently believes that everyone knows what they are thinking and feels that they have no privacy.\" []"}

name: Thought echo
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The personal experience that thoughts are echoing around them and that they are hearing their own thoughts as they are experiencing them internally.\" []"}

name: Disorder of thought content
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thought content disorders are characterized by abnormal beliefs and convictions (that are to be assessed given the culture and personal background of the affected individual).\" [PMID:36425242]"}

name: Abnormal volitional state
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of internal states of motivation or drive that compromise, or interfere with, the ability of the person to attend to basic personal, social, or vocational activities.\" []"}

name: Abnormal syntax
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistent abnormalities in sentence structure exceeding that of the context and background culture of the person.\" []"}

name: Diagnostic behavioral phenotype
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The Human Phenotype Ontology provides terms to describe specific phenotypic abnormalities rather than disease diagnoses. Nevertheless, it is common for descriptions such as 'Autism' to be used to describe individuals affected with Mendelian forms of neurodevelopmental disease and many other conditions. If possible, we recommend annotation using specific terms in other branchs of the Atypical behavior subontology, but if this is not possible, then terms from this branch may be used.\" []"}

name: Word salad
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Speech that consists of a series of recognizable words that are randomly strung together with no meaningful connection.\" []"}

name: Abnormal preoccupation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Preoccupations refers to being absorbed in any particular thought, activity, or concern that captures the attention of the individual. It may have a positive or negative connotation.\" []"}

name: Intraosseous lipoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraosseous lipomas are rare benign lesions composed of mature fat that reside within the intramedullary canal.\" [PMID:27298943]"}

name: Paraphilia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intense and typically recurring sexual arousal to atypical objects, fantasies, places, or individuals that frequently, but not always, lead to engagement of non-conventional sexual acts. This is a broad class of desires and behaviors that may include innocuous fetish behavior to illegal behaviors involving non-consenting individuals.\" []"}

name: Radiographic modifier
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A characteristic of a lesion on radiography.\" []"}

name: Radiolucent
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a lesion that allows x-rays to penetrate through them and expose the receptor (radiolucency). Soft tissues appear black or dark on the processed radiograph and are called radiolucent.\" []"}

name: Radiodense
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a lesion that attenuates X-rays and appears radiodense (white) on a radiograph.\" []"}

name: Delusion of guilt
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delusional belief of one's personal guilt for an event, real or imagined, and that one caused an outcome that is somehow catastrophic. It is generally impossible or fantastical that this could have happened in the manner believed by the person, that they were somehow responsible for an event despite not be anywhere near where it allegedly occurred.\" []"}

name: Abnormal cognitive process
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal cognitive process can be defined as a deviation from the typical development, structural organization, or functional execution of mental operations that connect informational inputs to behavioral outputs, typically involve at least one of the following processes: perception, memory, learning, emotion, intentionality, self-representation, rationality, and decision-making.\" []"}

name: Abnormal change in sexual drive
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal change in libido (sexual desire), typically accompanied by an altered frequency of sexual activity compared to from a person's previous norm.\" []"}

name: Reduced MHC I cell surface expression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Expression of major histocompatibility complex class I molecules at the cell surface is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Positive urine infectious agent test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any kind of test for an infectious agent in the urine positive (abnormal).\" []"}

name: Positive urine Legionella pneumophila antigen test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Demonstration of an antigen specific to Legionella pneumophila in urine.\" []"}

name: Unilateral sensorineural hearing impairment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of sensorineural hearing impairment that affects one ear.\" [PMID:36630865]"}

name: Wrist instability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Subjective or objective feeling of clunking/clicking in the wrist with movement, wrist giving way or difficulty twisting objects.\" []"}

name: Nail elevation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Elevation of the nail from the nail bed.\" []"}

name: Talipes varus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inversion of the foot, resulting in the outer side of the sole only touching the ground; usually some degree of talipes equinus is associated with it, and often talipes cavus.\" [PMID:22887726]"}

name: Mucocutaneous lesion painful
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to pain that colocalizes with lesions in the skin or mucous membranes.\" []"}

name: Painful lymphadenopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to pain that is localizes to a swollen lymph node.\" []"}

name: Absent circulating T cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of detectable circulating T cells, commonly characterized as CD3+ lymphocytes, in the blood. These may include both TCR alpha/beta and gamma/delta T cells. Usually, less than 50 T cells per microlitre is considered to be an absence.\" [PMID:32569607]"}

name: Decreased natural killer cell degranulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of NK cell degranulation in response to stimulation, commonly measured through surface CD107a expression in response to cocultivation with a murine cell line. Other methods may be used by different laboratories.\" [PMID:32569607]"}

name: Decreased natural killer cell-induced killing of target cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of natural killer (NK) cell cytotoxicity. Assaying NK cytotoxicity involves coculturing NK calls with target cells and measuring the extent of cell death by methods such as luminescence-based (luciferase) assays, biophotonic assays, and flow cytometry-based Cr-release assays.\" [PMID:22258454]"}

name: Generalized scaling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Desquamation (scaling) involving nearly all of the surface of the skin.\" [PMID:24506793]"}

name: Ichthyosis linearis circumflexa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of ichthyosis characterized by migratory, annular and polycyclic erythematous patches with double-edged scales at the periphery of the lesions.\" [PMID:25710899]"}

name: Trichorrhexis invaginata
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of hair shaft dysmorphology in which the proximal part of the hair shaft overlaps the distal part, showing a bamboo-like appearance. This feature is pathognomic for Netherton syndrome, and can be ascertained by light microscopy.\" [PMID:32029302, PMID:34659759]"}

name: Eyebrow scaling skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of the outer layer of the epidermis in the area of the eyebrow in large, scale-like flakes.\" []"}

name: Patchy stratum granulosum of epidermis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The stratum granulosum of the epidermis (granular layer) displays areas of discontinuity.\" [PMID:11123448]"}

name: Absent stratum granulosum of epidermis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The stratum granulosum of the epidermis (granular layer) cannot be observed.\" []"}

name: Hypogranulosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The height (thickness) of the stratum granulosum of the epidermis (granular layer) is below the lower limit of normal but the stratum granulosum is visible.\" [PMID:34611907]"}

name: Psoriasiform acanthosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of epidermal acanthosis characterized by regular elongated rete ridges.\" []"}

name: Intraepidermal microabscess formation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infiltrating neutrophils in the epidermis, mostly into the stratum corneum. Characteristic for psoriasis.\" [PMID:31942132]"}

name: Palmoplantar peeling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Splitting within the the upper lyer (stratum corneum) of the epidermis clinically characterized by shedding of dead cells from the outermost layer of skin.\" []"}

name: Offspring of consanguineous relationship
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The parents of the index patient are related as second cousins or closer.\" []"}

name: Lower eyelid erythema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Redness of the skin of the lower eyelid, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.\" []"}

name: Upper eyelid erythema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Redness of the skin of the upper eyelid, caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin.\" []"}

name: Positive provocative functional shoulder test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal result of a physical test of the shoulder that attempts to provoke pain in order to diagnosis a specific injury.\" [PMID:36277881]"}

name: Decreased neutrophil phagocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of neutrophil phagocytic activity, commonly measured after stimulation with E. coli using flow cytometry.\" [PMID:33679791]"}

name: Decreased neutrophil adhesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of neutrophil adhesion capacity, commonly measured as surface expression of CD18, CD11a or CD11b using flow cytometry.\" [PMID:19037827, PMID:23351991, PMID:25045887]"}

name: Severely decreased neutrophil count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severe decrease in circulating neutrophils, usually characterized as fewer than 500 neutrophils per microlitre.\" []"}

name: Abnormal Th1 T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase or decrease of Th1 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IFNg or surface expression of CXCR3, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies or the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.\" [PMID:10579123]"}

name: Increased Th1 T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase of Th1 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IFNg or surface expression of CXCR3, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies or the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin. name: Decreased Th1 T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of Th1 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IFNg or surface expression of CXCR3, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies or the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.\" [PMID:10579123]"}

name: Abnormal Th17 T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase or decrease of Th17 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IL-17 or surface expression of CCR6, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies, the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin, or staphylococcal enterotoxin B (SEB). Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.\" [PMID:36596896]"}

name: Increased Th17 T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase of Th17 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IL-17 or surface expression of CCR6, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies, the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin, or staphylococcal enterotoxin B (SEB). Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.\" []"}

name: Decreased Th17 T cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of Th17 cells, commonly characterized through the intracellular synthesis of IL-17 or surface expression of CCR6, measured as proportion of total CD3+CD4+ T cells, usually after stimulation. The stimulation is usually unspecific and may include the use of anti-CD3 beads or antibodies, the use of phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) with ionomycin, or staphylococcal enterotoxin B (SEB). Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.\" []"}

name: Decreased PMA/ionomycin-induced T-cell proliferation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of T cell proliferation in response to phorbol-12-myristate-13-acetate (PMA) and ionomycin stimulation. This is commonly measured through intracellular expression of Ki67, decreasing surface expression of carboxyfluorescein diacetate (CFSE), or 3H-thymidine incorporation. Length of incubation and strength of stimulation may vary between laboratories.\" []"}

name: Impaired phytohemagglutinin-induced T lymphocyte transformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Def: A reduced rate of T lymphocyte transformation in response to in vitro stimulation to the mitogen phytohemagglutinin (PHA). Following PHA stimulation, T cells normally undergo morphological and biochemical alterations that reflect the transformation into lymphoblasts. There are several methods for quantifying this effect including measuring the uptake of the radioactive marker 3H-TdR, methyl thiazolyl tetrazolium colorimetric analysis (MTT assay), and morphological examination under the microscope or using a hematology analyzer. Various types of stimulation index compare the amount of proliferation between treated and control cells. An impaired test refers to a result in which the amount of stimulation is subnormal.\" [PMID:36393975]"}

name: Decreased CD8+ T cell degranulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal decrease of CD8-positive T cell degranulation in response to stimulation, commonly measured through surface CD107a expression in response to cocultivation with a murine cell line. Other methods may be used by different laboratories.\" []"}

name: Increased total CD8+ T cell proportion

name: Paranasal sinus neoplasm
