name: Reduced muscle fiber perlecan
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Immunohistochemistry reveals reduced perlecan protein in the muscle biopsy. Perlecan is a basement membrane-specific heparan sulfate proteoglycan core protein (HSPG) also known as heparan sulfate proteoglycan 2 (HSPG2).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal muscle fiber lamin A/C
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal amount of lamin A/C in muscle tissue. The LMNA gene gives rise to at least three splicing isoforms including the two main isoforms, lamin A and lamin C. These are constitutive components of the fibrous nuclear lamina and have different roles, ranging from mechanical nuclear membrane maintenance to gene regulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24843229]"}

name: Reduced muscle fiber lamin A/C
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decreased amount of lamin A/C in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_htrang, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Sacralization of the fifth lumbar vertebra
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly, in which the transverse process of the last lumbar vertebra (L5) fuses to the sacrum on one side or both, or to ilium, or both.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UToronto_bgallinger]"}

name: Abnormal endometrium morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the inner mucous membrane of the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Endometriosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The growth of endometrial tissue outside the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25221341]"}

name: Impaired ristocetin cofactor assay activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin to platelet-poor plasma.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Impaired von Willebrand factor collagen binding activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability of von Willebrand factor (vWF) to bind collagen. Abnormal response to collagen as manifested by reduced or lacking ability of plasma von WIllebrand Factor to bind collagen. An ELISA-based assay is typically used; the test is sensitive to loss of von Willebrand Factor high molecular weight multimers.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller, PMID:18809794]"}

name: Abnormal von Willebrand factor multimer distribution
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deviation from the normal von Willebrand factor multimer pattern.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Absence of large von Willebrand factor multimers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of large von Willebrand Factor multimers on gel electrophoresis.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Abnormal presence of ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of abnormal ultra-large von Willebrand factor multimers.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller, PMID:11756169, PMID:25983111]"}

name: Total absence von Willebrand factor multimers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete absence of all von Willebrand factor multimers.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Absence of intermediate von Willebrand factor multimers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of intermediate von Willebrand Factor multimers on gel electrophoresis.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Enhanced ristocetin cofactor assay activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by increased aggregation of platelets upon addition of low-dose ristocetin to platelet-rich plasma.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Prolonged bleeding following circumcision
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bleeding that persists for a longer than usual time following circumcision.\" []"}

name: Excessive bleeding from superficial cuts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased degree of bleeding following a superficial injury to the surface of the skin.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Excessive bleeding after a venipuncture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal high amount of bleeding following the procedure of taking a blood sample.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Oral cavity bleeding
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Recurrent or excessive bleeding from the mouth.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:cmiller]"}

name: Abnormality of the posterior hairline
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the placement or shape of the hairline (trichion) on the back of the head (neck), that is, the border between skin on the back of the head that has head hair.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal bowel sounds
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the amount or nature of abdominal sounds. Abdominal sounds (bowel sounds) are made by the movement of the intestines as they promote passage of abdominal contents by peristalsis.\" []"}

name: Hyperactive bowel sounds
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased gurgling/rumbling sounds made by the movement of fluid and gas in the intestines.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22767621]"}

name: Lack of bowel sounds
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Complete lack of abdominal sounds as assayed by examination of the abdomen with a stethoscope.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal liver parenchyma morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the liver located predominantly in the hepatocytes as opposed to stromal cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11157536]"}

name: Truncal titubation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tremor of the trunk in an anterior-posterior plane at 3-4 Hz.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Heart murmur
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An extra or unusual sound heard during a heartbeat caused vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cardiogenic shock
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severely decreased cardiac output with evidence of inadequate end-organ perfusion (i.e., tissue hypoxia) in the presence of adequate intravascular volume.\" [PMID:24188221]"}

name: Plasmacytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased number of plasma cells in tissues, exudates, or blood\" []"}

name: Cholangitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the biliary ductal system, affecting the intrahepatic or extrahepatic portions, or both.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21994886]"}

name: Cholangiocarcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cholangiocarcinoma is a primary cancer originating in the biliary epithelium i.e., the cholangiocytes, of the extrahepatic and intrahepatic biliary ducts. It is extremely invasive, develops rapidly, often metastasizes, and has a very poor prognosis. They are slow growing tumors which spread longitudinally along the bile ducts with neural, perineural and subepithelial extension.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18536057, PMID:8268770]"}

name: Gallbladder perforation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rupture of the wall of the gallbladder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22210542]"}

name: Scrotal pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the scrotum.\" []"}

name: Bence Jones Proteinuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of free monoclonal immunoglobulin light chains in the urine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7876381]"}

name: Flank pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the flank.\" []"}

name: Cervical ectropion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cervical ectropion occurs when eversion of the endocervix exposes columnar epithelium to the vaginal milieu\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21270291, PMID:28460993]"}

name: Cervical polyp
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal growth of tissue projecting from a mucous membrane of the endocervix.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21270291]"}

name: Vaginal pruritus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sensation of itching in the vagina.\" []"}

name: Glomerulomegaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally large size of glomeruli.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21115671, PMID:9402101]"}

name: Jaw claudication
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pain in the jaw or ear induced by chewing or otherwise moving the jaw.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12972467]"}

name: Temporal artery tortuosity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of the temporal artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Night sweats
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Occurrence of excessive sweating during sleep.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23136329]"}

name: Antimitochondrial antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against mitochondria.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dilated superficial abdominal veins
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in diameter of the veins located underneath the skin of the abdomen.\" [PMID:5897968]"}

name: Gastric varix
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Extreme dilation of the submucusoal veins in the stomach.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24891929]"}

name: Cystic artery pseudoaneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of a pseudoaneurysm in the artery that supplies the gallbladder and cystic duct with blood. A pseudoaneurysm, also known as a false aneurysm, forms when blood leaks through a breach of the arterial wall but is contained by the adventitia or surrounding perivascular soft tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24394852]"}

name: Perirenal hematoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A collection of clotted blood surrounding the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17963347, PMID:3360039]"}

name: Peripheral amyelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital absence of the myelin sheath on a nerve.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jbeats, PMID:22246888]"}

name: Increased peripheral myelin thickness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Elevated thickness of the myelin sheath of peripheral nerves, in a regular and concentric fashion.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jbeats]"}

name: Myelin tomacula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple sausage-shaped swellings of the myelin sheath (The Latin tomaculum means sausage).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jbeats, PMID:10727485]"}

name: Asymmetric peripheral demyelination
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of myelin from peripheral nerves in a pattern that differs between right and left.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jbaets]"}

name: Abnormality of peripheral nervous system electrophysiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the function of the electrical signals with which peripheral nerve cells communicate with each other or with muscles.\" []"}

name: Abnormality of central nervous system electrophysiology
Abnormal peripheral action potential amplitude
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the magnitude of the action potential along a peripheral nerve, that is, of the rapid rise and fall of the electrical membrane potential of the nerve.\" []"}

name: Oppenheim reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dorsiflexion of the big toe, sometimes accompanied by fanning of the other toes, elicited by stroking along the medial side of the tibia (the normal response would be no movement of the big toe).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UKB_tklockgether]"}

name: Gordon reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dorsal extension of the big toe, sometimes accompanied by fanning of the other toes, elicited by compressing the calf muscles (a normal response is no movement of the big toe).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UKT_rschuele, PMID:18637037]"}

name: Tetraplegia/tetraparesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of strength in all four limbs. Tetraplegia refers to a complete loss of strength, whereas Tetraparesis refers to an incomplete loss of strength.\" []"}

name: Impaired visually enhanced vestibulo-ocular reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The vestibulo-ocular reflex is responsible for the stabilization of the retinal image during movement. The visual vestibular ocular reflex (VVOR) or visual enhanced VOR, maintains ocular stability during head motion by generating compensatory eye movement opposite to head movement, and is a major component of visual vestibular interaction. This feature is an impairment of this reflex, manifested as the combined impairment of the three compensatory eye movement reflexes, namely the vestibulo-ocular reflex (VOR), smooth pursuit (SP) and optokinetic reflex (OKR).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16954982]"}

name: Isometric tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An isometric tremor occurs with muscle contraction against a rigid stationary object (e.g., when making a fist).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21404980]"}

name: Kinetic tremor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tremor that occurs during any voluntary movement. It may include visually or non-visually guided movements. Tremor during target directed movement is called intention tremor.\" []"}

name: Titubation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nodding movement of the head or body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:4821687]"}

name: Tremor by anatomical site
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tremor classified by the affected body part.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Oral motor hypotonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced muscle tone of oral musculature. In infants, this feature may be associated with difficulties in breast feeding, and may affect the latch, jaw motions, tongue placement, lip seal, suck/swallow/breathe pattern and overall feeding behavior.\" []"}

name: Abnormal peripheral nervous system synaptic transmission
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse in the peripheral nervous system.\" []"}

name: Fatigable weakness of bulbar muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of the bulbar muscles (muscles of the mouth and throat responsible for speech and swallowing) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UNCL_mbertoli, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17986328]"}

name: Fatigable weakness of chewing muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of the muscles involved in chewing that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UNCL_tevangelista, PMID:17986328]"}

name: Fatigable weakness of speech muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of the muscles involved in speech that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2324-8001, PMID:17986328]"}

name: Fatigable weakness of swallowing muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of the muscles involved in swallowing that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller, PMID:17986328]"}

name: Fatigable weakness of respiratory muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of the muscles involved in breathing (respiration) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UNCL_mbertoli]"}

name: Fatigable weakness of skeletal muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of skeletal muscle that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" []"}

name: Fatigable weakness of distal limb muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle of distal part of a limb that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller]"}

name: Fatigable weakness of neck muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle in the neck that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller]"}

name: Fatiguable weakness of proximal limb muscles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle of proximal part of a limb that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller]"}

name: Response to drugs acting on neuromuscular transmission
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Specific drugs interfere selectively with the different cellular mechanisms involved in neuromuscular transmission (synthesis, storage, release, action and inactivation of transmitter). The response of a patient to a specific drug can therefore be useful information for the differential diagnosis.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller]"}

name: Favorable response of weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Improvement of muscle strength in response to administration of an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller]"}

name: Unfavorable response of muscle weakness to acetylcholine esterase inhibitors
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of improvement of muscle strength in response to administration of an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller]"}

name: Increased jitter at single fiber EMG
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The variation in the time interval between the two action potentials of the same motor unit is called jitter. This term therefore applies to increased variability in the interval between successive action potentials of the same motor unit, which is measured by electromyography (EMG).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller, PMID:21654930]"}

name: EMG: incremental response of compound muscle action potential to repetitive nerve stimulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A compound muscle action potential (CMAP) is a type of electromyography (EMG). CMAP refers to a group of almost simultaneous action potentials from several muscle fibers in the same area evoked by stimulation of the supplying motor nerve and are recorded as one multipeaked summated action potential. This abnormality refers to an abnormal increase in the amplitude during the course of the investigation.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller, PMID:23970984]"}

name: Paradoxical respiration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Breathing movements in which the chest wall moves in on inspiration and out on expiration, in reverse of the normal movements. It may be seen in children with respiratory distress of any cause, which leads to indrawing of the intercostal spaces during inspiration. Patients with chronic airways obstruction also show indrawing of the lower ribs during inspiration, due to the distorted action of a depressed and flattened diaphragm. Crush injuries of the chest, with fractured ribs and sternum, can lead to a severe degree of paradoxical breathing.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:tevangelista]"}

name: Anti-neuromuscular Junction acetylcholine receptor antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against neuromuscular junction acetylcholine receptors.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UK_rheller]"}

name: Calcium channel antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against voltage-gated calcium channels.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UNCL_mbertoli, PMID:7739683]"}

name: Anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase antibody
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against muscle specific kinase (anti-MuSK Ab).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2324-8001, PMID:22770539, PMID:29321424, PMID:32830177]"}

name: Slow pupillary light response
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced velocity and acceleration in the pupillary light response.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:UNCL_tevangelista, PMID:974056]"}

name: Collectionism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive or pathological tendency to save and collect possessions.\" []"}

name: Emotional dearth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A diminished ability to experience, express, or connect with emotions across both positive and negative valences. This state is often characterized by a pervasive sense of emotional disconnection or detachment, where the individual may report feeling \\\"numb\\\" or lacking emotional responses that were previously present. The reduction can range from mild dampening of emotional responses to a near-total absence of emotional engagement. It is important to consider the individual's baseline emotional competence, as changes in emotional capacity may be more indicative of this phenomenon in those with a previously broad emotional range.\" [PMID:34008477]"}

name: Inappropriate crying
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Uncontrolled episodes of crying occur without any apparent motivating stimuli.\" []"}

name: Inertia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction of goal-directed behaviors linked to the impairment in frontal executive functions (planning of an action for example).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:ICM_PCaroppo]"}

name: Limb apraxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty in performing the correct execution of limbs movements in absence of motor impairment.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:ICM_PCaroppo]"}

name: Punding
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Punding is a stereotypical motor behavior characterized by an intense fascination with repetitive, excessive and non-goal oriented handling, and examining of objects.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:ICM_PCaroppo, PMID:15077237, PMID:25452726]"}

name: Semantic dementia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A progressive loss of the ability to remember the meaning of words, faces and objects.\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:ICM_PCaroppo, PMID:24966676]"}

name: Visual agnosia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The condition is known as visual agnosia, which refers to the inability to recognize objects that are visually presented, even though the individual may have normal visual field, acuity, color vision, brightness discrimination, language, and memory.\" []"}

name: Perseverative thought
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The repetitive production of the same response to different commands.\" []"}

name: Abnormal muscle fiber desmin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal in the expression of desmin in muscle tissue. Desmin is an 53-kDa protein.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Accumulation of muscle fiber desmin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of desmin protein in the muscle biopsy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Abnormal muscle fiber myotilin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal in the expression of myotilin in muscle tissue. Myotilin is a 57kDa cytoskeletal protein.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Accumulation of muscle fiber myotilin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of myotilin protein in the muscle biopsy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Abnormal muscle fiber valosin-containing protein
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from normal in the expression of valosin-containing protein in muscle tissue. Valosin-containing protein is an ubiquitously expressed multifunctional 100-kD protein that is a member of the AAA+ (ATPase associated with various activities) protein family.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Accumulation of muscle fiber valosin-containing protein
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Immunohistochemistry shows accumulation of valosin-containing protein in the muscle biopsy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Central core regions in muscle fibers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of disorganized areas called cores in the center of muscle fibers. There is a typical appearance of the biopsy on light microscopy, where the muscle cells have cores that are devoid of mitochondria and specific enzymes. Cores are typically well demarcated and centrally located, but may occasionally be multiple and of eccentric.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540, PMID:17504518]"}

name: Glycogen accumulation in muscle fiber lysosomes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased amount of glycogen in muscle tissue found specifically in lysosomes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Increased sarcoplasmic glycogen
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Elevated glycogen content in the sarcoplasm (cytoplasm) of muscle fibers.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Bethlem sign
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limitation of wrist and finger extension on asking patient to form a prayer sign. This is a result of progressive wrist and finger flexion contractures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Highly elevated creatine kinase
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased CPK level between 4X and 50X above the upper normal level.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Extremely elevated creatine kinase
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased creatine kinase level more than 50X above the upper normal level.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7941-2961, https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Abnormality of muscle size
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormalities of the overall muscle bulk based on clinical observation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9046-3540]"}

name: Hand muscle weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced strength of the musculature of the hand.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypoplasia of the upper arm musculature
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Underdevelopment of the musculature of the upper arm, which may include the deltoid, the triceps, the biceps, and the brachioradialis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Portal vein thrombosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thrombosis of the portal vein and/or its tributaries, which include the splenic vein and the superior and inferior mesenteric veins.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21960890]"}

name: Hepatic vein thrombosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An obstruction in the veins of the liver caused by a blood clot (thrombosis).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Maternal fever in pregnancy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The occurrence of an elevated body temperature of the mother during pregnancy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24567014]"}

name: Intrapartum fever
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The occurrence of maternal fever during labor.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11430951, PMID:8135133]"}

name: Maternal first trimester fever
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The occurrence of fever in a mother during the first trimester of pregnancy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24917213]"}

name: Splanchnic vein thrombosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term splanchnic vein thrombosis encompasses Budd-Chiari syndrome (hepatic vein thrombosis), extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO), and mesenteric vein thrombosis; the word splanchnic is used to refer to the visceral organs (of the abdominal cavity).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:20532730]"}

name: Mesenteric venous thrombosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A clot that obstructs blood flow in a mesenteric vein (the superior and the inferior mesenteric vein drain blood from the small and large intestine).\" []"}

name: Enanthema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sudden eruption (rash) of the surface of a mucous membrane of the mouth or pharynx.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Pulmonary granulomatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple granulomata (small nodular inflammatory lesions containing grouped mononuclear phagocytes) in the lung.\" []"}

name: Absent circulating B cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absence of detectable circulating B cells, commonly characterized as CD19+ or CD20+ lymphocytes, in the blood. Usually, less than 20 cells per microlitre is considered to be an absence.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32569607]"}

name: Nail bed hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Small areas of bleeding (hemorrhage) under the fingernail or toenail.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Large intestinal polyposis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple polyps in the large intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Small intestinal polyposis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of multiple polyps in the small intestine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Freckled genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"One or more brown punctate macules on the skin of the genitalia.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202]"}

name: Hypopigmented genitalia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Localized or generalized decreased genital pigmentation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:23650202]"}

name: Microphallus

name: Osteochondroma

name: Merkel cell skin cancer

extra_json: {"definition": "\"Left ventricular noncompaction (LVNC) is defined by 3 markers: prominent left ventricular (LV) trabeculae, deep intertrabecular recesses, and the thin compacted layer.\" [PMID:16670098, PMID:25443708]"}

name: Recurrent bacterial vaginosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repeated symptomatic episodes of inflammation of the vagina that can result from a spectrum of conditions that cause vaginal and sometimes vulvar symptoms, such as itching, burning, irritation, odor, and vaginal discharge.\" []"}

name: Abnormal adiponectin level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue, and that plays a crucial role in the regulation of insulin sensitivity and glucose metabolism.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26221520]"}

name: Decreased adiponectin level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased adiponectin level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevated circulating concentration of adiponectin, a 30-kDa complement C1-related protein that is the most abundant secreted protein expressed in adipose tissue.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating glucagon concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased glucagon level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevated concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased glucagon level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced concentration of glucagon in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Gingival cleft
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fissure in the gingiva (gums), i.e., the mucosal tissue that lies over the mandible and maxilla.\" []"}

name: Divergence nystagmus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which both eyes beat outward simultaneously.\" []"}

name: Brain neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from or metastasizes to the brain.\" []"}

name: Supratentorial neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign or malignant neoplasm that occurs within the intracranial cavity above the tentorium cerebelli.\" []"}

name: Ranula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A ranula is a mucocele that occurs in the floor of the mouth and usually involve the major salivary glands. Specifically, the ranula originates in the body of the sublingual gland, in the ducts of the sublingual gland, in the Wharton's duct of the submandibular gland or infrequently from the minor salivary glands at this location.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:23291329]"}

name: Myeloschisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The severe form of a neural tube defect where the open neural tube appears as a flattened, plate-like mass of nervous tissue with no overlying membrane.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:20885122]"}

name: Myelocystocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Myelocystocele is characterized by a large, ependyma-lined, cystic dilation of the caudal end of the central canal of the spinal cord; it projects dorsally through a lamina defect, with overlying varying amounts of lipomatous subcutaneous tissue. Myelocystoceles are associated with a tethered cord and meningocele, which communicates with the spinal subarachnoid space, but not with the central canal cyst.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:9514174]"}

name: Lipomeningocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of closed neural tube defect in which the spinal tissue lies within the spinal cord having a junction between the spinal cord and the lipoma. Intact skin covers the defect. Neurologic findings first appear during the second year of life.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Hydrocolpos
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Distention of the vagina caused by accumulation of fluid due to congenital vaginal obstruction.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Uterine synechiae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Adhesions or scar tissue that form inside the cavity of the uterus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformation is a choroidal type of arteriovenous malformation that develops between 6 and 11 weeks of gestation. It results from 1 or more arteriovenous fistulas shunting blood toward the prosencephalic vein of Markowski, the embryonic precursor of the vein of Galen. This abnormal shunt leads to progressive dilation of the vein and prevents its involution and subsequent development into the vein of Galen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:32706613, PMID:33168212]"}

name: Subchorionic thrombohematoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A large maternal clot that separates the chorionic plate from the villous chorion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:11125254]"}

name: Bronchial atresia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly characterized by focal obliteration of the proximal segment of a bronchus. The bronchial pattern is entirely normal distal to the site of stenosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Acrania
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial or complete absence of the flat bones of the cranial vault. The condition is frequently, though not always, associated with anencephaly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Meconium peritonitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Peritonitis caused by intrauterine intestinal rupture and spillage of fetal meconium into the fetal peritoneal cavity. Intra-peritoneal meconium usually calcifies, sometimes within 24 hours. Ultrasound findings may include intraabdominal calcifications.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:3317498]"}

name: Right atrial enlargement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in size of the right atrium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Unguarded tricuspid valve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of agenesis of the tricuspid valve in which (although the normal orifice between the right atrium and right ventricle exists) there is no tricuspid valvular tissue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:14246338]"}

name: Subchorionic septal cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cyst on the surface of the placenta consisting of amnion and chorion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Ectopic liver
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ectopic liver is a rare developmental anomaly in which liver tissue is situated outside the liver. Thus, ectopic liver refers to autonomous islands of normal liver parenchyma located outside the liver. The term ectopic liver is also used, to include liver appendices attached to the native liver by a thin stalk although being fully separated from the latter.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11988792, PMID:637502]"}

name: Congenital megalourethra
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dilation and elongation of the penile urethra associated with absence or hypoplasia of the corpora spongiosa and cavernosa.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:20981865]"}

name: Central nervous system cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fluid-filled sac (cyst) located within the central nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:11593239, PMID:24455569]"}

name: Neurenteric cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The neurenteric cyst is a rare lesion composed of heterotopic endodermal tissue. During the third week of human embryogenesis, the neurenteric canal unites the yolk sac and the amniotic cavity as it traverses the primitive notochordal plate. Persistence of the normally transient neurenteric canal prevents appropriate separation of endoderm and notochord. This results in a variable degree of communication between neural and enteric epithelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:20890417]"}

name: Spinal neurenteric cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A neurenteric cyst located in the spine.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Intracranial neurenteric cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A neurenteric cyst located within the skull.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Meromelia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial absence of a free limb (excluding girdle). It can refer to the proximal, middle or distal segment of the upper or lower limb. The deficiency may be transverse or longitudinal. Thus, meromelia is a lack of a part, but not all, of one or more limbs with the presence of a hand or foot.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Frontoethmoidal meningocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull at the junction of the frontal and ethmoidal bones.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Parietal meningocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A herniation of meninges through a congenital bone defect in the skull in the parietal region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Carcinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A malignant tumor arising from epithelial cells. Carcinomas that arise from glandular epithelium are called adenocarcinomas, those that arise from squamous epithelium are called squamous cell carcinomas, and those that arise from transitional epithelium are called transitional cell carcinomas (NCI Thesaurus).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dysplastic tricuspid valve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital malformation of the tricuspid valve characterized by leaflet deformation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:2007717, PMID:26059011]"}

name: Vesicoallantoic abdominal wall defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abdominal wall defected related to a developmental anomaly of the allantois, which is an embryonic structure that develops as a diverticulum off the yolk sac at about 16 days post fertilization. During further development, the allantois becomes incorporated into the body of the embryo, connecting the ventral aspect of the urogenital sinus (which will develop into the upper pole of the urinary bladder) to the external portion of the umbilicus. Upon further development, the lumen of the allantois becomes obliterated and forms a thick fibrous cord called the urachus, which connects the apex of the bladder to the umbilicus. In adults, the urachus is known as the median umbilical ligament. Failure of the allantoic cavity to obliterate can result of one of four conditions: 1) congenital patent urachus (a completely open connection between bladder and umbilicus); 2) vesicourachal diverticulum (a diverticulum off the bladder but not communicating with the umbilicus); umbilical cyst and sinus (not communicating with the bladder); and 4) alternating urachal sinus. An abdominal wall defect can be associated with a urachal cyst.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:2521673]"}

name: Ureterovesical junction obstruction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blockage at the level of the bladder and the ureter caused by stenosis of the ureteral valves or failure of a narrow juxtavesical ureteral segment to dilate due to segmented fibrosis or localized absence of muscle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Sacrococcygeal teratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A teratoma arising in the sacro-coccygeal region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Altman type I sacrococcygeal teratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external and projects from the sacrococcygeal region and presents with distortion of the buttocks.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Altman type II sacrococcygeal teratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly external but has a large intrapelvic component.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of sacrococcygeal teratoma that is predominantly intrapelvic with a small external, buttock mass.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anomalous muscle bundle of the right ventricle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An accessory (not normally present) muscle bundle in the right ventricle which obstructs the right ventricular outflow tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Mediastinal teratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A teratoma located within the mediastinum (the cavity between the pleural sacs that contains the heart and all of the thoracic viscera except the lungs).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Glial remnants posterior to lens
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This anomaly, also known as Mittendorf dot, is a benign, nonprogressive recognizable lesion that does not cause visual impairment. However, it can resemble a pathological congenital or acquired cataract lesion which may enlarge and cause visual impairment. The dot appears as a black speck that ranges in size from the dot made by a sharp pencil point to the size of a poppy seed. It is usually well defined, although occasionally there may be irregular, fine lines radiating outward from the dot.\" []"}

name: Glial remnants anterior to the optic disc
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Persistence of a posterior remnant of the hyaloid artery located at the optic disc.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hyaloid vascular remnant and retrolental mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of persistence of the hyaloid vascular system associated with a retrolental mass that may lead to fetal cataract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Dilatation of the ductus arteriosus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ductus arteriosus aneurysm (DAA) is a saccular dilatation of the ductus arteriosus. DAA can be either congenital or acquired (e.g. as a complication of surgical closure of a patent ductus arteriosus). Although the majority of patients with congenital DAA are asymptomatic and have a benign course, severe complications, such as rupture or thromboembolism, can occur. DAA is likely to emerge in the third trimester from the aortic junction of the DA, extending towards its pulmonary end.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:10898444, PMID:11788230, PMID:27433265, PMID:29656824]"}

name: Intraventricular hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bleeding into the ventricles of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a premature infant.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Grade I preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that is restricted to subependymal region/germline matrix which is seen in the caudothalamic groove.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25371784]"}

name: Grade II preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that has extension into normal-sized ventricles and typically fills less than 50% of the volume of the ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Grade III preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that has extension into dilated ventricles.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Grade IV preterm intraventricular hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraventricular hemorrhage that occurs in a preterm infant and that shows parenchymal extension.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Dacryocystocele
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nasolacrimal duct obstruction presenting as a grey-blue cystic swelling just below the medial canthus. Believed to be a result of concomitant upper obstruction of the Rosenmuller valve and lower obstruction of the Hasner valve.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:19205594]"}

name: Intrauterine fetal demise of one twin after midgestation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of one twin occurring after midgestation (17 weeks gestation).\" [HPO_CONTRIBUTOR:jdavis, PMID:10732306, PMID:2187353, PMID:24361180, PMID:2704493, PMID:9699754]"}

name: Allantoic cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A swelling formed at the base of umbilicus associated with a patent urachus which results from an allantoic remnant. The urachus is a fibrous remnant of the allantois which communicates from the apex of the urinary bladder to the umbilicus. Failed obliteration of the urachus can lead to various abnormalities: urachal cyst, urachal diverticulum, sinus or patent urachus - the most common type. Allantoic cysts in infants with patent urachus can be formed due to the drainage of urine into the umbilical cord, or in uncommon situations, after leakage of hypo-osmotic urine into the Wharton's jelly.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:24950576, PMID:26213613]"}

name: Craniofacial teratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A teratoma located in the craniofacial region.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Erythrodontia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reddish, brown opalescent discoloration of teeth in normal light.\" [PMID:21731282]"}

name: Tooth abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pocket of pus located within a region of a tooth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Periapical tooth abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tooth abscess that occurs at the tip of the root (apex) of a tooth.\" []"}

name: Adipocyte hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in mean adipocyte cell size. This feature can be measured by determining the average cell diameter of adipocytes microscopically using abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue obtained by biopsy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25148116]"}

name: Renal fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Renal fibrosis is the consequence of an excessive accumulation of extracellular matrix that occurs in virtually every type of chronic kidney disease.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16408108]"}

name: Mesangiolysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial or complete dissolution of the mesangial matrix, identified by reduced staining on a periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) or silver stain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32866505, PMID:6353041]"}

name: Amniotic Sheet
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sheet like projection that can result from uterine synechiae that has been encompassed by the expanding chorion and amnion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Ochronosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Brown or blue-gray discoloration of the skin that can present on the axillary and inguinal areas, face, palms or soles. In addition, blue-black discoloration can be apparent on skin overlying cartilage in which the pigment is deposited, such as the ears. This is a characteristic manifestation of alkaptonuria, which is an autosomal recessively inherited deficiency of homogentisic acid oxidase that results in accumulation of homogentisic acid in collagenous structures. The sclerae are also typically involved.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24447956, PMID:26929770]"}

name: Sleep terror
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Autonomic arousal, screaming, sweating, crying, outbursts during sleep, usually no recollection at the individual level; typically observed by others.\" [PMID:31612833]"}

name: Ear pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pain in the ear can be a consequence of otologic disease (primary or otogenic otalgia), or can arise from pathologic processes and structures other than the ear (secondary or referred otalgia).\" [PMID:20736106]"}

name: Epignathus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Epignathus is a teratoma originating from the upper jaw, usually connected with the sphenoid bone or hard palate.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:19240824]"}

name: Exencephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A malformation of the neural tube with a large amount of protruding brain tissue and absence of calvarium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:21887200]"}

name: Craniorachischisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A neural tube defect in which both the brain and spinal cord remain open to varying degrees.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:22095531]"}

name: Mallet finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mallet finger refers to a condition in which the end joint of a finger bends but will not straighten by itself. In this situation, the joint can be pushed straight but will not hold that position on its own.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9353-549, PMID:24839413]"}

name: Proximal femoral focal deficiency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Proximal femoral focal deficiency is a deformity manifested by hypoplasia of a variable portion of the femur with shortening of the entire limb.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:21438051, PMID:23915863]"}

name: Internuclear ophthalmoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of conjugate lateral gaze in which the affected eye shows impairment of adduction. The pathognomonic clinical sign of internuclear ophthalmoplegia is an impaired adduction while testing horizontal saccades on the side of the lesion in the ipsilateral medial longitudinal fascicule.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:1344079, PMID:21687160, PMID:25145891]"}

name: Mitochondrial swelling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The mitochondrial matrix refers to the substance occupying the space enclosed by the inner membrane of a mitochondrion, which contains enzymes, DNA, granules, and inclusions of protein crystals, glycogen, and lipid. Mitochondrial swelling refers to an increase in size of the mitochondrial matrix. This phenomenon is thought to be related to a permeabilized inner membrane that originates a large swelling in the mitochondrial matrix. Mitochondrial swelling may distend the outer membrane until it ruptures.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22907871]"}

name: Modic type vertebral endplate changes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate according to a widely used classification published by Dr. Michael Modic.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]"}

name: Modic type I vertebral endplate changes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a low signal on T1-weighted sequences and high signal on T2-weighted sequences. Modic type I changes are thought to represent bone marrow edema and inflammation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]"}

name: Modic type II vertebral endplate changes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a high signal on T1-weighted sequences and high- or isointense signal on T2 sequences. Modic type II signals are thought to indicate fatty replacement in the bone marrow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]"}

name: Modic type III vertebral endplate changes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal magnetic resonance tomography signal from a vertebral endplate with a low signal on T1 and T2-weighted sequences. Modic type III signals are thought to correspond to subchondral sclerosis seen on plain radiographs.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24162519]"}

name: Ethmocephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ethmocephaly is the rarest form of holoprosencephaly, which occurs due to an incomplete cleavage of the forebrain. Clinically, the disease presents with a proboscis, hypotelorism, microphthalmos and malformed ears.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:23248551]"}

name: Abnormality of the protein C anticoagulant pathway
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the protein C anticoagulant pathway, which serves as a major system for controlling thrombosis, limiting inflammatory responses, and potentially decreasing endothelial cell apoptosis in response to inflammatory cytokines and ischemia. A natural anticoagulant system denoted the protein C pathway exerts its anticoagulant effect by regulating the activity of FVIIIa and FVa. The vitamin K-dependent protein C is the key component of the pathway. Activated protein C (APC) cleaves and inhibits coagulation cofactors FVIIIa and FVa, which result in downregulation of the activity of the coagulation system. The endothelial protein C receptor stimulates the T-TM-mediated activation of protein C on the endothelial cell surface. The two cofactors, protein S and the intact form of FV, enhance the anticoagulant activity of APC.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12970121, PMID:15943976]"}

name: Increased circulating free fatty acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A higher than normal levels of the fatty acids which can occur in plasma as a result of lipolysis in adipose tissue or when plasma triacyglycerols are taken into tissues.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Increased circulating interleukin 6 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of interleukin-6 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:9883970]"}

name: Anomic aphasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An inability to name people and objects that are correctly perceived. The individual is able to describe the object in question, but cannot provide the name.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:18348092]"}

name: Mediastinal cystic lymphangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lymphangioma (congenital malformation consisting of focal proliferations of well-differentiated lymphatic tissue in multi cystic or sponge like structures) located within the mediastinum, i.e., the central compartment of the thoracic cavity that is surrounded by loose connective tissue. Mediastinal lymphangioma is a slow growing mass with benign features, and accounts for 1% of all mediastinal tumors.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:25821300]"}

name: Cerumen abnormality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the cerumen (ear wax), the yellowish waxy substance secreted in the ear canal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Impacted cerumen
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blockage of the external auditory canal by a buildup of earwax.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:15256605]"}

name: Abnormal cerumen color
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous earwax color. Earwax (cerumen) is usually light to dark brown or orange in color.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal jaw morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the jaw, the bony structure of the mouth that consists of the mandible and the maxilla.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Jaw neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tumor originating in the jaw (mandible or maxilla).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Jaw swelling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal enlargement in the upper jaw (maxilla) or in the lower jaw (mandible).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal circulating C-peptide concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of C-peptide in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating C-peptide concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of C-peptide in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating C-peptide concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of C-peptide in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Reduced volume of central subdivision of bed nucleus of stria terminalis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A diminished volume of the central part of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7477289]"}

name: Abnormality of the bed nucleus of stria terminalis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The stria terminalis is a slender, compact fiber bundle that connects the amygdala (amygdaloid body) with the hypothalamus and other basal forebrain regions. The bed nucleus of the stria terminalis is a limbic forebrain structure that receives heavy projections from, among other areas, the basolateral amygdala, and projects in turn to hypothalamic and brainstem target areas that mediate many of the autonomic and behavioral responses to aversive or threatening stimuli. This term refers to an anomaly of the bed nucleus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12600711]"}

name: Scaphocephaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Scaphocephaly is a subtype of dolichocephaly where the anterior and posterior aspects of the cranial vault are pointed (boat-shaped). Scaphocephaly is caused by a precocious fusion of sagittal suture without other associated synostosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16156241, PMID:23960302]"}

name: Abnormal visual accommodation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the process of visual accommodation, which is the process of adjustment of the eye to enable sharp vision of objects at different distances. Accommodation is mediated by contraction of the ciliary muscles, which alter the convexity of the lens and, consequently, its refractive power.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced visual accommodation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decreased ability of the eye to adjust and thereby enable sharp vision of objects at different distances.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Lower eyelid retraction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inferior malposition of the lower eyelid margin without eyelid eversion.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:10946945]"}

name: Trachyonychia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive longitudinal ridging that gives the surface of the nail plate a rough appearance. It results from multiple foci of defective keratinization of the proximal nail matrix.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22016269, PMID:26273150]"}

name: Absent lunula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of the lunula at the base of a nail. The lunula is the crescent-shaped whitish area of the bed of a fingernail or toenail.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Fast-growing nails
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nails whose growth is quicker than normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal nail growth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nail whose growth pattern or speed deviates from normal.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ragged cuticle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The cuticle (properly known as the eponychium, or the medial nail fold or the proximal nail fold), is the thickened layer of skin surrounding fingernails and toenails. Its function is to protect the area between the nail and epidermis from exposure to bacteria. This term refers to the presence of and irregular edge or outline of the cuticle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Tongue pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the tongue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Enlarged tonsils
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in size of the tonsils, small collections of lymphoid tissue facing into the aerodigestive tract on either side of the back part of the throat.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Orange discolored tonsils
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A phenomenon of orange colored oral tonsils. This feature is characteristic of Tangier disease and illustrated will by Figure 1 of PMID:19470903.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:19470903]"}

name: Lipoma of the tongue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lipoma localized to the tongue. May present as a nontender, soft, spherical mass of the tongue.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Gingival recession
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The loss of gum tissue. The result is that gum tissue is recessed and its position on the tooth is lowered, exposing the roots of the teeth.\" []"}

name: Beaked nails
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severe nail curvature, causing the tip of the nail to point downwards with respect to the axis of the finger. Beaked nails are caused by resorption of the distal digit.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Central nail canal
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a depressed line (canal) in the center of the nail.\" []"}

name: Ski jump nail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nails that slope upward at the free edge.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hooded eyelid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hooded lower eyelid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lower eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open.\" []"}

name: Hooded upper eyelid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Upper eyelid partly covered by skin when eyes are open.\" []"}

name: Scleral thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased dimension of the sclera in the anterior-posterior axis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Mizuo phenomenon
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Change in the color of the fundus from red in the dark-adapted state to golden immediately or shortly after the onset of the light. The color of the fundus reflex in the light adapted state has also been described as golden-yellow, gray-white, and yellow-white. This reflex can appear either homogeneous or in streaks in the fundus. The retinal vessels appear to be protruding in contrast to the radiant background. Dark adaptation leads to disappearance of the unusual fundus coloration [Digital Journal of Ophthalmology 2008; Volume 14, Number 14].\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Absent foveal reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Absent reflectivity of the fovea, which normally is a bright pinpoint of light that is observed to move sideways or up and down in response to movement of the opthalmoscope.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:27491360]"}

name: Eyelid fasciculation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tiny, repetitive muscle contractions in the eyelids, causing the appearance of twitching.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Wheezing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A high-pitched whistling sound associated with labored breathing.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:26229557]"}

name: Abnormal breath sound
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous (adventitious) sound produced by the breathing process.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Crackles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Crackles are discontinuous, explosive, and nonmusical adventitious lung sounds normally heard in inspiration and sometimes during expiration. Crackles are usually classified as fine and coarse crackles based on their duration, loudness, pitch, timing in the respiratory cycle, and relationship to coughing and changing body position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:26229557]"}

name: Rhonchi
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal breath sounds characterized by low-pitched, snoring or rattle-like sounds.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:26229557]"}

name: Vitreous strands
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fiber- or rope-like opacities located within the vitreous humor.\" []"}

name: Neck pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the neck.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Shoulder pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the shoulder.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Elbow pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the elbow.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Wrist pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the wrist.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Finger pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the finger.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Hip pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the hip.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Knee pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the knee.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Ankle pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the ankle.\" []"}

name: Toe pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the toe.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754]"}

name: Choking episodes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Incidents in which a piece of food or other objects get stuck in the upper airway and provoke coughing, gagging, inability to talk, and difficulty breathing.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cardiac amyloidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Extracellular deposition in cardiac tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:16186440]"}

name: Heliotrope rash of eyelid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Heliotrope rash is a violaceous discoloration of the eyelids associated with periorbital edema.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12786876, PMID:25587479]"}

name: Abnormal jugular venous pressure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the jugular venous pressure. The internal jugular veins, being continuous with the superior vena cava, provide a visible measure of the degree to which the systemic venous reservoir is filled. The vertical height above the right atrium to which they are distended and above which they are in a collapsed state provides an imperfect reflection of the right atrial pressure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24085809]"}

name: Hepatojugular reflux
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The examiner applies firm but persistent pressure over the liver for 10 seconds while observing the mean jugular venous pressure. Normally there is either no rise or only a transient (i.e., 2 to 3 sec) rise in mean jugular venous pressure. A sustained increase in the mean venous pressure until abdominal compression is released is abnormal and indicates impaired right heart function. This abnormal response is called hepatojugular reflux.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24085809]"}

name: Abnormal pulse pressure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the pulse pressure, which is defined as the systolic pressured minus the diastolic pressure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Low pulse pressure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced amplitude of the pulse pressure (systolic blood pressure minus diastolic blood pressure).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: High pulse pressure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased amplitude of the pulse pressure (systolic blood pressure minus diastolic blood pressure).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Heterotaxy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality in which the internal thoraco-abdominal organs demonstrate abnormal arrangement across the left-right axis of the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:21731561]"}

name: Scleral staphyloma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A staphyloma is a localized defect in the eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22454726]"}

name: Anterior staphyloma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A localized defect in the anterior eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:24600153]"}

name: Posterior staphyloma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A localized defect in the posterior eye wall with protrusion of uveal tissue due to alterations in scleral thickness and structure.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25376120]"}

name: Eye movement-induced pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eye that is worse in certain directions of gaze and during prolonged gaze holding.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12928305]"}

name: Addictive behavior
extra_json: {"definition": "\"When an activity, substance, object, or behavior becomes a major focus of a person's life, excluding other activities, or has begun to harm the individual or others physically, mentally, or socially, it can be considered addictive behavior. A person can become addicted or compulsively engaged with anything.\" []"}

name: Anti-topoisomerase I antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against topoisomerase I.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:16112028, PMID:2428564, PMID:31858335]"}

name: Abnormal CSF amyloid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).\" []"}

name: Decreased CSF amyloid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).\" []"}

name: Elevated CSF amyloid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of amyloid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).\" []"}

name: Nasal flaring
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Widening of the nostrils upon inhalation as a manifestation of respiratory distress.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0003-6754, PMID:25274969]"}

name: Intercostal retractions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pulling inward of the soft tissues between the ribs upon inhalation. This is a sign of increased use of the chest muscles for breathing and is a manifestation of respiratory distress.\" [PMID:25274969]"}

name: Large elbow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increased size of the elbow joint.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Large knee
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased size of the knee joint.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Vertical orbital dystopia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The orbits do not lie on the same horizontal plane, that is, one eye is lower than the other.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:7795293]"}

name: Monorchism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Having only one testis in the scrotum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Anorchism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of XY sexual development characterized by the absence of both testes at birth.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormality of spinal facet joint
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the small joints located between and behind adjacent vertebrae.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Facet joint arthrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Osteoarthritis of facet joints in the spine. Degeneration of cartilage in the facet joints results in bone rubbing on bone and reactive new bone formation visible on X-ray.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal cardiac ventricular function
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the cardiac ventricular function.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667]"}

name: Anti-centromere antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the centromeres or centromere components.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:17444587, PMID:31858335]"}

name: Oxygen desaturation on exertion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Oxygen saturation less than 95% on exertion or arterial partial pressure of oxygen falling by more than 1kPa.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:24121092]"}

name: Abnormality of pulmonary circulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A functional anomaly of that portion of the cardiosvascular system that carries deoxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs and returns oxygenated blood back to the heart.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Reduced FEV1/FVC ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally low FEV1/FVC (FEV1 - forced expiratory volume in 1 second; FVC forced vital capacity).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:22347750, PMID:24695507]"}

name: Abnormality on pulmonary function testing
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly measure by pulmonary function testing, which includes spirometry, measures of diffusing capacity, and plethysmography.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:22347750, PMID:24695507]"}

name: Interlobular septal thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of thickening of the interlobular septa of the lungs as seen on a CT scan.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:23247773]"}

name: Shoulder impingement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Trapping and compression of the rotator cuff tendons during shoulder movements.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Coronary artery aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of the diameter (cross-section) of a coronary artery as defined by a focal dilation of a segment at least 1.5 times larger than the reference vessel.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:28374180]"}

name: Femoroacetabular impingement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Femoroacetabular impingement (FAI) results from one or more bony abnormalities that lead to abnormal contact between the acetabulum and the femoral head or neck. The femoral abnormality is proposed to cause compression and shear stresses in the region between the labrum and cartilage, anterosuperiorly. These stresses cause a separation between the labrum and cartilage as the labrum is pushed outwards and the cartilage is pushed centrally. This eventually leads to articular degeneration and eventually global hip osteoarthritis.\" [PMID:22108232]"}

name: Recurrent parasitic infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to parasitic infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of parasitic infection.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal T cell apoptosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal apoptosis by peripheral blood T cells in an in vitro culture, compared to a healthy control sample. May be either spontaneous, induced by UV, X-ray, FasL or other agens. Commonly measured by surface expression of phosphatidyl serine labelled by Annexin V, but other methods such as staning of cleaved Caspases may be used by different laboratories.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:17562483]"}

name: Increased T cell apoptosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase of apoptosis by peripheral blood T cells in an in vitro culture, compared to a healthy control sample. May be either spontaneous, induced by UV, X-ray, FasL or other agens. Commonly measured by surface expression of phosphatidyl serine labelled by Annexin V, but other methods such as staning of cleaved Caspases may be used by different laboratories.\" []"}

name: C3 nephritic factor positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against C3 convertase (C3bBb).\" []"}

name: Congenital shortened small intestine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Substantially shortened length of the small intestine as a result of a developmental defect.\" [PMID:18209785]"}

name: Hyperintensity of cerebral white matter on MRI
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter.\" [PMID:15576652]"}

name: Periventricular white matter hyperintensities
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the cerebral ventricles.\" [PMID:15576652]"}

name: Deep cerebral white matter hyperintensities
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Areas of brighter than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from locations distant from the ventricular system.\" [PMID:15576652]"}

name: Abnormal response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator
