extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pulmonary vasodilator testing is performed during right-heart catheterization and involves a short-acting vasoactive agent such as adenosine, epoprostenol, or inhaled nitric oxide. The current definition of a normal (positive) response is a drop in mean pulmonary artery pressure of at least 10 mm Hg (or 20 percent) to below 40 mm Hg.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667, PMID:20004088]"}

name: Insufficient response to short acting pulmonary vasodilator
extra_json: {"definition": "\"No fall in mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) falls by at least 10 mmHg to an absolute value less than 40 mmHg without a degradation in cardiac output (CO) in response to a short-acting vasoactive agent such as adenosine, epoprostenol, or inhaled nitric oxide.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4546-6667]"}

name: Abnormal gastrointestinal motility
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the muscular contractions that propel food though the gastrointestinal tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Abnormal gastrointestinal transit time
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal amount of time required for food to pass through the intestines.\" [PMID:22206545]"}

name: Decreased intestinal transit time
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the length of time required for food to pass through the intestines.\" [PMID:22206545]"}

name: Pruritis on abdomen
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the abdomen.\" []"}

name: Pruritis on hand
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the hand.\" []"}

name: Pruritus on foot
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the foot.\" []"}

name: Pruritis on breast
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pruritus is an itch or a sensation that makes a person want to scratch. This term refers to an abnormally increased sensation of itching over the skin of the breast.\" []"}

name: Palmomental reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of primitive reflex characterized by an involuntary contraction of the mentalis muscle of the chin caused by stimulation of the thenar eminence of the palm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12122165, PMID:21250236]"}

name: Grasp reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of primitive reflex that can be elicated when the hand of the examiner is gently inserted into the palm of the patient's hand. The palmar surface is stroked or simply touched. The flexor surfaces of the fingers may be stimulated also by the examiner's fingers. The stimulus should be in a distal direction. With a positive response, the patient grasps the examiner's hand with variable strength and continues to grasp as the examiner's hand is moved. Ability to release the grip voluntarily depends on the activity of the reflex; some patients can do so readily, while others can even be lifted off the bed, since the grasp has such power [NCBI Books:NBK395].\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:12700289]"}

name: Glabellar reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by repetitive tapping on the forehead. Normal subjects usually blink in response to the first several taps, but if blinking persists, the response is abnormal and considered to be a sign of frontal release. Persistent blinking is also known as Myerson's sign.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Snout reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by tapping the upper lip lightly. The contraction of the muscles causes the mouth to resemble a snout.\" [PMID:21250236]"}

name: Suck reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of primitive reflex that is elicited by lightly touching or tapping on the lips with an object such as a tongue blade, reflex hammer, or the examiner's finger. At times the reflex is obtained merely by approaching the lips with an object. A positive suck reflex consists of sucking movements by the lips when they are stroked or touched.\" [PMID:21250236]"}

name: Thunderclap headache
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Severe head pain with sudden onset, reaching its maximum intensity in less than one minute and lasting from one hour to ten days.\" []"}

name: Liver kidney microsome type 1 antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against P450 2D6, a cytochrome P450 mono-oxygenase. Anti-LKM-1 antibodies are considered to be a diagnostic marker of autoimmune hepatitis type 2 (AIH2).\" [PMID:29554146]"}

name: Anti-liver cytosolic antigen type 1 antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against a 60-kd peptide contained in the liver cytosolic fraction.\" [PMID:7806169]"}

name: Exaggerated rugosity of the labia majora
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Marked rugae formation of the skin of the labia majora.\" [PMID:23650202]"}

name: Abnormal peristalsis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the wave-like muscle contractions of the digestive tract.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebellar edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Swelling from fluid accumulation (serous fluid infiltration into the interstitial space) in the cerebellum.\" []"}

name: Oral erythroplakia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A velvety red but not ulcerated lesion of the oral mucosa. The texture may be roughened or normal, and the lesion is neither raised nor depressed.\" []"}

name: Abnormal intestinal smooth muscle morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly of the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue of the intestine.\" []"}

name: Abnormal layering of muscularis propria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal layering of the intestinal muscularis propria into three layers; (1) inner circular; (2) additional oblique; and (3) outer longitudinal layer.\" [PMID:18788889, PMID:26078585]"}

name: Fibrotic muscularis propria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of excessive fibrous connective tissue in the muscularis propria of the intestine. Fibrosis is a reparative or reactive process.\" []"}

name: Enteric intraneuronal nuclear inclusion bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Aggregates of stainable substances (proteins) in the nuclei of enteric neurons.\" []"}

name: Palpebral thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased thickness of the eyelid not related to acute inflammation.\" []"}

name: Conjunctival papillae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Raised tissue masses located on the palpebral conjunctiva with a central vessel. Papillae are created by a focal infiltration of inflammatory cells.\" []"}

name: Conjunctival follicles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Small, dome-shaped nodules without a prominent central vessel located on the conjunctiva. The lymphoid follicles are located in the subendothelial region of the conjunctiva. They consist of a germinal center that contains immature, proliferating lymphocytes, as well as a corona that contains mature lymphocytes and plasma cells.\" []"}

name: Elevated gamma-glutamyltransferase level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues.\" [PMID:26543300]"}

name: Glomerular deposits
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal accumulation of protein in the glomerulus.\" []"}

name: Pulmonary venous hypertension
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal increase in pressure in the pulmonary veins, usually as a result of left atrial hypertension.\" []"}

name: Skeletal muscle fibrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessive formation of fibrous bands of scar tissue in between muscle fibers.\" [PMID:21798099]"}

name: Birdshot choroidal lesions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple cream-yellow colored hypopigmented lesions typically located at the level of the outer choroid. They are between 50 and 1,500 micrometers in size with a characteristic nasal, radial distribution in the postequatorial fundus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9114-8737, PMID:25667738, PMID:33845003]"}

name: Conjunctival hyperemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dilatation of the blood vessels of the conjunctiva leading to a red appearance of the sclera.\" []"}

name: Addictive alcohol use
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An addictive behavior is defined as drinking excessive amounts of alcohol over a prolonged period of time, having difficulty in reducing the amount of alcohol consumed, strongly desiring alcohol, and experiencing withdrawal symptoms when not drinking alcohol.\" []"}

name: Abnormality of cardiovascular system electrophysiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the electrical conduction physiology of the heart.\" []"}

name: Ventricular septal aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bowing (bulging to one side) of the interventricular septum of more than 15 mm on either side in adults and 5 mm in children during normal cardiac motion.\" []"}

name: Membranous ventricular septal aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bowing (bulging out) of the membranous part of the interventricular septum of more than 10-15 mm into the cavity of an adjacent ventricle (usually into the right ventricle).\" [PMID:5846101, PMID:6018320]"}

name: Muscular ventricular septal aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bowing (bulging out) of the muscular part of the interventricular septum of more than 10-15 mm into the cavity of an adjacent ventricle (usually into the right ventricle).\" [PMID:5846101]"}

name: Microspherophakia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Microspherophakia is a rare congenital anomaly characterized by the abnormal spherical shape of the crystalline lens. It is characterized by an increased anteroposterior thickness of the lens associated with reduced equatorial diameter. The primary pathology lies in the development of zonules. The condition is often bilateral and is characterized by small, thick, and spherical lenses.\" [PMID:35015420]"}

name: Abnormal morphology of the great vessels
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A structural anomaly affecting a blood vessel involved in the circulation of the heart, i.e., the superior or inferior vena cava, the pulmonary arteries, the pulmonary veins, and the aorta.\" []"}

name: Aortic stiffness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The elastic properties of the aorta allow the aorta to store half of the cardiac ejected blood volume per beat, whereby aortic recoil during diastole pushes the remaining stored volume forward into the peripheral circulation, a phenomenon known as the Windkessel function. Aortic stiffness occurs as the elastic fibers within the arterial wall become disrupted due to mechanical stress (with age or due to other factors). Aortic stiffness refers to a reduction in the elasticity of the aorta, which is associated with an elevated pulse pressure, increased wave reflection, and often hypertension.\" [PMID:28540066]"}

name: Abnormal pulmonary artery morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the structure of the pulmonary artery.\" []"}

name: Abnormal pulmonary artery physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the function of the pulmonary artery.\" []"}

name: Abnormal pulmonary vein morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the structure of the pulmonary veins.\" []"}

name: Abnormal pulmonary vein physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the function of the pulmonary veins.\" []"}

name: Abnormal vena cava physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the function of the veins that return deoxygenated blood from the body into the heart, i.e., the superior vena cava and the inferior vena cava.\" []"}

name: Abnormal systemic blood pressure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A chronic deviation from normal pressure in the systemic arterial system.\" []"}

name: Postexertional symptom exacerbation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Post-exertional symptom exacerbation (PESE), also referred to as post-exertional malaise (PEM), is defined as the worsening of symptoms that can follow minimal cognitive, physical, emotional, or social activity, or activity that could previously be tolerated. Symptoms typically worsen 12 to 72 hours after activity and can last for days or even weeks, sometimes leading to a relapse.\" [PMID:25695122, PMID:26904705, PMID:32105793, PMID:33071931]"}

name: Cryptozoospermia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of oligozoospermia in which spermatozoa can be detected in an ejaculate only after centrifugation and inspection of the pellet.\" [PMID:25780588]"}

name: Pontine tegmental cap
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal curved or vaulted (capped) structure covering the middle third of the dorsal pontine tegmentum and projecting into the fourth ventricle.\" [PMID:17690130, PMID:18842761, PMID:25691269]"}

name: Abnormal factor VIII activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal activity of coagulation factor VIII. Factor VIII (fVIII) is a cofactor in the intrinsic clotting cascade that is activated to fVIIIa in the presence of minute quantities of thrombin. fVIIIa acts as a receptor, for factors IXa and X.\" []"}

name: Increased factor VIII activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased activity of the coagulation factor VIII. Factor VIII (fVIII) is a cofactor in the intrinsic clotting cascade that is activated to fVIIIa in the presence of minute quantities of thrombin. fVIIIa acts as a receptor, for factors IXa and X.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2826-3879]"}

name: Decreased CSF/serum albumin ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction below normal limits of the ratio of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) albumin concentration to serum albumin concentration.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:27388694]"}

name: Dilatation of large choroidal vessels
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of the large blood vessels in the choroid.\" [PMID:26026923]"}

name: Reduced brain glutamine level by MRS
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An decrease in the level of glutamine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159, PMID:24123328]"}

name: Abnormal CSF/serum albumin ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal range of the ratio of the albumin concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) to the concentration in serum (which may be defined as 3.2-9.0). This is an index of blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity, adjusted for the serum albumin concentration, and an increased ratio is taken as a sign of a loss of integrity of the BBB with leakage of albumin into the CSF.\" [PMID:27388694]"}

name: Ovarian thecoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A sex cord-stromal tumor of the ovary. Thecomas range from small tumors to large solid or solid-cystic masses of up to 15 cm. They are unilateral in over 90 percent of cases and are rarely malignant. Thecomas are stromal tumors made up of cells that resemble theca cells, lutein cells and fibroblasts. They are traditionally classified within the sex cord-stromal tumor category of ovarian tumor types.\" [NCIT:C1882229, PMID:27284435]"}

name: Abnormal serum bile acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal concentration of serum bile acid concentration.\" []"}

name: Decreased serum bile acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the concentration of bile acid in the blood.\" []"}

name: Biliary epithelial hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperplasia of lining epithelia of the septal and large bile ducts manifesting as micropapillary projections or as a stratification of the epithelium with or without dilatation of the duct lumen.\" [PMID:21994886]"}

name: Suppurative cholangitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cholangitis characterized by the presence of numerous polymorphonuclear cells around and within the wall as well as within the lumen of the ducts. This may involve ducts of any size and is occasionally associated with abscess formation (cholangitic abscess).\" [PMID:21994886]"}

name: Granulomatous cholangitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cholangitis characterized by the accumulation of granulomas. Granulomas are aggregates of modified macrophages (epithelioid cells) and other inflammatory cells that accumulate after chronic exposure to antigens. The underlying trigger may be exposure to noxious agents that cannot be biochemically degraded or to immune dysfunction. The ultimate result is a release of a variety cytokines that stimulate mononuclear cells that fuse to form multinucleated giant cells with a surrounding rim of lymphocytes and fibroblasts.\" [PMID:22333006]"}

name: Lymphoid cholangitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cholangitis characterized by a close association between duct branches, usually interlobular bile ducts, and lymphocytic aggregates, which may show a follicular arrangement.\" [PMID:21994886]"}

name: Pleomorphic cholangitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cholangitis associated with mixed inflammatory infiltrates and the presence of fibrosis or sclerosis of the biliary tree.\" []"}

name: Sclerosing cholangitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cholangitis associated with evident ductal fibrosis that develops as a consequence of long-standing bile duct inflammatory, obstruction, or ischemic injury; it can be obliterative or nonobliterative.\" []"}

name: Abnormal pancreatic duct morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the pancreatic duct, which is the tubular structure that collects exocrine pancreatic secretions and transports them to the duodenum.\" [PMID:24265565]"}

name: Duplication of pancreatic duct
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of two separate pancreatic ducts.\" []"}

name: Pancreas divisum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly of the pancreas that results from failed fusion of the dorsal and ventral ducts during embyological development. Three variants have been described: type 1 or classical divisum in which there is total failure of fusion; type 2 in which dorsal drainage is dominant in the absence of the duct of Wirsung; and type 3 or incomplete divisum where a small communicating branch is present.\" [PMID:24265565]"}

name: Megaduodenum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dilation and elongation of the duodenum with hypertrophy of all layers of the duodenum.\" []"}

name: Atretic vas deferens
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal closure or blockage of the vas deferens.\" []"}

name: Cerebrospinal fluid rhinorrhoea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Drainage of cerebrospinal fluid through the nose. This can occur when there is a fistula between the dura and the skull base and discharge of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the nose.\" [PMID:17767107]"}

name: Abnormal vestibular saccule morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the saccule of the vestibule. The saccule is the otolith organ that senses motions in the sagittal plane (i.e., up-down movement).\" []"}

name: Vestibular saccular degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deterioration or loss of the tissues of the saccule of the vestibule.\" []"}

name: Minifascicle formation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A nerve fascicle or fasciculus is a small bundle of axons, enclosed by the perineurium. A minifascule refers to a group of thinly myelinated and unmyelinated axons surrounded by a delicate perineurium, and with a smaller diameter than a normal nerve fascicle.\" []"}

name: Hemiareflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Areflexia that is limited to one side of the body.\" [PMID:6722516]"}

name: Acroparesthesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of paresthesia (tingling, pins-and-needles, burning or numbness or stiffness) that occurs in the hands and feet and particularly in the fingers and toes.\" []"}

name: Orofacial action-specific dystonia induced by speech
Lingual dystonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Involuntary protrusions, movements, spams and contortions of the tongue.\" [PMID:24808861]"}

name: Ainhum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Development of a fibrotic constriction ring involving the base of one or more toes, conditioning eversion and absorption of distal structures, possibly progressing to spontaneous amputation.\" [PMID:26379327]"}

name: Hyperphalangy of the 3rd finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An accessory phalanx of the third (middle) finger that is arranged linearly with the other phalanges. Hyperphalangy results from an accessory ossification center at the metacarpophalangeal joint.\" [PMID:27738187, PMID:30728880]"}

name: Fatty streak
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Yellow-colored streaks, patches, or spots on the intimal surface of arteries. Fatty streaks stain red with Sudan III or Sudan IV.\" [PMID:8181179]"}

name: Thin-cap fibroatheroma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Thin-cap fibroatheroma is characterized by a relatively large necrotic core with an overlying thin fibrous cap measuring less than 65 micrometers and typically containing numerous macrophages, and is considered to be the precursor lesion of plaque rupture which is the most common cause of coronary thrombosis.\" [PMID:27500096]"}

name: Ankylosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction of joint mobility resulting from changes involving the articular surfaces.\" []"}

name: Intrahepatic portal vein sclerosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sclerosis of the intrahepatic portal veins of the liver and generally accompanied by non-cirrhotic portal hypertension, features of which may include splenomegaly and varices.\" [PMID:25796481]"}

name: Alternating radiolucent and radiodense metaphyseal lines
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Areas of radio-opaque sclerotic bands alternating with those of normal lucency give rise to stripes akin to a zebra.\" [PMID:28384951]"}

name: Eccrine syringofibroadenoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Eccrine syringofibroadenoma (ESFA) is a benign adnexal tumor arising most often on the extremities of elderly individuals characterized by anastomosing cords of cuboidal epithelial cells surrounded by a fibrovascular stroma containing plasma cells and ductal structures. ESFA stains positively with epithelial membrane antigen (EMA) and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA).\" [NCIT:CL017969, PMID:26937300]"}

name: Pyknotic bone marrow neutrophils
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nuclear lobes of neutrophils in the bone marrow are thickened and condensed, and individual lobes are connected by unusually long chromatin filaments.\" []"}

name: Bone marrow hypercellularity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A larger than normal amount or percentage of hematopoietic cells relative to marrow fat.\" []"}

name: Squamous Papilloma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign epithelial neoplasm characterized by a papillary growth pattern and a proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells without morphologic evidence of malignancy [NCI thesaurus].\" []"}

name: Oropharyngeal squamous papilloma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign exophytic neoplasm that arises from the oropharynx. It is characterized by the presence of a connective tissue core covered by stratified squamous epithelium [NCI thesaurus].\" []"}

name: Multiple mucosal neuromas
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple painful, dome-shaped, translucent pink to skin-colored papules on oral mucosa. Histologically, the lesions may demonstrate dermal proliferation of well-demarcated nerve bundles associated with abundant mucin and surrounded by a distinct perineural sheath.\" [PMID:16702501]"}

name: Cylindroma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign skin adnexal tumor of eccrine differentiation.\" [NCIT:C27094, PMID:27294061]"}

name: Gastric leiomyosarcoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A malignant neoplasm of the stomach that grows submucosally in the gastric wall. Necrosis and hemorrhage may be visible radiologically. Histologically, spindle cells with abnormal mitotic activity may be visible.\" [NCIT:C27200, PMID:25069607]"}

name: Snail-like ilia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The ilia is round and hypoplastic with a very flat acetabular roof and a very unusual medial projection of bone that is said to resemble the head of a snail. Figure 4 of PMID:3799723 illustrates this feature.\" [PMID:3799723]"}

name: Internal notch of the femoral head
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A small V-shaped indentation on the internal aspect of the femoral head. This feature is well illustrated in Figure 5 of PMID:11694546.\" [PMID:11694546, PMID:24339047]"}

name: Lactescent serum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Serum sample with a grossly white (milk-like, i.e., lactescent) appearance. This feature is indicative of an extremely elevated serum triglyceride level.\" [PMID:15368719]"}

name: Elevated circulating CEA concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of CEA (carcinoembryonic antigen) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating mucin 16 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of mucin-16 (also known as CA-125) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating retinol-binding protein concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of retinol-binding protein in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating retinol-binding protein concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of retinol-binding protein in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Impaired urinary acidification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The kidney contributes towards acid-base homeostasis by excreting H+ ions and retaining bicarbonate. This process is known as acidification of the urine. The pH of urine ranges normally from 4.5 to 8. The inability to reduce the pH of the urine in a situation where it would be otherwise expected is known as an acidification defect.\" [PMID:6876936]"}

name: Abnormal circulating insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein acid labile subunit in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:8816745]"}

name: Chronic infection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of a protracted or persistent infection by a pathogen potentially related to an underlying abnormality of the immune system that is not able to clear the infection.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating GH-binding protein concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of GH-binding protein (= growth hormone-binding protein) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Reduced insulin-like factor 3 level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blood concentration of insulin-like factor 3 (ILF3) is below normal limits.\" [PMID:24640568]"}

name: Spermatogenesis maturation arrest
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Maturation arrest (MA) is defined as germ cells that fail to complete maturation. Uniform MA is characterized by spermatogenic arrest at the same stage of spermatogenesis throughout the seminiferous tubules. MA is subcategorized into early MA, in which only spermatogonia or spermatocytes are found, and late MA, in which spermatids are detected without spermatozoa.\" [PMID:21684558]"}

name: Spermatocyte maturation arrest
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of spermatogenesis maturation arrest in which the block of developmental occurs in the spermatocyte stage. Testicular histology shows seminiferous tubules with Sertoli cells, spermatogonial cells and spermatocytes but no further differentiated cells like round spermatids.\" [PMID:21684558]"}

name: Round spermatid arrest
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A failure of spermatogenesis to progress beyond the round spermatid stage. The round spermatid is the first haploid cells produced during spermatogenesis and normally further develop into mature spermatozoa. This abnormality can be visualized with testicular biopsy and is characterized seminiferous tubules with increased numbers of round spermatids with few or no mature spermatozoa.\" [PMID:21684558, PMID:9510006]"}

name: Obstruction of the superior vena cava
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blockage of blood flow through the superior vena cava (SVC). Because the venous drainage from the upper extremities, upper thorax and head is obstructed, SVC obstruction presents with symptoms related to engorgement of these areas. Both the degree of SVC compromise and the extent of collateral veins determine the varied clinical presentation, which can be as mild as slight facial and upper extremity edema or as dire as intracranial swelling, seizures, hemodynamic instability and tracheal obstruction.\" []"}

name: Strawberry tongue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflamed tongue with hyperplastic (enlarged) fungiform papillae that is said to resemble a strawberry or raspberry.\" [PMID:26222562]"}

name: Type A4 brachydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of brachydactyly characterized by brachymesophalangy affecting mainly the 2nd and 5th digits.\" [PMID:8387724]"}

name: Type A5 brachydactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of brachydactyly characterized by absent middle phalanges of digits 2 to 5.\" [PMID:18554391]"}

name: Acral blistering
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bullae (defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls) of the skin with an acral distribution (affecting peripheral regions such as hands and feet).\" []"}

name: Absent soft palate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect characterized by lack of a soft palate.\" [PMID:11420024]"}

name: Paraproteinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal immunoglobulin or part of an Ig (light chain) in the circulation. Paraproteins are typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.\" [PMID:17403946]"}

name: Light-chain paraproteinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal immunoglobulin light chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.\" []"}

name: Heavy-chain paraproteinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal immunoglobulin heavy chain in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.\" [PMID:12057070]"}

name: Whole-immunoglobulin paraproteinemia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal immunoglobulin (heavy and light chain) in the circulation and typically produced by a clonal population of B-cell derived plasma cells.\" []"}

name: Tarsal sclerosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation in bone density in one or more tarsal bones of the foot. Sclerosis is normally detected on a radiograph as an area of increased opacity.\" []"}

name: Elevated vascular endothelial growth factor level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased blood concentration of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF).\" []"}

name: Coarctation in the transverse aortic arch
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Narrowing or constriction of the aorta localized to the region of the transverse aortic arch.\" []"}

name: Long segment coarctation of the aorta
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Coarctation of the aorta is a narrowing or constriction of a long segment of the arch of the aorta.\" [PMID:23909637]"}

name: Abnormal branching pattern of left aortic arch
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviance from the norm of the origin or course of the right brachiocephalic artery, the left common carotid artery, the left subclavian artery or the proximal vertebral arteries, whereby the aortic arch descends on the left as normal (as opposed to right aortic arch).\" []"}

name: Fusiform cerebral aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A localized circumferential (i.e., bulges on all sides) dilatation or ballooning of a cerebral artery.\" []"}

name: Skin fissure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A clearly-defined and roughly linear cleavage in the skin that usually extends to the dermis.\" []"}

name: Impairment of activities of daily living
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty in performing one or more activities normally performed every day, such as eating, bathing, dressing, grooming, work, homemaking, and leisure.\" []"}

name: Impaired ability to bathe oneself
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This term applies to an individual who requires help to bathe more than one part of the body, get in or out of the tub or shower, or who requires total bathing.\" [PMID:10362969]"}

name: Impaired ability to dress oneself
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This applies to an individual who needs help with dressing or needs to be completely dressed.\" [PMID:10362969]"}

name: Impaired toileting ability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"This term applies to an individual who requires help transferring to the toilet, cleaning self or who uses bedpan or commode.\" []"}

name: Impaired transferring ability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to an individual who needs help in moving from bed to chair or requires a complete transfer.\" [PMID:10362969]"}

name: Impaired feeding ability
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to an individual who needs partial or total help with feeding or requires parenteral feeding.\" []"}

name: Impaired continence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Partial or total incontinence of bowel or bladder.\" []"}

name: Empty ovarian follicle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A failure to collect oocytes after an apparently normal controlled ovarian hyperstimulation cycle for in vitro fertilization.\" [PMID:19562053]"}

name: Abnormal femoral torsion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Femoral torsion, also known as femoral rotation or femoral version, refers to the twist between the proximal and distal parts of the femur on the transverse plane. Femoral anteversion averages between 30-40 degrees at birth, and between 8-14 degrees in adults. This term applies if the amount of femoral torsion deviates from this range.\" []"}

name: Abnormal endocrine morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the structure of an organ ofthe endocrine system.\" []"}

name: Abnormal endocrine physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the function of the endocrine system.\" []"}

name: Abnormal response to endocrine stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous response to a test that is designed to probe the function of the endocrine system.\" []"}

name: Abnormal response to ACTH stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous response to stimulation by administration of the adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH). ACTH stimulation normally stimulates the adrenal glands to release cortisol and adrenaline.\" []"}

name: Abnormal response to insulin tolerance test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous response to the insulin tolerance test (ITT), in which insulin is administered intravenously and blood glucose and potentially other compounds are measured at intervals. Insulin administration is intended to induce extreme hypoglycemia (bloodgluoce below 40 mg/dl), which in turn induces release of adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) and growth hormone (GH). ACTH induces the adrenal gland to release cortisol, which together with GH opposes the action of insulin on the blood glucose level.\" []"}

name: Impaired cortisol response to insulin stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the insulin tolerance test (ITT).\" []"}

name: Abnormal response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous response to the corticotropin releasing hormone (CRH) stimulation test. Normally,CRH is released by the hypothalamus to induce adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) release by the anterior pituitary. In the stimulation test, CRH is administered intravenously and ACTH and cortisol are measured at intervals.\" []"}

name: Impaired cortisol response to corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the corticotropin releasing hormone stimulation test.\" []"}

name: Impaired growth-hormone response to insulin stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of growth hormone levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the insulin tolerance test (ITT).\" []"}

name: Abnormal response to glucagon stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous response to the glucagon stimulation test, which like the insulin tolerance test (ITT) stimulates the release of both adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) and growth hormone (GH).\" []"}

name: Impaired cortisol response to glucagon stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of cortisol levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the glucagon stimulation test.\" []"}

name: Impaired growth-hormone response to glucagon stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of growth hormone levels to respond adequately (by increasing) to the glucagon stimulation test.\" []"}

name: Abnormal response to human chorionic gonadotrophin stimulation test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomalous response to intravenous stimulation by human chorionic gonadotrophin. Stimulation with hCG stimulates testicular Leydig cells to secrete androgens via the Leydig hormone receptors.\" []"}

name: Excessive insulin response to glucagon test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally high increase in insulin levels following a glucagon stimulation test.\" [PMID:21791970]"}

name: Decreased circulating prealbumin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of prealbumin in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Ectopic ovary
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Undescended or ectopic ovaries are characterized by the attachment of the upper pole of the ovary to an area above the level of the common iliac vessels.\" [PMID:12584384]"}

name: Absent pubertal growth spurt
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The abrupt and transient increase in the annual growth rate normally observed in adolescent individuals does not occur.\" []"}

name: Palatal edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Swelling related to fluid accumulation within the palate.\" []"}

name: Finger dactylitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fingers appear swollen and plump owing to inflammation of the complete finger.\" []"}

name: Toe dactylitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Toes appear swollen and plump owing to inflammation of the complete toe.\" []"}

name: Spindle-shaped finger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Swelling of the hand at the knuckles, that gives the fingers a spindle shape (i.e., a round stick with tapered end and a broader base).\" []"}

name: Abnormal breast morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the structure of the breast.\" []"}

name: Abnormal breast physiology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the function of the breast.\" []"}

name: Abnormal humerus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the structure of the humerus (i.e., upper arm bone).\" []"}

name: Delayed vertebral ossification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decrease in the amount of mineralized bone in one or more vertebrae compared with that expected for a given developmental age.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating thyroid-stimulating hormone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal amount of the thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the anterior pituitary gland and stimulates the function of the thyroid gland.\" []"}

name: Decreased thyroid-stimulating hormone level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced amount of the thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which is produced by the anterior pituitary gland and stimulates the function of the thyroid gland.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating inhibin level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of inhibins, which are heterodimeric protein hormones secreted by granulosa cells of the ovary in females and Sertoli cells of the testis in males. Inhibins suppress the secretion of pituitary follicle-stimulating hormone.\" [PMID:12790766]"}

name: Decreased circulating inhibin B concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of inhibin B in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" [PMID:11720872]"}

name: Abnormal circulating antimullerian hormone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal range of the antimullerian hormone, a peptide produced by the granulosa cells of follicles. Anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH), also known as Mullerian inhibiting substance, is produced by the granulosa cells of small antral follicles of the ovary. AMH has an inhibiting role in the ovary, contributing to follicular arrest. AMH levels in women are low until the age of 8, rise rapidly until puberty and decline steadily from the age of 25 until menopause, when AMH production ceases.\" [PMID:22693172]"}

name: Increased circulating antimullerian hormone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation above the normal range of the antimullerian hormone in the circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating antimullerian hormone circulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction below the normal range of the antimullerian hormone in the circulation.\" []"}

name: Insulin receptor antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against the insulin receptor.\" [PMID:3280181]"}

name: Abnormal uterus morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any anomaly of the structure of the uterus\" []"}

name: T-shaped uterus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the uterus characterized by a normal uterine outline but with an abnormal T-shaped uterine cavity with narrowing cavity due to thickened lateral walls with a correlation 2/3 uterine corpus and 1/3 cervix. The abnormlaity is said to resemble the letter T in hysterosalpingographic imaging.\" [PMID:23771171]"}

name: Decreased fibular diameter
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula.\" []"}

name: Triceps weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lack of strength in the triceps muscle, which normally is responsible for extending (straightening) the elbow and mediating certain shoulder movements.\" []"}

name: Agalactia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of secretion of milk following childbirth associated with an inability to breastfeed an infant.\" []"}

name: Twin-to-twin transfusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"As a result of sharing a single placenta, the blood supplies of monochorionic twin fetuses can become connected, so that they share blood circulation: although each fetus uses its own portion of the placenta, the connecting blood vessels within the placenta allow blood to pass from one twin to the other.Depending on the number, type and direction of the interconnecting blood vessels (anastomoses), blood can be transferred disproportionately from one twin (the donor) to the other (the recipient). This state of transfusion causes the donor twin to have decreased blood volume, retarding the donor's development and growth. The blood volume of the recipient twin is increased, which can strain the fetus's heart and eventually lead to heart failure.\" [PMID:19283655]"}

name: Cutaneous hamartoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the skin.\" []"}

name: Purely bicuspid aortic valve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by two equal-sized cusps, with no raphe and only two commissures. There is a lateral arrangement of the free edge of the cusps. Note that this differs from some other forms of BAV in which there are three commissures and two of the three cusps are joined by a raphe forming two functional leaflets. This type of BAV often is associated with aortic stenosis.\" [PMID:17467434]"}

name: Single raphe bicuspid aortic valve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of bicuspid aortic valvue (BAV) characterized by the presence of a single raphe that extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps, resulting in two leaflets of unequal size.\" [PMID:17467434, PMID:24827036]"}

name: Bicuspid aortic valve with right-left cusp fusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the right and left cusps (RL fusion pattern). This results in two leaflefts with an anterior-posterior leaflet orientation (also called the typical pattern). There is thus one completely developed noncoronary cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped left and right coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure.\" [PMID:17467434, PMID:24827036]"}

name: Bicuspid aortic valve with right-noncoronary cusp fusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the right and noncoronary cusps (RN fusion pattern). This results in two leaflets with right-left leaflet orientation (also called the atypical pattern). There is thus one completely developed left cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped right and noncoronary coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure.\" []"}

name: Bicuspid aortic valve with left-noncoronary cusp fusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) characterized by a single raphe between the left and noncoronary cusps (LN fusion pattern). There is thus one completely developed right cusp, two completely developed commissures, and one raphe between the underdeveloped left and noncoronary coronary cusps extending to the corresponding malformed commissure.\" []"}

name: Two-raphe bicuspid aortic valve
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of bicuspid aortic valvue (BAV) characterized by the presence of two raphes that each extend from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV has developmental anlagen of three cusps, commissures, and sinuses, but two commissures are more or less malformed and obliterated, giving rise to a raphe, a fibrous ridge, which extends from the commissure to the free edge of the two underdeveloped, conjoint cusps. This type of BAV is typically associated with a high degree of aortic stenosis.\" [PMID:17467434]"}

name: Recurrent gastroenteritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to gastroenteritis, an infectious inflammationof the stomach and small intestines manifested by signs and symptoms such as diarheas and abdominal pain, as manifested by recurrent episodes of gastroenteritis.\" []"}

name: Decreased platelet thromboxane A2 receptor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased cell membrane concentration of thromboxane A2 receptor that is stimulated by thromboxane A2 (TBXA2).\" []"}

name: Decreased platelet alpha-2A-adrenergic receptor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased cell membrane concentration of alpha-2A adrenergic receptor that is stimulated by epinephrine.\" []"}

name: Impaired clot retraction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Platelets contain contractile proteins (actin and myosin) that induce clot retraction. As the platelets contract, they pull on the surrounding fibrin strands, squeezing serum form the mass, compacting the clot and drawing the ruptured edges of the blood vessel more closely together. Clot retraction is directly proportional to the platelet count and inversely proportional to the fibrinogen concentration.\" []"}

name: Impaired convulxin-induced platelet aggregation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal response to convulxin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of convulxin.\" []"}

name: Impaired collagen-related peptide-induced platelet aggregation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal response to collagen-related peptide (CRP) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of CRP.\" []"}

name: Impaired phorbol myristate acetate-induced platelet aggregation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal response to phorbol myristate acetate (PMA) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of PMA.\" []"}

name: Impaired calcium ionophore-induced platelet aggregation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal response to calcium Ionophore (such as A23187) as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of the ionophore.\" []"}

name: Abnormal platelet phosphatidylserine exposure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of phosphatidylserine (PS) on activated platelets. PS is normally located on the cytoplasmic face of the resting platelet membrane but appears on the plasma-oriented surface of discrete membrane vesicles that derive from activated platelets. Thrombin, the central molecule of coagulation, is produced from prothrombin by a complex (prothrombinase) between factor Xa and its protein cofactor (factor V(a)) that forms on platelet-derived membranes. This complex enhances the rate of activation of prothrombin to thrombin by roughly 150,000 fold relative to factor X(a) in solution. The negatively charged surface of PS-containing platelet-derived membranes is at least partly responsible for this rate enhancement.\" [PMID:12814644]"}

name: Impaired annexin V binding to platelet phosphatidylserine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced binding of annexin V to platelet membrane, which is mediated by exposed phosphatidylserine. This can be measured by flow cytometry.\" []"}

name: Increased annexin V binding to platelet phosphatidylserine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Elevated binding of annexin V to platelet membrane, which is mediated by exposed phosphatidylserine. This can be measured by flow cytometry.\" []"}

name: Cor triatriatum sinister
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly of the heart characterized by the presence of three atria because the left atrium is divided by an abnormal septum.\" [PMID:22379596]"}

name: Triggered by physical trauma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a trauma (injury to tissue).\" []"}

name: Decreased acrosin in sperm head
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced amount of the enzyme acrosin in the sperm head acrosome. The acrosome is an organelle in the anterior half of the head of spermatozoa, and acrosin is a protease that contributes to the digestation of the zona pellucida in the fertilization process.\" []"}

name: Storage in hepatocytes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hepatocytes (liver parenchymal cells) exhibit a bloated appearance because of expansion of the cytoplasm by accumulated material.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating B-type natriuretic peptide concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal circulating concentration of B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP).\" [PMID:22145138]"}

name: Frog-leg posture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of rest posture in an infant that indicated a generalized reduction in muscle tone. The hips are flexed and the legs are abducted to an extent that causes the lateral thigh to rest upon the supporting surface. This posture is said to resemble the legs of a frog.\" []"}

name: Abnormal liver sonography
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal appearance of the liver or any of its components on sonography (ultrasound).\" []"}

name: Increased hepatic echogenicity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased echogenicity of liver tissue on sonography, manifested as an increased amount of white on the screen of the sonography device.\" [PMID:21472065]"}

name: Abnormal hepatic echogenicity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal degree of echogenicity of the liver on sonography. Echogenicity refers to the ability of a tissue to reflect or transmit ultrasound waves in the context of surrounding tissues. Whenever there is an interface of structures with different echogenicities, a visible difference in contrast will be apparent on the screen. Based on echogenicity, a structure can be characterized as hyperechoic (white on the screen), hypoechoic (gray on the screen) and anechoic (black on the screen).\" [PMID:21472065]"}

name: Decreased hepatic echogenicity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced echogenicity of liver tissue on sonography, manifested as an increased amount of black on the screen of the sonography device.\" [PMID:21472065]"}

name: Coarsened hepatic echotexture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The appearance of the liver in sonographic images is normally uniform. This term applies when there is an irregular or non-uniform appearance of the liver parenchyma in liver sonography.\" []"}

name: Starry sky appearance on hepatic sonography
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal echotexture visible in liver ultrasound manifesting as a diffuse hyperechoic liver echotexture with multiple, small hypoechoic lesions. The appearance is said to resemble a starry sky (multiple white spots on a dark background).\" [PMID:26157918]"}

name: Impaired oral bolus formation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of swallowing characterized by reduced tongue coordination to form bolus after chewing. Food material spreads over the oral cavity instead of being concentrated into a bolus that is easily swallowed.\" [PMID:16776766]"}

name: Vitreomacular adhesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Perifoveal vitreous separation with remaining vitreomacular attachment and unperturbed foveal morphologic features. It is an OCT finding that is almost always the result of normal vitreous aging, which may lead to pathologic conditions.\" [PMID:24053995]"}

name: Vitreomacular traction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Vitreomacular traction is characterized by anomalous posterior vitreous detachment accompanied by anatomic distortion of the fovea, which may include pseudocysts, macular schisis, cystoid macular edema, and subretinal fluid. Vitreomacular traction can be subclassified by the diameter of vitreous attachment to the macular surface as measured by OCT, with attachment of 1500 micrometers or less defined as focal and attachment of more than 1500 micrometers as broad.\" [PMID:24053995]"}

name: Full-thickness macular hole
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Full-thickness macular hole (FTMH) is defined as a foveal lesion with interruption of all retinal layers from the internal limiting membrane to the retinal pigment epithelium. Full-thickness macular hole is primary if caused by vitreous traction or secondary if directly the result of pathologic characteristics other than vitreomacular traction. Full-thickness macular hole is subclassified by size of the hole as determined by OCT and the presence or absence of vitreomacular traction.\" [PMID:24053995]"}

name: Membranous vitreous appearance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Vitreous humor of the eye displaying consisting of a vestigial gel in the retrolental space bounded by a convoluted membrane.\" [PMID:20513134, PMID:21921955]"}

name: Beaded vitreous appearance
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Vitreous humor of the eye displaying beaded bundles of irregular diameters.\" [PMID:20513134, PMID:21921955]"}

name: Increased Arden ratio of electrooculogram
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal increase in the Arden ratio, which is the ratio between the light peak and the dark trough of the smoothed (physiologic) EOG record.\" []"}

name: Decreased platelet glycoprotein Ib
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased platelet cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein Ib.\" [PMID:11157507]"}

name: Carotid cavernous fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal connection between a carotid artery and the cavernous sinus.\" [PMID:23571267]"}

name: Widened atrophic scar
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An atrophic scar (fibrous connective tissue resulting from incomplete healing of a wound) that has stretched (gotten wider), a manifestation of tissue fragility.\" [PMID:22353005]"}

name: Thinning of Descemet membrane
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the thickness of Descemet's membrane.\" []"}

name: Myelokathexis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Impaired egress of mature neutrophils from bone marrow causing neutropenia.\" [PMID:10607719, PMID:25662009]"}

name: Reduced brain glutamate level by MRS
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An decrease in the level of glutamate (Glu) in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).\" [PMID:24123328]"}

name: Impaired oropharyngeal swallow response
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delay or absence of the swallow response, reflexes triggered by the contact the food bolus makes with the anterior faucial pillars.\" [PMID:27785002]"}

name: Low femoral bone density
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced bone mineral density of the femur.\" [PMID:19580459]"}

name: Growth arrest lines
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Growth arrest lines are alternating transverse rings of sclerosis at the metaphysis of a long bone.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0169-8159]"}

name: Multifocal seizures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Seizures that start from several different areas of the brain (i.e., with multiple ictal onset locations).\" [PMID:27091239]"}

name: Eyelid myokymia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Involuntary, fine, continuous, undulating contractions of the eyelid.\" []"}

name: Triggered by ingestion of potassium-rich food
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by eating or drinking foods rich in potassium.\" [PMID:19472919]"}

name: Postterm pregnancy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pregnancy that extends to 42 weeks of gestation or beyond.\" [PMID:24753906]"}

name: Femoral spur
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from the femur, often in the medial femoral neck.\" []"}

name: Sectoral retinitis pigmentosa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A variant of retinitis pigmentosa in which there is a regional distribution of the retinal degeneration.\" []"}

name: Tibial spur
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from the tibia.\" []"}

name: Double-layered patella
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly of the patella characterized by two layers visible on lateral knee X-ray such that one layer is in front of the other in the sagittal orientation (See Figure 2A and 3B of PMID:12966518). This finding persists into adulthood.\" [PMID:12525546, PMID:12966518]"}

name: Absent cervical vertebra
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies of the cervical spine.\" []"}

name: Absent thoracic vertebra
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies of the thoracic spine.\" []"}

name: Finger flexor weakness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced ability to flex (bend) the fingers. This can manifest as incomplete closure of the hand due to weakness in finger flexion.\" [PMID:15668452]"}

name: Fixed head retroflexion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Head is bent in the posterior direction in a permanent fashion.\" [PMID:25288843]"}

name: Nuchal rigidity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Resistance of the extensor muscles of the neck to being bent forwards (i.e., impaired neck flexion) as a result of muscle spasm of the extensor muscles of the neck. Nuchal rigidity is not a fixed rigidity. Nuchal rigidity has been used as a bedside test for meningism, although its sensitivity for this purpose has been debated.\" [PMID:12060874]"}

name: Erythema migrans
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An expanding erythematous (red) skin lesion, usually round or oval, by definition at least 5 cm in size (in largest diameter).\" [PMID:18452799]"}

name: Necrolytic migratory erythema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acral or periorificial lesions that evolve in recurrent crops, with an annular and migratory distribution.\" [PMID:20054043]"}

name: Elevated circulating NT-proBNP concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of NT-proBNP (= N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide, = N-terminal prohormone of brain natriuretic peptide) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating deoxycorticosterone level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the concentration of deoxycorticosterone in the blood. Deoxycorticosterone comprises 11-deoxycorticosterone and 21-deoxycorticosterone.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating pregnenolone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the concentration of pregnenolone in the blood.\" [PMID:24849255]"}

name: Genital edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A buildup of fluid that causes swelling in the soft tissues of the genital area.\" []"}

name: Wrist drop
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which the affected individual cannot extend the wrist, which hangs flaccidly.\" []"}

name: Superficial dermal perivascular inflammatory infiltrate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Numerous lymphocytes surrounding blood vessels in the superficial part of the dermis.\" []"}

name: Deep dermal perivascular inflammatory infiltrate
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Numerous lymphocytes surrounding blood vessels in the deep part of the dermis.\" []"}

name: Abnormal morphology of left ventricular trabeculae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the left ventricle of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).\" []"}

name: Abnormal morphology of right ventricular trabeculae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the right ventricle of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).\" []"}

name: Increased density of left ventricular trabeculae
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased density (number and tightness) of the muscular columns which project from the inner surface of the left ventricles of the heart (cardiac trabeculae, trabeculae carneae).\" []"}

name: Apical hypertrabeculation of the left ventricle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased number and density of the trabeculae in the apex (tip) of the left ventricle.\" []"}

name: Thin myocardium compact layer
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced thickness of the outer, dense layer of the myocardium.\" []"}

name: Cellular urinary casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of urinary cast composed of cells incorporated in a protein matrix. The cells can be those found in the urinary sediment (erythrocytes, leuklocytes, renal tubular epithelial cells).\" []"}

name: Renal tubular epithelial cell casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of cellular urinary cast composed of renal tubular epithelial cells.\" []"}

name: Acellular urinary casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of urinary cast composed of a proteinaceous matrix without a substantial number of cells.\" []"}

name: Hyaline casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of acellular urinary cast that are composed only of Tamm-Horsfall glycoprotein, a fact which explains their low refractive index. Hyaline casts may display a spectrum of morphologies, which includes fluffy, compact, convoluted or wrinkled casts. Hyaline casts have a smooth texture and usually have parallel sides with clear margins and blunted ends.\" [PMID:26079824]"}

name: Granular casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of acelluar casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented.\" [PMID:26079824]"}

name: Waxy casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of acellular urinary casts that display a melted wax (waxy) appearance, which gives them a high refractive index. They are frequently dark, with blunt extremities, indented and cracked edges and a large size, which is often several times that of other types of casts.\" [PMID:26079824]"}

name: Fatty casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of acellular urinary casts that contain lipid droplets, oval fat bodies or cholesterol crystals, and are often associated with the free forms of these elements. Their identification may require the use of polarized light microscopy, under which fatty particles embedded into the cast matrix appear as Maltese crosses.\" [PMID:26079824]"}

name: Bacterial cell casts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of urinary cast that contain bacteria. Bacterial casts can be difficult to identify and can be distinguished from other types of casts using phase contrast microscopy. Bacterial casts are diagnostic of acute pyelonephritis or intrinsic renal infection.\" [PMID:26079824]"}

name: Reduced lysosomal acid lipase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction in the activity of lysosomal acid lipase (LAL) in the blood. Lysosomal lipase activity is measured. LAL hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters derived from cell internalization of plasma lipoproteins.\" [PMID:22227072]"}

name: Striatal T2 hyperintensity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally bright T2 signal from the striatum on brain magnetic resonance imaging.\" [PMID:27058447]"}

name: Hepatic hemangioma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital vascular malformation in the liver composed of masses of blood vessels that are atypical or irregular in arrangement and size.\" [NCIT:C3869, PMID:21191518]"}

name: Increased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081). This alpha subunit is common to luteinizing hormone (LH) , follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) , thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), which are glycoprotein hormones composed of an identical alpha subunit together with a beta subunit that confers biological specificity. The alpha subunit is used as a marker for tumors that produce these hormones.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction in the level of lipoprotein lipase in the blood.\" [PMID:18194851, PMID:30725725]"}

name: Abnormal circulating hyaluronic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal concentration of hyaluronic acid in the blood.\" [PMID:11861239]"}

name: Elevated circulating cholesteryl ester concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of cholesteryl ester in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating 17-hydroxyprogesterone concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased level of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood. 17-hydroxyprogesterone is an intermediate steroid in the adrenal biosynthetic pathway from cholesterol to cortisol and is the substrate for steroid 21-hydroxylase.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduced concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood.\" []"}

name: Increased circulating progesterone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevated concentration of progesterone in the blood.\" []"}

name: Hot flashes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden feelings of warmth that are generally most pronounced over the face, neck and chest.\" []"}

name: Inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A state of increased circulating antidiuretic hormone despite hyponatremia and hypo-osmolality with normal or increased plasma volume.\" []"}

name: Reduced radioactive iodine uptake
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decreased amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.\" []"}

name: Increased radioactive iodine uptake
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevated amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.\" []"}

name: Abnormal radioactive iodine uptake test result
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from normal in the amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating thyroxine-binding globulin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Focal pancreatic islet hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans that affects only certain regions of the pancreas and not others.\" []"}

name: Diffuse pancreatic islet hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans with a generalized distribution.\" []"}

name: Intrapulmonary shunt
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Blood flow through a region of the lung in which little or no ventilation takes place, resulting in reduced oxygenation of the blood leaving the lungs.\" []"}

name: Perinephric fluid collection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An accumulation of fluid in one or more of the perinephric spaces, which consist of the subcapsular, perirenal, anterior and posterior pararenal spaces. This abnormality can be demonstrated by cross-sectional imaging, particularly computed tomography.\" [PMID:12014928]"}

name: Nasopharyngeal teratoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A teratoma arising in the nasopharyngeal region.\" [PMID:23056797]"}

name: Abnormal incisura morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal shape of the incisura, defined as the narrowed downward continuation of the conchal space bounded anteriorly by the borders of the tragus, posteriorly by the antitragus, and along its lower lateral margins and inferior boundary by the connection between the first two. The upper boundary is a somewhat arbitrary line crossing from the apices of the antitragus and the tragus.\" [PMID:20082456]"}

name: Increased incisura length
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is greater than that observed in the average population.\" [PMID:20082456]"}

name: Decreased incisura length
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is less than that observed in the average population.\" [PMID:20082456]"}

name: Narrow incisura width
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Width of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border less than that observed in the average population.\" [PMID:20082456]"}

name: Increased incisura width
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Breadth of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border greater than that observed in the average population.\" [PMID:20082456]"}

name: Horizontal inferior border of scapula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A morphological abnormality of the scapula in which there is a flat (horizontal) inferior edge of the scapula. The entire scapula is said to resemble a square, leading to the designation sqaring of the scapula (in Figure 1 of PMID:24706940 the scapulae have a roughly rectangular shape).\" [PMID:24706940]"}

name: Neutrophilic infiltration of the skin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A predominantly neutrophilic infiltrate of the dermis and or epidermis (i.e., a large number of neutrophils inferred to have migrated into the skin).\" []"}

name: Internally nucleated skeletal muscle fibers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased proportion of nuclei of sarcomeres with an internal localization. Individual muscle fibers are syncytia, formed by embryonic fusion of many myoblasts or later, myosatellite cells. Each muscle fiber contains many nuclei, peripherally positioned immediately adjacent to the sarcolemmal membrane. In healthy muscle only 3-5% of fibers contain nuclei that are located internally, within the cell, but many disease processes lead to internal nuclei.\" [PMID:22938878]"}

name: Necklace skeletal muscle fibers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A histological alteration of muscle fibers that resembles a necklace (necklace fibers). A substantial proportion of fibers (4-20% in PMID:19084976) show internalized nuclei aligned in a basophilic ring (necklace) at 3 micrometers beneath the sarcolemma. Ultrastructurally, such necklaces consist of myofibrils of smaller diameter, in oblique orientation, surrounded by mitochondria, sarcoplasmic reticulum and glycogen granules.\" [PMID:19084976]"}

name: Extrafoveal choroidal neovascularization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 200 to 1500 micrometers from the center of the fovea.\" []"}

name: Juxtafoveal choroidal neovascularization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 1 to 199 micrometers from the center of the fovea.\" []"}

name: Subfoveal choroidal neovascularization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the area of neovascularization overlaps with the center of the fovea.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating chylomicron concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced plasma concentrations of chylomicrons, the large lipid droplet (up to 100 mm in diameter) of reprocessed lipid synthesized in epithelial cells of the small intestine and containing triacylglycerols, cholesterol esters, and several apolipoproteins.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating VLDL-C concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of very-low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Swollen lip
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of the lip typically due to fluid buildup or inflammation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]"}

name: Productive cough

name: Intramuscular myxoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign tumor that is usually solitary, painless, palpable mass that is firm in consistency and slightly movable and often fluctuant. On microscopic examination, there is abundant mucoid material and relative hypo cellularity and loose reticulin fibers. Vascular structures are sparse. The cells have a stellate shape with small hyper chromatic pyknotic nuclei and scanty cytoplasm. Some myxomas may show focal areas of hyper cellularity. The intensity, duration, or impact of the state exceeds what would be expected for the individual based on their baseline emotional functioning, the context, cultural norms, or situational triggers, or when it persists despite efforts at self-regulation.\" [PMID:27732016, PMID:36104987]"}

While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments).\" []"}

name: Anger
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A state of excessive negative emotional reactivity characterized by strong feelings of hostility or antagonism typically in response to perceived provocation. It is often accompanied by physiological arousal (e.g., increased heart rate, muscle tension, or activation of the sympathetic nervous system) and expressions of blame, perceived injustice, or judgment. The experience of anger may be directed outwardly toward individuals, groups, objects, or abstract entities, or inwardly toward oneself.\" [PMID:1521100, PMID:31809773]"}

extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of normal alpha rhythm in the EEG. Alpha rhythm has been defined as a rhythm at 8-13 Hz occurring during wakefulness over the posterior regions of the head, generally with higher voltage over the occipital areas. name: Abnormally low T cell receptor excision circle level

name: Follicular infundibulum tumor

name: Lymphocytoma cutis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lymphocytoma cutis, or Spiegler-Fendt sarcoid, is classed as one of the pseudolymphomas, referring to inflammatory disorders in which the accumulation of lymphocytes on the skin resemble, clinically and histopathologically, cutaneous lymphomas. Careful clinical evaluation, histopathological and immunohistochemical exams may be needed to make the correct diagnosis.\" [PMID:24346899]"}
