name: Abnormal circulating short-chain fatty acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of short-chain fatty acid in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Increased circulating isovaleric acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of isovaleric acid, a C5, branched-chain saturated fatty acid, in the blood concentration.\" [PMID:16602101]"}

name: Intrahepatic bile duct dilatation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased diameter (caliber) of intrahepatic bile ducts (bile ducts that transport bile between the Canals of Hering and the interlobar bile ducts).\" [PMID:32386558]"}

name: Anorectal abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abscess located at the junction of the anal canal and the rectum.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating dodecenoylcarnitine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased circulation of dodecenoylcarnitine, C12:1, in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating deoxypyridinoline concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of lysyl-pyridinoline (deoxypyridinoline) cross-links in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:12661898]"}

name: Elevated circulating L-alloisoleucine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased concentration of L-alloisoleucine in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:10508118, PMID:28919799]"}

name: Elevated urine L-alloisoleucine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased level of L-alloisoleucine in the urine.\" [PMID:28919799]"}

name: Elevated circulating 3-methylhistidine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase of the concentration of 3-methylhistidine in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:6780020]"}

name: Reduced respiratory ciliary beating frequency
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in the number of beats per unit time of the respiratory cilia.\" [PMID:10722772]"}

name: Reduced urinary inosine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Inosine is a purine nucleoside in which hypoxanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.\" [PMID:402573]"}

name: Decreased urinary guanosine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Guanosine is a purine nucleoside in which guanine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.\" []"}

name: Abnormal urinary purine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal amount of a purine compound in the urine. Purines are aromatic heterocyclic compounds containing a purine moiety, which is formed a pyrimidine-ring ring fused to an imidazole ring. Two of the four deoxyribonucleotides (deoxyadenosine and deoxyguanosine) and two of the four ribonucleotides (adenosine, or AMP, and guanosine, or GMP) are purines.\" []"}

name: Abnormal urinary pyrimidine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal amount of a pyrimidine compound in the urine. Pyrimidines and pyrimidine derivatives are compounds containing a pyrimidne ring, which is a six-member aromatic heterocycle which consists of two nitrogen atoms (at positions 1 and 3) and four carbon atoms. The nucleotides cytosine, thymine and uracil are pyrimidines.\" []"}

name: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased number and/or abnormal type of bacteria in the small bowel. Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth has been defined as the presence of greater than one hundred thousand bacteria (i.e. colony-forming units, CFU) per mL of proximal jejunal aspiration. The normal value is ten thousand or few CFU/ml.\" [PMID:20572300]"}

name: Focal active colitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Focal active colitis (FAC) is characterized by focal crypt damage caused by neutrophils. FAC is characterized by an inflammatory infiltrate consisting of intraepithelial neutrophils and/or neutrophils invading the lumen of the criptae, with no other microscopic alteration of the colonic mucosa and, in particular, without the presence of signs of chronic inflammation.\" [PMID:21880133, PMID:29254324, PMID:9191008]"}

name: Necrotizing enterocolitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the intestine leading to bacterial invasion causing cellular damage and death which causes necrosis of the colon and intestine.\" [PMID:30020729]"}

name: Recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased susceptibility to viral upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections (otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis).\" [PMID:30422556]"}

name: Neutrophilic urticarial dermatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A neutrophilic interstitial, perivascular and/or perieccrine infiltrate with leukocytoclasia. Notably, leukocytoclastic vasculitis is not present.\" [PMID:32490121]"}

name: Reduced mevalonate kinase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally reduced activity of mevalonate kinase, which is a key enzyme in the mevalonate biosynthetic pathway that leads to the synthesis of both cholesterol and nonsterol isoprenoids.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3411-9598, PMID:27499643]"}

name: Reduced total lung capacity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally reduced volume of air in the lungs upon the maximum effort of inspiration.\" [PMID:28194273]"}

name: Abnormal skinfold thickness measurement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal range of a skinfold thickness, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.\" [PMID:7492193]"}

name: Abnormal triceps skinfold thickness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal range of the thickness of the triceps skinfold, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.\" [PMID:27669294]"}

name: Increased triceps skinfold thickness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased thickness of the triceps skinfold, which is measured halfway down the back of the upper arm is increased.\" [PMID:27669294]"}

name: Milky appearance of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Return of lavage fluid with a milky appearance due to the accumulation of a mixture of pulmonary surfactant, which is a lipoprotein complex, in the alveolar space.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:26110014, PMID:28771412]"}

name: Bloody bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Return of lavage fluid characteristically has a bloody appearance in pulmonary alveolar hemorrhage. This is due to admixture of blood, which typically increases with each consecutive lavage portion. Microscopically erythrocytes can be seen. After 24 to 48 h macrophages contain phagocytosed erythrocytes, indicating previous bleeding.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X]"}

name: Elevated circulating 5-oxoproline concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of L-pyroglutamic acid in the blood is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:8789605]"}

name: Submandibular lymph node enlargement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased size of the lymph nodes that are located beneath the mandible (lower jaw).\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating suberic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of suberic acid in the blood circulation. Suberic acid is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the 1,6-dicarboxy derivative of hexane.\" []"}

name: Increased circulating interleukin 8 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of interleukin-8 in the circulation.\" [PMID:15831231]"}

name: Elevated circulating aconitic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of aconitic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Torsion of appendix of testis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The appendix testis or hydatid of Morgagni, is a vestigial remnant of the M\u00fcllerian duct located on the superior pole of the testicle between the testis and epididymis. Although this appendage has no vital function, it is present in 50% of males. Torsion of twisting of this vestigial remnant can be incredibly painful, but usually requires no medical intervention.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8169-9049, PMID:31550101]"}

name: Spinal epidural abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spinal epidural abscess (SEA) is caused by a suppurative infection in the epidural space. The mass effect of the abscess can compress and reduce blood flow to the spinal cord, conus medullaris, or cauda equina.\" [PMID:24007734, PMID:26540492]"}

name: Increased circulating cathepsin D level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in concentration of cathepsin D in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:26995190]"}

name: Bilobed right lung
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect of pulmonary lobation characterized by the presence of only two lobes of the right lung.\" [PMID:19500772]"}

name: Triggered by EBV infection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by the Epstein-Barr virus.\" [PMID:19425169]"}

name: Misalignment of the pulmonary veins
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The term is commonly used to describe a putative abnormal location of pulmonary vein branches adjacent to pulmonary arteries within the same adventitial sheath. However, evidence has been provided that the vessels in question are not pulmonary veins, however represent dilated bronchial veins.\" [PMID:19500772, PMID:25052575, PMID:27071622]"}

name: Hyperimidodipeptiduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Elevated levels of proline-containing dipeptides in urine.\" [PMID:9196362]"}

name: Cystic acne
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A severe type of acne characterized by the formation of cysts enclosing a mixture of keratin and sebum.\" [PMID:9212761]"}

name: Radiculomegaly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Tooth root length more than 2 SD above mean, or subjectively apparently increased tooth root length.\" [PMID:29574060, PMID:31468724]"}

name: Hypertrichotic hyperpigmented patch
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A large nonpalpable spot of the skin over 1 cm in dimension with increased pigmentation and increased hair growth.\" [PMID:18410979]"}

name: Increased circulating selenium concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:25519493]"}

name: Decreased circulating selenium concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally reduced concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:25519493]"}

name: Ballooning hepatocyte degeneration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Swelling of the hepatocyte, rounding of its contour, and alteration of the cytoplasm, which takes on a reticulated, rarefied, or flocculant quality. The cytoplasm of the ballooned hepatocytes often contains clumps of eosinophilic ropey material known as Mallory-Denk bodies (MDBs) or Mallory hyaline, which is composed of hyperphosphorylated misfolded intermediate filaments, ubiquitin, and ubiquitin-binding protein P62.\" [PMID:31603713, PMID:31885839]"}

name: Perioral erythema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the mouth.\" []"}

name: Perianal erythema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the anus.\" []"}

name: Portal inflammation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infiltration of portal fields by inflammatory cells.\" [PMID:16939061, PMID:19142989]"}

name: Hepatic lobular inflammation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Infiltration of inflammatory cells in lobules of the liver. A focus of lobular inflammation can be defined as two or more inflammatory cells (neutrophils, lymphocytes and other mononuclear cells, eosinophils and microgranulomas) within the lobule present within the sinusoids or surrounding injured hepatocytes (ballooned or apoptotic hepatocytes).\" [PMID:31583739]"}

name: Triggered by viral infection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by a virus.\" []"}

name: Increased circulating interleukin 10 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation of the concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:18424693]"}

name: Triceps hyporeflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced intensity of the triceps tendon reflex.\" []"}

name: Biceps hyporeflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced intensity of the biceps tendon reflex.\" []"}

name: Brachioradialis hyporeflexia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced intensity of the brachioradialis tendon reflex.\" [PMID:32119424]"}

name: Increased CD21low B cell proportion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased proportion relative to B-lymphocytes of a subset of B lymphocytes characterized by dim/low levels of CD21, i.e., CD21-/low, in flow cytometry, and additionally enriched in autoreactive clones as determined for instance by clonse showing rheumatoid factor (anti-IgG) reactivity and antibodies recognizing cytoplasmic and to a lesser extent nuclear structures.\" [PMID:26119182]"}

name: Alveolar capillary dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect of the alveolar airspace during cananicular lung development characterized by a decreased number of pulmonary capillaries located away from the alveolar epithelium, thickened alveolar septae, media hypertrophy of small pulmonary arteries and muscularization of distal arterioles, and in some cases lymphangiectasis.\" [PMID:21471096]"}

name: Acinar dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Arrest of lung development in the pseudoglandular stage (weeks 8 to 16 of human gestation) resulting in small sized lungs, predominantly composed of bronchial and bronchiolar structures embedded in abundant loose mesenchyme that is poorly vascularized. Acinar structures are essentially absent, with no significant formation of saccules and no alveoli.\" [PMID:31151956, PMID:31189067]"}

name: Congenital alveolar dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Arrest of lung development in the cananicular stage (weeks 18 to 26 of human gestation) resulting in simplified acinar spaces, frequently with abundant intervening mesenchyme and no alveoli. In later arrest growth stages early saccular formations may be seen. May resemble the lobular maldevelopment often seen in alveolar capillary dysplasia/misaligment of the pulmonary veins without vein misalignment or marked hypertensive changes of the pulmonary arteries.\" [PMID:31189067]"}

name: Decreased total iron binding capacity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity.\" [PMID:3542299]"}

name: Abnormal total iron binding capacity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added.\" [PMID:3542299]"}

name: Elevated urine suberic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of suberic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:6466694]"}

name: Recurrent viral pneumonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased susceptibility to viral pneumonia, as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral pneumonias.\" [PMID:27427983]"}

name: Obliterative abnormality of the renal glomerulus
Glomerular hyalinosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus. Distribution can include vascular pole, perihilar, tip or neither tip, perihilar or vascular.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Perihilar glomerular hyalinosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the vascular pole/perihilum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Glomerular hyalinosis at the tubular pole
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the tip/tubular pole.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Glomerular hyalinosis away from the vascular and tubular poles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at neither tip nor perihilar/vascular poles. Both the vascular and the tubular pole are present in the glomerular cross section.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: 2-ethylhydracylic aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of 2-ethylhydracylic acid in the urine.\" [PMID:15615815]"}

name: Increased CD4:CD8 ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal elevation of the relative proportion of CD4+ to CD8+ T cells.\" []"}

name: Inverted CD4:CD8 ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"CD4:CD8 ratio less than 1, measured either as proportion of total CD3+ T cells, or in absolute numbers per microliter. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population. Normally there are relatively more CD4+ than CD8+ T cells.\" [PMID:29095912]"}

name: Abnormal glomerular parietal epithelial cell morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of the parietal epithelial cells that line the inside of Bowman's capsule and form an inconspicuous sheet of flat epithelial cells in continuity with the proximal tubular epithelial cells at the urinary pole and with the podocytes at the vascular pole.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:28361304]"}

name: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased number of parietal epithelial cells lining Bowman's capsule. Hyperplasia leads to the cells being present in 2 or more layers, often with crowding and multilayering.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Glomerular parietal epithelial cell hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the glomerular parietal epithelial cells characterized by (1) Increased parietal epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets; or (2) enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli. Both features can be present\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Bowman capsular hyaline drops
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An insudative accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material protruding from Bowman's capsule into the urinary space. Although not always evident by light microscopy, this material is located between Bowman's capsule and the parietal epithelial cells, in some cases associated with newly formed matrix material.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular synechial adhesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An area of basement membrane continuity between the glomerular tuft and Bowman's capsule, without intervening crescent and not adjacent to an area of segmental sclerosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Abnormal glomerular mesangial cellularity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal number of its constituent cells of the mesangium of the glomerulus of the kidney.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Abnormal glomerular mesangial matrix morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of the glomerular matrix. Mesangial cells generate and embed in their own extracellular matrix. The mesangial matrix is different in composition from the glomerular basement membrane. Its constituents are type IV collagen (but only the alpha1 and alpha2 chains); type V collagen; laminin A, B1, and B2; and considerable amounts of fibronectin, heparan sulfate and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans, entactin, and nidogen. Furthermore, small amounts of the proteoglycans decorin and biglycan are found in the mesangial matrix.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:19470685]"}

name: Paramesangial deposits
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mesangial immune deposit located adjacent to the paramesangial glomerular basement membrane.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Mesangial hyaline deposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Extracellular mesangial accumulation of moderately electron-dense, generally homogenous, amorphous-appearing extracellular material.\" []"}

name: Cognitive fatigue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A failure to sustain attention that requires self-motivation to optimize performance.\" [PMID:21128132]"}

name: Visceral epithelial cell detachment
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detachment of visceral epithelial cells (podocytes) from underlying glomerular basement membrane with intervening new loose basement membrane material (pale on Hematoxylin and eosin, periodic acid-Shiff, trichrome, or silver stain) forming a so-called 'halo'.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Podocyte microvillous transformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cytoplasmic projections into the urinary space from the luminal side of the podocyte.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Visceral epithelial cell capping
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Layer of hypertrophied visceral epithelial cells overlying a sclerosed segment of the tuft of the glomerulus.\" []"}

name: Elevated RV/TLC ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in the ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and (3) body plethysmography. An elevated RV/TLC can be interpreted as a sign of air trapping and hyperinflation.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:12934788]"}

name: Polyalveolar lobe
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An elevation of the total count of alveoli as determined by microscopic point-counting of randomly taken lung sections, not secondary to abnormalities in number, size and structure of the airways. In polyaveolar lobe, the number of alveoli is generally increased three to fivefold.\" [PMID:7463297]"}

name: Horseshoe lung
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A horseshoe lung is an uncommon congenital abnormality caused by the partial fusion of the bases of both lungs behind the pericardial sac.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:29970781, PMID:3484566]"}

name: Pulmonary necrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cellular death affecting one or more parts of the lung. Necrosis is caused by diverse external and internal factors which result in the unregulated digestion of cell components.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158]"}

name: Glycogen accumulation in pulmonary interstitial cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of immature interstitial cells containing abundant cytoplasmic glycogen defined by periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) positive cells.\" [PMID:29957271]"}

name: Abnormal alveolar type II pneumocyte morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of alveolar type 2 (ATII) cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:10445627, PMID:27792742]"}

name: Type II pneumocyte hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in size of type II pneumocytes, characterized by qualitative morphologic alterations, including cuboidal shapes, increased nucleocytoplasmic ratio, enlarged nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and various alterations in their nuclear chromatin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:17554398, PMID:2166657]"}

name: Pulmonary amyloidosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Extracellular deposition in lung tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding.\" []"}

name: Multiple pulmonary interstitial hyalinized nodules
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fibrosing nodules, consisting of either unilateral or bilateral central whorled deposits of lamellar collagen hyalin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:31538016]"}

name: Focal substantia nigra T2 hyperintensity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperintense lesion in the substantia nigra on magnetic resonance T2 imaging.\" []"}

name: Nailfold capillary tortuosity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased number of turns of the blood vessels of the nailfold with a charactereistic winded or twisted appearance of the blood vessels.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:25029335]"}

name: Elevated residual volume
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation.\" [PMID:12934788]"}

name: Palmar hyperlinearity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Exaggerated skin markings (dermatoglyphics) on the palms of the hand.\" [PMID:23301728]"}

name: Reduced circulating interferon gamma concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A reduction in the concentration of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Anorectal stricture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Narrowing of the anorectum associated with inflammation or scar tissue.\" [PMID:25109493]"}

name: Congenital lobar overinflation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital malformation characterized by an overdistended segment of lung, affecting an party of a lobe or the entire one. It results in progressive overinflation of one or more lobes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:31118601]"}

name: Delayed ability to walk with support
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A failure to achieve the ability to walk with support (cruise) at an appropriate developmental stage.\" []"}

name: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) is a sudden, unexpected, witnessed or unwitnessed, non-traumatic and non-drowning death, occurring in benign circumstances, in an individual with epilepsy, with or without evidence for a seizure and excluding documented status epilepticus, in which postmortem examination has not revealed a cause of death.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1735-8178, https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9588-2944, PMID:22191982]"}

name: Non-motor seizure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A seizure with clinical manifestation but without motor signs (other than possible behavior arrest) as its initial clinical manifestation. The electrographic onset may be generalized, focal, or unknown.\" [PMID:2827606, PMID:28276060]"}

name: Livedo racemosa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Livedo racemosa describes a reddish-blue mottling of the skin in an irregular, reticular pattern. It differs from the more common livedo reticularis by its shape. Livedo racemosa consists of broken circular segments resulting in a seemingly larger pattern, as opposed to the fine, regular, complete network of livedo reticularis. Livedo racemosa results from permanent impairment of peripheral blood flow and, unlike livedo reticularis, it persists on warming.\" [PMID:26500860, PMID:31753828]"}

name: Renal artery aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in diameter of a segment of the renal artery that can be defined as a focal, isolated dilatation of all three layers of the arterial wall over 1.5 times the diameter of the disease-free proximal adjacent arterial segment.\" [PMID:25537277]"}

name: Transphyseal fracture of the distal humerus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fracture through the distal humeral physis that separates the entire distal humeral epiphysis from the metaphysis.\" [PMID:26808044]"}

name: Absent platelet dense granules
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of platelet dense granules, a type of platelet organelles.\" [PMID:11809908]"}

name: Podocyte myelin figures
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lamellated intracytoplasmic lipid inclusions within podocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular pseudocrescent
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia with resulting cellular crowding of the the urinary space. In contrast with true crescents, these proliferations lack inflammatory cells and fibrin. The cells are typically plump (not spindle-shaped) and often vacuolated, and Bowman's capsule is usually intact.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Abnormal glomerular capillary lumen morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the capillary of the renal glomerulus.\" [PMID:24875196]"}

name: Deflation of the glomerular tuft
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Wrinkling and folding of the capillaries without epithelial cell (podocyte) hyperplasia (formerly called ischemic type of collapse) involving o 80% of the glomerular tuft. The wrinkling is generally made by small regular folds of the glomerular basement membrane.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:27102348]"}

name: Glomerular capillary collapse
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Collapse is generally accompanied by other descriptors such as hypertrophy and hyperplasia of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, halo, protein droplets in podocytes and glomerular parietal epithelial cells (PECs).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular capillary congestion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Global distention of glomerular capillaries with intraluminal intact red blood cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular capillary microaneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Glomerular capillary dilatation due to loosening/detachment of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) from its anchoring points, usually in the context of mesangiolysis or nodular glomerulosclerosis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Abnormal glomerular endothelial cell morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal structure of the glomerular endothelial cells, which are highly specialized cells with fenestrae and a charged luminal glycocalyx layer that contribute to the filtration barrier.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29629372]"}

name: Loss of glomerular endothelial cell fenestration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of round to oval discontinuities normally present in the glomerular capillary endothelial cell cytoplasm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:19129259]"}

name: Glomerular endotheliosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of glomerular endothelial cells by cytoplasmic swelling with resulting partial or complete occlusion of the lumen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:14511965]"}

name: Glomerular endothelial tubuloreticular inclusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inter-anastomosing tubular structures located within cisternae of endoplasmic reticulum, most often within endothelial cells and associated with exposure to interferon.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:23957425]"}

name: Glomerular fibrinoid necrosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fibrin associated with glomerular basement membrane disruption and/or lysis of the mesangial matrix; this lesion does not require the presence of karyorrhexis.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:29459092]"}

name: Reduced CD95-induced lymphocyte apoptosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced amount of programmed cell death in peripheral blood lymphocytes following exposure to CD95 (APO-1/Fas), which is a member of the death receptor family, a subfamily of the TNF-R superfamily. Crosslinking of CD95 with its natural ligand CD95L (CD178) or with agonistic antibodies such as anti-APO-1 induces apoptosis in sensitive cells.\" [PMID:21625644]"}

name: Enterocutaneous fistula
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal connection (fistula) between the intra-abdominal intestinal tract and the skin.\" [PMID:27247538]"}

name: Paratracheal lymphadenopathy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Enlargement of lymph nodes surrounding the trachea.\" [PMID:4023240]"}

name: Circulating nucleated red blood cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of nucleated red blood cells in the peripheral blood circulation.\" [PMID:28633658]"}

name: Abnormal glomerular basement membrane morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormal sttructure of the glomerular basement membrane.\" [PMID:29435440]"}

name: Segmentally thickened glomerular basement membrane
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting a segmental and increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Diffusely thickened glomerular basement membrane
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an diffuse and relatively uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with no electron dense deposits
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by electron microscopy.\" []"}

name: Thickened glomerular basement membranes with electron dense deposits
Glomerular basement membrane lucencies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lucent zones within the glomerular basement membranes. May reflect remote/resolved deposits.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular basement membrane wrinkling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Irregular folding of the glomerular basement membrane with an intact lamina densa.\" []"}

name: Glomerular subendothelial widening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Expansion of the space between the glomerular endothelium and lamina densa by electron-lucent material.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:21827618, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular karyhorrhectic debris
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Apoptotic, pyknotic, and fragmented nuclei within the glomerulus.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular fibrin thrombus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An aggregate of coagulated blood containing fibrin, with or without entrapped cellular elements, within a glomerular capillary lumen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Glomerular hyaline pseudothrombus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intracapillary amorphous, eosinophilic material consisting of immune deposits.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Glomerular lipoprotein thrombus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intracapillary silver-positive material that is finely vacuolated and laminated, and stains with oil red O on frozen sections.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Mesangial Immune complex deposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Extracellular meangial accumulation of finely granular material corresponding to immunoglobulin and/or complement by immunofluorescence/immunohistochemistry; most typically electron-dense although this may decrease with resorption of the deposit.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Binucleated visceral epithelial cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Visceral epithelial cells with 2 nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Multinucleated visceral epithelial cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Visceral epithelial cells with more than two nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Abnormal circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of complement factor H-related protein 1 in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of complement factor H-related protein 1 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating complement factor H-related protein 1 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of complement factor H-related protein 1 in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating 1-methylhistidine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased level of 1-methylhistidine in the blood circulation. 1-methylhistidine is a derivative of L-histidine.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of 4-Hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urinary monocarboxylic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased amount of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine. Monocarboxylic acids are molecules with one COOH functional group.\" []"}

name: Abnormal circulating fetuin-A concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal concentration of fetuin-A in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating fetuin-A concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of fetuin-A in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating fetuin-A concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of fetuin-A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Ileoileal intussusception
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of intussusception of the small intestine in which one part of the ileum invaginates (telescopes) into another part of the ileum.\" [PMID:17872641]"}

name: Osmotic diarrhea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Osmotic diarrhea results from the presence of osmotically active, poorly absorbed solutes in the bowel lumen that inhibit normal water and electrolyte absorption.\" [PMID:22677080]"}

name: Abdominal aortic dissection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A tear in the intimal layer of the abdominal aorta causing a separation between the intima and the medial layers.\" [PMID:15902826]"}

name: Abnormal Bowman space morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Structural anomaly located in Bowman's space, which represents the beginning of the urinary space and is contiguous with the proximal convoluted tubule of the nephron.\" [PMID:32119361]"}

name: Urinary space collagenization
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Acellular collagenous matrix within Bowman's space, not associated with extracapillary hypercellularity or necrosis, associated with sclerosis or deflation of the tuft.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased number of visceral epithelial cells (2 or more layers), often with crowding and multilayering, but without continuity with the parietal epithelium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Visceral epithelial hyaline droplets
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Round to ovoid, Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, fuchsinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions within visceral epithelial cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Glomerular crescent formation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Glomerular crescent refers hyperplastic lesions involving 10% or more of the circumference of Bowman's capsule. Crescents can be composed of a variable mixture of epithelial/leukocyte hypercellularity, fibrous matrix, and fibrin.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32132388]"}

name: Cellular crescent
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of greater than two cell layers and involving more than 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of greater than 75% cells with or without fibrin, and less than 25% fibrous matrix.\" [PMID:32866505]"}

name: Fibrocellular crescent
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of more than 2 cell layers and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of 25% to 75% cells with or without fibrin, and the remainder fibrous matrix.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Fibrous crescent
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary fibrosis composed of greater than 75% matrix and of less than 25% cells with or without fibrin, usually associated with disruption of Bowman's capsule and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X, PMID:32866505]"}

name: Mesangial cell loss
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of mesangial cells segmentally or globally.\" []"}

name: Glomerular obsolescence
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Globally sclerotic glomeruli are that are small and without hyalinosis and may appear with collapse of the tuft with collagenization of the urinary space. Bowman's capsule is completely or partially absent and there is no periglomerular fibrosis and glomerular size is decreased by more than 50% compared to all other glomeruli in the same biopsy. Obsolescent glomeruli may appear to be receding into the interstitium.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Glomerular capillary wall duplication without cellular interposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix, with or without endocapillary hypercellularity and no evidence of interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Glomerular capillary wall duplication with cellular interposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix with interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2356-950X]"}

name: Elevated circulating homovanillic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of homovanillic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating sebacic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of sebacic acid in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating hydroxyphenyllactic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of 4-hydroxyphenlyllactic acid in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Nail psoriasis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Psoriatic nail abnormality characterized by the presence of neutrophils in the nail bed epithelium, hyperkeratosis with parakeratosis, presence of exudates on the corneal epithelium, focal hypogranulosis and psoriasiform hyperplasia of the nail bed.\" [PMID:24770509, PMID:27041288]"}

name: Type II pneumocyte hyperplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in the number of type II pneumocytes.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:11079017]"}

name: Abnormal postural reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anomaly of the physiological response to maintain the body's posture when movement and position is altered.\" [PMID:15246484]"}

name: Impaired neck-righting reflex
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal neck-righting response, which is said to be a physiological response when a child is placed flat on his or her back and the head is turned 90 degrees to the right or the left. With a normal neck-righting response, there follows a reflected torsion of the vertebral column in the same direction as the induced rotation of the neck. That is, the whole body follows the direction in which the head was turned. The response is present from birth to the age of five years.\" [PMID:13502822]"}

name: Acute phase response
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of one or more manifestations of the acute phase response. Acute phase proteins (APP) are blood proteins primarily synthesized by hepatocytes as part of the acute phase response (APR). The APR is part of the early-defense or innate immune system, which is triggered by different stimuli including trauma, infection, stress, neoplasia, and inflammation. The APR results in a complex systemic reaction with the goal of reestablishing homeostasis and promoting healing.\" [PMID:20034426, PMID:30137854]"}

name: Elevated circulating serum amyloid A concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of serum amyloid A in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Jaw contracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limitation of motion of the jaw due to structural changes in a muscle such as the massseter responsible for jaw movement.\" [PMID:12453260]"}

name: Abnormal embryonic development
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the development of the embryo, that is, of the early developmental stage of development that follows the fertilization of an egg by sperm.\" [PMID:32680920]"}

name: Abnormal preimplantation embryonic development
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the development of the embryo in a stage prior to implantation.\" []"}

name: Zygotic cleavage failure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Failure of a fertilized oocyte to undergo the first round of cell division.\" [PMID:32502391]"}

name: Abnormal gametogenesis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An anomaly in the process by a a haploid cell is formed from a diploid cells through meiosis. In males, diploid spermatogonia produce two haploid cells (secondary spermatocytes) in meiosis I and four haploid spermatids in meiosis II. In females, primordial germ cells under meiosis II before birth to form primary oocytes. Once puberty cell begins, these cells form secondary oocytes through meiosis II.\" []"}

name: Increased circulating inosine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of inosine in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Increased circulating guanosine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of guanosine in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating sitosterol concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of beta-sitosterol in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Anti-aquaporin 4 antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against aquaporin-4.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:24260168, PMID:24415568, PMID:25889963, PMID:31312230]"}

name: Mucoid diarrhea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Passage of an increased number of stools containing mucus, a thick fluid substance secreted by mucous membranes.\" [PMID:31869107]"}

name: Pleural cobblestoning
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pleural cobblestone appearance characterized by irregular bumps surrounded by depressed lines in open lung biopsy. Caused by underlying scarring causing retraction of the interlobular septa where they insert on the pleura.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:27618319]"}

name: Neuralgia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pain (An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience) along the course of a nerve.\" []"}

name: Psychic epileptic aura
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Aura with affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual phenomena including illusory or composite hallucinatory events.\" []"}

name: Cognitive epileptic aura
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to altered cognition.\" []"}

name: Epileptic aura
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An epileptic aura is a purely subjective clinical manifestation of an epileptic seizure. If an epileptic aura is not followed by loss of awareness or propagation to a bilateral tonic-clonic seizure then it is a type of focal aware non-motor seizure.\" []"}

name: Seizure cluster
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fourfold or greater increase of usual seizure frequency within a 3-day period, where the patient demonstrates full recovery between seizure events within the cluster. The seizure cluster should be recognizable by the primary clinician, carer or patient.\" [PMID:29871784, PMID:32305858]"}

name: Elevated forced expiratory volume in one second
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in the amount of air a person can forcefully expel in one second, compared to some standard or previous measure of same subject.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5361-6739, PMID:19671143]"}

name: Candida esophagitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Candida infections of the esophagus are considered opportunistic infections and are seen most commonly in immunosuppressed patients, the most common symptoms being dysphagia, odynophagia, and retrosternal pain.\" [PMID:30725953]"}

name: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pulmonary hypertensive crisis involves sudden and potentially lethal increases in PAP and PVR that cause acute rise in right atrial and right ventricular end-diastolic pressure accompanied by low cardiac output.\" [PMID:27295157]"}

name: Abnormal blood vessel morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural anomaly of a blood vessel (artery, arteriole, capillary, venule, or vein).\" []"}

name: Abnormal urine metabolite level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal amount of a metabolite in urine.\" []"}

name: Increased urine deoxypyridinoline level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased level of deoxypyridinoline in the urine. Deoxypyridinoline is a crosslink product of collagen molecules found in bone and excreted in urine during bone degradation, has been described as a marker of bone turnover.\" [PMID:12661898, PMID:9127470]"}

name: Elevated circulating o-phosphoserine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased level of o-phosphoserine in the blood circulation. o-phosphoserine is a derivative of serine.\" []"}

name: Limited head rotation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced range of motion turning the head side to side.\" []"}

name: Abnormal urine osmolality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A deviation from the normal range of concentration of particles in urine.\" []"}

name: Hyperosthenuria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally high urinary specific gravity, i.e., increased concentration of solutes in the urine.\" []"}

name: Impaired ability to shift attention
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A behavioral abnormality whereby a person is unable to move freely from one situation, activity or aspect of aa problem to another as circumstances demand. Key aspects of shifting include the ability to make transitions, problem solve flexibly, switch or alternate attention, and change focus from one mind-set or topic to another. Mild deficits in the ability to shift compromise the efficiency of problem solving, whereas more severe difficulties are reflected in perseverative behaviors. Sometimes this is described as being rigid or inflexible.\" [PMID:23356593]"}

name: Nasal ulcer
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An open sore of the nasal mucosa.\" [PMID:11314863, PMID:25441476, PMID:26657735]"}

name: Recurrent coughing spasms
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Repeated occurrence of episodes of coughing, with each episode consisting of at least five minutes of continuous coughing.\" []"}

name: Hyaline membranes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyaline membranes are homogeneous eosinophilic material composed of cellular debris, plasma proteins, and surfactant plastered against alveolar ducts and alveolar walls. The hyaline membranes are deposited along the walls of the alveoli, where gas exchange typically occurs, thereby making gas exchange difficult.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:24224590]"}

name: Lipoid pneumonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A specific form of lung inflammation that results from accumulation of lipids in the alveoli. Lipoid pneumonia can be either exogenous or endogenous in cause based on the source of the lipid.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:20028911]"}

name: Endogenous lipoid pneumonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is the body itself. When an airway is obstructed, it is often the case that distal to the obstruction, lipid-laden macrophages and giant cells fill the lumen of the disconnected airspace.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0104-692X, PMID:20028911]"}

name: Exogenous lipoid pneumonia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is external to the body.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:20028911]"}

name: Orthodeoxia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Low level of blood oxygen induced by changing from a recumbent to an upright position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:27669319]"}

name: Platypnea
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of dyspnea that occurs when the affected person changes from a recumbent to an upright position.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:27669319]"}

name: Cavitating leukodystrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of leukodystrophy characterized by multiple small cavitations typically in the periventricular and deep cerebral white matter. The cavitations are visible as a central cavity with cerebrospinal fluid-like signal intensity.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:32522799]"}

name: Bronchial telangiectasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Telangiectasias (small dilated blood vessels located near the surface of the skin or mucous membranes) located in the trachoebronchial system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:31466963, PMID:3359830]"}

name: Bronchocentric granulomatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Granulomatous inflammation that surrounds the bronchi and bronchioles, replacing bronchial walls and mucosa. In bronchocentric granulomatosis, the lumen of the airway contains necrotic debris, and palisaded histiocytes surround the lumen.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158, PMID:26744680]"}

name: Abnormal KCO
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal range of KCO. The KCO is a measurement of the rate constant for alveolar uptake of CO during breath-holding in the single breath measurement of DLCO at full inflation. The DLCO is derived as the product of the KCO and the single breath alveolar volume (VA) divided by PB-PH2O.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:11334115]"}

name: Increased KCO
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:11334115]"}

name: Decreased KCO
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Decreased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:11334115]"}

name: Anthracosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anthracosis is the deposition of black carbon pigment. It is commonly seen in perihilar lymph nodes as well as within lung parenchyma. There can be prominent storiforming (i.e., spiral patterning) of histiocytes, to such an extent as to mimic a neoplastic lesion histologically. Anthracosis is a common finding in smokers and polluted city dwellers.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:29892540]"}

name: Alveolar septal thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased width of the alveolar septum, which is the structure that separates neighboring alveoli. This finding can be appreciated on histology.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7371-8158]"}

name: Increased airway neuroendocrine cells
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cells (NECs) within distal airways. There are no formal criteria for an increase (which is also dependent on the sensitivity of the staining method), findings of neuroendocrine cells in at least 70% of bronchioles by lung biopsy and at least 10% NECs in an individual airway are consistent with the diagnosis of Neuroendocrine cell hyperplasia of infancy in the appropriate clinical setting. Increases are also seen in other clinical settings. Neuroendocrine neoplasms of the lung encompass NE tumors (NETs), which split into typical and atypical carcinoids, and NE carcinomas (NECs).\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:20884725, PMID:26474448, PMID:30521210, PMID:32558323, PMID:33306420]"}

name: Increased airway neuroepithelial bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cell cluster (neuroepithelial bodies) in the alveolar ducts.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0113-912X, PMID:10623675]"}

name: Bilateral superior vena cava
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a left and a right superior vena cava.\" [PMID:18847480]"}

name: Nasal chondritis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammation of the cartilage of the nose.\" [PMID:33108101]"}

name: Elevated circulating stearoylcarnitine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased concentration of O-stearoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating palmitoylcarnitine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased concentration of palmitoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Decreased compound muscle action potential amplitude
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced level of the compound muscle action potential (CMAP), which is recorded following electrical stimulation of a nerve from surface electrodes overlying a muscle supplied by that nerve.\" [PMID:15961865]"}

name: Elevated urinary collagen degradation products
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased level in the urine of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine pyridinoline level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased amount of pyridinoline in the urine.\" [PMID:26306627]"}

name: Abnormal circulating collagen degradation product concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal concentration in the blood circulation of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating pyridinoline concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline (pyridinoline) in the blood circulation.\" [PMID:26306627]"}

name: Abnormal bronchial artery morphology
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any structural abnormality of a bronchial artery.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:25590386]"}

name: Bronchopulmonary anastomosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal arterial anastomosis (connection) between bronchial and pulmonary arteries.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:10598843]"}

name: Bronchial artery dilatation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased caliber of a bronchial artery, which can be defined as a bronchial artery diameter that exceeds 2 mm.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:25590386, PMID:32430593]"}

name: Bronchial artery hypertrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in the volume of bronchial artery wall due to the enlargement of its component cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4095-8489, PMID:25590386]"}

name: Perivascular pre-capillary pulmonary artery inflammation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Inflammatory cell infiltration surrounding precapillary pulmonary arteries (arterioles; 20-70 micrometer).\" []"}

name: Irregularly shaped sperm tail
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Irregular or changing caliber (diameter) along the tail of the sperm.\" [PMID:26472152]"}

name: Anti-carbonic anhydrase II antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against carbonic anhydrase II.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3387-1836, PMID:16932997]"}

name: Tissue ischemia

name: Intestinal ischemia
