name: Amyloidosis of peripheral nerves
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of amyloid deposition in the nerves of the peripheral nervous system.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hypertrophied muscle fibers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an increased amount of muscle fibers with an increased diameter. This feature can be ascertained by microscopic examination of a muscle biopsy sample. Together with fiber size variation and atrophied muscle fibers, and hypertrophied muscle fibers are commonly found in myopathies.\" []"}

name: Increased endomysial connective tissue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased volume of the endomysium, which is a connective tissue sheath that surrounds each muscle fiber. Together, bundles of muscle fibers form a fasciculus, surrounded by another layer of connective tissue called the perimysium.\" [PMID:32508678]"}

name: Muscle fiber tubular inclusions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Unusual regions of densely packed membranous tubules known as tubular aggregates which present as membranous inclusions, derived from membranes of sarcoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria, containing miscellaneous proteins with a variety of enzymatic activities.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154, PMID:15113116]"}

name: Muscle fiber cytoplasmatic inclusion bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells. Inclusion bodies are aggregates (deposits) or stainable material, usually misfolded proteins.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Muscle fiber intranuclear inclusion bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of inclusion bodies within the nucleus of muscle cells. Inclusion bodies are aggregates (deposits) or stainable material, usually misfolded proteins.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Ring fibers
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Ring fibers are formed by a bundle of peripheral myofibrils which are circumferentially oriented such that they encircle the internal portion of the sarcoplasm which is normal in structure and orientation.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Muscle fiber hyaline bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions in the cytoplasm of muscle fibers. Hyaline bodies show significant reactivity to myofibrillar ATPase after acid pre-incubation and with immunohistochemistry, show intense reactivity with only slow myosin heavy chain. Electron microscopy of the affected areas show a lack of myofibrils and a uniform, finely granular matrix, sometimes suggesting a filamentous nature, containing few scattered nuclei and mitochondria.\" [PMID:16018165]"}

name: Cerebral cortical hemiatrophy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Atrophy of one side of the brain, characterized by findings including thinning of the cerebral cortex, reduced volume of the cerebral white matter with abnormal myelination, and enlargement of the ispilateral fourth ventricle.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Subdural hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemorrhage occurring between the dura mater and the arachnoid mater.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Epidural hemorrhage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hemorrhage occurring between the dura mater and the skull.\" [https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4530-3154]"}

name: Cerebral ventricular adhesions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bands of scar-like tissue that have formed within a cerebral ventricle.\" []"}

name: Cerebral germinoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a germ cell tumor of the cerebrum.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Cerebral granulomatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cerebral inflammation involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199, PMID:937513]"}

name: Cerebral inclusion bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within cells of the brain.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Hirano bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intracellular aggregates of actin and actin-associated proteins within nerve cells.\" [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0736-9199]"}

name: Argyrophilic inclusion bodies

name: Lafora bodies

name: Cerebral hyaline bodies

name: Rosenthal fibers

name: Juvenile aseptic necrosis

name: Retinopathy of prematurity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An avascular or abnormally vascularized retina that occurs in premature infants and can lead to blindness.\" [ISBN:978-3-319-52190-9, PMID:16009843]"}

name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 1
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The retinal vessels stop and then a linear flat white line is present that usually runs the circumference of the vascular retina.\" [ISBN:978-3-319-52190-9, PMID:16009843]"}

name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 2
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The accumulating neovascularization thickens and manifests as a linear bump. The neovascularization remains along the surface of the retina and does not extend off the retina into the cortical vitreous.\" [ISBN:978-3-319-52190-9]"}

name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 3
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The neovascularization accumulates at the edge of the vascularized retina and extends into the vitreous (also called extra retinal fibrosis proliferation). In cases of Zone 2 and Zone 3, this may be sausage shaped. In more posterior Zone 1 disease, the stage 3 can appear as a direct extension of the normal retinal vessels but extending tangentially over the avascular retina.\" [ISBN:978-3-319-52190-9]"}

name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Scar tissue that forms a continuous sheet coming up from the edge of the vascularized retina. This scar tissue can grow toward the vitreous base/posterior lens capsule resulting in traction, distortion, and even detachment.\" [ISBN:978-3-319-52190-9]"}

name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4a

name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 4b
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A detachment that involves the peripheral retina that involves the macula itself. The detachment usually starts in the temporal periphery although can also involve the nasal retina as well.\" [ISBN:978-3-319-52190-9]"}

name: Retinopathy of prematurity stage 5
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Funnel detachment from the retina with generally traction in all four quadrants.\" [ISBN:978-3-319-52190-9]"}

This definition has been further refined in the later clinical trials in which the diagnosis of plus disease could be made if sufficient vascular dilatation and tortuosity are present in at least 2 quadrants of the eye.\" [PMID:16009843]"}

name: Delusional atmosphere

name: Unusual infectious pancreatitis

name: Unusual viral pancreatitis

name: Unusual parasitic pancreatitis

name: Unusual bacterial cystitis

name: Unusual fungal osteomyelitis

name: Parasitic encephalitis

name: Recurrent otitis externa

name: Recurrent keratitis

name: Consanguinity

name: 2--hydroxyphenylacetic aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased concentration of 2-hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the urine.\" []"}

name: 4-hydroxyphenyllactic aciduria
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Amount of 4-hydroxyphenyllactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated CSF beta-alanine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of beta-alanine present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating 2-aminoadipic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of 2-aminoadipic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:23141293]"}

name: Elevated urinary N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of N-carbamoyl-beta-alanine present in urine, when adjusted for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated CSF cystathionine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of cystathionine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urinary gamma-glutamylphenylalanine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of gamma-glutamylphenylalanine in the urine, when normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:466810]"}

name: Elevated circulating aspartylglucosamine concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of aspartylglucosamine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urinary saccharopine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of saccharopine in the urine, when normalized to urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:30573525, PMID:32768327, PMID:33996359]"}

name: Tectal plate enlargement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal increase in size of the tectal plate (also known as the tectum or the quadrigeminal plate). The tectum is the dorsal portion of the midbrain (brainstem).\" []"}

name: Retroperitoneal mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A swelling or enlargement localized to the retroperitoneal region. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.\" []"}

name: Focal T1 hyperintense brainstem lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lighter than expected T1 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.\" []"}

name: Subchondral fracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of fracture that occurs in the trabecular cancellous bone just beneath the subchondral bone plate without disruption of the articular surface.\" []"}

name: Deep neck abscess
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abscess (i.e., a circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris) localized in the area surrounded by the deep fascia of the neck including the pharynx, larynx, trachea, upper esophagus, thyroid, and parathyroid glands. Infections of pharyngeal, tonsillar, and laryngeal origin affect this space, which includes the parapharyngeal and retropharyngeal spaces.\" [PMID:30020634]"}

name: Epiglottic enlargement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Anlarged and edematous epiglottis. This sign can be observed on a lateral radiograph of the neck and it suggests a diagnosis of acute infectious epiglottitis.\" [PMID:21812674]"}

name: Prevertebral space enlargement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in the anterior posterior dimension of the prevertebral space, which is located in the neck region between the anterior part of the cervical spine and the deep layer of the deep cervical fascia running between the transverse processes of the spine.\" [PMID:19001541]"}

name: Third cranial nerve thickening
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increase in diameter of the third cranial nerve (oculomotor nerve). This feature can be observed by magnetic resonance imaging and may be accompanied by contrast enhancement.\" [PMID:22241707]"}

name: Elevated tissue sphingomyelin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of sphoingomyelin in tissues above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: History of recent iodated contrast medium administration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Medical history of recent iodinated or radioiodine contrast use.\" [PMID:23148056, PMID:33948409]"}

name: Difficulty passing nasogastric tube
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Difficulty inserting a nasogastric tube (NGT), a flexible plastic tube that is placed through the nose and esophagus into the stomach and used to administer drugs or for feeding. There are certain circumstances that may make NGT insertion difficult. They are esophageal narrowing, comatose or intubated patients, and patients who have sustained severe facial or skull injuries.\" [PMID:2917506]"}

name: Persistent falcine venous sinus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A falcine sinus that does not involute but persists beyond birth is defined as a persistent falcine sinus. In the 20-mm embryo stage, the primitive falx cerebri contains the sagittal plexus, a meshwork of anastomotic venous channels from which the superior sagittal sinus and straight sinus are thought to develop. A persistent falcine sinus represents a persistent channel of the caudal anastomotic loops of the sagittal plexus.\" [PMID:19779000]"}

name: Penis uncircumcised
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A medical history in a male of not having been circumcized.\" [PMID:25011345]"}

name: History of facial cosmetic use
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A medical history of use of facial makeup.\" [PMID:28722951]"}

name: Snapping sensation at metacarpophalangeal joint
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A feeling of clicking or snapping at the knuckle (metacarpophalangeal joint) upon extension of flexion of the finger.\" []"}

name: Forearm pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the forearm.\" []"}

name: Rotational fracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of displaced fracture in which there has been a rotation of the distal fracture fragment in relation to the proximal portion.\" []"}

name: Localized over bony prominences
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to an abnormality that is situated on the skin in areas where bones are close to the surface (bony prominences).\" []"}

name: History of compressive footwear
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A past medical history of wearing tight shoes, toe-box shoes, or high heel shoes.\" [PMID:20934103]"}

name: Decreased skin turgor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced skin turgor means reduced elastic recoil of the skin to its normal contour after being pinched in a fold.\" [PMID:30705869]"}

name: Recent foraged mushroom consumption
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Medical history of recently eating wild mushrooms.\" [PMID:29262102]"}

name: Proximal to distal progression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Refers to symptomatology that begins in the proximal limbs and subsequently affects the distal limbs.\" []"}

name: Autonomic-voluntary dissociation of facial movements
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The selective paralysis of voluntary fascio-pharyngo-glosso-masticatory movements with preservation of reflexive and automatic functions is referred to as autonomic-voluntary dissociation, which is a distinctive feature of Anterior opercular syndrome (also known as Foix-Chavany-Marie syndrome).\" [PMID:23809752]"}

name: Jaw mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A swelling or enlargement localized to the jaw. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.\" []"}

name: Excessive nocturnal light exposure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Exposure to continuous light at night, including night-shift work or a nocturnal lifestyle.\" [PMID:34903129]"}

name: Menstruating female between menarche and menopause
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Past medical history of a woman who is menstruating, i.e., not premenstrual or post-menopause.\" []"}

name: Preterm premature rupture of membranes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"PPROM (preterm premature rupture of membranes) occurs at less than 37 weeks of gestation. PPROM can happen spontaneously, during preterm labor, or following a procedure such as amniocentesis.\" [PMID:15167875]"}

name: History of abdominal surgery
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A past medical history that indicates that the patient had a surgical procedure involving the abdomen.\" []"}

name: Thickened Descemet membrane
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The thickness of the Descement membrane is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Incomplete right bundle branch block
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Right bundle branch block (RBBB) represents an abnormality in the intraventricular electrical conduction system of the human heart, generating enlarged QRS and modified vectors on the electrocardiogram (ECG). Incomplete RBBB (IRBBB) is defined by (i) QRS duration between 110 and 120 ms in adults; (ii) rsr, rsR, or rSR in leads V1 or V2. The R or r deflection is usually wider than the initial R wave. In a minority of patients, a wide and often notched R wave pattern may be seen in leads V1 and/or V2; (iii) S wave of greater duration than R wave or greater than 40 ms in leads I and V6 in adults; and (iv) Normal R peak time in leads V5 and V6 but greater than 50 ms in lead V1. The first 3 criteria should be present to make the diagnosis. When a pure dominant R wave with or without a notch is present in V1, criterion 4 should be satisfied.\" [PMID:34100724]"}

name: Perimenopausal onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of signs or symptoms of disease during the period of a woman's life shortly before the occurrence of the menopause.\" []"}

name: Postmenopausal onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Onset of signs or symptoms of disease during the period of a woman's life after the occurrence of the menopause.\" []"}

name: Spastic monoplegia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Spastic weakness found in only one upper or lower extremity.\" [PMID:24111874]"}

name: Mosaic attenuation pattern in lung
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mosaic attenuation pattern in the lung is a term used to describe regions of differing pulmonary attenuation on CT imaging. It is a non-specific finding, although is associated with several conditions such as obstructive small airway disease, occlusive vascular disease (in which case is called mosaic perfusion pattern), pulmonary edema, and parenchymal diseases.\" []"}

name: Elevated aldosterone:renin ratio
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The ratio of aldosterone concentration to renin concentration is above the upper limit of normal. If aldosterone is expressed in ng/dl and plasma renin activity is expressed as ng/ml/hr, then values above 20 with aldosterone level above 15 are considered indicative of primary aldosteronism.\" [PMID:25907736]"}

name: Meteorism
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increase in the gas content inside the bowel associated with distension of the abdomen and hydroaeric noises. The most common symptom of meteorism is a bloated sensation. It may be associated with abdominal discomfort. Some individuals may also complain of a distended stomach and excessive belching and/or passage of flatus.\" [PMID:28613601]"}

name: Failure to elevate ammonia on ischemic exercise
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Normal subjects display an increase in the concentration of ammonia in the blood following an ischemic exercise test. This term refers to an increase in ammonia that is below the lower limit of normal.\" [PMID:3476851]"}

name: Labile Hypertension
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Frequent fluctuations of blood pressure between normal and high levels, changing more dramatically than normal.\" []"}

name: Absent axon flare response after intradermal histamine injection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The axon reflex (also known as the flare response) is a response that is stimulated by peripheral nerves of the body that travels away from the nerve cell body and branches to stimulate target organs. In the human skin, there are three different phenomena mediated by axon reflex mechanism; flare, sweating and pilomotion. Stroking or intradermal injection of histamine or substance P into the human skin pro- duces widespread vasodilatation (flare) and plasma extravasation (wheal). This term refers to the failure of intradermal hista injection to elicit flare.\" [PMID:2456128]"}

name: Reduced sympathoneural responses to the cold pressor test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Response to the cold pressor test below the lower limit of normal. The cold pressor test is a simple and validated test in which the subject immerses one hand or foot into ice water for 1 to 3 minutes while blood pressure (BP) and heart rate are monitored. The cold stimulus activates afferent sensory pathways that, in turn, trigger a sympathetic response resulting in an increase in BP.\" [PMID:33712946]"}

name: Positive stool Giardia antigen test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fecal analysis for Giardia antigen is abnormal. Tests include direct fluorescent-antibody (DFA), which detects intact organisms, and enzyme immunoassays (EIAs), which detect soluble stool antigens.\" [PMID:12574257]"}

name: Excessive blood loss during delivery
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of a substantial amount of blood during delivery (some definitions stipulate 1000 ml or more), typically associated with manifestations such as low blood pressure, a rapid heart rate, dizziness, light-headedness, fatigue, and weakness.\" [PMID:33913640]"}

name: Cardiac valve vegetations
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Endocarditis infection occurs along the edges of the heart valves. Damage to the cardiac endothelium followed by platelet and fibrin deposition results in a sterile lesion known as nonbacterial thrombotic endocarditis (NBTE) or vegetation. Microbes entering the bloodstream via routine or invasive procedures adhere to the vegetation and are engulfed in an outer meshwork of fibrin and platelets. Subsequent rapid microbial multiplication in a protected area of impaired host defense leads to vegetation growth and continuous bacteremia.\" [PMID:17678415]"}

name: Thoracic cage flatness
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The anteroposterior dimension of the chest on the lateral radiograph is often relatively narrow compared with the chest width on the frontal radiograph.\" [PMID:3500611]"}

name: Absent zona pellucida
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of the oocyte extracellular matrix region (zona pellucida). This feature can be observed following follicular aspiration (retrieval of eggs for fertility treatments).\" [PMID:24670168]"}

name: Umbilical cord prolapse
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of the umbilical cord (UC) between the fetal presenting part and the cervix, regardless of the membrane status (intact or ruptured). Descent of the UC through the cervix is essential for diagnosing cord prolapse. It can be either overt (past the presenting part) or occult (alongside the presenting part).\" [PMID:31194398]"}

name: Increased ratio of deoxypyridinoline to pyridinoline cross-links in urine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The relative concentration of deoxypyridinoline (Dpyr) to that of pyridinoline (Pyr) cross-links in urine is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:20301635]"}

name: Elevated urinary thymine level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of thymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urinary indoleacetic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of indoleacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:4228120]"}

name: Reduced hepatic phosphorylase kinase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of phosphorylase kinase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal. Phosphorylase kinase (PhK) has a major regulatory role in the breakdown of glycogen. The enzyme PhK comprises four copies each of four subunits, encoded by PHKA1, PHKA2, PHKB, and PHKG.\" [PMID:21634085]"}

name: Reduced hepatic ornithine transcarbamylase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity or concentration of ornithine transcarbamylase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.\" [PMID:6733950]"}

name: Elevated urinary quinolinic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of quinolinic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Quinolinic acids is a pyridinedicarboxylic acid that is pyridine substituted by carboxy groups at positions 2 and 3. It is a metabolite of tryptophan.\" [PMID:29517768]"}

name: Rectal duplication
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental anomaly characterized by an additional rectum that is typically lined with intestinal mucosa with one or more cell types of the gastrointestinal tract overlying submucosa and smooth muscle layer.\" [PMID:26691370]"}

name: Thinned small intestinal mucosa
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abrnormal reduction in the height of the mucosa of the small intestine. The mucosa is arranged in regular circular folds (the circular valves of Kerckrin), the mucosal surface is covered with small projections called villi, which are slender, about 1.5-2 mm long projections of the mucosa into the lumen. In between the villi are the crypts. This term refers to a pathological thinning of these structures.\" []"}

name: Seminal vesicle hypoplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly characterized by underdevelopment of one or both seminal vesicles, which are the two small glands that store and produce the majority of the fluid that makes up semen.\" []"}

name: Decreased fetal abdominal circumference
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The distance around the abdomen of a fetus, generally as measured by prenatal sonography, is below the lower limit of normal.\" [PMID:30646865]"}

name: Prenatal flattened diaphragm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The diaphragm normally projects up into the thoracic cavity. In the presence of malformations such as enlarged lungs, the diaphragm may appear abnormally flat or even everted (with the middle of the diaphragm projecting downwards into the abdominal cavity).\" [PMID:30319217]"}

name: Snowflake effect in amniotic cavity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Dense floating particles in amniotic fluid, said to resemble snowflakes. This finding can result from shedding of the epidermis in conditions such as Harlequin ichthyosis.\" [PMID:33569485]"}

name: Thickened mitral valve cusp
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormally increased thickness of a leaflet of the mitral valve.\" []"}

name: Antiparietal cell antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against parietal cell antigens.\" [PMID:34913949]"}

name: Anti-intrinsic factor antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against intrinsic factor.\" [PMID:34913949]"}

name: Anti-human immunodeficiency virus antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).\" []"}

name: Anti-polio virus antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of poliovirus.\" [PMID:32644370]"}

name: Anti-NR2A antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the N-Methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor NR2A subunit.\" [PMID:28154472]"}

name: Antistreptolysin O antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against streptolysin O.\" []"}

name: Reduced tissue tissue AICAR transformylase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase; EC 2.1.2.3) a in a tissue is below the lower limit of normal.\" [PMID:15114530]"}

name: Ameliorated by gastric acid-reducing therapy
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with an agent that reduces gastric acidity such as proton pump inhibitors, histamine receptor blockers,omeprazole, esomeprazole, dexlansoprazole, pantoprazole, lansoprazole, famotidine, or ranitidine.\" []"}

name: Anti-coagulation factor antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against a coagulation factor.\" []"}

name: Reduced tissue argininosuccinate synthetase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of argininosuccinate synthetase (EC 6.3.4.5) in body tissues is below the lower limit of normal. Clinically, argininosuccinate synthetase is measured in the liver or in cultered skin fibroblasts.\" [PMID:28111830]"}

name: Reduced aspartoacylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of aspartoacylase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts. Aspartoacylase (EC 3.5.1.15), also called aminoacylase-2, is an enzyme that hydrolyzes N-acetyl-L-aspartic acid (NAA) to aspartate and acetate.\" [PMID:8252036]"}

name: Reduced malonyl-CoA decarboxylase activity in cultured fibroblasts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of malonyl-CoA decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.9) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.\" [PMID:9869665]"}

name: Reduced tissue medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (EC 1.3.8.7;MCAD) in tissues is below the lower limit of normal.\" [PMID:2393404]"}

name: Reduced cystathionine beta-synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of cystathionine beta-synthase (EC 4.2.1.22) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.\" [PMID:5647845]"}

name: Reduced muscle glycogen phosphorylase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of the enzyme glycogen phosphorylase in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. Glycogen phosphorylase (EC 2.4.1.1) is also known as amylophosphorylase, muscle phosphorylase a and b, polyphosphorylase, and myophosphorylase.\" [PMID:21880526]"}

name: Reduced muscle 6-phosphofructokinase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of the enzyme 6-phosphofructokinase in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. 6-phosphofructokinase (EC 2.7.1.11) is also known as phosphofructokinase I and phosphohexokinase. The PFKM gene encodes the muscle isoform of phosphofructokinase. PFK catalyzes the irreversible conversion of fructose-6-phosphate to fructose-1,6-bisphosphate and is a key regulatory enzyme in glycolysis.\" [PMID:6227635]"}

name: Reduced tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.\" [PMID:12202988]"}

name: Reduced succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid-CoA transferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid-CoA transferase (SCOT, or OXCT1; EC 2.8.3.5) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.\" [PMID:11757586]"}

name: Blunted aldosterone response to aldosterone suppression test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A non-suppressible aldosterone excess, defined as an abnormal result of one of any four suppression tests. These tests use oral sodium loading, oral fludrocortisone, oral captopril, or saline infusion to suppress aldosterone secretion.\" [PMID:20482833]"}

name: Flank mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the flank, which is the fleshy part of the side of the body between the ribs and the hip.\" []"}

name: Synovial cyst
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A fluid-filled sac or pouch-like mass that is a distention of a preexisting bursa in a joint, tendon sheaths or bursae. Synovial cysts contain synovial fluid and are lined by synovial membrane.\" []"}

name: Brown pigmentation of the conjunctiva
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deposition of brown pigmentation in the conjunctiva.\" [PMID:15249376, PMID:20301627]"}

name: Gastrocnemius contracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Limitation of simultaneous ankle dorsiflexion and knee extension during mid-stance of gait.\" [PMID:22819670]"}

name: Central thinning of the outer nuclear layer of the retina
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduced thickness of the outer nuclear layer in the middle region of the retina. The outer nuclear layer (ONL) of the retina contains the nuclei of the cone and rod photoreceptors. Loss of the cellular machinery found in these nuclei causes irreparable loss of the photoreceptors and the capacity for visual function. This feature can be appreciated by directional optical coherence tomography.\" [PMID:25829348]"}

name: Sonographic renal salt and pepper pattern
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Heterogeneous, increased parenchymal echogenicity. This imaging appearance is caused by multiple tiny cysts smaller than or just approaching the size necessary for detection, which disrupt the echo pattern without being clearly distinguishable, and appear as white grains on renal ultrasound, mainly in a subcapsular location.\" [PMID:22034641, PMID:30599104]"}

name: Ductus venosus agenesis with intrahepatic drainage
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of ductus venosus agenesis in which the umbilical vein connects via the portal sinus to the portal venous system (PVS) without giving rise to the ductus venosus. In some cases an intrahepatic shunt from a portal to a hepatic vein can be detected prenatally. This variant has been reported to have a favorable prognosis.\" [PMID:28934814]"}

name: Ductus venosus agenesis with extrahepatic drainage and liver bypass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A form of ductus venosus agenesis in which umbilical vein does not connect to the portal venous system. The liver is bypassed and the umbilical vein drains into a systemic vein such as the inferior vena cava. This variant has been reported to have an unfavorable prognosis due to a presumed association with congestive heart failure and hydrops.\" [PMID:28934814]"}

name: Elevated circulating D-glyceric acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of D-gyceric acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated CSF D-glyceric acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of D-carboxylic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Ameliorated by riboflavin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingestion of riboflavin (Vitamin B2).\" []"}

name: Increased circulating interleukin 1beta concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An increased concentration of interleukin-1beta in the blood circulation.\" []"}

name: Reduced neutrophil myeloperoxidase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of myeloperoxidase (EC 1.11.1.7) as measured in neutrophils is below the limits of normal.\" [PMID:5796360]"}

name: Jugular foramen stenosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Reduction in diameter of the jugular foramen, an opening in the base of the skull that is located behind the carotid canal and is formed by the temporal bone and the occipital bone. The inferior petrosal sinus, three cranial nerves, the sigmoid sinus, and meningeal arteries pass through the jugular foramen.\" [PMID:17236138]"}

name: Intramural intestinal gas
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of extraluminal gas within the bowel wall.\" [PMID:25400871]"}

name: Delayed scintigraphic gallbladder filling
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hepatobiliary scintigraphy is a nuclear imaging technique that permits evaluation of the liver and biliary system for acute and chronic cholecystitis, biliary atresia, biliary obstruction, and post-surgical biliary leak. With this investigation, a radiotracer is administered intravenously, bound to albumin, transported to the liver, and excreted into the biliary system. This term refers to a longer than normal time for the radiotracer to be visualized in the gallbladder. This finding may be a sign of chronic gallbladder disease or partial obstruction of the common bile duct.\" [PMID:30855831]"}

name: Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pancreatic arteriovenous malformation is defined as an abnormal vascular net, developed from one or more feeding arteries and enlarged early draining veins, creating an arteriovenous shunting.\" [PMID:29904461]"}

name: Anti-perilipin-1 antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against perilipin-1 (PLIN1).\" [PMID:30283460, PMID:35709010, PMID:35771980, PMID:36538601]"}

name: Splenic calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the spleen.\" []"}

name: Short esophagus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal reduction in the length of the esophagus.\" [PMID:29262377]"}

name: Gastric perforation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A full-thickness injury of the wall of the stomach.\" [PMID:30137838]"}

name: Gastric volvulus
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A gastric volvulus occurs when the stomach rotates on itself at least 180 degrees along its transverse or longitudinal axis.\" [PMID:29939663]"}

name: Elevated circulating sCD163 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of sD163 (= soluble cluster of differentiation 163, = soluble CD163) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Positive cold agglutinin test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Cold agglutinin are erythrocyte antibodies which possess the property of agglutinating red blood cells at temperatures of below 37 degrees C, this phenomenon is reversible after heating.\" [PMID:34285751]"}

name: Anti-D-L antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of Donath-Landsteiner (D-L) autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum.\" [PMID:34433582]"}

name: Anti-erythrocyte autoantibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of an antibody in the blood circulation that is directed against an antigen on the surface of erythrocytes (red-blood cells).\" []"}

name: Non-glucose reducing substance in urine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal result for this screening test for urinary reducing substances including glucose, fructose, galactose, lactose, pentose and maltose, as well as amino acids, cysteine, tyrosine, homogentisic acid, ketone bodies, ascorbic acid and many drugs. name: Anti-annexin A5 antibody positivity

name: Bulging fontanelle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An outward curving of a fontanelle, which occurs when fluid builds up in the brain or the brain swells, causing increased pressure inside the skull.\" [PMID:12825844]"}

name: 3-4 toe cutaneous syndactyly
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the toes 3 and 4.\" [PMID:25251565]"}

name: Triangular nail

name: Distal tibiofibular synostosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Fusion of the distal (i.e.., located away from the trunk) part of the tibia and fibula.\" [PMID:27326275, PMID:27577507]"}

name: Abnormal metacarpal ossification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormal process of ossification of the metacarpal bones, which normally are each ossified from two centers: one for the body, and one for the head (metacarpal II,III,IV, and V) and one for the body and one for the base (metacarpal I). At the eighth to ninth week of fetal life, ossification commences in the middle of the body. At the third year the distal extremities of the metacarpals of the fingers and the base of the metacarpal of the thumb begin to ossify; they unite with the bodies at about the twentieth year.\" [PMID:12624140]"}

name: Rib spur
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A bony projection (spur, osteophyte) originating from a rib.\" [PMID:36388615]"}

name: Crescent-shaped iliac bone
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Deficient mineralization of the iliac wings, giving a paraglider/crescent shape to the iliac bone.\" [PMID:28744080]"}

name: Abnormal ischium ossification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of ischial bones.\" [PMID:9933334]"}

name: Femoral neck fracture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A partial or complete breakage of the neck of femur.\" [PMID:30726032]"}

name: Papillary dermis eosinophilic hyaline material
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of eosinophilic hyaline material observed around the papillary dermis and the blood vessels located in it. The papillary dermis is the uppermost layer of the dermis. It intertwines with the rete ridges of the epidermis and is composed of fine and loosely arranged collagen fibers.\" [PMID:26803878]"}

name: Pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm (IPMN) is an exocrine neoplasm of the pancreas consisting of epithelial cells growing within the pancreatic ducts (main pancreatic duct or its major branches) and producing mucin. IPMN is a mucin-producing pancreatic cystic tumor. IPMN contains epithelial cells that can create papillary projections.\" [PMID:35070031]"}

name: Medium vessel vasculitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects medium-sized blood vessels. By common usage, vasculitis predominantly refers to arterial disease. Medium-sized vasculitis is observed in diseases including polyarteritis nodosa, Kawasaki disease, and cutaneous polyarteritis nodosa.\" [PMID:19946711]"}

name: Elevated muscle fiber laminin alpha 5 expression
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A decreased amount of laminin alpha-5 in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue. Laminin subunit alpha-5 is a protein encoded by the LAMA5 gene.\" [PMID:21953594]"}

name: Paravertebral mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A swelling or enlargement localized next to the vertebral column. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.\" [PMID:30517335]"}

name: Phlebolith
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A calcified structure that forms within a vein. The pathogenesis of phleboliths is thought to involve an organized thrombus produced when the peripheral blood flow slows. The thrombus calcifies, form- ing the core of the phlebolith. Then, the fibrinous com- ponent undergoes secondary calcification and becomes attached. Repetition of this process causes enlargement of the phlebolith.\" [PMID:37981851]"}

name: Bladder rupture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A perforation in the wall of the urinary bladder. Bladder rupture, a relatively rare condition, is most commonly due to abdominal or pelvic trauma but may be spontaneous or iatrogenic in association with surgical or endoscopic procedures. In most cases, patients with bladder rupture have gross hematuria. Other symptoms of bladder rupture include pelvic pain, lower abdominal pain, and difficulty voiding.\" [PMID:29262195]"}

name: Elevated myocardial iron load
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Increased amount of iron in myocardial tissue.\" [PMID:16888797, PMID:28458697]"}

name: Right ventricular regional wall motion abnormality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The occurrence of abnormal or absent contractility of a region of the heart muscle of the right ventricule. Conventional assessment of RWMA is based on visual interpretation of endocardial excursion and myocardial thickening from the echocardiogram videos.\" [PMID:36700970]"}

name: Right ventricular regional akinesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A region of the right ventricle exhibits absent contraction (akinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle.\" [PMID:20172912]"}

name: Right ventricular regional dyskinesia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A region of the right ventricle exhibits abnormal contraction (dyskinesia) compared to the rest of the ventricle, leading to outward bulging or ballooning during contraction or inadequate inward movement.\" [PMID:20172912]"}

name: Right ventricular aneurysm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A localized, abnormal dilation or bulging of a portion of the right ventricular wall.\" [PMID:34256889]"}

name: Glomerular immune-complex deposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of immune deposits, containing immunoglobulins, complement, and other proteins, at various intraglomerular locations. This can lead to glomerulonephritis, with the type of injury that results being dependent on four factors: the mechanism of the deposit formation, the site of deposit formation, the composition of the deposits and the amount of the deposits.\" [PMID:16189625]"}

name: Glomerular PLA2R immune-complex deposition
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of immune deposits, containing auto-antibodies against the podocyte antigen M-type phospholipase A2 receptor (PLA2R) in intraglomerular locations.\" [PMID:21323563, PMID:25997506]"}

name: Elevated urinary L-glycerate level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of L-glycerate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:24116921]"}

name: Breast myxoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A rare, benign mesenchymal tumor of the breast characterized histologically by stellate, round, and spindle-shaped cells with vesicular nuclei and scant cytoplasm that are scattered in the myxoid stroma.\" [PMID:17214801]"}

name: Ovarian cystadenoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A common, benign ovarian tumor that carries a good prognosis. The two most frequent types of cystadenomas are serous and mucinous cystadenomas whereas endometrioid and clear cell cystadenomas are rare.\" [PMID:30725635]"}

name: Abnormal CSF N-acetylaspartic acid concentration

name: Anti-von Willebrand factor antibody positivity

name: Increased total natural killer cell count
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The absolute count of natural killer cells in the blood, per microlitre, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Myositis-specific autoantibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that display a high degree of specificity for idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (myositis-specific autoantibodies (MSAs)). Many of these are also associated with a unique clinical subset of PM/DM, making them useful in predicting and monitoring certain clinical manifestations.\" [PMID:26424665]"}

name: Abnormal serum osmolality
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any deviation from the normal range of the serum osmolality, defined as the sum of the osmolalities of every single dissolved particle in the blood such as sodium and associated anions, potassium, glucose, and urea.\" [PMID:35779183]"}

name: Low serum osmolality

name: High serum osmolality

name: History of compressive dressings

name: Triggered by overhead motions

name: Radiating pain
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pain that is perceived to extend or spread out from one area of the body to another.\" []"}

name: Mitral opening snap
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Opening snap is an additional sound heard in the diastole that is related to the opening of a stenotic but mobile mitral valve. name: Absent Bell phenomenon

name: Dalen-Fuchs nodules

name: Gelatinous drop-like dystrophic cornea

name: Hepatic reticuloendothelial system cell iron deposition

name: Reduced epidermal kindlin-1 expression

name: Central giant cell lesion of the jaw
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign proliferative and asymptomatic intraosseous lesion of the jaw formed by fibrous tissue that contains multiple focus of hemorrhage and an aggregation of multinucleated giant cells.\" [PMID:20301316, PMID:28316283, PMID:29988246]"}

name: Terminal hepatic lobular vascular occlusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of Hepatic venous outflow obstruction characterized by fibrous concentric narrowing of zone 3 terminal hepatic venules, centrilobular hepatocyte necrosis, and sinusoidal congestion, accomapnied by necrosis of pericentral hepatocytes, and narrowing and eventual fibrosis of central veins.\" [PMID:17461490, PMID:20301448]"}

name: Axonal spheroids

name: Reduced tissue guanidinoacetate methyltransferase activity

name: Salty tasting skin

name: Scalp nodule

name: History of undercooked pork ingestion

name: History of recent rodent exposure

name: Flexural reticulate hyperpigmentation

name: Gastric carcinoid tumor
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Originating from enterochromaffin-like cells, gastric carcinoid tumors are rare tumors that develop within the gastric mucosa. They can present as an isolated lesion or there can be multiple lesions. The tumor can invade locally into deeper structures of the gastrointestinal tract wall. Solitary gastric carcinoids have a greater chance for the development of malignancy and metastasis as compared to multiple gastric carcinoids due to hypergastrinemia.\" [PMID:21603501]"}

name: Positive skin scabies test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Identification of scabies by means of an examination of the skin such as microscopic identification of scabies mites, eggs, or feces from obtained scales by skin scraping.\" [PMID:37233429]"}

name: Positive mumps virus PCR test in the blood circulation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of nucleic acid of the mumps virus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) or reverse transcriptase (RT)-PCR.\" []"}

name: Positive bloodstream tuberculosis-induced T-cell-based interferon-gamma release assay
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in the bloodstream by means of detection of interferon-gamma secreted by T cells in response to specific antigens from Mycobacterium tuberculosis, commonly 6kD early secretory antigenic target-6 and 10kD culture filtrate protein-10.\" [PMID:28798488]"}

name: Positive blood Neisseria gonorrhoeae culture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Growth of Neisseria gonorrhoeae in a culture derived from circulating blood.\" []"}

name: Anti-mumps antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Mumps virus.\" []"}

name: Positive Vibrio cholerae stool culture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Growth of Vibrio cholerae in a culture derived from a feces sample.\" []"}

name: Positive cutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of mucocutaneous varicella zoster virus nucleic acid in the skin by a method such as polymerase chain reaction. The sample is usually obtained by swab from skin or mucous membranes.\" []"}

name: Positive bloodstream cryptococcus culture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Growth of Cryptococcus in a culture derived from a blood sample.\" []"}

name: Positive bloodstream Borrelia miyamotoi nucleic acid test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of nucleic acid of Borrelia miyamotoi in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).\" [PMID:29664394]"}

name: Positive bloodstream Coxsackievirus nucleic acid pathogen test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of nucleic acid of Coxsackievirus in the blood circulation by a method such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).\" []"}

name: Diminished tissue alpha-L-iduronidase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of alpha-L-iduronidase (IDUA; EC 3.2.1.76) below the lower limit of normal. FECH enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including cultured fibroblasts and leukocytes.\" [PMID:818611]"}

name: Reduced tissue neuraminidase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity of neuraminidase (EC 3.2.1.18)in tissues below the lower limit of normal. The activity can be measured in multiple tissues including culutured fibroblasts. Neuraminidase is also known as lysosomal sialidase.\" [PMID:610423]"}

name: Nummular keratitis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nummular keratitis consists of multiple scattered small round anterior corneal superficial stromal infiltrates.\" [PMID:34816054]"}

name: Swelling of inguinal region
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Bulging in the area of the lower abdomen, just above the thigh and near the groin.\" []"}

name: Single lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are solitary and localized to a part of the skin, a tissue or an organ that differs from the surrounding healthy tissue.\" []"}

name: Dysorthography
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A specific disorder of spelling. A score on a standardized spelling test is at least two standard errors of prediction below the level expected on the basis of the child's chronological age and general intelligence in the context of scores on reading accuracy and comprehension and on arithmetic that are within the normal range (within two standard deviations from the mean).\" [PMID:21348173]"}

name: Echogenic fetal colon
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of echogenic fetal bowel in which the hyperechogenicity is strictly limited to the colon.\" [PMID:17202504]"}

name: Bone marrow edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of excess fluid in the bone marrow.\" [PMID:35522786]"}

name: Transverse terminal upper limb defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the arm, e.g. humerus, proximal forearm, wrist or finger. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.\" [PMID:34263545]"}

name: Trousseau sign
extra_json: {"definition": "\"After inflating a blood pressure cuff from 10 mm Hg to 20 mm Hg over the patient's systolic blood pressure, the Trousseau sign is considered positive if carpal spasm develops, with flexion of the thumb and adduction of the finger within 3 minutes. However, this can be painful, so the time should be noted, and the cuff should be deflated once the test is positive.\" [PMID:28722928]"}

name: Craniocervical junction constriction
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Congenital or acquired abnormalities of the occipital bone, foramen magnum, or first two cervical vertebrae that decrease the space for the lower brain stem and cervical cord. These malformations can lead to cranial nerve compression, vertebral artery compression, and obstructive hydrocephalus.\" [PMID:1566672]"}

name: Fibular torsion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Excessively rotated (also called torsion) position of the fibula (calf bone). An increased external rotation of the fibula in the incisura tibiofibularis of more than 5 degrees may lead to an increased pressure and will negatively affect the cartilage.\" [PMID:24796832, PMID:9409794]"}

name: Abnormal finger phalanx ossification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Any abnormal process of ossification of the phalangeal bones, which normally are ossified from the body and proximal extremity. Ossification of the body commences during the eighth week of fetal development. Ossification of the proximal extremity commences in the bones between the third and fourth years.\" []"}

name: Positive bloodstream EBV monospot test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The monospot test is a latex agglutination test which utilizes equine erythrocytes as the primary substrate and tests for specific heterophile antibodies produced by the human immune system in response to EBV infection. When these specific antibodies are present in the patient's blood specimen, exposure to equine erythrocytes will lead to clumping of the sample, thus signaling a positive agglutination reaction.\" [PMID:30969561]"}

name: Positive CSF Toxoplasma gondii antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Toxoplasma gondii.\" []"}

name: Positive tuberculin skin test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A positive result of the tuberculin skin test suggesting previous expouse or infection with mycobacterium teberculosis. A standard dose of five tuberculin units (TU) (0.1ml) is injected intradermally (into the skin) and read 48 to 72 h later. A person who has been exposed to the bacteria is expected to mount an immune response in the skin containing the bacterial proteins. The volar aspect of the forearm is the preferred site of test. The basis of reading is the presence or absence of induration, which may be determined by inspection (from a side view against the light as well as by direct light) and by palpation. For standardization, the diameter of induration should be measured transversely to the long axis of the forearm and recorded in millimeters.\" []"}

name: Anti-Treponema pallidum antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that react against a component of Treponema pallidum.\" []"}

name: Positive CSF Borrelia burgdorferi antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of Borrelia burgdorferi.\" []"}

name: Positive CSF JC-virus antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) that react against a component of JC-virus (also known as JC-polyomavirus and John Cunningham virus).\" []"}

name: Neutralizing anti-rabies virus antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of antibodies in the blood circulation that act against the rabies virus function by blocking the binding of the glycoprotein to a receptor or preventing the membrane fusion process.\" [PMID:38075404]"}

name: Impaired hepatobiliary scintigraphy tracer uptake
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal reduction in the amount of radioactive tracer uptake upon hepatobiliary scintigraphy.\" [PMID:15347715]"}

name: Calcified pulmonary nodule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A pulmonary nodule with calcium deposits. On radiography, these nodules appear dense.\" [PMID:20582171]"}

name: Postprandial exacerbation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Applied to a sign or symptom that is more severe following a meal.\" []"}

name: Koebner Phenomenon
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The appearance of new skin lesions on previously unaffected skin secondary to trauma. This phenomenon is also termed the isomorphic (from Greek, equal shape) response, given the fact that the new lesions that appear are clinically and histologically identical to the patient's underlying cutaneous disease.\" [PMID:31971748]"}

name: Glenoid dysplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Glenoid dysplasia is a developmental anomaly of the scapula that is characterized by a bony deficiency of the posteroinferior glenoid and the adjacent scapular neck.\" [PMID:27055054]"}

name: Prolonged retraction of penile foreskin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A past medical history of recently having retracted the penile foreskin for a prolonged period of time. Paraphimosis commonly occurs iatrogenically, when the foreskin is retracted for cleaning, placement of a urinary catheter, a procedure such as a cystoscopy, or for penile examination. Failure to return the retracted foreskin over the glans promptly after the initial retraction can lead to paraphimosis.\" [PMID:29083645]"}

name: Thickened cortex of the clavicle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the clavicle.\" [PMID:24389367, PMID:24390061]"}

name: Thickened cortex of the mandible
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal thickening of the cortex of the mandible.\" [PMID:24389367, PMID:24390061]"}

name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 1
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Minor hypoplasia (developmental undergrowth) of the thumb, whereby all musculoskeletal and neurovascular components of the digit are present, just small in size (Blauth classification).\" [PMID:24362256]"}

name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 2
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby all of the osseous structures are present (may be small), and there is metacarpophalangeal joint ulnar collateral ligament instability and thenar hypoplasia.\" [PMID:24362256]"}

name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3A
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies with the carpometacarpal (CMC) joint intact. Absence of active motion at the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint.\" [PMID:24362256]"}

name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 3B
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb, whereby there are musculotendinous and osseous deficiencies characterized by basal metacarpal aplasia with deficient carpometacarpal (CMC) joint, and absence of metacarpophalangeal (MCP) or interphalangeal (IP) joint.\" [PMID:24362256]"}

name: Thumb hypoplasia grade 4
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A type of developmental undergrowth of the thumb characterized by attachment to the hand only by the skin and digital neurovascular structures.\" [PMID:24362256]"}

name: Femoral osteopoikilosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Multiple multiple, small, well-defined radiodense foci of cortical-like bone in the medullary space parallel to the trabeculae located in the femur. The loci correspond to condensations of the lamellar trabeculae on histology.\" [PMID:30430046]"}

name: Carotidynia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Pain or tenderness in the region of the carotid artery.\" [PMID:32809676, PMID:38522944]"}

name: Asymmetric blood pressure between arms
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A substantial difference in blood pressure (e.g., 20 mmHg) between the right and left arms.\" [PMID:36351705, PMID:37525862]"}

name: Transverse terminal lower limb defect
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A congenital anomaly that appears as an amputation at different levels of the leg, e.g. femur, foreleg, ankle or toe. The limb is missing the terminal (distal) segment(s), with preservation of all the segment(s) proximal to the missing segment.\" [PMID:34263545]"}

name: Hemimelia of lower leg
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the lower leg (eg tibia and fibula), ankle and foot.\" [PMID:26172360]"}

name: Hemimelia of forearm
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect leading to a transverse deficiency with absence of the forearm (eg ulna and radius), wrist and hand.\" [PMID:32954639]"}

name: Sodium glucose transport inhibitor exposure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"History of having been treateed with a sodium glucose transport inhibitors such as dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, canagliflozin, sglt-i, SGLT2, bexagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin, jardiance, invokana, forxiga, brenzavvy, steglatro, inpefa.\" []"}

name: Breath-holding spell
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A benign paroxysmal nonepileptic disorder occurring in healthy children 6 to 48 months of age. The episodes start with a provocation such as emotional upset or minor injury, and might progress to breath holding, cyanosis, and syncope.\" [PMID:1736640]"}

name: Flared proximal tibial metaphysis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of a splayed (i.e.,flared) metaphyseal segment of the proximal tibia.\" []"}

name: Delayed toe phalanx ossification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Delayed maturation and calcification of any of the toe phalanges.\" [PMID:23401428, PMID:33364240]"}

name: Sorbitol ingestion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A history of ingestion of a relatively high amount of foods containing sorbitol.\" []"}

name: Positive peritoneal fluid bacterial culture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Growth of bacteria in a culture dervied from ascites fluid.\" []"}

name: Corneal cystine crystals
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Accumulation of cystine crystals in the cornea. The crystals, which have a fine, uniform needle-shaped structure, are diffusely distributed within the corneal tissues.\" [PMID:30242621]"}

name: Exuberant granulation tissue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A manifestation of abnormal wound healing in which there is formation of excessive granulation tissue, with the granulation tissue rising above the level of surrounding skin and creating a raised, reddish, moist, and bumpy surface.\" [PMID:28492007]"}

name: Oral mucosal papule
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A small (less than 5 mm in diameter), elevated, circumscribed, solid, palpable mass located in thte mucosa of the oral cavity.\" []"}

name: Excessive piloerection
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally increased degree of goose bump formation, that is, of involuntary formation of bumps on a person's skin at the base of body hairs.\" [PMID:30252268]"}

name: Scalp edema
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A palpable swelling in the scalp caused by an increase in interstitial fluid volume (excess fluid).\" []"}

name: Serpiginous burrow
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A slightly raised and often reddish serpentine or curvilinear path in the skin.\" [PMID:34615594]"}

name: Positive brain-tissue rabies nucleic acid test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of rabies nucleic acid in brain tissue by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.\" []"}

name: Positive respiratory tract Bordetella pertussis nucleic acid test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Detection of Bordetella pertussis PCR nucleic acid in in nasopharyngeal secretions by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.\" []"}

name: Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli in wound tissue
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Demonstration of acid-fast bacilli by microscopic examination of wound tissue. Acid fastness is a physical property that gives a bacterium the ability to resist decolorization by acids during staining procedures.\" [PMID:30725806]"}

name: Positive tissue encapsulated budding yeast test
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Identification of encapsulated budding yeasts in smears of body fluids, secretions, exudates, or other specimens.\" []"}

name: Positive tissue coccidioidomycosis culture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Growth of coccidioidomycosis in a culture derived from skin or an organ.\" []"}

name: Diminished tissue dihydropteridine reductase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of dihydropteridine reductase (EC 1.6.99.7) below the lower limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and erythrocytes.\" [PMID:7627180]"}

name: Decreased circulating transcobalamin-1 concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of transcobalamin-1 in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Decreased circulating cationic trypsinogen concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of cationic trypsinogen in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Diminished circulating hyaluronidase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The activity or concentration of hyaluronidase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.\" [PMID:8793927]"}

name: Diminished sulfotransferase activity in cultured fibroblasts
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Rate of proteoglycan sulfation (sulfotransferase activity) is below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.\" [PMID:18513679]"}

name: Elevated tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) above the upper limit of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.\" [PMID:30046013]"}

name: Abnormal tissue alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration or activity of alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase (EC 3.2.1.50) outside of the limits of normal. This enzyme can be measured in multiple tissues including leukocytes and cultured fibroblasts. It is also known as alpha-acetylglucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminidase, N-acetyl-alpha-glucosaminidase, and alpha-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucosidase.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating trihydroxycholestanoic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of trihydroxycholestanoic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated circulating glyoxylic acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The concentration of glyoxylic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated CSF sepiapterin concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of sepiapterin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:18502672]"}

name: Intrahepatic inclusion bodies
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within hepatocytes.\" []"}

name: Muscle vacuoles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. The vacuoles are often associated with cytoplasmic and occasionally intranuclear eosinophilic inclusions.\" []"}

name: Nonrimmed muscle vacuoles
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Presence of abnormal vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles) in the sarcolemma. On histological staining with hematoxylin and eosin, non-rimmed vacuoles lack the prominent dark border (rim) seen in rimmed vacuoles.\" []"}

name: Reduced hepatic glycogen phosphorylase activity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Activity or concentration of glycogen phosphorylase L in the liver below the lower limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Bone marrow hemophagocytosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the bone marrow.\" []"}

name: Splenic granulomatosis
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Splenic inflammation involving a granulomatous response, i.e., a non-specific inflammatory response involving granulomas, defined as a compact organized collection of mature mononuclear phagocytes including epithelioid and giant cells.\" []"}

name: Immediate detumescence of penis at time of symptom onset
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Loss of erection at the time point of pain or other symptom onset.\" []"}

name: History of aortic valve replacement
extra_json: {"definition": "\"History of having received a surgical replacement of the aortic valve.\" [PMID:31354937]"}

name: Coved type ST segment elevation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An ST-segment elevation of at least 2 mm in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by an r'-wave and a concave or straight ST segment. The descending ST segment crosses the isoelectric line and is followed by a negative and symmetric T-wave.\" [PMID:30139433]"}

name: Saddle-back type ST segment elevation
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An ST-segment elevation of at least 0.5 mm (generally at least 2 mm in V2) in at least one right precordial lead (V1 to V3), followed by a convex ST. The r'-wave may or may not overlap the J point, but it has a slow downward slope. The ST segment is followed by a positive T-wave in V2 and is of variable morphology in V1.\" [PMID:30139433]"}

name: Substantially elevated circulating ethanol concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A blood concentration of ethanol that is consistent with alcohol intoxication, generally assumed to be 0.0800 g/dL or higher.\" [PMID:33209539]"}

name: Tortuous appearance of the stomach
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal twisting or winding of the stomach.\" []"}

name: Cochlear nerve aplasia
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A developmental defect causing an absence of the cochlear nerve resulting in sensorineural hearing loss.\" [PMID:37591623]"}

name: Slit-like lateral ventricle
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormally small lateral ventricle with a slit-like appearance.\" [PMID:38054405]"}

name: Fetal methamphetamine exposure
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A history of exposure during pregnancy (including during the period of conception) of the mother of a fetus or child to methamphetamine.\" [PMID:26212684]"}

name: Elevated circulating 4-hydroxybutyric acid concentration
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Concentration of 4-hydroxybutyric acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:9683595]"}

name: Elevated urinary 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of 2,4-dihydroxybutyric acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Pupillary hypersensitivity to parasympathomimetic agents
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A higher than normal tendency of parasympathomimetic agents to induce miosis.\" [PMID:16754691, PMID:20301359]"}

name: Lack of pupillary response to hydroxyamphetamine
extra_json: {"definition": "\"4-hydroxyamphetamine is used in eye drops to dilate the pupil, e.g.., to induce mydriasis for fundus examinations. This term refers to a lack of response of the pupil to topical application of 4-hydroxyamphetamine.\" [PMID:20301647]"}

name: Subcortical U fiber lesion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal morphology of subcortical U fibers, typically as assessed by abnromal intensity on magnetic resonance imaging of the brain.\" [PMID:38223048]"}

name: Intraspinal extradural lipoma
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A lipoma (a benign encapsulated mass with lobulated mature adipose tissue enclosed by fibrous tissue) located within the spine but outside of the dura mater.\" [PMID:30488010]"}

name: Intranasal mass
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the nasal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.\" []"}

name: Liver rupture
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Subcapsular hepatic rupture is characterized by the development of a hematoma, often quite large, beneath the liver capsule. An interval of days or hours may elapse between the time of injury and the first appearance of symptoms. A history of injury may be entirely lacking, or may be so unremarkable that it is elicited only by diligent interrogation. The hematoma tends to increase in size.\" [PMID:13915569]"}

name: Elevated urinary mandelic acid
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of mandelic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine malic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of malic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine 3-hydroxysebacic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of 3-hydroxysebacic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urinary vanillactic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of vanillactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of 4,5-dihydroxyhexanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" []"}

name: Elevated urine hydroxyphenyllactic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of hydroxyphenyllactic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:4720815]"}

name: Positive gastric CMV intranuclear inclusions
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Demonstration of the presence of cytomegalovirus in the stomach by means of a method such as in-situ hybridization.\" [PMID:24010116]"}

name: Elevated urine dihydroxycholestanoic acid level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of dihydroxycholestanoic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:27647924]"}

name: Elevated urinary bile alcohol level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of bile alcohol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:20301583]"}

name: Elevated urine glucose tetrasaccharide level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of glucose tetrasaccharide in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:20301438]"}

name: Increased urine 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate level
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The amount of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.\" [PMID:26401545]"}

name: Inability to protrude lips
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Lack of ability to purse or pucker the lips.\" [PMID:30804066]"}

name: Wet voice
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Wet voice is a perceptual vocal quality that is gurgly or liquid sounding and is due to the voice being produced through moisture. It is commonly used as an indicator of penetration and/or aspiration in clinical swallowing assessments and bedside screening tests.\" [PMID:25001523]"}

name: Erythema marginatum
extra_json: {"definition": "\"An erythematous (pink-red, depending on the skin color of the affected individual) macule that spreads peripherally and coalesces to form polycyclic or serpentine patches or plaques. Lesions occur in crops over days to weeks and are evanescent. The rate of migration is 2 to 12 mm over a period of a few hours. Erythema marginatum tends to affect the trunk more than the extremities and to not be accompanied by pruritus.\" [PMID:32491767]"}

name: Mechanic's hands
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Mechanic's hands are fissured, erythematous, hyperkeratotic eruptions on the hands, resembling the type of occupational dermatosis said to resemble the hands of a manual laborer. The lesions are classically on the lateral edges of the fingers and thumbs, largely sparing the palmar, and dorsal aspects of the digits.\" [PMID:32284267, PMID:36186825]"}

name: Hiker's feet
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Hyperkeratotic scaly fissured plaques on the fingers/palms or soles, generally more evident on the lateral aspect of index fingers.\" [PMID:32284267, PMID:35382516]"}

name: Anti-HLA-DQ antibody positivity
extra_json: {"definition": "\"The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen (HLA-DQ). DQ is one of several antigens involved in antibody-mediated rejection of organ transplants.\" [PMID:23260706]"}

name: Inappropriate normal or low erythropoietin
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Erythropoietin is produced and released into the blood by the kidneys in response to hypoxemia, and would normally be expected to increase with decreasing hemoglobin levels. This term applies if the increase fails to occur, as may be seen in conditions including chronic kidney disease.\" [PMID:32311841]"}

name: Rapid gastric emptying
extra_json: {"definition": "\"A condition in which food moves through the stomach into the small intestine at an abnormally fast rate.\" [PMID:16207692]"}

name: Mediastinal lymph node calcification
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal deposition of calcium in mediastinal lymph nodes.\" [PMID:29791561]"}

name: Eggshell calcification of lymph nodes
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Eggshell calcification refers to fine calcification seen at the periphery of a mass and usually relates to lamellar lymph node calcification.\" [PMID:29791561, PMID:6779537]"}

name: Knee joint effusion
extra_json: {"definition": "\"Abnormal accumulation of fluid within the knee joint or around the knee. Symptoms maye include, pain, swelling, and stiffness.\" [PMID:31575400]"}

name: Subcutaneous emphysema
